**Location: Bangalore/Mumbai**

**Grade:** **E1/E2**

* Account(s) Delivery \& Leadership
	+ Manage a) SAP S/4 Large transformation Program (s) like Greenfield implementation, b) Brownfield \| Bluefield S/4 conversions. (c) Global S/4 Roll Outs.

	+

**Our Ideal** **Candidate**  



* Must have managed global SAP Transformation Programs, ideally in S/4\. Should have managed the program end to end.

a895a8ef.description:
We are the leading provider of professional services to the middle market globally, our purpose is to instill confidence in a world of change, empowering our clients and people to realize their full potential. Our exceptional people are the key to our unrivaled, inclusive culture and talent experience and our ability to be compelling to our clients. You’ll find an environment that inspires and empowers you to thrive both personally and professionally. There’s no one like you and that’s why there’s nowhere like RSM.
   

  

**Overview**
 RSM US Integrated Services India Private Limited supports RSM US LLP’s Risk Consulting, Transaction Advisory, Technical Accounting, Financial Consulting, Technology and Management Consulting, Tax, and Assurance practices by providing access to highly skilled professionals for scalable and repeatable business processes across an extended business day. USI is a member of RSM International, the sixth largest global network of independent accounting, tax, and consulting firms.
   

  

**Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement – Functional Manager**
 RSM’s Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement (Dynamics 365 CE) practice is a team of highly specialized, multi\-disciplinary professionals delivering innovative Microsoft business application solutions for global clients.
   

  

 RSM is seeking a
 **Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement (CE) Functional Manager** 
 who blends deep, hands\-on configuration and customization experience with the leadership skills to run multiple concurrent engagements. The ideal candidate brings end\-to\-end mastery of the Dynamics 365 CE suite and the Microsoft Power Platform, sound solution architecture judgment, strong client presence, and a passion for growing the next generation of consultants. This role is a true player–coach: you will partner directly with US\-based leaders, shape solutions on the whiteboard, and actively mentor and coach a team of Supervisors, Senior Associates, and Associates.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Hands\-on configuration, customization, and implementation experience of Microsoft Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement applications and the Power Platform to meet complex client business needs
* Translate complex business problems into clear functional specifications, solution designs, and architecture recommendations across CE, integrations, and the broader Microsoft cloud
* Own functional and architectural integrity across all phases of the project lifecycle — discovery, design, build, test, deployment, and post\-go\-live support
* Lead and oversee multiple concurrent Dynamics 365 CE engagements, owning delivery quality, risk, and outcomes across a portfolio of projects
* Serve as a trusted advisor to US\-based engagement leaders and client stakeholders, managing priorities, timelines, escalations, and deliverables across time zones
* Facilitate design reviews, demos, and solution walkthroughs with confidence and clarity
* Review and quality\-assure work products — including configuration, customization, testing, and documentation
* Direct data migration, integrations, security model design, and ALM strategy (solutions, pipelines, managed environments) across engagements
* Coach, mentor, and develop junior talent across the team; provide performance feedback, career guidance, and hands\-on knowledge transfer
* Support post\-go\-live activities including hypercare, enhancements, governance, and continuous improvement
* Champion delivery excellence, documentation standards, and a great client experience on every engagement


**Required Qualifications**
- 10\+ years of hands\-on functional experience implementing Microsoft Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement

- Demonstrated experience leading multiple concurrent Dynamics 365 CE projects to successful delivery in a consulting environment

- Strong, hands\-on configuration and customization expertise across the Dynamics 365 CE suite, including:

* Customer Service
* Contact Center / Omnichannel
* Sales
* Customer Insights – Journeys
* Field Service
* Project Operations


- Hands\-on experience with the Microsoft Power Platform, including:

* Power Automate
* Power Pages
* Copilot Studio
* Power BI
* Power Apps
* Proven solution design and architecture experience across CE, integrations, and surrounding Microsoft cloud services
* Strong business process mapping and requirements analysis skills across various Dynamics 365 CE apps
* Experience with environment and ALM management (solutions, pipelines, managed environments)
* Demonstrated ability to mentor, coach, and develop junior consultants and grow high\-performing teams
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with strong executive presence
* Experience working in global delivery models and collaborating with onshore/offshore stakeholders
* Proven ability to manage competing priorities, navigate ambiguity, and consistently meet delivery commitments


**Certifications (Strongly Preferred)**
* Microsoft Dynamics 365 certification(s)
* Power Platform certification(s)
* Actively pursuing and maintaining Microsoft certifications is highly encouraged and supported


 At RSM, we offer a competitive benefits and compensation package for all our people. We offer flexibility in your schedule, empowering you to balance life’s demands, while also maintaining your ability to serve clients. Learn more about our total rewards at https://rsmus.com/careers/india.html.

d0be5260.description:
Senior Cloud Developer  



This role has been designed as ‘’Onsite’ with an expectation that you will primarily work from an HPE office.**Who We Are:**


Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge\-to\-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.

**Job Description:**

  



In the HPE **Hybrid Cloud**, we lead the innovation agenda and technology roadmap for all of HPE. This includes managing the design, development, and product portfolio of our next\-generation cloud platform, Green Lake. Working with customers, we help them reimagine their information technology needs to deliver a simple, consumable solution that helps them drive their business results. Join us redefine what’s next for you.

 ***Job Family Definition:***


The Cloud Developer builds from the ground up to meet the needs of mission\-critical applications, and is always looking for innovative approaches to deliver end\-to\-end technical solutions to solve customer problems.  

  

Brings technical thinking to break down complex data and to engineer new ideas and methods for solving, prototyping, designing, and implementing cloud\-based solutions.  

  

Collaborates with project managers and development partners to ensure effective and efficient delivery, deployment, operation, monitoring, and support of Cloud engagements.  

  

The Cloud Developer provides business value expertise to drive the development of innovative service offerings that enrich HPE's Cloud Services portfolio across multiple systems, platforms, and applications.

***Management Level Definition:***


Contributions impact technical components of HPE products, solutions, or services regularly and sustainable. Applies advanced subject matter knowledge to solve complex business issues and is regarded as a subject matter expert. Provides expertise and partnership to functional and technical project teams and may participate in cross\-functional initiatives. Exercises significant independent judgment to determine best method for achieving objectives. May provide team leadership and mentoring to others.

 **What you will do:**

***Responsibilities:***

* Leads the project team for design and development of complex products and platforms, including solution design, analysis, coding, testing, and integration for building efficient, scalable and robust cloud subsystems.
* Reviews and evaluates designs, test plans, and develops code for compliance with cloud design and development guidelines and standards.
* Provides tangible feedback to improve product quality and mitigate risks.
* Represents the engineering team in various technical forums and provides guidance and mentoring to less\-experienced team members.
* Drives innovation and integration of new technologies into projects and activities in the software systems design organization.
* Analyzes science, engineering, business, and other data processing problems to develop and implement solutions to complex application problems, system administration issues, or network concerns.

 **What you will need to bring:**

 ***Education and Experience Required:***

* Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, engineering, information systems, or closely related quantitative discipline.
* Typically, 7\-10 years’ experience.

***Knowledge and Skills:***

* Strong JAVA/C\+\+/Golang programming skills
* Expertise in File Systems, Networking, or Distributed storage/compute systems
* Good debugging and problem\-solving skills
* Communication skills and the ability to work independently
* Through knowledge of the Linux/UNIX and Kubernete environment
* Must have proficiency with data structures, algorithms and multi\-threaded programming
* Must have in\-depth knowledge of OS internals and storage concepts.
* Understanding microservice architecture and how they can be built in a containerized, Kubernetes\-managed environment is central to all modern cloud\-native applications.
* Designing and integrating software systems running on multiple platform types into the overall architecture.
* Evaluating forms and processes for software systems testing and methodology, including writing and executing test plans, debugging, and testing scripts and tools.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Ability to effectively communicate product architectures and design proposals at senior management levels.

**Accessibility**

  

HPE is committed to creating an inclusive and accessible workplace and encourages applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities. If you believe you require accommodation during any stage of the application or interview process, please submit your request by completing our secure form linked here.

  

Note: This option is reserved for applicants needing assistance/reasonable accommodation related to a disability.

**What We Can Offer You:**

**Health \& Wellbeing**


We strive to provide our team members and their loved ones with a comprehensive suite of benefits that supports their physical, financial and emotional wellbeing.

**Personal \& Professional Development**


We also invest in your career because the better you are, the better we all are. We have specific programs catered to helping you reach any career goals you have — whether you want to become a knowledge expert in your field or apply your skills to another division.

**Unconditional Inclusion**


We are unconditionally inclusive in the way we work and celebrate individual uniqueness. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good.

**Let's Stay Connected:**


Follow @HPECareers on Instagram to see the latest on people, culture and tech at HPE.

9fe443d6.title: Principal Program Manager
9fe443d6.description:
**Description**
 Synaptics is leading the charge in AI at the Edge, bringing AI closer to end users and transforming how we engage with intelligent connected devices, whether at home, at work, or on the move. As the go\-to partner for the world’s most forward\-thinking product innovators, Synaptics powers the future with its cutting\-edge Synaptics Astra™ AI\-Native embedded compute, Veros™ wireless connectivity, and multimodal sensing solutions. We’re making the digital experience smarter, faster, more intuitive, secure, and seamless. From touch, display, and biometrics to AI\-driven wireless connectivity, video, vision, audio, speech, and security processing, Synaptics is the force behind the next generation of technology enhancing how we live, work, and play.
   

  

**Overview**
 Synaptics is looking for a Principal Program Manager to join our Global Operations team. The ideal candidate will have a strong technical background in semiconductor design and manufacturing processes, coupled with exceptional program management skills. As the ASIC Program Manager, you will oversee the entire product lifecycle from concept through production, working closely with cross\-functional teams including design, verification, validation, and manufacturing to ensure timely delivery of high\-quality ASICs. The successful candidate will play a key project leadership role, acting as the primary owner of SOC program execution on the project planning scheduling, inter\-team coordination, status tracking and reporting. Sr. Director, Program Management.
   

  

**Responsibilities \& Competencies**
 Job Duties
   

  

* Own end\-to\-end program management of engineering programs from idea to mass production including planning, scoping, design, development, and change management
* Lead and coordinate all aspects of ASIC development programs from requirements gathering through to final product release, including design, verification, validation, and production rampup
* Work closely with internal engineering teams (ASIC design, firmware, validation, etc.), external partners, and vendors to manage deliverables and ensure alignment on project goals and schedules
* Support the teams in issue resolution and risk mitigation through well balanced and efficient processes leveraging tools and automation
* Actively support sustainable, effective cross\-functional communication at multiple levels in the organization
* Analyze technical issues and lead the team in generating creative mitigation options and solutions
* Act as the primary point of contact between engineering, product management, and senior leadership, providing regular status updates on program progress, issues, and risk management
* Monitor and manage the program budget, ensuring projects are delivered within financial constraints
* Manage relationships with operation team and external ASIC vendors, ensuring that they meet technical and delivery requirements
* Ensure proper documentation of program processes, designs, and decisions throughout the ASIC development lifecycle
* Drive continuous improvement of all processes, methodologies, and systems


 Competencies
   

  

* Well organized with strong attention to data and detail; proactively ensures work is accurate
* Ability to ask difficult but important questions and drive discussion to find answers
* Ability to influence horizontally across multiple internal functional organizations
* Developing talent, ability to inspire and excite team
* Highly structured planner with a strong discipline towards pragmatic and efficient processes
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with expertise in agile execution and facilitating multiple projects simultaneously
* Ability to synthesize and report complex matters simply for senior and executive management to grasp quickly
* Good verbal and written communication skills with the ability to work within a diverse team


**Qualifications (Requirements)**
* Bachelor's (Master’s preferred) in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field or equivalent
* A deep understanding of ASIC design, verification, and manufacturing processes is essential.
* 15\+ years of experience in Program Management, including 5\+ years of expertise in engineering program management Experience in rigorous life\-cycle management including capturing requirements, decomposition, architecture, design, unit testing and integration testing among others
* Proven expertise in planning tools and methodologies (Jira, MS Project / SCRUM, waterfall)
* Hands\-on technical experience preferred
* No travel required


*Belief in Diversity
   

  

 Synaptics is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to workforce diversity. Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, color, age, religion, protected veteran or disability status, or genetic information.*

4a131d6d.title: Edtech Program Manager
4a131d6d.description:
**Company Description** 
 Skillofy\_AI is a next\-generation edtech company focused on empowering learners with technical and non\-technical skills needed to succeed in a rapidly evolving digital world. The company delivers hands\-on, industry\-driven programs for students, working professionals, and organizations through live, mentor\-led sessions and practical, project\-based learning. Skillofy\_AI offers a wide range of tech programs in AI, system design, full stack development, and engineering, alongside non\-tech programs in program management, product management, and professional skills. In addition to education, Skillofy\_AI builds AI\-powered solutions for businesses and supports career transformation through structured learning paths, mentorship, and real\-world exposure. Its mission is to bridge the gap between learning and real\-world application and become a global hub for talent development and innovation powered by AI.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Edtech Program Manager at Skillofy\_AI is a full\-time, remote role responsible for end\-to\-end ownership of learning programs across tech and non\-tech domains. In this role, the Program Manager designs and structures curricula, coordinates live mentor\-led sessions, and ensures that program content is aligned with industry needs and learner outcomes. Day\-to\-day tasks include managing program timelines, collaborating with instructors and subject\-matter experts, tracking learner progress, and implementing feedback to continuously improve course quality. The Program Manager also oversees learner communication, supports onboarding and engagement, and partners with operations, marketing, and product teams to drive enrollment, retention, and successful career transitions for participants. This role requires strong program execution, data\-driven decision making, and a learner\-centric mindset.
   

**Qualifications**
  

* Program and project management skills, including planning, scheduling, stakeholder coordination, and risk management.
* Experience in curriculum design, instructional planning, and learning experience optimization for online or blended programs.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to engage mentors, instructors, and diverse learner groups.
* Data analysis and reporting abilities to track learner outcomes, program performance, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Familiarity with edtech platforms, LMS tools, and remote collaboration technologies.
* Understanding of both tech and non\-tech career paths; exposure to AI, software development, or product/program management is a plus.
* Bachelor’s degree in Education, Business, Engineering, Management, or a related field; advanced certifications in program or project management are beneficial.
* Demonstrated ability to work independently in a remote setting, with a focus on accountability, organization, and results.

 \|
 **Introduction**
 Exclusive Networks is the global cybersecurity go\-to\-market specialist that provides partners and end\-customers with a wide range of services and product portfolios. With offices in over 45 countries and the ability to serve customers in over 170 countries, we combine deep local expertise with the scale and delivery of a single global organization.
   

  

 Our best\-in\-class vendor portfolio is carefully curated with all leading industry players. Our services range from managed security to specialist technical accreditation and training and capitalize on rapidly evolving technologies and changing business models. For more information visit www.exclusive\-networks.com.
   

  

 At Exclusive Networks, we are passionate about making a difference. That means delivering the best to our ecosystem, shaping a prosperous and trusted digital world, and helping our people to realize their full potential.
   

  

**DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES** 
 \|
 **About the role**
 This role will report to the Senior Solution Engineer
   

  

**As The Senior Solution Engineer , You Will**
* Handle F5 pre\-sales activities, including customer meetings, technical presentations and solution demonstrations.
* Understand customer requirements and design appropriate F5 solutions.
* Conduct POCs, technical workshops and solution validation.
* Prepare HLD/LLD, BOM, technical proposals and RFP/RFI responses.
* Provide technical expertise on F5 BIG\-IP LTM, WAF, DNS, APM, AFM and Distributed Cloud solutions.
* Support F5 implementation, configuration, migration, integration and troubleshooting
* Work on application delivery, load balancing, SSL/TLS, high availability and traffic management requirements.
* Support F5 upgrades, migrations and performance optimization.
* Coordinate with F5 OEM, sales, partners and customer technical teams for technical discussions and escalations.
* Provide customer training and knowledge\-transfer sessions.
* Identify opportunities for F5 Professional Services, implementation, migration and managed services. 1


**QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE** 
 \|
 **About you**
**The Ideal Senior Solution Engineer**
* Qualification achelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
* 3\-6 years of experience in network security, application delivery, or cybersecurity solutions.
* Strong hands\-on knowledge of F5 BIG\-IP technologies.
* Experience with F5 BIG\-IP LTM, DNS, Advanced WAF, APM and AFM is preferred.
* Good understanding of TCP/IP, routing, switching, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, SSL/TLS and network security.
* Experience in F5 pre\-sales, POC, solution design, implementation and troubleshooting.
* Knowledge of load balancing, application delivery, high availability and traffic management.
* Experience working with enterprise and multi\-vendor network environments.
* Exposure to F5 migration, upgrades, performance tuning and integration.
* Good customer\-facing, communication and technical presentation skills.
* Ability to prepare HLD/LLD, BOM, technical proposals and RFP/RFI responses.
* F5 certification such as F5\-CA or F5\-CTS is an added advantage.
* Experience with F5 Distributed Cloud, automation/API and cloud environments will be an added advantage. 1


**WHO ARE EXCLUSIVE NETWORKS?** 
 \|
 **Why work for us**
 We are people focused and strongly believe that talent empowers us to continue our dynasty of disruption and growth in the future. Our Mission is to drive the transition to a totally trusted digital world for all people and organizations. Visit our website www.exclusive\-networks.com.
   

  

 We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to the recruitment and hiring of individuals from diverse backgrounds and experiences, as we believe this strengthens our ability to develop superior solutions, make informed decisions, and better serve our valued customers. We do not discriminate against individuals on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, disability status, or any similar characteristic. Employment decisions are made solely on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need. Please click here to review our Diversity and Inclusion Policy for further information.
   

  

 We care about your data: please click here to read our Recruitment Data Protection Policy prior to applying, and therefore sharing your data with us.

23581e4a.title: Associate Manager - Digital Strategy & Solutions
23581e4a.description:
We are a technology\-led healthcare solutions provider. We are driven by our purpose to enable healthcare organizations to be future\-ready. We offer accelerated, global growth opportunities for talent that’s bold, industrious, and nimble. With Indegene, you gain a unique career experience that celebrates entrepreneurship and is guided by passion, innovation, collaboration, and empathy. To explore exciting opportunities at the convergence of healthcare and technology, check out www.careers.indegene.com
 



  





 Looking to jump\-start your career?
 



  





 We understand how important the first few years of your career are, which create the foundation of your entire professional journey. At Indegene, we promise you a differentiated career experience. You will not only work at the exciting intersection of healthcare and technology but also will be mentored by some of the most brilliant minds in the industry. We are offering a global fast\-track career where you can grow along with Indegene’s high\-speed growth.
 



  





 We are purpose\-driven. We enable healthcare organizations to be future ready and our customer obsession is our driving force. We ensure that our customers achieve what they truly want. We are bold in our actions, nimble in our decision\-making, and industrious in the way we work.
 



  





 If this excites you, then apply below.
 



  





 About Indegene
 



  





 We are a technology\-led healthcare solutions provider driven by our purpose to enable healthcare organizations to become future\-ready. At Indegene, you will work at the intersection of healthcare, technology and innovation, while gaining exposure to global clients, experienced industry leaders and high\-impact transformation programs.
 



 We value entrepreneurship, collaboration, empathy and continuous learning. If this excites you, apply below.
 



  





 Role Description
 



  





 We are seeking an AM/Manager – Digital Strategy and Solutions to lead
 **strategic solutioning, solution packaging, executive storytelling and digital transformation initiatives** 
 for life sciences clients.
 



 The role will work across business, technology, operations and commercial teams to convert client needs into
 **clear, scalable and commercially viable solutions** 
 . The individual will support proposals, RFPs, client workshops, capability development, pilots and strategic transformation programs.
 



 The role requires the ability to move from an early\-stage idea to a
 **well\-structured solution, compelling client narrative and implementation roadmap** 
 .
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 



  





 Strategy and Solutioning
 



  




* Lead the design and execution of strategic digital transformation initiatives.
* Translate business challenges into scalable digital solutions and operating models.
* **Structure ambiguous client requirements into clear use cases, workflows, capabilities and roadmaps.**
* **Recommend suitable solution approaches based on client maturity, existing technology and transformation readiness.**
* Identify operational gaps and define opportunities for process improvement, automation and AI adoption.



  





 Solution Packaging and Commercialization
 



  




* Develop solution frameworks for proposals, RFPs and client engagements.
* **Package capabilities, platforms, accelerators and delivery experience into repeatable offerings.**
* **Define the solution scope, value proposition, differentiators, outcomes and delivery approach.**
* **Work with pricing, delivery and finance teams to ensure solutions are commercially practical.**
* **Create reusable assets such as playbooks, assessment frameworks, use\-case libraries and reference architectures.**



  





 Storytelling and Client Engagement
 



  




* **Develop executive\-ready narratives for client pitches, proposals, analyst briefings and capability presentations.**
* **Convert complex business and technology concepts into clear and easy\-to\-understand stories.**
* **Partner with design teams to create simple, visual and impactful presentations.**
* Support client workshops, presentation preparation and leadership discussions.
* **Prepare talking points, scripts and responses for strategic client meetings and oral presentations.**



  





 Proposals and GTM Support
 



  




* Lead or support RFPs, RFIs, proactive proposals and strategic pursuits.
* **Bring together inputs from domain, technology, delivery, creative and commercial teams.**
* **Ensure that proposals communicate one connected solution story rather than a list of disconnected capabilities.**
* **Support the development of pilots, demonstrations, case studies and sales\-enablement content.**
* Capture client and market feedback to improve future solution offerings.



  





 AI and Emerging Solutions
 



  




* Stay current on developments in AI, GenAI, automation, analytics and digital platforms.
* **Identify opportunities to redesign end\-to\-end workflows using AI and agentic solutions.**
* **Shape solutions across content, customer engagement, commercial operations, market research and knowledge management.**
* **Consider data readiness, governance, evaluation, integration and human oversight while designing AI solutions.**
* Balance innovation with feasibility, compliance and business value.



  





 Delivery and Team Leadership
 



  




* Manage transformation initiatives and ensure timely delivery and measurable outcomes.
* Define and track KPIs aligned to client and organizational goals.
* Ensure quality, governance and compliance across solution delivery.
* Build and manage cross\-functional teams across strategy, operations and technology.
* Mentor team members and support capability development.
* **Coach teams on problem structuring, solution design, proposal development and executive storytelling.**



  





 Desired Profile
 



  




* 4–12 years of experience in digital strategy, consulting, solutioning, pre\-sales or transformation roles.
* **Experience in life sciences, healthcare or another regulated industry is preferred.**
* Strong experience in client engagement, proposals, RFPs and transformation programs.
* **Proven ability to convert business requirements into structured solutions and client\-ready narratives.**
* **Experience in packaging services, platforms or capabilities into differentiated offerings.**
* Working knowledge of digital platforms, automation, analytics, AI and enterprise technologies.
* **Understanding of life sciences commercial areas such as CRM, marketing automation, content operations, customer data and digital analytics.**
* Strong problem\-solving, communication, presentation and stakeholder\-management skills.
* Ability to balance business, technology, operational and commercial considerations.
* Experience managing cross\-functional and global teams.
* Ability to work effectively in fast\-paced and ambiguous environments.
* MBA or Engineering background preferred. Consulting or GTM experience will be an advantage.



  





 Equal Opportunity
 



  





 Indegene is an Equal Opportunity Employer and is committed to fostering a culture of inclusion and diversity.
 



 All employment decisions are based on business requirements, candidate merit and qualifications. Qualified applicants will receive consideration without discrimination based on race, religion, sex, colour, age, national origin, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, veteran status or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

108d5f36.description:
Architect – THE BAD OFFICE

**Job Type:** Full\-time  
**Location:** Chennai, Tamil Nadu  
**Work Mode:** In\-person

About THE BAD OFFICE

**THE BAD OFFICE** is an AEC practice working across architecture, engineering and construction. We approach architecture as a holistic practice, connecting design, economics, engineering, technology and construction to create practical and meaningful outcomes.

Role

We are looking for an **Architect** who is interested in working across the different stages of a project — from concept and design development to drawings, coordination and site execution.

Responsibilities

* Develop architectural concepts and design proposals.
* Prepare plans, elevations, sections and working drawings.
* Develop 3D models, presentations and visualisations.
* Coordinate with structural, MEP and other consultants.
* Coordinate with contractors, vendors and site teams.
* Attend site visits and assist with project execution.
* Prepare and maintain project drawings and documentation.
* Research materials, construction methods and design solutions.
* Participate in client and project discussions.
* Identify design or site issues and assist in finding practical solutions.
* Work on multiple projects and meet project deadlines.

Skills Required

* B.Arch / M.Arch.
* Good architectural design and planning skills.
* Knowledge of construction and detailing.
* Good communication and coordination skills.
* Ability to work independently as well as part of a team.
* Attention to detail and willingness to learn.

Software

Knowledge of **AutoCAD, Revit, SketchUp, Rhino, Grasshopper, Adobe Creative Suite, Lumion, Enscape or similar tools** will be an advantage.

What We Look For

Someone who is **curious, responsible, design\-oriented and willing to understand architecture beyond drawings** — including construction, materials, coordination and execution.

**Freshers and experienced candidates are welcome to apply.**

Pay: ₹12,014\.36 \- ₹51,896\.11 per month

Work Location: In person

d608ff30.title: Senior Business Solutions Engineer, BizTech(LegalTech)
d608ff30.description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.
   

  

 L9 \- Senior Business Solutions Engineer, Legal Tech
   

  

 Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.
   

  

**The Community You Will Join**
 The Legal Technology team, within the BizTech organization, leads the mission to deliver innovative technology, empowering our legal function to utilize technology productively, driving connection, and scale support. This role sits within BizTech and partners directly with Airbnb's global Legal organization to accelerate the deployment of AI\-powered tools, implementation of legal systems \& integrations, and workflow automation across the CLO org.
   

  

**The Difference You Will Make**
 We're looking for a world\-class Senior Business Systems Engineer to help redefine how Legal operates. You'll deliver fast, practical solutions using internal tools and agentic AI — owning system and tool changes end\-to\-end, from design through support.
   

  

 You'll spot what's slowing teams down, champion best practices, and safeguard data integrity across our platforms — all while staying ahead of how AI is reshaping the way we work.
   

  

 This isn't conventional IT or Legal Ops. You'll be embedded directly within our Legal teams, solving real challenges in real time. As a key driver of our Legal Tech strategy, you'll lead the deployment of AI agents, legal application implementations, and automation that scales our global legal infrastructure.
   

  

 If you're energized by fast\-paced problem\-solving and want to shape the future of legal technology with AI — this is the role for you.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

 Embedded Deployment \& Enablement
   

  

* Partner directly with practice group leads, paralegals, and in\-house counsel to identify high\-value workflow automation and AI integration opportunities.
* Act as the technical DRI for Legal AI tools — from intake through deployment — owning the full lifecycle development within your assigned legal function.
* Build, test, and deploy Legal AI workflows, multi\-agent workflows, RAG pipelines, and AI copilots powered by Claude Enterprise. Building MCPs would be add on
* Run discovery workshops and translate business requirements into engineering\-ready specifications for internal engineering teams.


 Governance \& Stakeholder Management
   

  

* Navigate internal governance processes (PLADIS, Security, Privacy) on behalf of Legal stakeholders — managing intake, review, and approvals.
* Maintain the Legal Tech project portfolio, ensuring initiatives are tracked, prioritized, and communicated effectively to leadership.
* Build trusted relationships with Deputy General Counsels, Legal Ops leads, and cross\-functional partners in BizTech, Security, and Engineering.


 AI Enablement
   

  

* Design and deliver Claude Enterprise training sessions for Legal teams — covering prompting, workflow integration, and responsible AI use.
* Create adoption playbooks, user guides, and enablement materials tailored to Legal personas (lawyers, paralegals, legal ops).
* Track usage metrics and adoption KPIs; report to Legal Technology and CLO leadership on impact.


 What We're Looking For
   

  

* 8\+ years of professional experience in Legal Technology, or Enterprise SaaS implementation — preferably in a tech company or law firm technology function.
* Minimum of 2 years of experience demonstrably using AI in workflows and to support customers.
* Proven track record of architecting and building AI\-powered applications including multi\-agent workflows, retrieval systems, and LLM integrations
* Proven track record in forward\-deployed, embedded, or client\-centric technical positions.
* Experience researching and implementing custom applications from the Marketplace from research, to design and implementation
* Advanced degree (e.g., MS/MBA) in Business, Computer Science, or related fields preferred.
* Demonstrated experience designing and implementing custom business solutions and integrations using enterprise platforms.
* Skilled at stakeholder engagement and cross\-functional collaboration in large global organizations.
* Adept at leading complex projects, simplifying technical concepts, and promoting operational excellence.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, especially in critiquing technical designs and leading workshops, and engaging with senior leadership.
* Identifies opportunities for product and process improvements and can lead and implement said improvements, obtaining necessary buy\-in from stakeholders and leadership..


**Reasonable Accommodations:** 
 We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role.
   

  

**A Note on Recruiting Scams:** 
 Scammers sometimes pose as Airbnb recruiters to get money or personal information from candidates. A few things that will always be true for Airbnb’s hiring process: our open roles are posted on Airbnb’s Career’s Page at careers.airbnb.com, and our recruiters correspond only from @airbnb.com or @ext.airbnb.com email addresses. Our recruiters will never ask for your Social Security number, bank account details, passport, or payment app information while you are interviewing. We’ll also never ask you to pay a fee, send money, deposit or cash a check, or purchase work\-related equipment (such as a company laptop) during the interview process. We encourage candidates to remain vigilant of these recruiting scams and not share sensitive information if you do not believe an individual is actually affiliated with Airbnb.

5687ad4d.title: Solutions Architect
5687ad4d.description:
Role Overview
 



 We are looking for an experienced Senior Technical Advisor / Senior Solution Architect to
 



 serve as a senior individual contributor and technical subject matter expert across strategic
 



 customer engagements.
 



 This is a hands\-on role that spans both the sales and delivery lifecycle. The successful
 



 candidate will lead technical solutioning, build critical components, resolve complex
 



 implementation challenges, and remain accountable for the technical quality and successful
 



 delivery of assigned customer solutions.
 



 The role requires strong experience in low\-code platforms, enterprise architecture, integrations,
 



 hands\-on application development, customer\-facing solutioning, and technical delivery
 



 ownership. The individual will also mentor the broader technical team and help strengthen
 



 delivery capability, standards, and execution quality.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**Solution Architecture \& Development** 



* Lead the end\-to\-end technical solution for strategic and enterprise customer engagements
* Translate business requirements into scalable, secure, maintainable applications and workflows
* Design and build complex low\-code applications, workflows, integrations, data models, reports, and automation components
* Develop prototypes, proof\-of\-concepts, and reusable components
* Troubleshoot and resolve complex functional, technical, integration, performance, and security issues
* Establish development standards, reusable patterns, and implementation best practices



**Technical Delivery Accountability** 



* Own the technical solution from pre\-sales handover through implementation and go\-live
* Ensure delivered solutions align with agreed business requirements, architecture, scope, and platform capabilities
* Identify technical risks, dependencies, and delivery constraints early in the engagement
* Work closely with project managers and delivery leads to track progress, risks, and milestones
* Take ownership of technical escalations, working directly with internal teams and customers to resolve them
* Ensure successful handover, documentation, and knowledge transfer



**Pre\-Sales Solutioning** 



* Partner with sales and account management during opportunity discovery and solution qualification
* Lead technical discovery workshops covering business processes, systems, integrations, and security requirements
* Build proof\-of\-concepts and prototypes to validate proposed solutions
* Contribute to proposals, statements of work, effort estimates, and implementation roadmaps
* Communicate platform capabilities, limitations, and delivery risks clearly to customers
* Identify potential expansion opportunities based on customer needs and platform capabilities



**Project \& Engagement Support** 



* Take ownership of selected customer projects or technical workstreams as needed
* Support project planning, milestone definition, risk tracking, and status reporting
* Manage a limited number of smaller projects alongside hands\-on solution responsibilities



 Team Growth \& Mentoring
 


* Mentor solution architects, technical consultants, and developers through pairing and hands\-on coaching
* Create reusable solution patterns, development standards, templates, and technical documentation
* Contribute to hiring, onboarding, and technical evaluation of team members



 Required Experience
 


* Significant experience as a solution architect, technical architect, senior developer, or technical lead
* Strong hands\-on experience building enterprise applications on low\-code/no\-code platforms such as Kissflow, Microsoft Power Platform, OutSystems, Mendix, Appian, ServiceNow, Salesforce Platform, or similar
* Proven experience leading technical solutioning across both pre\-sales and delivery stages
* Strong application development experience — workflow design, data modeling, business rules, UI, integrations, reporting, and automation
* Strong knowledge of enterprise integrations, REST APIs, web services, identity and access management, databases, and cloud platforms
* Experience troubleshooting complex technical issues through testing, deployment, and production stabilization
* Experience contributing to proposals, statements of work, estimates, and implementation plans
* Strong communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills — able to work with business stakeholders, IT teams, and senior customer leaders
* Experience mentoring technical team members while remaining an individual contributor

2a6dfe64.title: Technical Architect – AI & Platform Engineering
2a6dfe64.description:
**Role overview**  
We are looking for a hands\-on Technical Architect to own the technology architecture for a large\-scale digital platform programme with our client. The role combines solution design, AI/ML architecture, and technical governance across engineering and client stakeholder teams.

**Key responsibilities**

* Own end\-to\-end solution architecture — application, data, integration, and infrastructure layers — for platform builds and modernisation programmes.
* Design and guide implementation of AI/ML capabilities: LLM\-based solutions, RAG pipelines, agentic workflows, model integration, prompt and evaluation frameworks.
* Define architecture standards, reference patterns, and non\-functional requirements (scalability, security, performance, cost).
* Lead technical discovery with client stakeholders; translate business problems into architecture blueprints, effort estimates, and delivery roadmaps.
* Evaluate and select platforms, frameworks, and third\-party tools; own build\-vs\-buy recommendations.
* Provide technical leadership to engineering teams through design reviews, code governance, and mentoring.
* Own data architecture and governance in coordination with security and compliance teams.
* Act as the senior technical authority in client\-facing forums, including steering committee and CXO\-level discussions.

**Must\-have skills**

* 10\+ years in software engineering, with at least 3–4 years in an architect capacity.
* Proven architecture ownership on at least two large enterprise or platform\-scale programmes.
* Strong depth in cloud (AWS / Azure / GCP), microservices, APIs, and event\-driven architecture.
* Practical, production\-level experience with AI/ML and GenAI stacks — model integration, vector databases, orchestration frameworks (LangChain/LlamaIndex or equivalent), MLOps.
* Solid grounding in data engineering: pipelines, warehousing, real\-time and batch processing.
* Security, identity, and compliance\-aware design (data privacy, access control, audit).
* Excellent client\-facing communication; able to defend architecture decisions to both technical and business audiences.

**Good to have**

* Prior experience in a consulting, Big 4, or systems integrator environment.
* Cloud architect certification (AWS SA Pro, Azure Solutions Architect Expert, or GCP Professional Architect).
* Exposure to education technology, learning platforms, or large content\-delivery systems.

**Qualification:** B.E./B.Tech/MCA or equivalent; postgraduate qualification an advantage.

Pay: ₹689,775\.61 \- ₹1,896,020\.98 per year

Work Location: In person

ae35df9b.title: Functional Architect – Ed-Tech Ecosystem & Process
ae35df9b.description:
**Role overview**  
We are looking for a Functional Architect with deep domain command of the education technology ecosystem to own the functional design of a large learning platform programme. The role sits between client business stakeholders and the engineering team, and is accountable for process design, functional blueprints, and solution fit.

**Key responsibilities**

* Own the functional architecture and process blueprint for the ed\-tech platform — learner, faculty, institution, and administrator journeys.
* Run discovery and requirement\-elicitation workshops with client business teams; convert outcomes into functional specifications, process maps, and user stories.
* Map current\-state processes, identify gaps, and design target\-state operating processes with clear change impact.
* Define the functional ecosystem view: LMS, SIS/ERP, assessment and proctoring, content management, certification, analytics, and their integration touchpoints.
* Partner with the Technical Architect to ensure functional design is technically coherent and delivery\-feasible.
* Own functional governance across the programme — traceability, change control, sign\-offs, and UAT strategy.
* Advise on regulatory, accreditation, and policy requirements applicable to the education sector.
* Support pre\-sales and solutioning inputs, effort sizing, and stakeholder presentations where required.

**Must\-have skills**

* 10\+ years of experience, with substantial time in education technology, higher education, skilling, or EdTech product/consulting environments.
* Demonstrated functional ownership of at least one large learning or education platform implementation.
* Strong working knowledge of the ed\-tech stack: LMS platforms (Moodle, Canvas, Blackboard or equivalent), student information systems, assessment engines, content and learning standards (SCORM, xAPI, LTI, QTI).
* Business process design and re\-engineering capability — process mapping, SOP definition, operating model design.
* Excellent requirement documentation: BRD/FRD, functional specs, process flows, wireframe\-level articulation.
* Confident stakeholder management with senior client and institutional stakeholders.

**Good to have**

* Consulting, Big 4, or advisory background.
* Exposure to government or public\-sector education programmes, NEP\-aligned initiatives, or accreditation frameworks.
* Certification in business analysis or process (CBAP, Lean Six Sigma, TOGAF).
* Familiarity with learning analytics and AI\-enabled personalisation in education.

**Qualification:** Graduate/postgraduate in a relevant discipline; MBA or education\-domain postgraduate qualification an advantage.

**To Apply:** Please share your resume to hr@icogz.com

Work Location: In person

c383f5bd.title: Predictive Science - AI Engineering & Prompt Architecture Lead - Vice President
c383f5bd.description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  

  

  

Take a lead role in acquiring, managing and retaining meaningful relationships that deliver outstanding experience to our customers. In this role, you will balance your focus on business results by offering options and finding solutions to help our customers with issues.
As a Vice President – AI Engineering \& Prompt Architecture Lead in Predictive Science, you will own the technical vision and delivery for a team of prompt engineers and AI/ML model developers building intelligent document processing and data extraction solutions in the KYC/AML domain.


**Job Responsibilities:**

Architect agentic, multi\-step AI workflows chaining classification extraction cross\-validation* exception routing with human\-in\-the\-loop checkpoints.
* Debug and remediate complex prompt failures (context\-window overflow, instruction drift in long chains, RAG retrieval poisoning, output/format instability).
* Design prompt/model evaluation frameworks measuring accuracy plus consistency, robustness, latency, cost\-per\-call, and hallucination rate.
* Operationalize prompt lifecycle management as production code: versioning, CI/CD prompt tests, A/B experiments, rollback, and audited change history.
* Guide model selection and optimization (prompting vs fine\-tuning vs custom training) balancing accuracy, latency, cost, and data sensitivity.
* Design RAG architectures for financial documents: chunking, embeddings, vector store design, re\-ranking, and context injection.
* Oversee fine\-tuning/training workflows: dataset curation, annotation quality, training configurations, and generalization across document variants.
* Build and maintain evaluation infrastructure: benchmark/golden datasets, regression suites, and automated scoring to catch regressions pre\-production.
* Define confidence calibration and escalation logic so systems estimate uncertainty and route low\-confidence outputs to human reviewers with the right context.
* Partner with governance/model risk and data engineering: produce validator\-ready documentation (explainability/auditability) and ensure robust, refreshed data/annotation/eval pipelines; drive AI\-native development practices to improve velocity.

**Required qualifications, capabilities and skills:**


* 10\+ years in NLP/AI/ML or computational linguistics, including 3\+ years leading technical teams with direct reports.
* Hands\-on LLM internals expertise: tokenization impacts, attention limits, context window management, and temperature/sampling trade\-offs.
* Proven prompt architecture design/debugging: multi\-turn chains, few\-/many\-shot, chain\-of\-thought, self\-consistency, and constitutional AI.
* Strong RAG system design experience: embeddings trade\-offs (e.g., ada/BGE/Cohere), chunking for semi\-structured docs, hybrid retrieval (dense\+sparse), and re\-ranking.
* Fine\-tuning experience: LoRA/QLoRA, instruction tuning, RLHF/DPO, dataset curation, and evaluating tuned vs prompted performance.
* Python \+ ML engineering proficiency: PyTorch, Hugging Face, LangChain/LlamaIndex (or equivalents), vector DBs (Pinecone/Weaviate/pgvector), and API development.
* AI evaluation systems experience beyond F1: faithfulness, answer relevance, RAG context precision/recall, automated eval pipelines, and LLM\-as\-judge.
* Deep understanding of LLM failure modes: hallucinations, sycophancy, long\-context instruction degradation, prompt\-format sensitivity, and catastrophic forgetting.
* Structured output enforcement in production: JSON mode, function calling, constrained decoding, output parsers, and schema validation.
* Build\-vs\-buy/model selection track record: benchmarking foundation models (GPT\-4/Claude/Llama/Mistral) against task requirements.
* Leadership under ambiguity: pragmatic trade\-offs, rapid iteration as practices evolve, and strong communication with compliance, risk, and business stakeholders.

**Preferred qualifications, capabilities and skills:**
* Domain expertise in KYC/AML or financial document processing: entity extraction from registries, beneficial ownership structures, sanctions screening logic, adverse media classification.
* Experience designing autonomous AI agents: tool\-use patterns, planning/reasoning loops, memory architectures, and safety guardrails for regulated environments.
* Knowledge of AI security/adversarial robustness: prompt injection defense, jailbreak detection, data poisoning awareness, and output monitoring for sensitive financial data.
* Experience with model distillation to produce smaller, faster models for cost\-effective deployment.
* Familiarity with AI observability/monitoring: tracking prompt/model performance, drift detection, alerting, and health dashboards.
* Experience with multi\-modal AI combining OCR, layout understanding, and LLM\-based extraction for complex documents.
* Advanced degree (MS/PhD) in CS/NLP/ML or equivalent depth via publications, open\-source, or production system design and Passion for talent development: growing engineers from junior prompt writers into senior AI system designers via structured mentorship.

**ABOUT US**  

  

  

JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.

The Commercial \& Investment Bank provides strategic advice, raises capital, manages risk and extends liquidity in markets around the world.

b3008b2c.title: Cloud DBA Migration Consultant
b3008b2c.description:
Are you passionate about helping organizations modernize and migrate business\-critical databases to the cloud?
 





 Do you enjoy solving complex database migration challenges across AWS, Azure, and hybrid environments?
 





 Would you like to work on large\-scale cloud transformation projects while combining database expertise, customer engagement, and migration delivery?
 




  
 




 At SoftwareOne, we help organizations modernize their data platforms and accelerate cloud adoption through expert consulting and delivery services. We are looking for a Cloud Database Migration DBA to support database transformation initiatives across AWS, Azure, and on\-premises environments, helping customers migrate, optimize, and modernize their database workloads.
 




  
 




 As a Cloud Database Migration DBA, you will be responsible for assessing, planning, and executing database migration and modernization projects across cloud and on\-premises environments. Working closely with Cloud Architects, Infrastructure Engineers, Application Teams, Security Specialists, and customer stakeholders, you will ensure successful migration outcomes while minimizing risk, downtime, and business disruption.
 




  
 




**Key responsibilities:** 




* Delivering database migration and modernization projects across on\-premises, AWS, Azure, and managed database platforms.
* Performing database assessments, compatibility reviews, migration planning, sizing recommendations, and technical discovery activities.
* Designing and executing migration approaches, validation plans, cutover strategies, rollback plans, and post\-migration support activities.
* Supporting database administration activities including performance tuning, backup and recovery, replication, security, availability, and disaster recovery.
* Troubleshooting migration issues, replication challenges, connectivity problems, performance bottlenecks, and data consistency concerns.
* Collaborating with customer and project teams to develop migration runbooks, technical documentation, knowledge transfer materials, and successful project outcomes.


**Job Requirements** 


 Strong experience working with enterprise database platforms such as SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Oracle, or MySQL.
 





 Practical experience delivering cloud database migration projects involving AWS and/or Azure database services.
 





 Strong understanding of database migration methodologies including assessment, schema conversion, remediation, validation, reconciliation, and cutover execution.
 





 Knowledge of Change Data Capture (CDC), replication technologies, high availability, disaster recovery, backup and recovery, and downtime minimization strategies.
 





 Strong SQL skills, database performance troubleshooting expertise, and experience optimizing database workloads.
 





 Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and customer\-facing consulting skills.
 



**Company description** 







  
 




 SoftwareOne and Crayon have come together to form a global, AI\-powered software and cloud solutions provider with a bold vision for the future. With a footprint in over 70 countries and a diverse team of 13,000\+ professionals, we offer unparalleled opportunities for talent to grow, make an impact, and shape the future of technology. At the heart of our business is our people. We empower our teams to work across borders, innovate fearlessly, and continuously develop their skills through world\-class learning and development programs. Whether you're passionate about cloud, software, data, AI, or building meaningful client relationships, you’ll find a place to thrive here. Join us and be part of a purpose\-driven culture where your ideas matter, your growth is supported, and your career can go global.

5fc038e3.title: Staff Cloud Network Architect
5fc038e3.description:
**WHO WE ARE** 




 Aviatrix® is pioneering the Cloud Native Security Fabric — the architecture the Containment Era requires. The Cloud Native Security Fabric governs every workload communication path across every cloud, every VPC, every Kubernetes cluster, and every serverless function, from a single policy plane. One rule. Universal propagation. Enforced at the workload, not at a chokepoint. Trusted by more than 500 of the world's leading enterprises. For more information, visit aviatrix.ai.
 



  





**About the Role** 
 :
 **Staff Cloud Network Architect** 




 The Staff Cloud Network Architect is a strategic, customer\-facing technical role responsible for ensuring the success of enterprise customers operating Aviatrix in production environments. As the primary technical point of contact, the Staff Cloud Network Architect partners closely with customers to understand their architecture, guide best practices, and drive long\-term platform adoption and health. This is not a sales role and focuses on customer outcomes and operational excellence.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Serve as the dedicated technical point of contact for assigned enterprise customers, owning architecture design, deployment oversight, and operational excellence across their Aviatrix deployments.
* Design and validate multi\-cloud network architectures (AWS, Azure, GCP, OCI) including transit networks, hub\-and\-spoke topologies, segmentation, and inter\-cloud connectivity.
* Design and implement cloud network security architectures using Aviatrix Distributed Cloud Firewall, including microsegmentation policies, security domains, and Zero Trust network access controls.
* Lead quarterly business and technical reviews with customer stakeholders ranging from network engineers to C\-level executives, identifying optimization opportunities and demonstrating platform value.
* Act as the technical escalation point for critical incidents, driving rapid resolution while coordinating with Aviatrix TAC and Engineering teams.
* Proactively identify risks, gaps, and adoption opportunities within customer environments, then drive implementation of solutions that unlock full platform value.
* Relay customer feedback, feature requests, and product gaps to Aviatrix Product and Engineering teams, serving as the internal voice of the customer.



  





**Requirements/Qualifications** 



* 8\+ years of hands\-on experience in enterprise networking, cloud networking, or network security roles within production environments.
* Demonstrated expertise with at least two major public clouds (AWS, Azure, GCP, or OCI), including VPC/VNet design, transit gateways, routing, and hybrid connectivity solutions.
* Strong foundation in BGP, SD\-WAN, MPLS, and hybrid cloud connectivity technologies such as AWS Direct Connect, Azure ExpressRoute, or Google Cloud Interconnect.
* Hands\-on experience designing and implementing network security architectures using NGFWs, IDS/IPS systems, microsegmentation, and Zero Trust network access principles.
* Proficiency with infrastructure automation and scripting using Python, Terraform, or Ansible for network provisioning and configuration management.
* Working knowledge of monitoring and observability tools such as CloudWatch, Azure Monitor, Splunk, or Datadog applied to network and security telemetry.
* Familiarity with cloud security compliance frameworks including SOC 2, FedRAMP, HIPAA, PCI\-DSS, or NIST Cybersecurity Framework.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts for audiences ranging from network engineers to executive stakeholders.



  





**Nice to Have** 



* Hands\-on experience with Aviatrix Distributed Cloud Firewall (DCF), including smart groups, security domains, stateful inspection, and policy enforcement.
* Prior experience in a customer success, solutions engineering, or technical advisory role for enterprise infrastructure or security platforms.
* Certifications in cloud platforms (AWS Solutions Architect, Azure Administrator) or security (CISSP, CEH) that demonstrate advanced networking and security expertise.
* Experience integrating and managing third\-party network security solutions such as Palo Alto Networks, Fortinet, or Check Point within multi\-cloud environments.
* Demonstrated expertise in designing and implementing SD\-WAN or network segmentation solutions at scale within enterprise organizations.

351fe3da.title: Engagement Manager, Professional Services
351fe3da.description:
The Engagement Manager is the delivery lead on our enterprise programmes.
 




  






 Our engagements increasingly run through to the systems that execute the pricing. A current programme covers a new packaging model, a new commercial model, and a migration from Salesforce CPQ to Revenue Cloud, working with the client's executive team, their systems integrator, and stakeholders across Sales, Deal Desk, Finance and RevOps. You would start there and take on further engagements as they come.
 




  






 You own whether a programme lands. You are in the working sessions, you hold what was decided, you translate commercial intent into requirements the integrator can build against, and you check that what gets built is what was asked for.
 




  






 Roughly 60% of the role is delivery and programme management. The other 40% is turning commercial decisions into business requirements: stories, acceptance criteria, edge cases and test scenarios. We write business requirements, not technical specifications. You will not be asked to write code or configure Salesforce. You do need to follow a systems discussion closely enough to know when something carries commercial consequence.
 




  





 Responsibilities
 

  





 Delivery and programme management
 
* **The quarterback.** 

 Lead delivery across the client, the systems integrator and the Monetizely team, aligned to a programme plan you own and maintain.
* **Own the record.** 

 Decisions, actions, owners and deadlines. The standard is that Monetizely is never the party asking the client or the integrator what was agreed.
* **Run the cadence.** 

 Working sessions, standing calls, design reviews. You set the agenda and you close the loop.
* **Escalate early.** 

 Identify drift, ambiguity and slippage before it becomes a problem, and raise it with a recommendation attached.
* **Client relationships.** 

 Build and hold multi\-level stakeholder relationships across commercial, finance and systems functions.



  





 Requirements and quality
 
* **Translate commercial intent into requirements.** 

 Business\-level stories, acceptance criteria and edge cases that an integrator can build from without guessing.
* **Hold the coverage view.** 

 Check what has actually been delivered against what was specified, release by release, and raise gaps in writing before they reach testing. This is the function our clients value most.
* **Design test scenarios** 

 and track what has and has not been verified.
* **Produce the written work clients read:** 

 status, recaps, recommendations, escalations.



 Minimum qualifications
 
* Significant experience delivering complex, multi\-phase enterprise software implementations, in professional services, delivery or consulting at an enterprise SaaS company
* Experience running engagements with American and European enterprise clients, including at executive level
* Proven ability to lead cross\-functional teams to deliver enterprise programmes
* Excellent written and spoken English, and sound judgement about what can and cannot be said to a client



 Preferred qualifications
 
* **Strategic advisory.** 

 Demonstrated focus on the why behind a business requirement over the technical how of its implementation.
* **Influential leadership.** 

 Proven ability to command executive presence and lead technical teams through influence rather than direct reporting authority.
* **Proactive problem solving.** 

 You treat a business problem as a puzzle to be solved rather than a metric to report.
* **Communication.** 

 Exceptional ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear business value for non\-technical stakeholders.
* Commercial exposure to pricing, packaging, quoting, discounting or renewals
* Salesforce, CPQ or Revenue Cloud familiarity
* Experience working alongside a systems integrator
* Engineering/Science/Analytics background preferred



 The shape of the role
 


 This is a hands\-on role. You will be in the meetings, writing the requirements and maintaining the record yourself. There is no team beneath you today, though there will be as we grow, and the person who does this well will build it.
 




  






 It sits in professional services rather than customer success. The focus is on delivering the programme itself, rather than on adoption, account health or renewals, which sit elsewhere.
   






 Working arrangement
 
* Full\-time, based in Delhi NCR. This is a hard requirement.
* Daily overlap with UK hours and frequent overlap with US hours. The working day typically runs from early afternoon into the evening IST.
* Client confidentiality applies from day one.



  





  





 About Monetizely
 


 Monetizely is a pricing strategy consultancy built by operators with nearly three decades of combined leadership in Product Management, Product Marketing and Pricing at companies including Zoom, Twilio, LinkedIn, Squarespace, Medallia and Microsoft. We are the authors of
 
*Price to Scale* 

 and teach a top\-rated course on SaaS, Agentic and AI Pricing Strategy and Monetization.
 




  






 We work with software companies from Seed stage to post\-IPO on how they package, price and monetize. Increasingly that work does not stop at strategy. We take the pricing model through to the systems that run it: packaging, quoting, discounting, approvals, renewals and amendments, and the CRM and CPQ platforms underneath. We call it monetization engineering.

YouTrip is the leading and fastest\-growing multi\-currency payment platform in Asia Pacific. In 2018, we pioneered the region's first multi\-currency digital wallet. Now, YouTrip is the \#1 multi\-currency digital wallet trusted by millions across the region, processing over US$15 billion in total payment value annually.


Our consumer and business propositions – YouTrip and YouBiz – empower individuals and businesses with inclusive, accessible, and affordable financial solutions. YouTrip has raised over US$110 million to date, including its recent Series B round led by global venture capital firm Lightspeed Venture Partners—underscoring strong investor confidence in its mission to transform digital financial services across the Asia Pacific.


Recognised as World Economic Forum’s Global Innovator 2025, CNBC’s World’s Top Fintech Companies (2025, 2024\), and LinkedIn’s Top Startup (2024, 2023\), YouTrip is dedicated to creating the next generation of digital finance services for consumers and businesses.


Valuing an entrepreneurial culture of diversity and inclusion, we are seeking driven individuals to join our fast\-growing regional team as we push the boundaries of innovative fintech solutions.


Job Description: Technical Program Manager

  

As a Technical Program Manager at YouTrip, you'll help our engineering organization deliver complex, cross\-team programs that power payments for millions of customers and businesses across Asia Pacific. You'll bring structure to large initiatives that span mobile, backend, infrastructure, risk, and compliance. **Company Description** 
 VMVCUBE INFOSYSTEM INDIA PVT LTD is a global System Integration and end\-to\-end IT solutions provider, helping businesses adopt cutting\-edge and scalable technologies. Established in 2021 and headquartered in India, the company focuses on digital transformation, operational efficiency, and secure IT environments for clients worldwide. Its core expertise includes data center solutions, cloud transformation, cybersecurity, enterprise communication, and networking, delivered through tailored, high\-performance architectures. VMVCUBE maintains a strong global footprint across India, UAE, USA, UK, and Singapore, combining local presence with international reach. As a strategic partner to leading technology brands such as Dell, HP, Lenovo, Microsoft, Google, Cisco, AWS, and others, VMVCUBE offers access to modern tools and solutions that support long\-term growth and innovation.

**Pre\-Sales Design \& Solution Engineer**

**Structured Cabling, Data Center Infrastructure, Active Networking, and Passive Networking solutions**

**Structured Cabling Solutions** 

 for Data Centers, Server Rooms, Offices, and Enterprise Networks.

**Copper and Fiber Optic Cabling** 

 solutions based on customer requirements.

* Cat6/Cat6A/Cat7 cabling

* ODF/FDF
* Patch Panels
* LIUs
* Patch Cords
* Racks \& Cabinets
* Cable Managers
* PDU
* Raceway/Trunking
* Labeling and Cable Management

**3\. Data Center Solution Design**

**Data Centers, Server Rooms, MDF/IDF and Network Rooms** 

 .

**rack elevation diagrams, connectivity diagrams, cable schedules, and pathway designs** 

 .

**BOQ/BOM, technical specifications, and solution costing inputs** 

 .

* Technical Compliance Sheets

Budget/resource planning experience is a plus

* Demonstrated success structuring and selling complex, enterprise software solutions to large clients in financial services/banking a plus.

* Techno\-Functional expertise preferred
* A Passion to learn and educate customers and FICO colleagues through presentations, and conversations. Strong soft skills, and a genuine interest in people and a desire to help them be wildly successful.

* A Collaborative style of working where the strengths of teammates are celebrated and the whole team is greater than the sum of its players.

* The opportunity to make an impact and develop professionally by leveraging your unique strengths and participating in valuable learning experiences.
* Highly competitive compensation, benefits and rewards programs that encourage you to bring your best every day and be recognized for doing so.

**Why Make a Move to FICO?**
 At FICO, you can develop your career with a leading organization in one of the fastest\-growing fields in technology today – Big Data analytics. You’ll play a part in our commitment to help businesses use data to improve every choice they make, using advances in artificial intelligence, machine learning, optimization, and much more.
   

  

 FICO makes a real difference in the way businesses operate worldwide:
   

  

* Credit Scoring — FICO® Scores are used by 90 of the top 100 US lenders.
* Fraud Detection and Security — 4 billion payment cards globally are protected by FICO fraud systems.
* Lending — 3/4 of US mortgages are approved using the FICO Score.


 Global trends toward digital transformation have created tremendous demand for FICO’s solutions, placing us among the world’s top 100 software companies by revenue. We help many of the world’s largest banks, insurers, retailers, telecommunications providers and other firms reach a new level of success. Our success is dependent on really talented people – just like you – who thrive on the collaboration and innovation that’s nurtured by a diverse and inclusive environment. We’ll provide the support you need, while ensuring you have the freedom to develop your skills and grow your career. Join FICO and help change the way business thinks!
   

  

 Learn more about how you can fulfil your potential at www.fico.com/Careers
   

  

 FICO promotes a culture of inclusion and seeks to attract a diverse set of candidates for each job opportunity. We are an equal employment opportunity employer and we’re proud to offer employment and advancement opportunities to all candidates without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, pregnancy, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. **About Kinaxis**
 Elevate your career journey by embracing a new challenge with Kinaxis. We are experts in tech, but it’s really our people who give us passion to always seek ways to do things better. As such, we’re serious about your career growth and professional development, because People matter at Kinaxis.
   

  

 In 1984, we started out as a team of three engineers based in Ottawa, Canada. Today, we have grown to become a global organization with over 2000 employees around the world, and support 40,000\+ users in over 100 countries. As a global leader in end\-to\-end supply chain management, we enable supply chain excellence for all industries. We are expanding our team in Chennai and around the world as we continue to innovate and revolutionize how we support our customers.

Building a high\-trust and high\-performance culture is important to us and we are proud to be Great Place to Work® Certified TM . Our state\-of\-the\-art office, located in the World Trade Centre in Chennai, offers our growing team space for expansion and collaboration.
   

  

**Location**
 Chennai, India
   

  

**About The Team**
 As a member of our Consulting Team, you understand our customers’ most pressing business performance challenges and you are committed to helping our customers solve complex challenges in the distributed value chain that is prevalent in manufacturing today.
   

  

****What you will do****
* Participate in in the end\-to\-end deployment of production scheduling tool including deep\-dive customer business requirements discovery sessions and develop requirements specifications documentation.
* Collaborates closely with agile team members to support the configuration, implementation of Maestro software to enable the solution according to our customers distinct needs
* Translate business requirements into Kinaxis Maestro software specifications, following supply chain industry trends and best practices.
* Support senior team members in providing creative solutions to complex business problems while maintaining best practices.
