* Provide technical support to end users and resolve issues of the configured solutions, escalating to senior team members as needed.
* Support the validation and testing of the solution and capture user feedback.
* Actively engage, guide and mentor to develop the skills of junior consultants on projects.
* Any other reasonable project related tasks as assigned by the Project Manager.


****What we are looking for****
* Candidates with results\-oriented mindset, focusing on improving client satisfaction and providing a very high standard of service, driving towards Kinaxis’s success.
* Sound knowledge in Supply Chain concepts especially scheduling with 6\+ years of experience.
* Strong intent to learn our first in class product “Maestro”
* Work in a fast\-paced project environment and co\-ordinate with members at all levels in an organization
* Highly adaptable professional, able to embrace teamwork in diverse and evolving work environments.
* Capability to lead by example, having the drive to think in an innovative way and have passion about new challenges
* Ability to solve complex problems, think critically and make sound judgement decisions.
* A passion for working in customer facing roles that require high level of interpersonal, communication, facilitation and presentation skills.
* Ability to communicate complex ideas effectively in English, both verbally and in writing
* Technical skills such as SQL, R, Java Script, Python, etc.
* Experience with manufacturing planning solutions such as Kinaxis, SAP, JDA, etc. is an added advantage


 \#Senior
   

  

**Work With Impact:** 
 Our platform directly helps companies power the world’s supply chains. We see the results of what we do out in the world every day—when we see store shelves stocked, when medications are available for our loved ones, and so much more.
   

  

**Work with Fortune 500 Brands:** 
 Companies across industries trust us to help them take control of their integrated business planning and digital supply chain. Some of our customers include Ford, Unilever, Yamaha, P\&G, Lockheed\-Martin, and more.
   

  

**Social Responsibility at Kinaxis:** 
 Our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion Committee weighs in on hiring practices, talent assessment training materials, and mandatory training on unconscious bias and inclusion fundamentals. Sustainability is key to what we do and we’re committed to net\-zero operations strategy for the long term. We are involved in our communities and support causes where we can make the most impact.
   

  

 People matter at Kinaxis and these are some of the perks and benefits we created for our team:
   

  

* Flexible vacation and Kinaxis Days (company\-wide day off on the last Friday of every month)
* Flexible work options
* Physical and mental well\-being programs
* Regularly scheduled virtual fitness classes
* Mentorship programs and training and career development
* Recognition programs and referral rewards
* Hackathons


 For more information, visit the Kinaxis web site at www.kinaxis.com or the company’s blog at http://blog.kinaxis.com .
   

  

 Kinaxis welcomes candidates to apply to our inclusive community. We provide accommodations upon request to ensure fairness and accessibility throughout our recruitment process for all candidates, including those with specific needs or disabilities. If you require an accommodation, please reach out to us at recruitmentprograms@kinaxis.com. Please note that this contact information is strictly for accessibility requests and cannot be used to inquire about application statuses.

After the initial screening, all subsequent decisions regarding your application, including final selection, are made by our human recruitment team. AI does not make any final hiring decisions.

6020ec80.title: Senior Associate-Cloud Engineer
6020ec80.description:
Job Description
**Job purpose**


We are seeking a Cloud Engineer for a multi\-year strategic transformation program modernizing the global middle\- and back\-office technology platform through a cloud\-native, event\-driven architecture. The platform leverages AWS, Azure, Kafka\-based event streaming, Databricks, modern workflow orchestration, API\-led integration and scalable cloud infrastructure. The Cloud Engineer will help design, build, automate, deploy and support critical cloud infrastructure services spanning both AWS (primary) and Azure environments. The successful candidate will work closely with architects, application development teams, infrastructure engineering, security and data engineering teams to deliver highly resilient, secure and scalable cloud solutions supporting real\-time trade processing, event\-driven integration, analytics and regulatory reporting.


**Key responsibilities**


* Multi\-cloud infrastructure engineering: build and support cloud infrastructure across AWS and Azure environments, and implement secure connectivity using technologies such as Megaport, ExpressRoute, Direct Connect, Private Endpoints and VPC/VNet peering.


* Configure and maintain cloud networking, routing, DNS, load balancing and security controls, and support high\-availability and disaster\-recovery designs across multiple availability zones and regions.


* Event\-driven platform engineering: deploy and manage Kafka infrastructure including Confluent Cloud, Confluent Platform and Amazon MSK, and implement event\-streaming infrastructure for realtime trade and lifecycle event processing.


* Configure topics, partitions, consumer groups, Schema Registry, ACLs and cluster linking / replication, and support event replay, resiliency, monitoring, recovery and operational controls.


* Cloud automation \& DevOps: develop Infrastructure\-as\-Code solutions using Terraform, CloudFormation and Azure Bicep (preferred), and build CI/CD pipelines supporting cloud infrastructure deployments.


* Automate infrastructure provisioning and environment build processes, and contribute to platformengineering standards and reusable deployment modules.


* Platform monitoring \& observability: implement monitoring and alerting for cloud infrastructure and event platforms using CloudWatch, Azure Monitor, OpenSearch, Grafana and Prometheus.


* Monitor Kafka consumer lag, throughput, infrastructure utilization, connectivity and operational health.


* Security \& compliance: implement secure cloud controls consistent with financial\-services standards, supporting IAM, Azure Entra ID, RBAC, TLS, encryption at rest and in transit, and secrets management.


* Partner with Cyber Security and Infrastructure teams during architecture reviews and approvals.


* Data \& analytics platform support: support connectivity and integration between Kafka platforms and Databricks, and implement secure data\-ingestion patterns from real\-time event streams into analytics platforms.


* Assist with cloud storage services including Amazon S3 and Azure Data Lake Storage (ADLS), and support data governance, retention and resiliency requirements.


**Key competencies**


* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology or a related field.


* 4–8 years of cloud engineering experience, including 2\+ years hands\-on AWS and 2\+ years handson Azure.


* Experience supporting production cloud environments within large enterprises and working within Agile delivery teams.


* Strong AWS experience across EC2, VPC, IAM, S3, CloudWatch, Route 53, Security Groups and Amazon MSK.


* Strong Azure experience across Azure Networking, Azure Monitor, Azure Databricks, Azure Data Lake Storage and Entra ID.


* DevOps expertise: Terraform, GitHub Actions / Azure DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, Linux administration and Shell or Python scripting.


* Messaging \& integration: Apache Kafka, Confluent, event\-driven architectures, APIs and microservices, and ESB / integration concepts.


* Containers: Docker and Kubernetes (EKS / AKS preferred).


**Preferred qualifications**


* Experience with Confluent Cloud and Cluster Linking.


* Experience implementing multi\-cloud networking with Megaport.


* Experience building real\-time event\-streaming platforms and working with Databricks.


* Experience in Capital Markets, Investment Banking or Financial Services.


* Understanding of trade lifecycle concepts across FX, Rates, Derivatives and Securities.


* Exposure to event\-driven reference architectures and enterprise integration patterns.


* AWS and/or Azure cloud certifications.

f7856517.title: Lead Solution Architect
f7856517.description:
**About Milliman**
 Independent for over 75\+ years, Milliman delivers market\-leading services and solutions to clients worldwide. Today, we are helping companies take on some of the world’s most critical and complex issues, including retirement funding and healthcare financing, risk management and regulatory compliance, data analytics and business transformation.
   

  

 Through a team of professionals ranging from actuaries to clinicians, technology specialists to plan administrators, we offer unparalleled expertise in employee benefits, investment consulting, healthcare, life insurance, and financial services, and property and casualty insurance.
   

  

**Role Summary**
 The Lead Solutions Architect will lead the design, implementation, and delivery of scalable data architecture and engineering solutions within a Microsoft Fabric\-based sandbox environment supporting advanced analytics, actuarial discovery, and business intelligence use cases.
   

  

 This role will define ingestion patterns, Lakehouse structure, data layer strategy, data quality controls, and analytics\-ready datasets that enable pricing, underwriting, claims, fraud, risk segmentation, and broader healthcare and insurance analytics use cases.
   

  

 This is a senior client\-facing role that requires a combination of strong technical architecture skills, hands\-on data engineering capability, consulting mindset, and communication excellence. The individual will work directly with clients and internal stakeholders to understand business challenges, assess current\-state data environments, architect scalable solutions, and align client needs with Milliman’s analytics, actuarial, and technology capabilities.
   

  

 The successful candidate will possess an entrepreneurial and startup\-oriented mindset, demonstrate strong ownership and accountability, remain hands\-on in delivery, guide junior team members, and drive cross\-functional teams toward shared delivery goals.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Data Architecture and Engineering Leadership**
* Lead the end\-to\-end data architecture for the sandbox environment, including ingestion patterns, Microsoft Fabric Lakehouse structure, bronze, silver, and gold table strategy, and data quality framework.
* Own the technical design and implementation approach for data ingestion into Microsoft Fabric, including pipeline design, file validation, schema handling, partitioning, metadata management, and incremental load strategy.
* Translate raw and curated source data into analytics\-ready datasets, including daily summary, event\-summary, exposure, behavioral, contextual, actuarial, and business feature tables.
* Define and implement data profiling, reconciliation, and validation outputs such as row counts, file counts, duplicate checks, null analysis, timestamp coverage, identifier stability, unit validation, and business rule checks.
* Design scalable and reusable data architecture patterns that support pricing, underwriting, claims, fraud detection, risk segmentation, operational analytics, and management reporting use cases.
* Establish documentation standards for data models, transformation logic, quality rules, assumptions, limitations, lineage, operational procedures, and handover materials.


**Client Engagement and Communication**
* Engage directly with client business, analytics, actuarial, technology, and operational stakeholders to understand their current data environment, business objectives, pain points, systems landscape, and analytical maturity.
* Facilitate discovery workshops, requirements gathering sessions, architecture discussions, solution design reviews, and technical walkthroughs.
* Translate complex technical architecture concepts into clear business implications, options, trade\-offs, and recommendations for both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Communicate effectively with senior client stakeholders, including technology, analytics, operations, actuarial, and business leadership teams.
* Prepare and present architecture recommendations, solution roadmaps, implementation options, delivery risks, dependencies, mitigation plans, and business benefits.
* Act as a trusted advisor to clients by helping them understand how data architecture, analytics, and Milliman solutions can support measurable business outcomes.


**Solution Design and Milliman Solution Alignment**
* Assess client data ecosystems, technology platforms, operational workflows, and analytical needs to identify where Milliman solutions, accelerators, methodologies, and actuarial expertise can create value.
* Translate client requirements into practical, scalable, and outcome\-driven solution architectures.
* Link client challenges with Milliman capabilities across actuarial analytics, payer analytics, fraud, waste and abuse, pricing, underwriting, claims, risk adjustment, utilization management, and business intelligence.
* Support solution shaping for client opportunities, including technical approach, architecture design, level\-of\-effort estimation, delivery planning, and proposal inputs.
* Partner with Milliman consulting, actuarial, product, analytics, and technology teams to ensure proposed solutions are commercially relevant, technically feasible, and aligned with client priorities.
* Identify opportunities to industrialize repeatable solution components, reusable data models, accelerators, templates, and delivery playbooks.


**Team Leadership and Delivery Ownership**
* Provide technical direction, design guidance, code review, and mentoring to junior engineers and analysts.
* Drive the team toward shared delivery goals by clarifying priorities, removing obstacles, and maintaining accountability for outcomes.
* Partner closely with actuarial teams to understand required features and ensure data models support pricing, underwriting, claims, fraud, and risk segmentation analysis.
* Coordinate with product leadership, IT, and security stakeholders on Microsoft Fabric configuration, Lakehouse setup, roadmap decisions, access controls, and environment readiness.
* Maintain a hands\-on role in solution design, data engineering, troubleshooting, quality reviews, and delivery execution.
* Balance strategic architecture thinking with practical implementation needs, especially in fast\-moving or ambiguous client environments.
* Promote a collaborative delivery culture focused on quality, speed, client value, and continuous improvement.


**Required Skills And Experience**
**Technical Architecture and Engineering**
* Strong experience designing and implementing scalable data engineering or data architecture solutions.
* Hands\-on experience with Microsoft Fabric, Azure data services, Lakehouse architecture, OneLake, pipelines, notebooks, and modern cloud data platforms.
* Strong understanding of bronze, silver, and gold data layer design, data modeling, data integration, and data quality frameworks.
* Proficiency in SQL, Python, Spark, and data pipeline development.
* Experience with schema management, incremental processing, partitioning, validation, reconciliation, and performance optimization.
* Ability to design analytics\-ready datasets and feature layers for actuarial, operational, financial, and business intelligence use cases.
* Strong understanding of data governance, access control, security, lineage, metadata, and documentation practices.
* Ability to translate business and actuarial requirements into robust technical data models and feature datasets.


**Client\-Facing And Consulting Skills**
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to engage client stakeholders confidently and professionally.
* Demonstrated ability to explain complex technical topics to business, actuarial, product, engineering, IT, and security stakeholders.
* Ability to understand client environments, ask structured discovery questions, identify business problems, and translate findings into solution options.
* Experience facilitating requirements gathering sessions, data discovery workshops, architecture discussions, and client presentations.
* Ability to develop clear documentation, executive\-level summaries, technical notes, solution narratives, and implementation recommendations.
* Strong consulting mindset with the ability to connect technical delivery to client outcomes, business value, operational improvement, and measurable impact.


**Solution Architecture and Business Alignment**
* Ability to design end\-to\-end data and analytics solutions spanning ingestion, transformation, storage, quality control, feature engineering, reporting, analytics, and operationalization.
* Strong capability to assess current\-state architecture and recommend pragmatic future\-state solutions.
* Ability to link client needs with Milliman solutions, accelerators, actuarial methods, analytics assets, and delivery capabilities.
* Understanding of how data and analytics solutions support business outcomes in insurance, healthcare, payer, provider, actuarial, claims, fraud, pricing, underwriting, risk, or operational environments.
* Ability to support proposal development, solution estimation, delivery planning, and technical sales conversations.


**Leadership, Ownership, and Mindset**
* Demonstrated ability to lead multidisciplinary teams while remaining hands\-on in architecture, data engineering, troubleshooting, and delivery.
* Strong ownership mindset with accountability for delivery outcomes, quality, timelines, and stakeholder satisfaction.
* Entrepreneurial and startup\-oriented mindset, with comfort working in ambiguous, evolving, and fast\-paced environments.
* Willingness to roll up sleeves and contribute directly to solution design, development, analysis, documentation, and issue resolution.
* Ability to motivate and guide teams toward shared goals, especially when requirements are evolving or delivery timelines are tight.
* Proactive problem solver who identifies risks early, removes blockers, and continuously improves delivery approach.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience working with insurance, actuarial, claims, pricing, underwriting, mobility, operational, or risk analytics data.
* Experience working in healthcare payer, provider, health insurance, actuarial consulting, fraud, waste and abuse, utilization management, or population health analytics environments.
* Experience working in a consulting, professional services, client advisory, or solution delivery environment.
* Experience leading client\-facing data modernization, cloud migration, analytics transformation, or data platform implementation initiatives.
* Experience integrating data from GCP or other cloud platforms into Azure or Microsoft Fabric environments.
* Familiarity with data governance, access control, security configuration, and compliance\-oriented data environments.
* Prior experience mentoring junior engineers or leading technical delivery in a cross\-functional product environment.
* Experience working with geographically distributed teams across consulting, actuarial, product, technology, and client delivery functions.
* Familiarity with Power BI, Azure DevOps, Git, CI/CD practices, data cataloging, metadata management, and cloud cost/performance optimization.


**Key Leadership Attributes**
* Be a strong communicator who can effectively engage both technical teams and executive stakeholders.
* Understand client environments and business challenges beyond technology alone.
* Actively identify opportunities to connect client needs with Milliman solutions, capabilities, and intellectual property.
* Balance strategic architecture thinking with hands\-on delivery execution.
* Thrive in a startup\-like environment that requires ownership, flexibility, initiative, and resourcefulness.
* Build high\-performing teams and drive collective success through collaboration, accountability, and leadership.
* Consistently focus on delivering measurable client outcomes and long\-term business value.


**Success Measures**
* Design and deliver a scalable, reliable, and well\-documented Microsoft Fabric\-based data architecture.
* Convert complex client data environments and business problems into practical, implementable solution designs.
* Build trust with client stakeholders through clear communication, structured problem solving, and credible technical leadership.
* Create analytics\-ready datasets that support actuarial and business use cases including pricing, underwriting, claims, fraud, and risk segmentation.
* Identify opportunities to connect client needs with Milliman analytical, actuarial, and technology capabilities.
* Lead junior engineers and cross\-functional teams toward high\-quality delivery outcomes.
* Operate with a hands\-on, entrepreneurial mindset while maintaining accountability for client value and delivery excellence.

Job Title: Lead Specialist, Solution Architect

**Role Summary** 



  

  


 As a Solution Architect (E30\), you will design and deliver new services on Microsoft Azure aligned with Pearson’s enterprise standards. Your remit includes the development of secure, scalable solution architectures, while ensuring integration across legacy on\-premise and AWS components where needed. You will collaborate with product owners, business analysts, delivery teams (including technical architects and developers) and external partners to convert business requirements into effective technical solutions. This includes evaluating solution options, estimating costs and ensuring that designs meet both functional and non\-functional requirements (e.g. security, performance, availability, scalability). Clear communication and stakeholder engagement are essential in this role.
 


  

  


**Key Responsibilities** 



  

  
* Solution Architecture Design: Lead the design of end\-to\-end solutions on Azure (and advise on on\-premise or AWS where needed), selecting optimal services and patterns to meet both functional and non\-functional requirements. Produce architecture blueprints, dataflows and interface specifications.
  

  
* Solution Option Analysis \& Cost Estimation: Work with business analysts and product owners to evaluate multiple solution options, ensuring the trade\-offs are understood. Provide cost and effort estimations (including infrastructure, licensing and operational considerations), and help recommend solutions that balance performance, scalability and total cost of ownership.
  

  
* Technical Leadership \& Governance: Serve as design authority throughout delivery. Provide guidance, mentoring and quality assurance to delivery teams and third\-party partners. Develop and refine architectural standards where gaps exist to ensure consistent best practices.
  

  
* Support Delivery Teams: Collaborate closely with delivery teams—including technical architects, developers, testers and DevOps engineers—to interpret and implement architecture designs correctly. Assist with troubleshooting technical issues, and ensure that Technical Architects and developers share a common understanding of architecture decisions and design patterns.
  

  
* Stakeholder Collaboration: Engage with product owners, business analysts, subject matter experts and external partners to refine requirements. Communicate complex technical concepts clearly to diverse audiences, ensuring alignment and shared understanding.
  

  
* Vendor Oversight: Work with third\-party delivery teams, reviewing their architectures, holding them accountable to Pearson’s standards and supporting them in meeting quality targets.
  

  
* Documentation \& Planning: Produce system diagrams, interface specifications and implementation roadmaps. Ensure design decisions are thoroughly documented and communicated.
  

  
* Innovation \& Continuous Improvement: Monitor industry trends and evaluate new technologies (e.g. infrastructure automation, AI, data platforms) for relevance to Pearson. Propose enhancements that support robust, modern and cost\-effective solutions.
  

  
* Compliance \& Security: Ensure all solutions comply with Pearson’s security and data privacy standards. Participate in design reviews and governance forums to ensure compliance with enterprise architecture policies.
  

  
* Lifecycle Support: Support implementation teams from development through deployment, addressing technical issues and ensuring solutions deliver the intended business value.
  


  


**Essential Experience \& Skills** 



  

  
* Extensive Solution Architecture Experience: Proven track record of designing and implementing complex enterprise solutions, with a strong emphasis on Azure cloud services and cloud\-native principles.
  

  
* Architecture \& Design Expertise: Ability to produce architecture blueprints, dataflows, integration diagrams and detailed specifications.
  

  
* Cloud Proficiency: Deep understanding of Azure compute, storage, networking, security and infrastructure\-as\-code (e.g. ARM, Terraform). Familiarity with cybersecurity best practices.
  

  
* Technical Leadership \& Collaboration: Experience overseeing design implementation, defining architectural standards and providing technical guidance to teams and vendors.
  

  
* Solution Analysis \& Cost Estimation: Ability to evaluate solution options and provide well\-reasoned recommendations based on technical fit, effort and cost.
  

  
* Stakeholder Engagement: Strong communication and interpersonal skills; able to articulate architecture rationale to technical and non\-technical stakeholders and foster alignment.
  

  
* Problem Solving \& Adaptability: Proven analytical skills and adaptability; comfortable working in dynamic environments and adjusting solutions as requirements evolve.
  

  
* Business Insight: Ability to balance technology decisions with business outcomes to ensure solutions deliver value.
  

  
* Education \& Certification: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field; Master’s degree and/or relevant certifications (e.g. BCS Intermediate Certificate in Enterprise Architecture, Azure Solutions Architect Expert) are highly regarded.
  


  


**Desirable Skills** 



  

  
* Knowledge of relational databases, data modelling and data analytics solutions.
  

  
* Familiarity with DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines and containerisation (e.g. Docker, Kubernetes).
  

  
* Experience with Agile methodologies, TDD and other modern development practices.
  

  
* Programming/scripting for automation (PowerShell, Python).
  

  
* Good understanding of AWS PaaS services (such as RDS/SQL, SNS, Aurora) to support integrated or legacy components.
  

  
* Understanding of business continuity and disaster recovery planning.
  

  
* Awareness of AI/ML and emerging technologies and their impact on architecture.
  


  


**Job Location and Hours** 



  

  


 The role is aligned to our Bangalore or Chennai offices in India, working a 45 hour week. All our roles are hybrid working; our current policy requires our team to work from their base office 3 times per week.

3e1c108e.title: SAP Cloud Platform & SSO Consultant
3e1c108e.description:
**About Position:** 




  





 We are seeking an experienced SAP Cloud Platform \& SSO Consultant to own and deliver administration, integration, monitoring, and support activities across SAP Cloud ALM, SAP Datasphere, SAP cloud services, and enterprise Single Sign\-On (SSO) environments. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in SAP cloud platforms, identity management, cloud connectivity, and security integration. In this role, you will work closely with security, infrastructure, application, and business teams to ensure secure, reliable, and efficient operation of SAP cloud environments. You will be responsible for cloud administration, access management, monitoring, troubleshooting, documentation, and customer\-facing advisory activities across enterprise SAP landscapes.
 



  




* **Role: SAP Cloud Platform \& SSO Consultant**
* **Location: Pune**
* **Experience: 5 to 8 Years**
* **Job Type: Full Time Employment**



  





**What You'll Do:** 




  




* Configure, administer, monitor, and support SAP Cloud ALM environments for implementation and operational use cases.
* Manage SAP Datasphere tenant administration, user access, connectivity, monitoring, and operational support activities.
* Administer SAP cloud services including Destinations, Connectivity Services, Certificates, Identity Services, Service Configurations.
* Design, configure, and support Single Sign\-On (SSO) solutions across SAP and enterprise applications.
* Configure and maintain trust relationships between SAP cloud applications and identity providers.
* Support Identity and Access Management activities including user provisioning, authentication, and authorization processes.
* Implement and troubleshoot SAML 2\.0, OAuth, and certificate\-based authentication mechanisms.
* Monitor cloud service health, performance, availability, and operational readiness.
* Investigate and resolve connectivity, access, authentication, and integration issues.
* Conduct root\-cause analysis and implement corrective actions for recurring incidents.
* Coordinate with security, network, infrastructure, functional, and application teams to resolve complex cross\-platform issues.
* Support incident, service request, change management, and release management activities.
* Develop implementation plans, configuration documentation, operational procedures, and support runbooks.
* Prepare testing evidence, implementation documents, and knowledge\-transfer materials.
* Participate in customer workshops and provide technical recommendations.
* Communicate project status, risks, dependencies, and operational updates to stakeholders.
* Identify automation opportunities and recommend service improvements.
* Ensure compliance with security, governance, and operational standards.



  





**Expertise You'll Bring:** 




  




* 5\-8 years of SAP technology experience with strong exposure to SAP cloud environments.
* Hands\-on experience administering SAP Cloud ALM.
* Experience supporting SAP Datasphere environments.
* Strong understanding of SAP cloud service administration and operations.
* Experience monitoring and managing cloud\-based SAP platforms.
* Ability to troubleshoot cloud platform and service\-related issues.
* Hands\-on experience with SAP Cloud ALM implementation and operational support.
* Experience managing monitoring, alerts, business processes, and operational dashboards.
* Knowledge of SAP Datasphere administration, connectivity, and access management.
* Experience supporting cloud analytics and data management environments.
* Familiarity with cloud monitoring and performance optimization practices.
* Strong understanding of enterprise identity and access management concepts.
* Hands\-on experience implementing and troubleshooting Single Sign\-On (SSO), SAML 2\.0, OAuth, Identity Federation, Trust Configuration, Certificate Management.
* Knowledge of user lifecycle and access governance processes.
* Experience with role\-based access control frameworks.
* Understanding of authentication and authorization models.
* Experience configuring and supporting secure cloud connectivity.
* Knowledge of Identity Providers (IdP), User Provisioning, Security Policies, Certificate Management, Secure Connectivity.
* Experience troubleshooting authentication and integration issues.
* Strong understanding of cloud security best practices and governance controls.
* Exposure to SAP Business Technology Platform (SAP BTP).
* Familiarity with SAP Identity Authentication Service (IAS), SAP Identity Provisioning Service (IPS), SAP Cloud Connector, Hybrid SAP Landscapes.
* Understanding of cloud integration concepts and enterprise connectivity requirements.
* Experience supporting integrated SAP and non\-SAP environments.
* Experience supporting Incident Management, Problem Management, Change Management, Release Management, Service Request Management.
* Knowledge of ITIL\-based operational processes.
* Experience maintaining operational documentation and knowledge repositories.
* Strong focus on service quality and operational excellence.



  





**Benefits:** 




  




* Competitive salary and benefits package
* Culture focused on talent development with quarterly growth opportunities and company\-sponsored higher education and certifications
* Opportunity to work with cutting\-edge technologies
* Employee engagement initiatives such as project parties, flexible work hours, and Long Service awards
* Annual health check\-ups
* Insurance coverage: group term life, personal accident, and Mediclaim hospitalization for self, spouse, two children, and parents

 Persistent is dedicated to fostering diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We invite applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities, and regardless of gender or gender preference. We welcome diverse candidates from all backgrounds.
 



  




* We support hybrid work and flexible hours to fit diverse lifestyles.
* Our office is accessibility\-friendly, with ergonomic setups and assistive technologies to support employees with physical disabilities.

dbc04920.title: Application Consultant-AWS Cloud
dbc04920.description:
**Introduction**
 A career in IBM Consulting is built on long\-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You’ll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you’ll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You’ll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long\-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences.
   

  

**Your Role And Responsibilities**
 As an Application Consultant for AWS Cloud, you will lead the implementation of architecture for omnichannel systems of engagement and utilize your strong understanding of software architecture fundamentals to drive project success. You will collaborate with clients to deliver successful projects, leveraging your proficiency in cloud implementation methodologies like the garage method.
   

  

**Your Primary Responsibilities Will Include**
* Implement Cloud Architecture: Lead the implementation of architecture for omnichannel systems of engagement, utilizing your knowledge of software architecture fundamentals and cloud native development principles to ensure successful project delivery.
* Collaborate with Clients: Work closely with clients to understand their needs and deliver tailored solutions, leveraging your strong communication and leadership skills to ensure effective collaboration and project success.
* Map Components to AWS Services: Utilize your experience with AWS to map existing components and functionalities to AWS\-specific services, ensuring seamless integration and optimal system performance.
* Develop Cloud Solutions: Apply your proficiency in technologies like Node.js, Spring Boot, or Netflix OSS to develop cloud solutions that meet client needs and adhere to cloud native development principles.
* Provide Technical Guidance: Offer technical guidance and support to clients, leveraging your knowledge of cloud computing fundamentals, containers, and serverless computing to help them make informed decisions about their cloud architecture.


**Preferred Education**
 Master's Degree
   

  

**Required Technical And Professional Expertise**
* Software Architecture Fundamentals: Exposure to software architecture fundamentals, including design patterns and principles, to lead the implementation of architecture for omnichannel systems of engagement.
* Cloud Implementation Methodologies: Proficiency in using the garage method for cloud implementation, with experience working with cloud native development principles, containers, and serverless computing fundamentals.
* API and Microservices Architecture: Experience working with API and Microservices\-based architecture implementation, with proficiency in at least one of the following technologies: Node.js, Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, or Netflix OSS.
* AWS Services Mapping: Experience with AWS, including the ability to map existing components/functionalities to AWS\-specific services, with a solid understanding of the advantages and disadvantages of related AWS Services.
* Cloud Development Technologies: Exposure to scripting technologies like JavaScript, CSS, and familiarity with Angular.js, with the ability to apply this knowledge to develop cloud solutions.


**Preferred Technical And Professional Experience**
* Familiarity with Scripting Technologies: Exposure to scripting technologies like JavaScript and CSS is beneficial for developing cloud solutions. Knowledge of these technologies can be applied to create tailored solutions for clients.
* Knowledge of Angular.js: Familiarity with Angular.js is advantageous for developing cloud solutions, allowing for more versatile and effective solutions to be delivered to clients.

8dc6a3b9.description:
Overview:

Planview has one mission: to close the gap between strategic intent and business outcome, providing the intelligence organizations need to act decisively.


As the global leader in Strategic Portfolio Management, Planview helps organizations of all sizes achieve their business goals, faster and smarter. Our comprehensive platform bring initiatives, investments, and resources into a continuous, connected model of the business: the actionable understanding leaders need to move decisively, keep teams and AI in lockstep, and know how their initiatives are performing.—now powered by Planview Anvi, our next\-generation enterprise AI that delivers expert guidance, intelligent recommendations, and actionable insights, turning complex data into decisive action from strategy through execution.


Recognized as a Leader in the 2026 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Strategic Portfolio Management for the fifth consecutive year, we proudly serve more than 3,000 customers globally, including 45% of the Fortune 100—and more than 3 million users worldwide.

**Why Join Planview?**


At Planview, our people’s connections drive our innovation and success. Our global team of 1,500\+ employees work remotely and across offices in Austin, Vancouver, Hod HaSharon, Bangalore, Sydney, and Stockholm. We've built a world\-class, connected culture rooted in shared values that empowers our teams to thrive and succeed from anywhere. When you join Planview, you're not just joining a company, you're joining a movement to transform how the world works.


Discover more about our portfolio at planview.com, and connect with us on LinkedIn, Instagram, and X.


Responsibilities:
* Support Planview SaaS applications: monitoring, delivery coordination, and reporting.
* Provide functional and technical support and troubleshooting for complex client issues and incidents, working trouble tickets, SQL jobs, and application\-level diagnostics (including IIS).
* Develop and maintain documentation for client systems, configurations, and procedures.
* Act as a subject matter expert on Planview's managed services offerings and capabilities.
* Collaborate with internal teams to develop and deliver client training programs and Planview functionality walkthroughs.
* Participate in client meetings and discussions to understand their business needs, challenges, and priorities.
* Assist in developing service improvement plans and initiatives for client accounts.
* Conduct regular health checks and performance assessments of client environments, including portfolio setup, configuration, and administration.
* Manage user access, security roles, and governance within client portfolios.
* Build reporting and dashboards (e.g., Power BI) to give clients visibility into portfolio health, risk, and performance.
* Maintain positive, trusted relationships with customers through proactive communication and reliable service delivery.

Qualifications:
* 2\+ years of experience in managed services, technical support, or SaaS application administration.
* Intermediate **SQL skills** (Oracle SQL or Microsoft SQL) and comfort troubleshooting web/application\-tier issues (e.g., IIS).
* Working knowledge of project/agile/lean portfolio management concepts and tools **(Planview, Clarity, CA PPM, JIRA, or similar).**
* Experience with reporting and dashboarding tools, Power BI preferred.
* Basic understanding of budgeting, forecasting, and financial analysis as they relate to portfolio management.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills; able to work independently as a subject matter expert for clients.
* Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent, or demonstrated equivalent experience.
* Willingness to work **shifts aligned to supported customer time zones (e.g., US or European hours).**

Great Benefits and Fun Perks:

At Planview, you’ll join our global team and culture which reflects the vibrant communities in which our employees live and work. To support you at Planview, you will enjoy:* Unplugged Days: 4 company\-wide paid days off per year to recharge and relax.
* Generous PTO offerings (region dependent).
* Region specific competitive benefit plans to support you at any life stage including parental leave, retirement, medical plans, wellness support, and remote work support.
* Paid time to volunteer through Planview’s Force for Good Week.
* Employee Referral bonus program.
* Weekly office lunches for hybrid team members and social events.
* Flexible work hours/environment.


Now is a great time to join our team. If you are looking for a place to grow your career, innovate with best\-in\-class solutions, and build the future of connected work, Planview is the right place for you!

51973dbb.description:

 The JIRA ITSM \& ServiceNow eBonding Lead is responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining bi\-directional integration (eBonding) between JIRA Service Management (JSM), ServiceNow, and customer ITSM platforms. * Design and implement bi\-directional ticket synchronization between JIRA ITSM, ServiceNow, and customer ITSM tools.
* Configure REST/SOAP API integrations for Incident, Problem, Change, Request, CMDB, and Knowledge modules.
* Define field mappings, status mappings, priority translations, and workflow synchronization rules.
* Implement attachment exchange, comments synchronization, and audit trail management.



 Integration Administration
 


* Configure authentication mechanisms including OAuth, Mutual Authentication, API Keys, and Basic Authentication.
* Manage integration middleware and API gateways where applicable.
* Monitor integration health and resolve synchronization failures.
* Maintain integration documentation and support knowledge transfer activities.



 ITSM Process Governance
 


* Support Incident, Problem, Change, Request Fulfillment, Knowledge, and Asset Management processes.
* Ensure SLA and OLA adherence across interconnected ticketing systems.
* Support CAB activities and Change Management governance.
* Establish operational runbooks and escalation procedures.



 Technical Skills

* JIRA Service Management (JSM)
* ServiceNow ITSM
* REST APIs \& Web Services
* JSON/XML payload handling
* OAuth/SAML/API Security
* ITSM Integration \& eBonding solutions
* Microsoft Azure
* Azure Compute, Networking, Identity \& Access Management, Storage, Security, Monitoring, Automation, and DevOps



 Azure Technical Skills
 


* **Compute:** 
 Azure VM, VMSS, Availability Set, Availability Zones
* **Networking:** 
 VNet, NSG, Load Balancer, VPN Gateway, ExpressRoute
* **Identity:** 
 Azure AD (Entra ID), MFA, RBAC

 Blob Storage, File Shares, Managed Disks
* **Monitoring:** 
 Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Grafana
* **Automation:** 
 Terraform, ARM Templates, Azure CLI, PowerShell
* **Containers:** 
 AKS, Docker, Kubernetes
* **DevOps:** 
 Azure DevOps, Jenkins, CI/CD
* **DR \& Backup:** 
 Azure Backup, Site Recovery



 ITSM Modules
 



 Experience configuring:
 


* Incident Management
* Problem Management
* Change Management
* CMDB / Assets
* Knowledge Management



 Experience
 


* 7–12 years of overall ITSM experience.
* 3–5\+ years of JIRA Service Management administration.
* 3–5\+ years of ServiceNow administration/integration experience.
* 5–7 years of experience working with Microsoft Azure and cloud infrastructure.
* Experience delivering enterprise\-scale eBonding implementations between customer and service provider ITSM platforms.



 Good to Have Certifications
 


* Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate (AZ\-104\)
* Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ\-305\)
* Microsoft Certified: Azure Security Engineer Associate (AZ\-500\)
* Terraform Associate (Optional)

**Job Summary**
 Responsible for the management, operations, delivery and support of defined IT applications and/or infrastructure services; directs and coordinates the efforts of people to accomplish goals and objectives using available resources.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 Contributes to the delivery and support of specific IT services. Supports the development and maintenance of services and ensures that tools and resources are capable and available (i.e. IT Service Catalog, Asset Management system) Generates and reports service delivery metrics and drives standards across regions and locations (i.e. Scorecards, Service Level Agreement (SLAs) and Customer Satisfaction or Net Promoter Scoring). Acts as a point of contact for customers for service related inquiries and maintains relationships with key customers and suppliers. Is familiar with SLA / Operational Level Agreements between other IT Services Provided. Encourages root cause analysis using the formal problem solving approach for recurring issues. Champions the use of Six Sigma to reduce costs and improve processes. Identifies opportunities for service improvements, discuss with the customer and raise the request for change for assessment if appropriate Maintains the accuracy of service related standards, procedures and work instructions in a knowledge management system. Able to support the Service Owner when needed. Champions the use of ITIL Standards for IT Service Deliverables Maintain strong relationships to deliver business value using relevant Business Relationship Management practices.
   

  

**Competencies**
 Financial acumen \- Interpreting and applying understanding of key financial indicators to make better business decisions.
   

  

 Balances stakeholders \- Anticipating and balancing the needs of multiple stakeholders.
   

  

 Customer focus \- Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer\-centric solutions.
   

  

 Global perspective \- Taking a broad view when approaching issues, using a global lens.
   

  

 IT Supplier Relationships \- Leverages a vendor management framework to manage strategic supplier relationships and supplier performance based on business need throughout the contract life using the required processes and tools to control costs, drive service excellence, mitigate risks, and gain increased value from the suppliers.
   

  

 Request Fulfillment \- Manages a service request through its life cycle with efficiency and professionalism using the required processes and tools to maintain customer satisfaction.
   

  

 Service Asset and Configuration Management \- Manages service assets and configuration items by maintaining accurate configuration records to support other service management processes with documented and verifiable information.
   

  

 Service Catalog Management \- Maintains a service catalog that contains all details of active and approved services in service operations using the required processes and tools to provide clear and relevant information to users.
   

  

 Service Level Management \- Ensures the quality of the services delivered meet agreed levels using the required processes and tools in order to maintain customer satisfaction.
   

  

 Troubleshooting \- Diagnoses and resolves the customer\-identified issue by utilizing appropriate department standards to satisfy customer expectations.
   

  

 Problem Solving \- Solves problems and may mentor others on effective problem solving by using a systematic analysis process by leveraging industry standard methodologies to create problem traceability and protect the customer; determines the assignable cause; implements robust, data\-based solutions; identifies the systemic root causes and ensures actions to prevent problem reoccurrence are implemented.
   

  

 Values differences \- Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.
   

  

**Education, Licenses, Certifications**
 College, university, or equivalent degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business, or related subject, or relevant equivalent experience required. This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.
   

  

**Experience**
 Intermediate level of relevant work experience required. 5\+ years of experience.
   

  

* Owns global operational accountability for SAP S/4HANA Service Management processes and supporting capabilities.
* Oversees service process performance, operational efficiency, customer service outcomes, warranty and contract execution support, service parts integration, and service business insights.
* Partners with service business leaders, process owners, field service teams, aftermarket operations, regional stakeholders, and delivery teams to improve process performance and adoption.
* Governs incidents, problems, enhancements, and operational risks impacting service execution, customer commitments, warranty performance, technician enablement, and service operations.
* Drives continuous improvement opportunities across service order management, service execution, service parts processes, customer support, and service reporting.Common Functional Operations Framework
* Run: Assures stable production operations, effective incident and problem management, and reliable service performance.
* Improve: Drives continuous improvement, process optimization, standardization, automation, and reduction of manual effort.
* Govern: Oversees Service Assurance, enhancement demand, release readiness, operational risk, and service provider performance.
* Measure: Uses business insights, SAP analytics, Signavio, Business Process Insights, and operational metrics to inform decisions.
* Transform: Shapes the functional operations roadmap, reduces technical debt, and influences future capability evolution through lessons learned from production operations.

ccbd3aed.title: Associate Program Manager
ccbd3aed.description:
Koita Foundation is committed to helping NGOs scale effectively and accelerating digital health adoption in India. Over the past five years, Koita Foundation has worked closely with over a dozen NGOs across the education, healthcare, and livelihood segments to help them digitally transform their operations. As part of its Digital Health initiative, Koita Foundation partners with leading academic institutions, hospitals, healthcare technology companies, and NGOs to drive digital health adoption in India.
  
Associate Program Manager
  
**Location :** Mumbai


**Koita Foundation Overview**

Koita Foundation is a not\-for\-profit organization founded 7 years ago by Rizwan Koita and Rekha Koita. Rizwan is the current chairperson of NABH and the co\-founder \& ex\-CEO of CitiusTech (www.citiustech.com), a global leader in healthcare technology and one of the Unicorns in India. Rizwan (an alumnus of IIT Bombay and MIT) is the recipient of the prestigious Ernst \& Young Entrepreneur of the Year Award (2013\) and the recipient of the 2002 Indo\-American Society's ‘Young Achievers Award in Business’. Rekha (LinkedIn), a recipient of IIT Bombay’s Distinguished Services Award in 2019, is a corporate trainer and specializes in business process consulting. Koita Foundation focuses on two key areas \- Digital Health and NGO Transformation.


**Digital Health:** KF partners with leading academic institutions, hospitals, healthcare technology companies, and NGOs to drive Digital Health adoption in India. In 2021, KF partnered with IIT Bombay, India’s \#1 academic institution, to establish the Koita Centre for Digital Health (www.kcdh.iitb.ac.in ). In 2022, KF partnered with Tata Memorial Centre and National Cancer Grid to establish the Koita Centre for Digital Oncology (www.kcdo.in). In 2024, KF partnered with the Research Society for the Study of Diabetes in India (RSSDI) to establish the Koita Centre for Digital Diabetology ( KCDD). KF is working on multiple Digital Health initiatives on a national scale, e.g., working with the Government of India’s ABDM initiative (www.abdm.gov.in) on their national roll\-out, supporting NABH (www.nabh.co), India’s large accreditation body for hospitals, with their Digital Health initiatives.


NGO Transformation: Koita Foundation works with NGOs with proven operating models and collaborates with them to scale effectively. KF helps NGOs to digitally transform their operations and use advanced data and analytics to drive organizational performance and impact, which are key success factors for sustainable growth. KF today works with over a dozen NGOs across healthcare, education, and livelihood segments.


**Associate Program Manager**


We are searching for a Associate Program Manager to help us maintain our position as a leader in driving Digital Health adoption in India. The ideal candidate will be a passionate individual with Digital Health knowledge and strong skills in developing and overseeing work plans. The Associate Program Manager will also prepare and present updates regularly to relevant management channels, ensuring that our goal of Digital Health adoption is being achieved.


Key responsibilities include some of the following:


* Oversee and manage strategic Digital Health initiatives in collaboration with academic institutions, hospitals, and NGOs.
* Build and maintain relationships with partners such as IIT Bombay, Tata Memorial Centre, National Cancer Grid, RSSDI, and government agencies like the National Health Authorities.
* Plan, execute, and monitor multiple Digital Health projects, ensuring timely delivery and alignment with organizational goals.
* Drive the development and implementation of long\-term strategies for Digital Health adoption in India.
* Coordinate large\-scale initiatives, such as supporting the national roll\-out of ABDM and NABH’s Digital Health programs.
* Collaborate with academic and healthcare partners to develop the outline of cutting\-edge Digital Health solutions, including oncology, diabetology, and other specialized areas.
* Establish metrics to assess the impact and effectiveness of Digital Health programs.
* Prepare detailed progress reports and presentations for internal and external stakeholders.

**Desired Profile**


* A professional with a minimum of 1\-4 years of experience in area of healthcare/ digital health.
* Motivated to work in the development sector with a not\-for\-profit organization.
* Experience working on chronic disease management projects is preferred.
* Master's degree in public health, hospital administration, healthcare management, business administration, or a related field preferred.

**Skills and Attributes**


* Demonstrated experience in project management or related roles, preferably in healthcare, Digital Health tools and technologies, or healthcare\-focused nonprofit organizations.
* Strong organizational and analytical skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and meet deadlines.
* Experience in crafting detailed reports, presentations, and stakeholder communication.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage effectively with diverse stakeholders.
* Preferred \- Familiarity with technologies relevant to digital health, such as HIS/EMR solutions, telemedicine, etc.

**ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD.**
 At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future.
   

  

 Whether you’re designing next\-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we’ll advance your career.
   

  

**The Role**
 We are seeking an experienced and dynamic Program Manager to join our Custom ASIC/SOC Development Group. In this role, you will lead high\-impact technical programs from concept through tapeout to post\-silicon validation. You’ll manage cross\-functional execution across RTL, verification, physical design, packaging, and bring\-up, delivering complex SoC solutions to our global partners.

* Own and drive SoC program execution from requirements through tapeout.
* Develop detailed plans of record, schedule, deliverables, resources, risks, and mitigation strategies.
* Coordinate across IP, SoC front\-end, back\-end, validation, test, and packaging teams.
* Act as the central point of contact for program status, issues, risks, and escalations—internally and externally.
* Monitor and communicate progress using dashboards, KPIs, Gantt charts, and performance metrics.
* Ensure quality gates are met and engineering change requests are tracked and resolved promptly.
* Collaborate with engineering leads to make technical tradeoffs and align with design goals.
* Facilitate executive reporting and program reviews.
* Promote best practices in program execution and risk management.


**Preferred Experience**
* Experience in managing multiple SoC programs in domains like mobile, compute, automotive, AI, etc.
* PMP certification or equivalent program/project management training.
* Familiarity with program tools such as MS Project, JIRA, Confluence, Power BI, or equivalent.
* Executive communication experience and ability to influence across technical and business functions.

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electronics, Electrical, or Computer Science Engineering.
* 10\+ years of experience in the semiconductor industry with 5\-8 years in technical program management.
* Strong hands\-on exposure in SoC design flows, IP development, integration, Verification/Validation, DFT, STA, physical design, and tapeout.

Monitors and drives the program from initiation through delivery, interfacing with internal and external stakeholders across functions on technical matters, as needed. Monitors budget/spending, on\-time delivery, and achievement of program milestones. Represents the program and drives alignment across stakeholders.

* Collaborates with key stakeholders and program sponsors to develop program goals, set the prioritization of deliverables, discuss involvement of business processes (e.g., program change management, communication) and drives decisions necessary for on time delivery.

8a5576d3.title: Solutions Consultant & Pre-sales
8a5576d3.description:
****FinBox: Where Fintech Meets Fun!****
 Welcome to FinBox, the buzzing hive of tech innovation and creativity!
   

  

 Since our inception in 2017, FinBox has built some of the most advanced technologies in the financial services space that help lenders like Banks, NBFCs and large enterprises build and launch credit products within a matter of days, not months or years. FinBox is a Series B funded company which is expanding globally with offices in India, Vietnam, Indonesia and Philippines.
   

  

 Our vision is to build the best\-in\-class infrastructure for lending products and help Banks \& Financial Services companies across the world scale and launch credit programs that set a new standard in the era of digital finance. So far, we’ve helped our customers disburse Billions of Dollars in credit across unsecured and secured credit including personal loans, working capital loans, business loans, mortgage and education loans. FinBox solutions are already being used by over 100\+ companies to deliver credit to over 5 million customers every month.
   

  

**Why Should You Be a FinBoxer**
* Innovative Environment: At FinBox, we foster a culture of creativity and experimentation, encouraging our team to push the boundaries of what's possible in fintech.
* Impactful Work: Your contributions will directly impact the lives of millions, helping to provide fair and accessible credit to individuals and businesses alike.
* Growth Opportunities: We are a Series B funded startup and have ample opportunities for growth, professional development and career advancement.
* Collaborative Culture: Join a diverse and inclusive team of experts who are passionate about making a difference and supporting one another.


****Who’s a Great FinBoxer:****
 At FinBox, we’re on the lookout for exceptional folks who are all about innovation and impact. If you’re excited to shake things up in the banking \& financial services world, keep reading!
   

  

**Creative Thinkers:** 
 If your brain is always bubbling with out\-of\-the\-box ideas and wild solutions, you’re our kind of person. We love disruptors who challenge the norm and bring fresh perspectives to the table.
   

  

**Customer Heroes:** 
 Our customers are our champions, and we need heroes who can understand their needs, deliver magical experiences, and go above and beyond to keep them happy.
   

  

**Team Players:** 
 We believe in the power of “we.” If you thrive in a collaborative environment, value different viewpoints, and enjoy being part of a spirited, supportive team, you’ll fit right in.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As a Solutions Consultant in Solutions Consulting and Pre\-Sales for International Markets, you will work in tandem with the Account team to build and deliver a winning value proposition for potential customers. The winning value proposition will include, but not be limited to, activities such as solution discovery discussions, RFX (RFP/RFI etc.) responses, crafting POVs/value propositions/solution approaches, and delivering right\-fit and contextual solution demos.
   

  

 You will partner with Account Executives to win and grow strategic accounts by translating FinBox’s credit infrastructure and risk intelligence platforms into outcome\-driven solutions for Banks, NBFCs and Fintech lenders. You will lead discovery, solution design, and buyer\-centric demos that showcase how FinBox can accelerate digital lending, embedded credit, and partnership lending programs while meeting regulatory and risk objectives.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Conduct deep discovery on customer journeys, tech stack, credit policies, and partnership models to identify value levers for FinBox solutions.
* Design end\-to\-end solution architectures using FinBox APIs and platforms (Prism, BRE, Risk Intelligence, Credit Infrastructure) aligned to business, risk, and compliance needs.
* Build and deliver tailored demos, PoCs, and walkthroughs that move conversations from features to measurable business outcomes (AUM growth, GNPA control, time\-to\-market, unit economics).
* Create solution decks, configuration documents, and proposal inputs (scopes, assumptions, phasing) for RFPs/RFIs and large pursuits in partnership with Account Executives.
* Act as the primary technical and product point of contact in deals, handling queries from business, risk, product, technology, InfoSec, and operations stakeholders on the customer side.
* Support commercial negotiations with solution\-level clarification, effort estimates, and rollout plans, ensuring feasibility and success metrics are clearly defined.
* Work closely with Account Executives, Sales, Product, Engineering and Delivery teams to drive opportunities forward and ensure strong alignment throughout the sales cycle.
* Document agreed architectures, configurations, and success KPIs, and ensure smooth handover to Delivery / Customer Success teams after deal closure.
* Continuously channel client and market feedback into Product and Engineering to influence roadmap for risk models, decisioning, and embedded credit capabilities.
* Develop a strong understanding of customer and market needs across international markets and translate these insights into actionable recommendations for internal teams.
* Collaborate closely with regional sales heads, account managers, Account Executives and inside sales/SDR teams to understand opportunities, prioritize pursuits and develop winning solution strategies.
* Contribute to the development and refinement of solutioning approaches, presales playbooks, demo narratives and reusable assets to improve the effectiveness and scalability of the presales function.
* Independently own and drive solutioning for strategic opportunities while collaborating with internal stakeholders to ensure timely and high\-quality outcomes.


**What We’re Looking For**
* 5–10 years of overall experience, with minimum 5 years of hands\-on Pre\-Sales / Solutions Consulting experience.
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate technical detail into simple, outcome\-focused narratives for CXO, business, and technology stakeholders.
* Strong problem\-solving and solutioning mindset with exposure to digital lending, LOS/LMS, bureau data, and embedded finance models.
* Exposure to international markets such as MENA, Africa and APAC.
* Ability to run discovery workshops, design solution architectures, and drive PoCs under tight timelines while collaborating closely with Sales, Product, and Engineering.
* Strong ability to independently manage multiple opportunities and work effectively with cross\-functional teams in a fast\-paced environment.
* Ability to operate as a hands\-on individual contributor and take ownership of complex enterprise opportunities from discovery through solution design, demo/PoC and deal closure.

 At Check Point, what you do matters. Every day, we protect over 100,000 organizations worldwide from increasingly sophisticated cyber and AI\-driven threats, securing their AI transformation.
   

  

 Our prevention\-first approach safeguards hybrid networks, cloud environments, digital workspaces, and AI systems, stopping attacks before they happen.

 \#aws\-ags\-India

Entering the agreement cycle during the technical evaluation phase for strategic accounts, you will ensure that solutions are shaped strictly through the lens of adoption, rapid activation, and viable delivery. You will be the overarching Enterprise Architect and Technical Delivery Manager charting the course. You will also be responsible for technical design, systemic debugging, product and engineering integration, and strategic FDE alignment. You will architect how these technical marvels actually integrate into the customer's IT ecosystem (connectors, identity, data residency, legal constraints) and drive the technical delivery strategy from start to finish.
   

  

 Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise\-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting\-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Partner with Account teams and practice Customer Engineer (CEs) during technical evaluation phases to assess project feasibility, shape proposals for long\-term adoption, and validate FDE engagement requests.
* Lead upfront technical design for enterprise\-grade AI solutions, ensuring seamless and secure integration of models, agents, and connectors into existing customer data pipelines, identity providers, and compliance boundaries.
* Dive into code\-level context to diagnose and resolve complex customer implementation issues, identify core product bugs, and test workarounds to clear execution roadblocks.
* Serve as the definitive liaison to core Product and Engineering teams, troubleshooting systemic deployment blockers and translating real\-world field feedback into actionable feature requests.
* Steer implementation strategy through technical authority and architectural foresight while owning the technical reality of delivery alongside customer\-facing teams.

388c0a77.description:
About This Role
**15 to 20 years of experience**  

**Skills: Solution Architecture, Enterprise Architecture, Supply Chain Finance, Cloud\-Native Architecture, Microservices, API Design, Event\-Driven Architecture, Payments, Core Banking, TOGAF / ArchiMate, Monolithic to Microservices Migration, Stakeholder Management, ISO 20022, Basel III, Roadmap Planning**

**About the Role**
  

We are seeking an experienced Solution Architect with 15\+ years of overall experience and 5\+ years in Solution and / or Enterprise Architecture. You will define target state architectures and high\-level designs for Supply Chain Finance — aligned to the bank's strategy and enterprise architecture guidelines — covering all relevant architecture dimensions including business, application, data, and technology. You will work across multiple stakeholder groups, domains, and geographies to deliver end\-to\-end solution designs that meet immediate business outcomes while progressing the long\-term enterprise architecture vision.  

  



**Key Skills and experience:**


* Proficient in defining the target state architecture and high\-level design for the assigned scope based on business outcomes and aligned with the bank's strategy. The target architecture and solution should cover all relevant dimensions – business, application, data and technology architecture.
* Domain \- Proficient in Trade Finance domain along with deep understanding of integration to Payments and Core Banking platform.
* Proficient in Cloud Native Architecture, Microservices design patterns, API design, Event\-Driven Architecture and Database concepts. Expected to have good understanding of monolithic to microservices migration.
* Ability to work with multiple stakeholders across multiple functional areas, domains and geographies, to define the strategic architecture for a given area.
* Analysis of options and delivery of end\-to\-end solution designs using the relevant building blocks making sure the implementation delivers both the immediate business outcomes and moves us towards the longer\-term enterprise architecture outcomes.
* Good communication and negotiation skills
* Preferrable to have knowledge and experience of Industry Architecture Frameworks: TOGAF, ArchiMate etc.
* Preferrable to have knowledge and experience of global and regional regulatory frameworks (e.g., Basel III, PSD2, ISO 20022\).

**Key Responsibilities:**


* Current State analysis – Collaborate with business, product owners, architects and technical SMEs from different areas to understand and document the current state architecture, pain points, objectives and strategy from different stakeholders.
* Architectural Strategy – Define target state architectural strategy for Trade Finance in\-line with bank’s strategy and enterprise architecture guidelines.
* Solution Development – Define target state solution architecture, design end\-to\-end architectural views and processes for the given scope.
* Roadmap options evaluation – Document different roadmap options, analysis of different options and define end\-to\-end roadmap for the recommended option.
* Implementation roadmap – Define high\-level implementation roadmap for the given scope and document impacts to other domains, ROM, dependencies, risk etc.
* Review and sign\-off of the target state and roadmap with relevant stakeholders.

94d87263.title: Sr. Pricipal, Architect Solutions
94d87263.description:
**About Northern Trust**
 As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.
   

  

 Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.
   

  

 With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.
   

  

**Sr Principal Solution Architect**
**Location:** 
 Pune
   

  

**Job Description AND PrinciplE Responsibilities**
 Senior Solution Architect will architect and guide delivery of solutions that meet strategic and tactical needs across channels and platforms. Will own the technical roadmap, manage technical risks, ensure alignment with enterprise architecture standards, and partner with engineering and security teams to deliver secure, scalable, and maintainable solutions. Senior Solution Architect is also responsible to design technical roadmap and processes. Design and develop change resilient application code and execute robust and effective testing. Manage project execution to ensure expected business requirements and related benefits are delivered within appropriate time/budget parameters with a product mindset. Comply with Technology mandates as they relate to methodology, process, and compliance.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Architecture \& Solution Design
   

  

* Architect solutions to meet strategic/tactical technical needs; drive end\-to\-end solution design for initiatives and enhancements.
* Ensure non\-functional requirements are incorporated into overall solution architecture (e.g., reliability, performance, maintainability, supportability).
* Define interactions between systems/components to optimize functional coverage and integration.


 Roadmap, Risk \& Standards
   

  

* Create and maintain a technical capability roadmap; own technical risks and mitigation approaches associated with features and technologies.
* Ensure alignment with architectures defined within the division and across the enterprise; ensure enterprise technical standards are met.
* Evaluate technologies/products/solutions and recommend introduction, retirement, or phase\-out aligned to roadmap and enterprise direction.


 Security \& Governance
   

  

* Coordinate and address security architecture requirements in partnership with enterprise security teams.
* Support governance/approval readiness by ensuring architecture diagrams reflect implemented reality; ensure monitoring/logging posture and enterprise pipeline usage evidence is in place when required.


 Engineering Leadership \& Collaboration
   

  

* Lead developers in creation/review of new or enhanced software and provide technical guidance through design and implementation decisions.
* Engage business partners to understand requirements; translate business needs into technical solutions and communicate recommendations to stakeholders.
* Collaborate closely with Business Architects/Product teams to ensure technical architecture supports business objectives.
* Collaborate with Enterprise Architects to ensure technical standards are defined (as needed) and implemented by the multiple Agile teams in accounting


**Qualifications/ Education \& Experience**
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science/engineering (or equivalent experience).
* 15\+ years of significant experience in solution architecture and delivery in complex environments (multi\-team, cross\-functional).
* 5\+ years in Finance domain, 2\+ in Investment domain within Finance. Custody domains experience a huge plus


**Core Skills**
* Strong solution design skills across application/integration/data/platform layers; ability to make tradeoffs and drive decisions.
* Strong stakeholder management, communication, decision\-making, and ability to prioritize multiple tasks under timelines.
* Ability to drive alignment to enterprise standards and ensure maintainability/supportability of solutions.
* Strong oral and written communication skills
* Experience in modern delivery methods (Agile) and guiding engineering teams through architecture and design decisions.
* Proven skills in building massive scale Cloud Native streaming apps that are resilient and elastically scalable and have built\-in redundancy.
* Experience coordinating security architecture and compliance expectations for enterprise solutions.


**Experience In Tech Stacks**
* Experience in programming languages (preferably Java) with hands\-on coding
* Experience in Azure Cloud, Terraform. Microservices (Container, Docker, Kubernetes, Cosmos DB), Backup and Disaster Recovery.
* Warehouse, Azure SQL, PostgreSQL.
* Azure DevOps \- GIT, CI/CD Pipeline / GitActions
* Azure Security and Governance \- Manage Identity, SAS, Microsoft Defender, Sentinel, Application Gateway, Application Security Group, Web App Security, Dynamic Data Masking
* Proven problem solving and organizational skills with strong interpersonal and team management skills


**Working with Us**
 As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.
   

  

 Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.
   

  

**Reasonable Accommodation**
 Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.
   

  

**About Our Pune Office**
 The Northern Trust Pune office, established in 2016, is now home to over 3,000 employees. The office handles various functions, including Operations for Asset Servicing and Wealth Management, as well as delivering critical technology solutions that support business operations across the globe.
   

  

 Our Pune team takes our commitment to service to heart. In 2024, they volunteered more than 10,000\+ hours into the communities where they live and work. Learn more.
