**We help the world run better**
 At SAP, we keep it simple: you bring your best to us, and we'll bring out the best in you. We're builders touching over 20 industries and 80% of global commerce, and we need your unique talents to help shape what's next. The work is challenging – but it matters. You'll find a place where you can be yourself, prioritize your wellbeing, and truly belong. What's in it for you? Constant learning, skill growth, great benefits, and a team that wants you to grow and succeed.
   

  

**What You'll Build**
 The digital Customer Engagement Manager (dCEM) is responsible for E2E customer engagement and delivery of contractual agreement and services for SAP Cloud Customers of SAP Global cloud operations, mainly focusing on SAP S/4HANA, private cloud edition deliverables.
   

  

 This role will primarily focus on customer onboarding scenarios, including system migrations and conversions from SAP ECC to SAP S/4HANA within the SAP private cloud landscape. The dCEM acts as the customer ambassador and primary point of contact, orchestrating migration projects, onboarding activities, and ongoing service delivery while ensuring customer satisfaction and successful adoption of RISE with SAP.
   

  

 The role requires strong SAP technical and migration expertise, combined with customer engagement and project management capabilities, to guide customers through complex cloud transformation journeys into the RISE with SAP.
   

  

 The dCEM oversees the customer lifecycle from the moment of contract signing, particularly customer onboarding, migration activities, continuous service delivery, release and maintenance project initiation, change management, and renewal support for a range of customers. The dCEM is also expected to maintain customer satisfaction through issue mitigation and escalation management and helping customers maximize the value of their partnership with SAP. The dCEM manages a variety of technical and engagement aspects during the various phases of a range of customer’s lifecycle. They will work in seamless collaboration with sales \& pre\-sales team and, SAP Global cloud operations internal delivery teams for the committed scope of delivery throughout the customer engagement lifecycle. This role also provides expert support in operations and facilitates the service lifecycle.
   

  

 In this role, you will be responsible for driving successful onboarding of customers transitioning to SAP Global Cloud Operations, particularly those undergoing On\-premise to Cloud migrations, ECC to S/4HANA conversions and RISE with SAP transformation programs.
   

  

 You will collaborate closely with SAP sales, presales, migration factories, delivery teams, and customer stakeholders to ensure successful execution of migration projects and stable post\-go\-live operations.
   

  

**Key Tasks Comprise The Following**
* Supports sales to delivery handover and supervise the delivery of services outlined in the customer contract.
* Orchestrate customer onboarding and migration activities for Brownfield customers moving to SAP Private Cloud Environment.
* Support downtime optimized migration strategies and coordinate with technical delivery teams to ensure minimal disruption to customer business operations.
* Orchestrates the overall service/project delivery according to planned scope, budget, and milestones.
* Supports critical customer situations in conjunction with Major Incident Management (MIM), SAP Global Cloud Operations Customer Escalation Team and SAP Product Support, as applicable.
* Supports customers on technical requirements throughout their lifecycle within the SAP Global Cloud Operations scope of engagement.
* Monitor project milestones, delivery timelines, and key risks to ensure successful project execution.
* Support customer satisfaction surveys (CSAT)


**What You Bring**
* 5 \- 7 years of work experience as SAP technical consultant with 2\+ years in a customer\-facing role (consulting, IT support, IT services, etc.)
* Hands on experience with SAP Basis activities, SAP brownfield migrations, and infrastructure updates for cloud customers.
* Strong experience in SAP system migrations and conversions, particularly SAP system migrations to cloud environments (RISE PCE)
* Hands\-on experience with SAP migration approaches, including conversion : DMO Move to S/4 HANA, SWPM on migration using Backup/Restore, Migration using HANA Replication, and Selective Data Migration.
* Must have exposure to SAP private cloud deployments on Hyperscaler, Azure/ AWS (in context of SAP Green Field and Brown Field Customers)
* Excellent customer focus / Networking / Relationship Building /Results\-driven / Self\-organized / Decision making.
* An individual in this role is expected to deliver ‘Effective customer communication’ using digital mediums to achieve high customer satisfaction. Strong knowledge of IT Service Management, SAP Basis, and SAP Application.
* Good understanding of ECSs operations infrastructure, processes, and automation tools like SPC, TIC, etc. is a plus.
* Proficiency in English (Written and verbal)


**Where You Belong**
 The SAP Global Cloud Operations (GCO) organization is a business unit responsible for providing cloud\-hosted infrastructure and application management services to SAP customers around the world in a 24x7 operations model. Our portfolio of private cloud solutions turns SAP products into a solution\-as\-a\-service on customer’s preferred infrastructure, including Hyperscaler, as one SAP. The portfolio is at the center of the SAP strategy to help customers on their journey to use SAP S/4HANA and become an Intelligent Enterprise.
   

  

 As part of ECS, the SAP Global Cloud Operations Private Cloud Customer Center, or PC3, is a shared services organization dedicated to managing service delivery at scale for high\-volume, low\-touch, private cloud customers.
   

  

 Because we are at the heart of the SAP strategy, our business unit is growing rapidly. In order to facilitate that growth, we are looking for people with diverse technical and customer engagement backgrounds to join our Center of Expertise around the world. You will become part of a great team of smart technical and customer engagement professionals, where there are great opportunities for growth and there is tremendous potential for specialized development of your skills.
   

  

 \#SAPECSCareers \#SAPInternalT2
   

  

**Bring out your best**
 SAP innovations help more than four hundred thousand customers worldwide work together more efficiently and use business insight more effectively. Originally known for leadership in enterprise resource planning (ERP) software, SAP has evolved to become a market leader in end\-to\-end business application software and related services for database, analytics, intelligent technologies, and experience management. As a cloud company with two hundred million users and more than one hundred thousand employees worldwide, we are purpose\-driven and future\-focused, with a highly collaborative team ethic and commitment to personal development. Whether connecting global industries, people, or platforms, we help ensure every challenge gets the solution it deserves. At SAP, you can bring out your best.

cb3ea9fb.title: T&T Program Manager
cb3ea9fb.description:
**Job Description**
===================

The Transition and Transformation Program Manager will lead complex, multi\-tower programs across cloud, infrastructure, cybersecurity, workplace, network, data center, and managed services portfolios. The role is accountable for transition strategy, governance, execution control, stakeholder alignment, operational readiness, and a smooth handover into steady\-state operations.


The role also requires proven experience in merger and acquisition driven technology transitions, including integration planning, Day\-1 readiness, TSA governance, divestiture support, carve\-out planning, and risk management across acquiring and acquired organizations.


**Key Accountabilities**
------------------------

* Lead end\-to\-end transition and transformation programs across multiple service towers, geographies, and customer environments.
* Own transition strategy, mobilization approach, governance model, delivery framework, success criteria, KPIs, and milestone tracking.
* Participate in RFPs, solution shaping, transition estimation, planning assumptions, and customer transition discussions.
* Drive program execution across transition managers, tower leads, solution teams, delivery teams, customer stakeholders, vendors, and partner teams.
* Lead merger, acquisition, divestiture, carve\-out, and separation transition planning, including integration roadmap, Day\-1 readiness, TSA exit plan, risk closure, and controlled handover.

**Core Delivery Areas**
-----------------------

* **Transition Governance:** Establish steering forums, stage\-gate reviews, reporting cadence, escalation paths, RAID controls, and executive decision points.
* **Cloud and Infrastructure Transition:** Oversee cloud migration, hybrid infrastructure, data center services, workplace, network, and managed services transition scope.
* **Cybersecurity Transition:** Govern security operations, identity and access, compliance, GRC, SOC readiness, vulnerability management, and security control transition.
* **M\&A Technology Integration:** Manage infrastructure and security integration, Day\-1 readiness, TSA obligations, service separation, vendor dependencies, licensing impacts, and business acceptance.
* **Commercial and Financial Control:** Track transition budgets, effort estimates, assumptions, dependencies, cost risks, commercial obligations, and value realization.
* **Operational Readiness and Hypercare:** Ensure KT completion, runbook readiness, service acceptance, stabilization, SLA readiness, and handover to steady\-state delivery.

**Qualifications and Certifications**
-------------------------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Information Technology, Computer Science, or Business Management.
* MBA or equivalent postgraduate qualification preferred.
* PMP, PgMP, MSP, PRINCE2, or equivalent program management certification preferred.
* ITIL certification required; ITIL Managing Professional or equivalent is preferred.
* Cloud certification in Azure, AWS, or GCP is desirable.

**Experience Required**
-----------------------

* 15\+ years of IT industry experience, with at least 10\+ years in transition, transformation, or complex program management roles.
* Strong experience leading global cloud, infrastructure, cybersecurity, network, workplace, data center, and managed services transitions.
* Proven background in large, multi\-million\-dollar programs involving multiple stakeholders, vendors, delivery teams, and executive sponsors.
* Experience in outsourcing, managed services, digital transformation, and service integration engagements.
* Hands\-on exposure to M\&A technology integration, divestiture, carve\-out, TSA exit, or post\-acquisition infrastructure and security transition programs.
* Demonstrated ability to manage geographically distributed teams and work across diverse customer and delivery environments.

**Technical and Functional Skills**
-----------------------------------

* Enterprise transition governance, program management, portfolio assurance, RAID management, and executive reporting.
* Cloud platforms and hybrid environments across Azure, AWS, GCP, private cloud, and multi\-cloud architectures.
* Infrastructure modernization, workplace transformation, network operations, data center transition, and managed services onboarding.
* Cybersecurity transition planning covering SOC, IAM, GRC, Zero Trust, endpoint security, vulnerability management, and security operations.
* M\&A transition management, TSA governance, service separation, integration planning, vendor transition, licensing impact analysis, and Day\-1 readiness.
* Commercial governance, business case tracking, financial forecasting, value realization, dependency management, and contract\-aligned delivery control.

**Behavioral Competencies**
---------------------------

* Executive presence with strong customer and leadership engagement.
* Clear ownership, accountability, and delivery discipline.
* Strong influencing, negotiation, conflict resolution, and decision\-making skills.
* Ability to work through ambiguity, pressure, and competing priorities.
* Collaborative leadership style with the ability to align business, technology, security, commercial, and delivery stakeholders.
* Strong written and verbal communication, with the ability to simplify complex program matters for senior audiences.

**Preferred Skills**
--------------------

* Prior experience in global delivery organizations, IT services, consulting, or managed services environments.
* Experience working with customers across BFSI, manufacturing, retail, healthcare, technology, telecom, or public sector domains.
* Exposure to tools such as ServiceNow, Microsoft Project, Jira, Azure DevOps, Power BI, and Microsoft 365\.
* Experience working with legal, procurement, finance, HR, security, and compliance teams during M\&A\-led technology transitions.

**Company Description**
 Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money.
   

  

**Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.**
 Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money.
   

  

 As part of our team, you will be helping us create an entirely new network for the world's money.
   

  

**For everyone, everywhere.**
**Job Description**
 More about
 **our mission** 
 and
 **what we offer** 
 .
   

  

**Role Overview**
 We are looking for an Technical Program Manager with a strong technical or product delivery background to join our newly established Implementation Management team.
   

  

 In this role, you will independently lead cross\-domain initiatives—ranging from high\-volume platform migrations to regional product launches, remediation projects, and platform onboardings. You will sit within the Servicing organisation, but will align directly with partner product segments outside Servicing, leading cross\-functional execution across Product, Engineering, Operations, and Compliance.
   

  

 This role demands strong stakeholder management, hands\-on systems curiosity, program management rigour, pattern recognition, and a passion for process
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Lead Cross\-Domain Initiatives: Take single\-threaded ownership of high\-impact, cross\-squad projects—including core platform migrations, control rollouts, product launches, and partner integrations.
* Consult Partners on Platform Integration: Understand the capabilities, integration flows, and limitations of Wise’s Servicing platforms. Guide partner teams through onboarding requirements and help translate business/compliance needs into clear user stories for Implementation Engineers where necessary.
* Drive Pragmatic, Hands\-On Delivery: Work comfortably at the intersection of product delivery and technical systems. You don't need to review deep technical specifications, but you are comfortable reading architecture diagrams, asking challenging technical questions, running API requests in Postman for testing, and creating dashboards or tables in Looker to track metrics.
* Manage Operational Transformation \& Launch Readiness: Work with Business Operations to ensure product launches are fully supported with operational workflows, queue structures, and agent guidance.
* Drive Program Management Lifecycle: Hold the pen on end\-to\-end program governance—authoring clear program briefs, setting SMART objectives, managing risk logs, tracking delivery milestones, and conducting post\-implementation reviews.
* Leave the Place Better Than You Found It: Assume every process executed today will be repeated tomorrow. Document workflows, automate manual steps, and establish telemetry to scale future execution.


**Qualifications**
**What You’ll Bring**
* 8\+ Years of Relevant Experience: Proven track record of delivering cross\-functional technical or operational projects as an Implementation Manager, Technical Program Manager (TPM), Technical Consultant, Product manager or Fintech Delivery Lead.
* Systems Literacy \& Practical Technical Curiosity: Ability to interpret system architecture diagrams, ask sharp and challenging questions about technical designs, run Postman calls for testing/validation, and build basic tables/dashboards in Looker or SQL.
* Program Management Excellence: Strong foundation in project/program delivery best practices—from scoping and brief writing to designing governance structures, stakeholder reporting, and post\-implementation audits.
* Exceptional Communication Skills: Outstanding written and verbal communication. Ability to adjust messaging seamlessly whether facilitating alignment with product managers, clarifying requirements with engineers, or updating business leaders.
* Pattern Recognition \& Structured Thinking: Ability to absorb unstructured information across disparate domains, spot commonalities, and design standardized, repeatable frameworks.


**What You’ll Benefit From**
* Payments / FinCrime / Platform Exposure: Exposure to Fintech, Payments, Financial Crime (AML, Fraud, KYC), or platform integration projects.


 Additional Information
   

  

 For everyone, everywhere. We're people building money without borders — without judgement or prejudice, too. We believe teams are strongest when they are diverse, equitable and inclusive.
   

  

 We're proud to have a truly international team, and we celebrate our differences.
   

  

 Inclusive teams help us live our values and make sure every Wiser feels respected, empowered to contribute towards our mission and able to progress in their careers.
   

  

 If you want to find out more about what it's like to work at Wise visit Wise.Jobs.
   

  

 Keep up to date with life at Wise by following us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

a2099d77.description:
**Your role**
**What You'll Be Doing**
 Solution Engineer
   

  

 What We Need
   

  

 Corpay is seeking a Solutions Engineer for our Cross\-Border division, within the Corporate Payments line of business department, located in Chennai, India.
 **Reports to:** 
 Payment Solutions Manager (Chennai)
   

  

**About Corpay Cross\-Border**
 Corpay Cross\-Border helps businesses move money globally, manage currency risk, and streamline international payments. Our technology supports customers operating across markets, currencies, and regulatory environments, where reliability, security, and scale matter every day.
   

  

 As part of Corpay, Inc. (NYSE: CPAY), a global corporate payments company, we combine the pace of a product\-led technology team with the reach and stability of a global financial services business. To learn more, visit Payments.corpay.com/cross\-border.
   

  

 How We Work
   

  

 As a Solutions Engineer at Corpay, Corpay will set you up for success by providing:
   

  

* Assigned workspace in our Chennai office
* Company\-issued equipment
* Formal, hands\-on training


 Role Overview
   

  

 As a Solutions Engineer at Corpay Cross\-Border, you will support the technical onboarding and implementation of clients integrating with Corpay's digital payment and FX solutions.
   

  

 The role will primarily support clients and internal stakeholders across North America, with working hours aligned to the US Eastern Time (ET) timezone, while also providing technical support to client implementations and initiatives across other global regions as required.
   

  

 You will work closely with Technical Sales Consultants and other Payment Solutions teams to support clients across integration modalities including REST APIs, File Upload, SFTP, ERP and other digital payment capabilities. The role requires strong technical aptitude, analytical problem\-solving skills and the ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
   

  

 In addition to client implementations, Solutions Engineering is regularly relied upon to support special projects, new product initiatives and ad\-hoc business requirements. The successful candidate should therefore be comfortable working across a variety of technical challenges and adapting to evolving business priorities.
   

  

 The position will be primarily remote; however, the successful candidate will initially attend the Chennai office for induction and training and will be expected to attend occasionally thereafter for team meetings, training and other business requirements.
   

  

 Role Responsibilities
   

  

**The Responsibilities Of The Role Will Include**
 Client Implementation \& Solutioning
   

  

* Support end\-to\-end technical implementation activities from onboarding through testing, certification and Production go\-live.
* Support clients integrating through Corpay's REST APIs, File Upload, SFTP, ERP and other supported integration modalities.
* Participate in technical discovery and solutioning discussions to understand client requirements and determine appropriate implementation approaches.
* Support clients with test environment setup, configuration and integration readiness activities.
* Provide clear and timely responses to client and internal technical implementation questions.
* Support certification testing, Production readiness and post\-go\-live warranty activities to ensure successful client adoption.
* Take ownership of assigned implementation activities while escalating complex technical or delivery risks appropriately.
* Maintain accurate and timely implementation documentation and project updates.


 Technical Analysis \& Troubleshooting
   

  

* Investigate integration, configuration and implementation issues using appropriate diagnostic tools and available system information.
* Analyse API requests and responses, file structures, payment workflows, logs and other technical data to identify potential causes and solutions.
* Work collaboratively with Technical Sales, Product, Engineering, Client Engagement, Support and other teams to resolve technical blockers.
* Clearly document technical findings, troubleshooting steps and recommended solutions.
* Contribute to testing and validation of new or enhanced product capabilities where Solutions Engineering support is required.


 Global Team \& Stakeholder Collaboration
   

  

* Work closely with Technical Sales Consultants and the Solutions Engineering Lead to support successful client delivery across North America and, where required, other global regions.
* Collaborate effectively with colleagues across different geographies and time zones.
* Share lessons learned, technical knowledge and implementation best practices with the wider Solutions Engineering team.
* Contribute to team documentation, implementation standards and knowledge\-sharing initiatives.
* Maintain effective communication with North American stakeholders while remaining connected to the wider Chennai and global Payment Solutions organisation.


 Special Projects, Automation \& Continuous Improvement
   

  

* Support special and ad\-hoc business initiatives requiring technical analysis, implementation support, testing, reporting or other Solutions Engineering expertise.
* Support Product and other stakeholders with the testing, analysis and rollout of new technical capabilities where appropriate.
* Identify opportunities to improve implementation and business processes through automation and improved tooling.
* Develop, maintain or enhance automated workflows using tools such as Microsoft Power Automate where appropriate.
* Work with stakeholders to understand automation requirements and translate them into practical and supportable solutions.
* Identify opportunities to reduce manual effort and improve operational efficiency, scalability and delivery quality.
* Contribute to the continued standardisation and improvement of Solutions Engineering processes, documentation and implementation approaches.


**Qualifications \& Experience**
* 3–5 years of experience in Solutions Engineering, Technical Sales, implementation consulting, technical support, or a comparable client\-facing technical role, ideally within payments, fintech or financial services.
* Demonstrated ability to work independently, take ownership of client\-facing technical issues and implementations, and exercise sound judgement when determining when escalation is required.
* Hands\-on experience with REST APIs, file\-based integrations, SFTP and/or ERP solutions.
* Strong troubleshooting, analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Experience using tools such as Postman, SQL, Kibana, SEQ, Jira, Confluence or equivalent would be advantageous.
* Experience within payments, fintech, banking or financial services would be advantageous.
* Experience supporting North American clients or working across US time zones would be beneficial.
* Exposure to workflow automation tools such as Microsoft Power Automate or equivalent would be advantageous.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities effectively while maintaining ownership of assigned deliverables.
* Ability to adapt to ad\-hoc projects, new technical requirements and changing business priorities.
* Strong organisational skills with attention to delivery timelines, quality and stakeholder communication.


 Benefits \& Perks
   

  

* Leaves: Earned, sick, casual, national holidays, maternity, paternity, bereavement, and adoption/surrogacy leave.
* Medical \& Insurance: Group medical coverage for self and dependents; personal accident insurance.
* Wellness \& Health: Wellness allowance and annual health check\-ups for self and family.
* Tech \& Meals: Broadband reimbursement and meal card support.
* Commute \& Retirement: Commuting allowance, provident fund, gratuity, voluntary provident fund, and pension.
* Culture \& Engagement: Support for philanthropic initiatives, fun contests, and an inclusive work environment.


**About Corpay**

Our specialized payment solutions help businesses control, simplify, and secure payment for fuel, general payables, toll and lodging expenses. Millions of people in over 80 countries around the world use our solutions for their payments.

 When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live.  We are seeking a skilled
 **IT Architect (Azure Cloud Architect** 
 ) to join

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.

****Top Candidates Will Also Have:****

 of major production application systems used for delivery of services to internal and external clients; ability to leverage major production application systems in diverse situations.

 : Knowledge of techniques and tools that promote effective analysis; ability to determine the root cause of organizational problems and create alternative solutions that resolve these problems.

**Level Extensive Experience:**

* Explains design considerations for commercial database systems, operating systems and web.
* Displays experience in estimating the cost of a specific design of a proposed product.

 : Knowledge of the concepts, processes and technologies of application modernization; ability to design, develop and deploy modernized applications in various business scenarios.
   

  

**Level Extensive Experience:**

10eb142f.title: Solutions Development Architect
10eb142f.description:
**Meet the Team**
 Security at Cisco is no longer a product you bolt on — it is table stakes, and it is a lifecycle, and our Customer Experience (CX) Professional Services team in Asia Pacific \& Japan is where that belief meets our largest Service Provider customers. We help Tier\-1 carriers, national operators, mobile network operators, and telco\-cloud/webscale providers across Japan, Australia/New Zealand, ASEAN, and India transform their security architecture — infusing protection into the network fabric, embedding zero trust by design, and standing up a modern, AI\-driven Security Operations Center. We are a small, senior, high\-trust group of architects of record who operate at the intersection of deep networking and security, and who are trusted by CISOs and CTOs to set the security direction for some of the region's most complex networks. What is exciting is the scope: you own the security agenda for an entire vertical across four diverse markets, and you get to shape how an agentic, AI\-powered SOC and security\-by\-design come to life at carrier scale.
   

  

**Your Impact**
 As a senior Security Solutions Development Architect, you will drive the CX Security pre\-sales architecture and delivery strategy for highly complex, large\-scale groundbreaking engagements across APJ Service Provider accounts, acting as the security architect of record. You will influence security, network, and operations decisions at executive and C\-levels (CISO, CTO, SVP and above) and translate security architecture into measurable outcomes — risk reduction, faster mean\-time\-to\-detect/respond, lower threat dwell\-time, stronger compliance posture, and analyst productivity — so customers can see the business value, not just the technology. You will architect zero trust transformations and security\-by\-design controls (segmentation, secure connectivity, policy\-based isolation) that embed protection into routing, transport, data center, edge, and peering layers, then develop the observability framework and high\-fidelity detections that power an agentic, AI\-driven SOC. You will uncover new and expansion security opportunities, lead CX security RFI/RFP responses, and scope and price cross\-architecture proposals so they can be cleanly delivered by CX's technical delivery teams — staying lightly engaged post\-sale to ensure realization and bring together reference wins. Success looks like a growing, balanced CX Security business across APJ SP, with customers advancing along zero trust, security\-by\-design, and SOC\-modernization journeys that Cisco helped them design and deliver.
   

  

**Security \& Service Provider Technical Domains**
 You Are Expected To Bring Architect\-level Expertise Across At Least Two Domains — Networking And Security Architecture — With Cross\-domain Fluency Over The Following
   

  

* Zero Trust Architecture — zero trust design principles, identity and access, least\-privilege/segmented access, and assume\-breach patterns at SP scale.
* Security\-by\-Design \& Infrastructure Controls — segmentation/micro\-segmentation, secure connectivity, DDoS protection, secure firewalling, and SP edge/peering security embedded in the fabric.
* Networking Foundation — SP routing, transport, data center, and edge architectures as the substrate into which security is infused.
* Observability \& Telemetry Engineering — data collection, parsing, ingestion, normalization, enrichment, and federated search across distributed, multi\-cloud data estates.
* Modern SOC \& Agentic Operations — high\-fidelity, actionable detection use cases, agentic investigation and response, advanced analytics, and SOC modernization.
* AI\-Driven Security — embedding AI and agentic capabilities across the security lifecycle to accelerate detection, investigation, and response.


**APJ Regional Context**
 This role drives and grows the CX Security business across the APJ Service Provider vertical — operating across Japan, Australia/New Zealand, ASEAN (Singapore, Indonesia, Malaysia, Thailand, Philippines, Vietnam), and India — markets with varying security maturity and regulatory environments. You will account for the global nature of strategic SP customers while navigating multi\-country deployments, data sovereignty, in\-country data residency, and security/privacy compliance requirements specific to APJ, and partner with the regional SI and channel\-partner ecosystem to orchestrate large\-scale transformations. Preferred hiring locations: Indonesia, Malaysia, India.
   

  

**Minimum Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree \+ 12 years of related experience, OR Master's degree \+ 8 years, OR PhD \+ 5 years, OR equivalent relevant work experience.
* Deep networking expertise with demonstrated ability to apply zero trust security design principles (verify explicitly, least\-privilege access, assume breach) to transform customer security architectures at Service Provider scale.
* Shown mastery of security\-by\-design (network segmentation/micro\-segmentation and infrastructure controls) AND the design of observability frameworks and a modern SOC for detection and response (data collection, ingestion, normalization, enrichment, federated search, and high\-fidelity detection use cases).
* Practical AI fluency for security: demonstrated experience designing AI\-driven detection, investigation, and response and building high\-fidelity, agentic/automation\-led SOC workflows.
* Deep technical pre\-sales experience AND professional services/delivery experience, holding required certifications: CCNP Service Provider (or CCNP Enterprise/equivalent) AND CCNP Security (or equivalent) AND CISSP (or equivalent senior security architecture certification).


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Expert\-level certifications such as CCIE Service Provider, CCIE Enterprise, or CCIE Security; and/or security architecture frameworks such as SABSA or TOGAF.
* Zero trust / SOC and security\-analytics certifications (e.g., Splunk certifications, SANS/GIAC such as GCIH/GCDA), AI\-security credentials, and/or cloud\-security specializations (AWS / Azure / GCP).
* Strong, fluent English (written and spoken) with the executive presence to influence at CISO/CTO/SVP\-and\-above level across diverse APJ markets.
* Recognized strategic influencer, comfortable shaping customer security vision and representing Cisco in industry forums and strategic alliances.
* Skilled at orchestrating the SI and channel\-partner ecosystem to deliver large\-scale, multi\-country Service Provider security transformations.


 Why Cisco?
   

  

 At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
   

  

 Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
   

  

 We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

 The Senior Solution Architect focuses on designing business\-driven, standards\-based, and future\-ready solutions within a complex, multiple solution, or product context. In this role, you will design solutions that meet product requirements, business priorities, and enterprise standards while managing non\-functional requirements (NFR) and fitness functions.  Within
 **RDT Pharma Technical Operations** 
 and specifically in the context of
 **Manufacturing Technologies** 
 , this Solution Architect for Process Data ensures the seamless fit of our manufacturing business solutions into the Roche ecosystem. The Process Data area is part of the digital backbone of our production environment, ensuring that complex scientific processes are translated into reliable, executable, and reportable digital formats.
   

  

 Our scope includes:

* Enterprise Recipe Management: Orchestrating the "blueprints" for our medicines across different sites to ensure consistency and scalability
* Data Historian Solutions: Managing the high\-frequency, real\-time data streams from the shop floor to enable deep analysis, troubleshooting, and continuous process improvement

Drives external technology trends and assesses feasibility, including vendor assessments
* Stakeholder Management: Communicates difficult concepts clearly and negotiates with others to adopt a different point of view. Drives information sharing across the complete product
* Impact/Strategy: Develops and maintains the product's technology roadmap. Provides technical oversight, guidance, and consultation on specific technologies for product teams. Improves existing solutions, manages technical debt, and researches, evaluates, pilots, and drives the adoption of new technologies. Identifies opportunities to enhance value and business processes within a Complex or Multiple Solution or Product Context
* Complexity / (Product Size): Operates within a Complex or Multiple Solution or Product Context
* Business / Technical ability: Applies in\-depth and expert\-level knowledge in multiple technology areas. Proactively contributes to Architecture Practices development and mentoring


**Qualifications**
**Education / Experience**
* Bachelor or advanced degree
* Demonstrated experience designing business\-driven, standards\-based, future\-ready solutions within a complex or multiple solution/product context
* Experience maintaining the vision, roadmap, and current landscape for multiple solutions, and assessing the impacts of initiatives on capabilities, risk, and application landscapes
* Proven track record of proactively contributing to architecture practices development and mentoring others
* 2\+ years of experience in the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or regulated healthcare technology industry
* 2\+ years of experience with pharmaceutical manufacturing IT solutions


**Technical Skills**
* Strong understanding of the product discovery and development lifecycle. Familiarity with GxP, FAIR data principles, and data privacy regulations (GDPR)
* In\-depth and expert\-level knowledge in multiple technology areas
* Proficiency in creating Conceptual \& Logical Data Models, Taxonomies, Ontologies, and Integration pathways for products
* Ability to define and drive reference architectures, patterns, NFRs, and fitness functions
* Strong capability to drive external technology trends and assess feasibility for multiple solutions, including conducting vendor assessments
* Experience with Enterprise Recipe Management systems in the pharmaceutical context is a plus


**Additional Qualifications**
* Exceptional communication and negotiation skills, with the ability to communicate difficult concepts and influence stakeholders to adopt different perspectives
* Proactive mindset to identify opportunities to enhance value, improve existing solutions, manage technical debt, and lead teams in identifying innovative solutions
* With a global team and the main stakeholders in NALA and EMEA the position requires regular availability for meetings outside of standard business hours
* Availability to travel up to 20% of the time


**Shift:**

 \#Hyderabad2026
   

  

 Who we are
   

  

 A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life\-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

e62eb266.title: Antino - AI Solution Architect
e62eb266.description:
**About The Role**
 We are looking for a hands\-on AI Solution Architect who can act as the technical face of Antino's AI practice with enterprise clients and also build what is proposed.
   

  

 You will lead technical discovery and pre\-sales discussions, understand business challenges, design AI/GenAI/Agentic AI solutions, estimate effort, explain trade\-offs and risks, and work closely with clients, sales, engineering, and data science teams.
   

  

 This is not a slides\-only role. You will build POCs, run demos, write code, define architecture, review production systems, and guide solutions from POC to production.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Pre\-Sales \& Client Solutioning :
* Lead technical discovery calls, workshops, RFP/RFI responses, proposals, SOWs, estimates, and ROI discussions.
* Translate business problems into practical AI/ML, GenAI, and Agentic AI solutions.
* Present solutions and technical trade\-offs to CXOs, architects, security, data, and engineering teams.
* Build rapid POCs and demos to validate and de\-risk solutions.
* Solution Architecture \& Delivery :
* Design scalable AI architectures using LLMs, RAG, AI Agents, vector databases, embeddings, prompt/context engineering, and knowledge graphs.
* Select the right approach across classical ML, LLMs, fine\-tuning, RAG, agents, or hybrid solutions.
* Build and deploy solutions across AWS, Azure, or GCP.
* Design APIs, data pipelines, model serving, enterprise integrations, and microservices.
* Build production\-grade agentic systems including tool calling, multi\-agent workflows, memory, human\-in\-the\-loop, and agent hand\-offs.
* Establish best practices for security, scalability, performance, observability, evaluation, reliability, and cost optimisation.
* AI Engineering \& Team Enablement :
* Stay hands\-on with Python, FastAPI, AI frameworks, LLM platforms, and cloud technologies.
* Guide engineering and data science teams from POC through production.
* Implement AI evaluation, monitoring, guardrails, and LLMOps practices.
* Train internal teams and create reusable reference architectures, accelerators, and playbooks.
* Track emerging AI models, frameworks, protocols, and research and apply relevant innovations to Antino's AI practice.


**Must\-Have Skills \& Experience**
* 5\+ years in software engineering, data science, ML engineering, or solution architecture.
* 2\+ years of hands\-on experience designing and deploying GenAI/LLM solutions in production.
* Strong experience building Agentic AI, including tool\-calling agents, multi\-agent systems, agentic RAG, memory, and orchestration.
* Strong foundations in statistics, classical ML, deep learning, feature engineering, model evaluation, and time series.
* Strong hands\-on Python and API development, preferably FastAPI.
* Experience with LLM platforms such as OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Gemini, AWS Bedrock, and open\-weight models such as Llama, Qwen, Mistral, or DeepSeek.
* Experience with frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, OpenAI Agents SDK, Claude Agent SDK, or Google ADK.
* Experience with vector/search technologies such as Pinecone, Weaviate, Milvus, Qdrant, pgvector, FAISS, Chroma, Elasticsearch/OpenSearch.
* Strong knowledge of Advanced RAG, GraphRAG, hybrid search, re\-ranking, query rewriting, multimodal RAG, and context engineering.
* Experience with MLOps/LLMOps, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, model serving, monitoring, evaluation, and cost optimisation.
* Strong understanding of distributed systems, microservices, databases, APIs, and secure enterprise architecture.
* Strong client\-facing and communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to both CXOs and engineering teams.


**Advanced AI Expertise**
* Agent Design : Tool/function calling, ReAct, planning, reflection, memory, state management, HITL, failure recovery.
* Multi\-Agent Systems : Supervisor, hierarchical and peer\-to\-peer patterns, task routing and agent hand\-offs.
* Agent Protocols : MCP and A2A.
* RAG : Hybrid search, re\-ranking, GraphRAG, knowledge graphs, agentic/multimodal RAG, permission\-aware retrieval.
* Model Adaptation : Reasoning, long\-context and multimodal models, SLMs, LoRA/QLoRA, distillation, prompting vs RAG vs fine\-tuning.
* Inference : vLLM/TGI, quantisation, prompt caching, model routing, latency and token\-cost optimisation.
* Evaluation : Ragas, DeepEval, LangSmith, Langfuse, Arize Phoenix, golden datasets, LLM\-as\-a\-Judge, tracing.
* AI Security \& Governance : Prompt injection defence, guardrails, PII protection, OWASP Top 10 for LLMs, NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, EU AI Act, and India's DPDP Act.


**Good To Have**
* Experience in IT services/consulting with global clients across the US, UK, or Middle East.
* Experience with enterprise knowledge platforms, knowledge graphs, or Company Brain\-style systems.
* Production experience in Voice AI, Document AI, or Computer Vision.
* Experience with Databricks, Snowflake, BigQuery, or Spark.
* Domain exposure to BFSI, Healthcare, Retail, Logistics, or Manufacturing.
* AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud certifications.
* Open\-source contributions, research papers, patents, technical blogs, or conference talks.


**About Antino**
 Antino is an AI\-native technology consulting company helping organisations embed intelligence into the way they operate.
   

  

 600\+ Engineers \| 50 AI Specialists \| 400 Projects Delivered \| 20 Countries Served
   

  

 With offices across India, the US, UK, and UAE, Antino has developed Company Brain \- a governed intelligence layer connecting enterprise knowledge, people, systems, and workflows to enable smarter decisions and coordinated action.

c7cd30bd.title: Associate Solutions Engineer- (Manufacturing) - Night Shift
c7cd30bd.description:
**About MISUMI Americas**
 MISUMI Americas, a division of MISUMI Group, is a leading provider of standard, configurable, and custom manufacturing solutions. By integrating a vast catalog of components with a world\-class digital manufacturing platform, MISUMI Americas empowers engineers and procurement teams to accelerate innovation across the entire product lifecycle. With operations in the San Francisco Bay Area and Chicago, the company serves as a vital partner for the most innovative companies in the Americas.
   

  

**What’s in it for you?**
**Opportunity To Unlock Your Creativity**
 Think of all the times you were held back from trying new ideas because you were boxed in by bureaucratic legacy processes or old school tactics. Having a growth mindset is deeply ingrained into our company culture since day 1 so Fictiv is an environment where you have the creative liberty and support of the team to try big bold ideas to achieve our sales and customer goals.
   

  

**Opportunity To Grow Your Career**
 There are plenty of jobs out there. The question is whether any of them will help you grow in your career? Will you be challenged by teammates to achieve your potential? Or are they roles that will ask you to do more of what you've already mastered. At Fictiv, you'll be surrounded by supportive teammates who will push you to be your best through their curiosity and passion.
   

  

**Impact In This Role**
 At Fictiv, we are building the world's premier platform for hardware manufacturing. As an Associate Solutions Engineer, you will support our critical quoting and manufacturability functions, working at the interface between our two sets of customers — the builders who order parts through us, and the manufacturing partners who make them.
   

  

 In this role you will learn to review the manufacturability and cost of parts submitted by our builders across processes such as CNC machining and 3D printing. Under the guidance of senior Solutions Engineers, you will apply your Mechanical Engineering background to interpret designs, prepare accurate quotes for custom parts, and flag design considerations that affect cost, quality, and lead time. Your work helps bring products to market faster and directly supports Fictiv's growth.
   

  

 You will report to a Team Lead within Solutions Engineering, who will support your development from guided execution toward independent ownership of quoting and DFM work.
   

  

 Why this role matters to our customers:
   

  

 Speed to Market — accurate quotes and timely DFM feedback help customers make faster decisions and launch sooner.
   

  

 Cost Confidence — precise, transparent costing prevents budget surprises later in the process.
   

  

 Risk Mitigation — catching manufacturability issues early avoids costly rework, material waste, and delays.
   

  

 Quality Assurance — confirming designs are feasible and tolerances are achievable helps customers get correct parts the first time
   

  

**What You’ll Be Doing**
 Quoting Support
   

  

 Prepare cost estimates for standard and moderately complex CNC machining and other manufacturing parts, combining your analysis with Fictiv's software recommendations.
   

  

 Escalate complex geometries, non\-standard processes, or challenging timelines to senior Solutions Engineers or High Touch (HT) quoting.
   

  

 Use platform tools to automate portions of the quoting process for speed and accuracy.
   

  

 Design for Manufacturability (DFM)
   

  

 Perform DFM reviews on straightforward parts to highlight risks and suggest design or process adjustments, with guidance on more complex cases.
   

  

 Interpret engineering drawings, GD\&T, and material requirements to assess feasibility.
   

  

 Technical Support \& Learning
   

  

 Build knowledge of machining, finishing, and assembly processes and their cost drivers.
   

  

 Learn region\-specific manufacturing considerations across the US, India, China, and Mexico.
   

  

 Customer Engagement
   

  

 Communicate with customers on routine clarifications and provide clear, timely updates during quoting.
   

  

 Support senior engineers in explaining trade\-offs between cost, lead time, and quality.
   

  

 Cross\-functional Collaboration
   

  

 Work with internal teams (Sales, Operations, Sourcing, Quality \& Logistics) to keep projects moving.
   

  

 Provide feedback to the quoting software team to help improve the accuracy of automated quoting.
   

  

 Documentation
   

  

 Assist in generating clear 2D drawings per ANSI/ASME Y14\.5 standards and maintain accurate records of your quoting analysis.
   

  

 All employees are expected to maintain and contribute to the QMS.
   

  

**Desired Traits**
 Experience \& Education
   

  

 1–2 years of hands\-on experience in manufacturing, quoting, design, or a related engineering function (internships and co\-ops count).
   

  

 4\-year Mechanical Engineering degree or equivalent technical training.
   

  

 Working familiarity with CNC machining and 3D printing is required; exposure to additional processes (sheet metal, urethane casting, injection molding, etc.) is a plus.
   

  

 Understanding of GD\&T and conventional (coordinate) tolerancing.
   

  

 Working knowledge of the manufacturability and limitations of common metals and plastics.
   

  

 Traits
   

  

 Meticulous, detail\-oriented, with an inclination for documentation.
   

  

**Excellent Verbal And Written Communication Skills In English Required.**
 Self\-starter who manages time efficiently and is eager to learn and take on more responsibility over time.
   

  

 Enjoys learning from others and, in time, sharing knowledge about manufacturing processes.
   

  

 We’re actively seeking teammates who:
   

  

* Bring diverse perspectives and experience to our culture and company.
* Excel at being part of a strong, empathetic team.
* Thrive in an environment emphasizing respect, honesty, collaboration, and growth.
* Have an ‘always learning’ mindset that celebrates learning, not just wins.
* Help us continue to build a world\-class organization that values the contributions of all of our teammates


 We encourage applications from members of underrepresented groups, including but not limited to women, members of the LGBTQ community, people of color, people with disabilities, and veterans.

**Your work profile**


**Functional Consultant – Project \& Client Management**


**Role Purpose**


The Functional Consultant will be responsible for managing assigned projects/workstreams while performing functional consulting activities across the solution lifecycle. The role will act as a bridge between business stakeholders, technical teams, and project leadership to ensure requirements are understood, translated into functional solutions, delivered on time, and adopted successfully.

* Develop and maintain project plans, milestones, deliverables, dependencies, and timelines.
* Track project progress and ensure delivery against agreed scope, timeline, and quality.
* Identify project risks, issues, assumptions, and dependencies and drive mitigation actions.
* Coordinate with functional, technical, and business teams to resolve delivery challenges.
* Conduct regular project status meetings and follow up on action items.
* Support resource planning and workload management for assigned workstreams.
* Ensure project documentation is maintained throughout the project lifecycle.

* Communicate project progress, risks, issues, and dependencies to relevant stakeholders.
* Support governance meetings and project steering discussions.
* Ensure timely closure of client queries and action items.
  

**4\. Solution \& Process Management**

* Analyse business challenges and recommend appropriate solutions using available platforms and technologies.
* Support platform and solution decision\-making in collaboration with architects and technical leads.
* Identify process standardization and automation opportunities.
* Ensure functional solutions align with business objectives and enterprise standards.
* Support integration discussions between ERP and surrounding applications.
  

**5\. Testing \& Quality Assurance**


* Prepare functional test scenarios and test cases.

* Coordinate defect management and resolution with technical teams.
* Validate that delivered functionality meets agreed business requirements.
* Support business users during UAT.
* Ensure proper documentation of test results and approvals.
  

**6\. Documentation \& Knowledge Management**


* Maintain functional and project documentation in agreed repositories.
* Develop reusable templates, accelerators, process libraries, and knowledge assets.
* Ensure documentation follows defined quality and governance standards.
* Support creation of training materials and user guides.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of functional consulting methodologies.

4495b8f1.title: Service Delivery Manager, Field Services
4495b8f1.description:
Job Description – Service Delivery Manager, Field Services
 



**Company:** 
 Teceze
 



**Position:** 
 Service Delivery Manager – Field Services
 



**Department:** 
 Service Delivery / Operations
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-Time
 



**Reporting To:** 
 Head of Service Delivery / Operations Director
 



 Role Overview
 



 Teceze is looking for an experienced
 **Service Delivery Manager – Field Services** 
 to manage and drive the successful delivery of onsite IT field services projects across multiple customer locations.
 



 The role will be responsible for end\-to\-end service delivery covering
 **Field IT Support, Smart Hands, Deskside Support, Data Center Support, Network Support, IMACD, Break/Fix, Rollouts, Deployments, and Dispatch Services** 
 .
 



 The SDM will act as the primary operational interface between Teceze, customers, engineers, subcontractors, and internal teams. The individual will be accountable for meeting contractual SLAs, maintaining service quality, managing engineer performance, ensuring timely resource deployment, and improving overall customer satisfaction.
 



 This is a highly operational and customer\-facing role requiring strong experience managing distributed field engineering teams and multi\-site IT support engagements.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 



 Service Delivery Management
 


* Manage end\-to\-end delivery of Field Services engagements across assigned customers, countries, regions, or service towers.
* Ensure all onsite IT support tickets, dispatch requests, projects, and scheduled activities are delivered within agreed SLA and quality standards.
* Act as the primary operational point of contact for customers.
* Conduct daily and weekly service reviews with customers and internal stakeholders.
* Track incidents, service requests, escalations, project activities, and engineer performance.
* Ensure customer commitments are clearly communicated and delivered.
* Maintain complete visibility of all active projects, open tickets, pending dispatches, and engineer assignments.
* Ensure services are delivered in accordance with contractual scope, SOPs, work instructions, and customer processes.



 Field Services Operations
 



 Manage delivery across services including:
 


* Deskside Support
* Desktop Support
* End User Computing Support
* Smart Hands
* Remote Hands
* Network Field Support
* Data Center Support
* IT Infrastructure Support
* IMAC / IMACD
* Break/Fix Support
* Hardware Installation
* Hardware Replacement
* Device Deployment
* Device Refresh
* Site Surveys
* Office Moves
* Network Rollouts
* Wi\-Fi Deployments
* Rack and Stack
* Cabling
* Server and Network Device Replacement
* POS Support
* Printer and Peripheral Support
* Project\-Based IT Deployments



 SLA \& KPI Management
 



 The SDM will be responsible for monitoring and maintaining service performance against agreed KPIs and SLAs.
 



 Key metrics may include:
 


* SLA compliance
* Response time
* Engineer acceptance time
* Engineer arrival time
* Resolution time
* First\-time fix rate
* Ticket backlog
* Repeat incident rate
* Engineer utilization
* Engineer attendance
* Customer satisfaction
* Escalation rate
* Ticket aging
* Resource fulfillment time
* Project completion rate



 The role should aim to consistently maintain
 **98% or higher SLA achievement** 
 , subject to customer contractual requirements.
 



 Engineer \& Resource Management
 


* Manage a distributed workforce of Field Engineers, Deskside Engineers, Smart Hands Engineers, Network Engineers, and Data Center Engineers.
* Coordinate with recruitment and sourcing teams to ensure adequate engineer coverage.
* Maintain backup engineer pools for critical locations.
* Ensure rapid backfill when engineers are unavailable.
* Monitor engineer attendance, punctuality, ticket acceptance, and service quality.
* Conduct regular engineer performance reviews.
* Address repeated SLA failures or customer complaints involving engineers.
* Ensure engineers have the correct tools, skills, access, documentation, and site information before dispatch.
* Coordinate engineer onboarding, access approvals, background verification, and customer compliance requirements.
* Maintain skill matrices for engineers across locations.



 Dispatch Management
 


* Ensure all dispatch tickets are assigned within agreed turnaround time.
* Coordinate engineer availability and scheduling.
* Track engineers from assignment through ticket completion.
* Monitor engineer ETA and site arrival.

1024a844.title: Solutions Strategist - APAC
1024a844.description:
**The Team** 




**Team:** 
 Solutions Strategists, part of Wingify's global PreSales organization
 



**Coverage:** 
 APAC \- East Asia, South East Asia, ANZ and India
 



**You'll work with:** 
 the VP Sales APAC, regional Account Executives and Solutions Engineers, and the Solutions Strategist covering Europe and MEA
 



**Role overview:** 
 You will be Wingify's first dedicated Solutions Strategist in APAC, building the strategic PreSales practice for the region from the ground up alongside existing regional Sales and Solutions Engineering teams.
 



**Who We Are** 




 Wingify is a global leader in experimentation, personalization and conversion rate optimization, born from the merger of AB Tasty and VWO. Together, we help some of the world's most ambitious brands turn insight into revenue across every digital touchpoint.
 



 With teams spanning Europe, the Americas, MEA and Asia\-Pacific, we partner with enterprise customers across retail, travel, media and financial services to build and scale high\-performing CRO and CXO programs. As we grow our Enterprise footprint globally, we're expanding the PreSales organization that makes our biggest deals win.
 



**Your Mission** 




 As a Solutions Strategist, you own the strategic and business narrative on Wingify's most complex Enterprise and strategic deals. You partner with the Account Executive and the Solutions Engineer as one team. Your work is structured around four levers:
 



 •
 **Differentiate:** 
 build one coherent strategic narrative across the entire pre\-sales journey, frame competitive differentiation at every step, and strategize ahead of an upcoming opportunity on strategic and key deals.
 



 •
 **De\-Risk:** 
 address the perceived risks that stall Enterprise evaluations (switching cost, resourcing, governance readiness, and CRO/CXO maturity) through direct CXO\-level conversations
 



 •
 **Visualize:** 
 make Wingify's impact tangible for each specific deal (tailored market and vertical insight, tool/suite fit, use cases built from real analysis of the prospect's business, and competitive positioning.)
 



 •
 **Prove:** 
 turn a ROI model into a business case narrative the Champion can defend in front of Finance, translating gains, savings and break\-even into language a CFO expects.
 



 Beyond the four levers, you will:
 


* Contribute to the strategic response and differentiation on complex, competitive RFPs.
* Steer multi\-stakeholder POCs and complex evaluations, facilitating decisions across technical and business stakeholders.
* Act as an evangelist for Wingify at conferences, webinars and workshops.



**What You'll Bring** 




**Core Competencies** 



* **Organizational Diagnosis:** 
 Assess an organization's CRO/CXO maturity and political dynamics within a single conversation, asking the right questions to enrich the Sales team's account intelligence.
* **Business \& Technical Diagnosis:** 
 Spot optimization opportunities at a glance and reframe a functional brief into the 2\-3 underlying problems Wingify can solve.
* **Product \& Solution Mastery:** 
 Understand how our solutions work well enough to quickly assess use case feasibility, propose new ones, and recommend the most relevant products for a prospect's context.
* **Consultative Posture:** 
 Hold consultative conversations on the execution of a CRO/CXO strategy, including on challenges peripheral to the tools themselves such as governance, resourcing or process.
* **Narrative \& Competitive Positioning:** 
 Build a narrative that puts our tools' value into sharp relief and position effectively in an intensely competitive context.



**Mindset \& Behaviors** 



* Active listening and organizational acumen : reads stakeholder dynamics and unspoken politics, not just stated requirements.
* Analytical thinking and structured problem\-solving : synthesizes and prioritizes quickly under ambiguity.
* Intellectual curiosity and learning agility : genuine appetite to dig into how things work without waiting for all the answers.
* Consultative presence and executive credibility : comfortable challenging a prospect's thinking without arrogance.
* Communication and storytelling : clear and compelling at executive level, composed under competitive pressure.
* Multi\-threading and autonomy : manages multiple stakeholders, issues and deals in parallel, structuring the approach on each account independently.



  





 If you don't meet 100% of these qualifications, tell us why you'd still be a great fit for this role in your application!
 



**Why You'll Love It Here** 



* Make a Real Impact: sit at the center of Wingify's biggest deals and directly influence win rate and deal size.
* Ownership \& Autonomy: no micromanagement, just the freedom to own your region's strategic deals.
* International Culture: collaborate with a diverse, global PreSales, Sales and Product organization spanning Europe, the Americas, MEA and APAC.
* Career Development: vast opportunities for professional growth as Wingify scales its Enterprise footprint globally.



**Details** 




**Contract:** 
 Permanent, full\-time
 



**Location:** 
 India
 



**Remote:** 
 100% remote
 



**Reporting line:** 
 Solutions Strategist Director

**Job Information**

* Date Opened 09/23/2026
* Job Type Full time
* Industry IT Services

**Job Description**
-------------------


This is a remote position.


Salesforce Technical Architect (TA)  

  

  

Job Details
  

* **Employment Type:** Contract
* **Work Mode:** Remote
* **Location:** Offshore
* **Total Experience Required:** 10\+ years
* **Relevant Experience Required:** 6\+ years of dedicated technical architecture experience within complex Salesforce enterprise environments
* **Mandatory Certification:** Salesforce Certified System Architect or Technical Architect (CTA) track status

  

Job Summary
  

We are seeking a **Salesforce Technical Architect** to spearhead the core technical implementation, programmatic governance, and systems integration of our enterprise Salesforce footprint. The ideal candidate will possess a deep understanding of software engineering patterns, apex optimization, platform execution constraints, and advanced data volume structures to deliver highly stable, scalable solutions.  

  

  

Key Responsibilities
  

* **Own the programmatic architecture**, technical design, and code quality standards across multiple enterprise\-scale Salesforce orgs.
* **Enforce platform governance guidelines**, optimizing application configurations to strictly respect Salesforce Governor Limits, execution ordering, and concurrency bounds.
* **Design robust technical integration frameworks**, orchestrating real\-time and asynchronous messaging patterns using Salesforce Pub/Sub API, Event Bus, Change Data Capture (CDC), and Apex REST web services.
* **Review and optimize programmatic foundations**, ensuring custom Apex triggers, asynchronous batch frameworks, and Lightning Web Components (LWC) are designed for peak performance and minimal technical debt.
* **Establish secure data architectures**, defining encryption\-at\-rest policies, custom sharing calculation rules, large data volume (LDV) indexing, and high\-throughput data migration scripts.
* **Direct identity and access management setups**, configuring Single Sign\-On (SSO) frameworks, SAML flows, OAuth authorization loops, and multi\-tenant security layers.
* **Lead technical review boards (TRB)**, evaluating and signing off on custom source code modifications, package selections, and structural platform dependencies.

  

  

### **Requirements**


* **10\+ years** of total IT enterprise software engineering experience, with **6\+ dedicated years** acting as a Technical Architect on the Salesforce platform.
* **Expert programmatic proficiency** in Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), JavaScript, and deep structural debugging.
* **Extensive experience managing massive data models**, handling millions of records, skinning query structures via SOQL/SOSL optimization, and managing data archiving policies.
* **Mandatory certification:** Salesforce Certified System Architect or Certified Application Architect.

  

Preferred Qualifications
  

* **Salesforce Certified Technical Architect (CTA)** credential or active pursuit of the CTA review board.
* **Prior engineering experience** managing modern automated DevOps delivery tools (e.g., Copado, Gearset, Flosum) alongside custom Git branching and CI/CD automation strategies.

9c0e8c9f.description:
**This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Resident Solution Architect based in India.**
 This role offers the opportunity to work directly with enterprise customers as a trusted technical advisor on complex data and AI initiatives. You’ll design scalable cloud data architectures and help organizations modernize their data platforms using Databricks and Lakehouse technologies. The position combines hands\-on engineering with solution architecture, consulting, technical workshops, and customer enablement. You’ll work across Apache Spark, PySpark, SQL, Delta Lake, cloud platforms, data pipelines, and AI\-related technologies. The role also provides ownership from early discovery and proof\-of\-concept stages through production deployment and adoption. It is well suited to an experienced data professional who enjoys solving complex technical challenges while communicating effectively with both engineering teams and business stakeholders.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Act as a trusted technical advisor to enterprise customers, understanding their business objectives and translating them into practical data and AI solutions.
* Gather and analyze customer technical requirements and design scalable, secure, and maintainable data architectures.
* Design and implement modern Lakehouse and Data \+ AI architectures using Databricks and associated platform capabilities.
* Develop and guide proof\-of\-concepts, technical workshops, architecture demonstrations, and solution evaluations.
* Work extensively with Apache Spark, PySpark, SQL, and Databricks to build and optimize data engineering solutions.
* Design scalable data ingestion, transformation, processing, and analytics pipelines.
* Leverage technologies such as Delta Lake and Unity Catalog to support reliable, governed, and scalable data platforms.
* Support data migration, modernization, and cloud transformation initiatives.
* Integrate data platforms with AWS, Azure, or GCP and provide guidance on cloud architecture and deployment strategies.
* Troubleshoot performance, scalability, reliability, and data pipeline challenges across customer environments.
* Collaborate with customer engineering, data science, architecture, and leadership teams to drive successful technical outcomes.
* Provide technical recommendations across data engineering, analytics, machine learning, AI, governance, and cloud architecture.
* Create reference architectures, technical documentation, implementation guidance, and other reusable technical assets.
* Support production deployments and help customers successfully adopt and scale data platform solutions.
* Conduct enablement sessions, knowledge\-sharing activities, and technical presentations for customer and internal teams.


**Requirements**
* 9\+ years of professional experience in data engineering, software engineering, solution architecture, or closely related technical disciplines.
* Strong hands\-on expertise with Databricks, Apache Spark/PySpark, SQL, and modern data engineering practices.
* Proven experience designing and implementing data pipelines, data platforms, Lakehouse architectures, data warehouses, or large\-scale data processing environments.
* Strong understanding of data engineering fundamentals, including ingestion, transformation, processing, storage, data quality, scalability, and reliability.
* Experience with at least one major cloud platform: AWS, Azure, or GCP.
* Demonstrated solution architecture and technical design experience, with the ability to translate complex customer requirements into scalable technical solutions.
* Strong customer\-facing and consulting experience, ideally working directly with enterprise engineering, data, architecture, and leadership stakeholders.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to lead workshops, explain complex technical concepts, and influence technical decisions.
* Strong Python skills and practical experience applying programming to data engineering or analytics solutions.
* Experience with Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, MLflow, Kafka, streaming, data migration, MLOps, machine learning, GenAI, data governance, Terraform, CI/CD, Snowflake, or the Hadoop ecosystem is advantageous.
* Strong troubleshooting and problem\-solving skills, particularly around data pipelines, performance, scalability, and production environments.
* Ability to work independently in a remote environment while managing multiple customer engagements and technical priorities.


**Benefits**
* Fully remote position for candidates based in India.
* Full\-time employment with an annual compensation range of ₹35,00,000–₹60,00,000, depending on experience and skills.
* Opportunity to work directly with enterprise customers on complex data, AI, and cloud transformation initiatives.
* Hands\-on exposure to Databricks, Apache Spark, Lakehouse architecture, cloud data platforms, and modern Data \+ AI technologies.
* Significant involvement across the full solution lifecycle, from discovery and POCs through production deployment and adoption.
* Opportunities to lead technical workshops, architecture engagements, enablement sessions, and customer\-facing initiatives.
* Exposure to AWS, Azure, and GCP environments and a broad range of modern data technologies.
* Opportunity to influence architecture decisions and provide strategic technical guidance to enterprise customers.
* Remote\-first working environment with flexibility and autonomy.
* Professional growth through challenging architecture, consulting, data engineering, and AI projects.

Our system identifies the top\-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.

 By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Jobgether will process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy and share relevant information with the hiring employer. This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre\-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). dcc6d523.description:
**About Us**
 With electric vehicles expected to be nearly 30% of new vehicle sales by 2025 and more than 50% by 2040, electric mobility is becoming a reality. ChargePoint (NYSE: CHPT) is at the center of this revolution, powering one of the world’s leading EV charging networks and a comprehensive set of hardware, software and mobile solutions for every charging need across North America and Europe. We bring together drivers, businesses, automakers, policymakers, utilities and other stakeholders to make e\-mobility a global reality.
   

  

 Since our founding in 2007, ChargePoint has focused solely on making the transition to electric easy for businesses, fleets and drivers. ChargePoint offers a once\-in\-a\-lifetime opportunity to create an all\-electric future and a trillion\-dollar market.
   

  

 At ChargePoint, we foster a positive and productive work environment by committing to live our values of Be Courageous, Charge Together, Love our Customers, Operate with Openness, and Relentlessly Pursue Awesome. These values guide how we show up every day, align, and work together to build a brighter future for all of us.
   

  

 Join the team that is building the EV charging industry and make your mark on how people and goods will get everywhere they need to go, in any context, for generations to come.
   

  

 Reports To
   

  

 Chief Information Officer
   

  

**What You Will Be Doing**
* Develop and maintain program roadmaps, timelines, and deliverables, ensuring effective coordination within IT\-InfoSec team, AI initiatives and cross\-functional teams.
* Create program charters, establish roles and timelines, develop communication strategies, and define success metrics for security and AI initiatives
* Create and maintain program\-level visibility across risk areas, security milestones, and cross\-org dependencies—ensuring outcomes are delivered reliably and at high quality.
* Facilitate collaboration and Communicate status, risks, trade\-offs, and decisions clearly to stakeholders and drive cross\-functional execution with urgency and care.
* Manage security control rollouts and migrations, like endpoint hardening, centralised networking etc, that require careful change management across organizations.
* Maintain structured communication across program stakeholders
* Identify operational gaps and opportunities for improvement and propose solutions to implement.
* Improve processes that support security program execution
* Assist in defining program milestones and success criteria


**What You Will Bring To ChargePoint**
* Strong track record coordinating business, IT, security, infrastructure, and engineering teams.
* Experience driving program governance, RAID management, dependency tracking, and program status reporting.
* Experience with at least one of the domain: GRC, Application Security, Vulnerability Management, Incident Response, DevSecOps, Cloud Security, Product Security, AI governance, ITSM.
* Experience with creating OKR and business aligned dashboards for leadership visibility
* Experience with project management tools like Jira, Confluence, Notion, etc.
* Have experience driving cross\-functional projects, building longer\-running programs, and interfacing with technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Demonstrated capability to work effectively in global, cross\-functional teams and collaborative environments across time zones.
* Ability to navigate complex stakeholder environments, ensuring effective communication between technical and non\-technical teams.


**Requirements**
* 8\+ years of experience, including Project execution experience in cyber security\-related initiatives.
* Self\-motivated, structured, results\-driven; capable of setting priorities and managing time effectively in demanding settings.
* Experience communicating and representing work to leadership, framing discussions to gain valuable feedback, and experience working with technical management teams to develop systems, solutions, and products.
* Experience applying AI tools and automation platforms (e.g., Copilot, Claude, Notion AI, or similar) to enhance program management workflows such as meeting summarization, dependency tracking, and automated reporting.
* CISM, PMP, PgMP, CSM, ACSM or SAFe certification is plus
* Have strong interpersonal skills that enable you to influence without authority, build cross\-organizational support, cooperation and action around security initiatives, policies and procedures.


**Location**
 Bangalore/ Gururam/ Remote – India
   

  

 We are committed to an inclusive and diverse team. ChargePoint is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, national origin, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, marital status or any legally protected status.
