2c1ea299.title: Lead Technical Program Manager
2c1ea299.description:
**Job Description**
 Leverage your deep technical expertise and leadership to guide cutting\-edge projects, fostering growth and innovation in a dynamic environment.
   

  

 As a Lead Technical Program Manager in Commercial and Investment Bank technology team, you will drive the successful delivery of complex technology projects and programs that will help reaching business goals across the firm. Leveraging your deep knowledge of technical principles, practices, and theories is essential for developing innovative solutions, while simultaneously effectively managing resources, budgets, and high\-performing teams. Your strong analytical reasoning and adaptability skills will enable you to navigate through ambiguity and change, ensuring that technology initiatives align with business goals. With advanced communication and stakeholder management abilities, you will foster productive working relationships and influence decision\-making to achieve mutually beneficial outcomes. As a subject matter expert, you will contribute to the development of operational plans and risk management strategies, ensuring the highest quality and professionalism in service delivery.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities**
* Develop and execute comprehensive project plans, incorporating technical requirements, resource allocation, and timelines to ensure on\-time delivery of technology solutions
* Identify and mitigate risks, proactively addressing potential roadblocks and implementing contingency plans to maintain project and program momentum
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams, including engineering, product, and business stakeholders, to define program scope, objectives, and deliverables, ensuring alignment with overall business goals
* Uses enterprise\-authorized AI capabilities within the work environment to accelerate project planning and risk synthesis (e.g., drafting plans, RAID, and status narratives), validating outputs and handling data according to sensitivity requirements.
* Promotes reuse\-first, AI\-assisted practices for project governance artifacts and reporting, ensuring human review and alignment to delivery standards.
* Utilize advanced analytical reasoning to assess program performance, identify areas for improvement, and implement data\-driven optimizations to enhance efficiency and effectiveness
* Champion the adoption of agile methodologies and technical solutions, fostering a culture of continuous learning and innovation within the team


**Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills**
* 5\+ years of experience or equivalent expertise in technical program management, leading complex technology projects and programs in a large organization
* Advanced expertise in stakeholder management, with the ability to establish productive working relationships and influence decision\-making across cross\-functional teams and clients
* Advanced experience in utilizing technical fluency, including knowledge of vendor products and managing vendor relations, to enable on\-demand access to shared pools of applications and services
* Demonstrated experience using enterprise\-authorized AI capabilities within the work environment to support technical program management workflows with strong validation habits and awareness of data sensitivity.
* Ability to review and validate AI\-assisted plans, risks, and recommendations before use, escalating when uncertain and following data handling expectations.
* Proven track record of effectively managing resources, budgets, and high\-performing teams in a fast\-paced, agile environment
* Demonstrated proficiency in applying analytical reasoning and problem\-solving techniques to break down business, technical, or operational objectives into manageable tasks and activities


**Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills**
* Experience in the Financial Services industry
* Experience working with Technology Controls
* Experience with Vulnerabilities Management
* Experience with Enterprise Level Infrastructure Technology Programs


**About Us**
 JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.
   

  

 We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.
   

  

**About The Team**
 J.P. Morgan's Commercial \& Investment Bank is a global leader across banking, markets, securities services and payments. Corporations, governments and institutions throughout the world entrust us with their business in more than 100 countries. The Commercial \& Investment Bank provides strategic advice, raises capital, manages risk and extends liquidity in markets around the world.

8823fa8f.title: Program Manager - Biotech
8823fa8f.description:
**Title** 
 : Program Manager\- Biotech
 



**Location:** 
 Gurugram
 



  





**About Us** 




 Absolute is a bioscience company founded with the vision of creating a shared future where both people and the planet thrive together. By harnessing the power of nature, science, and exponential innovation, Absolute is building a sustainable and prosperous future.
 



 Its Bio division is a generation\-defining platform operating across
 **Agriculture, Human Health, and Sustainable Materials** 
 , powered by breakthrough research from Xenesis — a team of 150\+ scientists working across disciplines.
 



 Backed by Sequoia, Tiger Global, and Alpha Wave, Absolute’s investors include Nadir Godrej (MD, Godrej Industries), Kamal Aggarwal (Promoter, Haldiram), and Kunal Shah (Founder, CRED).
 



  





**About INERA (An Absolute Company)** 




 INERA is Absolute’s agricultural biologicals platform, focused on transforming farming through
 **regenerative, science\-led solutions** 
 .
 



 At INERA, we develop next\-generation bio\-inputs that work in harmony with natural soil systems to improve productivity, restore soil health, and enable sustainable agriculture at scale. As a core part of Absolute’s Bio platform, INERA represents our commitment to building the future of agriculture through innovation and nature\-led science.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 This is a high\-impact role working closely with the Founders, scientific leadership, and business teams to drive execution across some of Absolute's most strategic biotechnology programs.
 



 As a Program Manager, you will orchestrate cross\-functional initiatives spanning research, product development, commercialization, and strategic partnerships. You will ensure scientific programs move seamlessly from concept to execution by bringing together multidisciplinary teams, driving governance, removing execution bottlenecks, and maintaining rigorous program discipline.
 



  





 In this role, you will:
 


* Partner with scientific and business leaders to translate research and innovation objectives into structured program plans with clear milestones, timelines, deliverables, and ownership.
* Drive execution across biotechnology programs, ensuring alignment between R\&D, regulatory, manufacturing, product, and commercial teams.
* Establish robust program governance through operating dashboards, milestone tracking, risk management, and regular program reviews.
* Monitor program progress, proactively identify execution risks, and drive corrective actions to ensure delivery against commitments.
* Support technology transfer, product development, pilot programs, and commercialization efforts by ensuring seamless coordination across teams.
* Prepare concise program updates, executive reviews, and decision\-support material for leadership and investors.



  





**Why would you love this role?** 



* Work directly with founders and senior scientific leaders on some of the company's most strategic biotechnology initiatives.
* Help build breakthrough technologies at the intersection of biology, agriculture, sustainability, and human health.
* Gain end\-to\-end exposure across the innovation lifecycle \- from scientific discovery to commercialization.
* Own high\-impact programs with significant autonomy, responsibility, and visibility.
* Accelerate your career in one of India's most ambitious biotechnology companies solving globally relevant challenges.



  





**What we are looking for:** 



* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Biotechnology, Life Sciences, Bioengineering, or a related discipline. An MBA is an advantage.
* 6\-10 years of experience in biotechnology, life sciences, pharmaceuticals, scientific program management, R\&D operations, innovation management, or consulting.
* Demonstrated ability to manage complex, multidisciplinary programs involving multiple stakeholders and competing priorities.
* Excellent project planning, execution, and stakeholder management skills with exceptional attention to detail.
* Strong analytical and structured problem\-solving abilities with a data\-driven approach to decision\-making.
* Outstanding written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to synthesize complex scientific information for diverse audiences.

dbf66a41.title: Associate - PreSales
dbf66a41.description:
**Job Profile:\-**




 This is a solutioning \& consulting\-focused role. We are looking for Pre\-Sales rockstars who deeply understand ORI’s conversational AI offerings and can map them to real business problems across industries (BFSI, Telecom, Retail, etc.).
 



 As a Pre\-Sales Consultant, you will work closely with Sales, Product, AI and Delivery teams to:
 


* understand customer journeys and pain points,
* design the right solution using ORI’s platforms,
* build compelling demos, proposals and PoCs that help win deals.



  





**Key Requirements:\-**



* Creating solution proposals, vision presentations and ideate solution architecture for the deployment of the conversational AI solutions.
* Understand customer technical requirements and work with partners and customers to align solutions.
* Participate in discovery calls and workshops with clients to understand business processes, current contact\-center setup, use cases, and KPIs
* Translate business problems into clear use cases, customer journeys, and high\-level bot flows (voice \& chat).
* Prepare and deliver product demos, PoC storyboards, and walkthroughs that showcase ORI’s capabilities in a simple, business\-friendly way.
* Work with internal teams (AI/ML, Product, DevOps, Delivery) to validate feasibility, dependencies, and effort for proposed solutions.
* Draft and structure solution documents, SoWs, effort estimates, and ROI outlines under guidance from senior pre\-sales / leadership.
* Support RFP/RFI responses by filling in solution, architecture, security, and functional sections using ORI’s internal knowledge base.
* Capture client requirements, assumptions, and risks clearly and ensure a smooth handover to Delivery after deal closure.
* Maintain and continuously improve internal collateral – decks, case studies, solution templates, domain\-specific playbooks.
* Stay updated on ORI’s roadmap, features, integrations, and success stories and reflect them in proposals and client conversations.
* Support Sales in pipeline reviews, bid/no\-bid decisions, and solution positioning, ensuring ORI is seen as a strategic partner and not just a tool/vendor.



  





**Our ideal candidate should have:\-**



* Total Experience: 2\-4 years in Pre\-Sales, Solution Consulting, Business Analysis, or Client\-Facing Tech/SaaS roles.
* Educational background in Engineering, Computer Science, IT, Mathematics, or related fields is preferred (but not mandatory if experience is strong).
* Strong conceptual understanding of at least one of the following:



 ○ Contact centers / customer support
 



 ○ SaaS / cloud solutions
 



 ○ APIs, integrations, and data flows
 


* Ability to grasp technical concepts (APIs, webhooks, cloud hosting, security basics) and explain them in simple business language.
* Excellent communication \& storytelling skills – strong in PowerPoint (solution decks, storytelling) and Excel (basic ROI modelling, effort estimates).
* Strong analytical thinking – can break vague problems into structured requirements and solution components.
* Comfort working in a fast\-paced startup environment with evolving products, where documentation and processes are maturing.
* Exposure to AI / ML / NLP / GenAI / chatbots / voicebots
* Experience in BFSI, Telecom, E\-commerce, or BPO/contact centers
* Prior experience in demoing products to clients or working on RFPs/PoCs



  





**What you can expect from ORI:\-**



* Passion and happiness in the workplace with great people and an open culture, with amazing growth opportunities.
* An ecosystem where leadership fosters and builds an environment where everyone is free to take necessary actions to learn from real experiences.
* Flat team structures, with the ability to work closely with Board Members, Key Stakeholders, etc.
* Freedom to pursue your ideas and the opportunity to tinker with existing processes as well as create new processes that can then have a big impact upon the business.



  





***If you value ownership and are driven by building business in the charged and exciting environment of a high\-growth, technology\-driven startup, then this is the right job for you!***

927084a0.title: Presales Engineer
927084a0.description:
**Location:** 
 Bangalore
   

  




**Description**
 The Sales Engineer will engage directly with our dealers to develop a deep understanding of our solutions through formal sales and technical training sessions. In this role, you will support our field sales team by responding to requests for proposals and information, conducting product demonstrations, and addressing dealer and end\-user inquiries.
   

  

 We are looking for a technical expert who is ready to "build it, break it, and fix it". This role offers the unique opportunity to manage your own home test lab to vet new Brivo products. If you're passionate about technology, customer service, and adhering to good operational practices, we invite you to join our team.
   

  

 This position is based in Bangalore, India and covers the APAC territory.
   

  

  

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Drive sales growth among independent resellers in the assigned territory by serving as a primary sales and technical advisor for Brivo products and third\-party API integrations.
* Conduct product demonstrations, presentations, customer engagements, and field events for resellers and end\-users, both virtually and on\-site.
* Provide technical and design support to resellers and Regional Sales Managers (RSMs), including project design, Bills of Materials (BOMs), competitive differentiation, and remote/on\-site support for escalated issues.
* Coordinate technical aspects of customer projects, including multi\-site and multi\-region deployments, phased rollout planning, technical QA, post\-installation health checks, and technical account reviews for large accounts.
* Strengthen reseller technical capabilities through Brivo University and product certification training, train\-the\-trainer programs, and ongoing technical enablement.
* Collaborate with product management and internal teams to communicate customer needs, improve reseller performance, and develop and maintain technical documentation.
* Maintain knowledge of regional competitors, including local VMS and cloud providers, to support RSMs and resellers with technical differentiation and competitive opportunities.


**Skills, Expertise \& Qualifications**
* Experience in physical security or access control, with 5\+ years as a pre\-sales technical professional OR relevant field experience selling, installing, or programming Brivo systems.
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.
* Proficiency with CRM, Google Workspace, and design tools.
* Previous experience crafting responses to functional and technical requirements for RFIs and RFPs.
* Demonstrated ability to deliver engaging product demonstrations to dealers and end users, both virtually and in person.
* Experience in creating a bill of materials (BOM).
* Proficient in delivering pre\-sales and technical training content.
* Strong communication skills, both verbal and written, with the ability to present ideas clearly and concisely.
* Confident, energetic, and enthusiastic approach.
* Capable of lifting 25 kg.
* Possession of a valid Passport and willingness to travel 25%\-50%, including outside the assigned territory; proximity to a major airport is required.


**About Brivo**
 Brivo and Eagle Eye Networks have come together to create a category\-defining, cloud\-first platform at the intersection of AI and the physical world. Our mission is simple and ambitious: to make physical spaces safer, smarter, and more autonomous—from single\-site businesses to global enterprises.
   

  

 As the unified global leaders in cloud\-based access control and video surveillance, we provide a comprehensive digital foundation for the built environment. By combining Brivo’s pioneering building access platform with Eagle Eye’s AI\-powered video management system (VMS), we have created a system of intelligence that protects over 600 million square feet across 90\+ countries. Every door, camera, and credential in our ecosystem acts as a real\-time sensor, leveraging AI to prevent incidents, improve operations, and enable entirely new workflows across sectors, including commercial real estate, retail, healthcare, education, and critical infrastructure.
   

  

 With a global footprint spanning headquarters in Bethesda, Maryland, and Austin, Texas, and international offices in Amsterdam, London, Bangalore, and Tokyo, we are leveraging our open APIs and cyber\-secure cloud infrastructure to reshape the future of physical security. Join us as we build the world’s most robust platform for video intelligence and smart space automation. Learn more at www.brivo.com.

Qualified candidates are considered for employment without regard to race, religion, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, age, military or veteran status, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. a04d71a2.title: Senior Solutions Architect
a04d71a2.description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100\* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.
   

  

 The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high\-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co\-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.
   

  

* Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025\. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.


**An Overview Of This Role**
 As a Senior Solutions Architect on GitLab's India team, you'll be a trusted advisor to prospects, customers, and partners across India. You'll help them understand how GitLab's AI\-powered DevSecOps platform addresses technical requirements and business goals across the software development lifecycle. This role supports Commercial and Enterprise segments in India's Southern Region. Experience with Global Capability Centers (GCCs), Digital Native organizations, and startups is highly valued given the accounts you'll support.
   

  

 You'll partner closely with Account Executives and cross\-functional teams to own technical evaluations, including proofs of value and workshops, shape solution architectures, and bring customer feedback to Product Management. You'll also occasionally support regional go\-to\-market partners that provide Professional Services. Your work will help customers adopt GitLab successfully, support revenue growth through solution selling, and build long\-term, trusted relationships.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Lead technical discovery, demonstrations, and validation to show how GitLab's AI\-powered DevSecOps platform meets customers' technical and business needs across the software development lifecycle.
* Own the technical evaluation process, including solution design, proofs of concept or value, workshops, and technical contributions to tenders, audits, and value stream assessments.
* Collaborate with Account Executives and regional sales teams across Commercial and Enterprise segments to shape account strategies for new customer acquisition and expansion, with a focus on GCC, Digital Native, and startup accounts.
* Support regional go\-to\-market partners that provide Professional Services, helping them deliver consistent technical guidance and apply effective practices during partner\-led engagements.
* Represent GitLab at online and in\-person marketing events, including webinars, industry events, presentations, roundtables, panels, demonstration days, and hackathons.
* Build trusted relationships with technical practitioners and business leaders, guide GitLab\-driven transformation, and help customers become GitLab advocates.
* Advise customers on modern software development, continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD), security, and cloud practices to improve their return on investment.
* Share customer feedback, use cases, and competitive insights with Product Management, Engineering, Sales, and Marketing while continuing to build expertise and reusable guidance in GitLab, DevSecOps, AI, and cloud technologies.


**What You’ll Bring**
* Experience guiding Commercial and Enterprise customers through solution design and evaluation in technical presales, consulting, or a similar role.
* Experience working with India's GCCs, Digital Native organizations, and startups is highly valued.
* Knowledge of the end\-to\-end software development lifecycle, including modern DevSecOps practices and CI/CD workflows.
* Hands\-on experience with GitLab or comparable source control, CI/CD, and collaboration platforms, with the ability to connect platform capabilities to customer use cases.
* Practical knowledge of cloud computing concepts and related technologies, including deployment, security, and operations options.
* Ability to lead proofs of concept or value, contribute to tenders or audits, and design and run workshops or value stream assessments.
* Clear technical communication and presentation skills, with the ability to adapt your message for practitioners and senior business and technical decision\-makers.
* Skill in building trusted relationships, listening with empathy, advocating for customers, collaborating with go\-to\-market or Professional Services partners, and continuously learning new technologies.


**About The Team**
 The Solutions Architect team is part of GitLab's Sales organization and serves as the technical counterpart to Account Executives. This role focuses on Commercial and Enterprise opportunities across India's Southern Region and works with Account Executives, the broader go\-to\-market team, and regional partners that provide Professional Services. The team advises on architecture, runs technical evaluations such as proofs of value, and guides customers through digital transformation. We collaborate asynchronously with Sales, Product Management, Engineering, and Marketing to share effective practices, create reusable technical resources, and represent the voice of the customer. Our focus is helping customers modernize software delivery, adopt GitLab at scale, and navigate a changing AI and DevSecOps landscape.
   

  

**How GitLab Supports Full\-Time Employees**
* Benefits to support your health, finances, and well\-being
* Flexible Paid Time Off
* Team Member Resource Groups
* Equity Compensation \& Employee Stock Purchase Plan
* Growth and Development Fund
* Parental Leave


 Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.
   

  

**Country Hiring Guidelines:** 
 GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location\-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.
   

  

**Privacy Policy:** 
 Please review our Recruitment Privacy Policy. Your privacy is important to us.
   

  

 GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. See also GitLab’s EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. a855030c.title: Account Strategist, Google Customer Solutions
a855030c.description:
Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **Gurugram, Haryana, India; Bengaluru, Karnataka, India; Mumbai, Maharashtra, India**.### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 2 years of experience with stakeholder management, business, sales industry or customer engagement.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Knowledge of the local market with excellent investigative skills.
* Knowledge of traditional and online marketing strategy and tactics, and products across all digital advertising.
* Ability to lead and manage multiple projects with internal and external stakeholders.
* Ability to think about issues and develop recommendations and action plans.

**About the job**
-----------------


Businesses of all shapes and sizes rely on Google’s unparalleled advertising solutions to help them grow in today's dynamic marketing environment. You bring a passion for sales, knowledge of online media, and commitment to maximize customer success. You act like an owner, move with velocity through change, finding innovative and strategic ways to consistently deliver extraordinary and incremental outcomes for both Google and your customers. You build trusted relationships with customers, uncovering their business needs and translating them into powerful solutions to achieve their most ambitious goals. You achieve as a team with sellers, shape the future of advertising in the AI\-era, and make a real impact on the millions of companies and billions of users that trust Google with their most important goals.



In this role, you will work with the advertisers to shape their business growth and strengthen relationships. You will drive product adoption and business growth. You will anticipate how decisions are made at C\-Level and you will explore and uncover the business needs of customers, and understand how the range of product offerings can grow their business. You will set the goal and strategy for how their advertising can reach users.


Google Customer Solutions (GCS) sales teams are trusted advisors and competitive sellers who maintain a relentless focus on customer success by bringing the best Google has to offer to small\- and medium\-sized businesses (SMBs), which are the backbone of our communities. As a member of our team, you’ll have the opportunity to work with company owners and make a real difference in their businesses by helping them grow. Together, we help shape the future of innovation for customers, partners, and sellers...and we have fun doing it.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Manage a portfolio of customers alongside account managers to deliver against goals, while prioritizing and delivering a quality sales experience to customers.
* Establish credibility with executives and serve as a trusted consultant to optimize and expand their advertising investment by understanding business drivers, identifying opportunities for growth, managing risks and creating multi\-quarter plans for sustainable business growth.
* Drive business growth, partnerships, business planning and strategy, review, and education for customers.
* Coach peers in the organization to create skill lift that drives customer growth and contributes to team success.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to enable customer growth.
Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

414c7a28.title: Sr. Principal Solution Consultant
414c7a28.description:
The driving force behind our success has always been the people of AspenTech. What drives us, is our aspiration, our desire and ambition to keep pushing the envelope, overcoming any hurdle, challenging the status quo to continually find a better way. You will experience these qualities of passion, pride and aspiration in many ways — from a rich set of career development programs to support of community service projects to social events that foster fun and relationship building across our global community.
   

  

**The Role**
 AspenTech is an AI\-powered software company helping the world’s leading energy, chemical and engineering companies succeed in their digital transformation, making their operations more efficient and reducing impact on the environment. At AspenTech, you will be part of a global market\-leading company with double digit growth and a blue\-chip customer base.
   

  

 We offer the opportunity to make an impact, to drive innovation and to be an agent of positive change. Our culture and vision have taken dramatic leaps forward over the past two years and we still have work to do. We need extraordinary individuals to pave the way ahead. The reviews on here paint many stories of successes, failures, excitement and disappointment. Every person has their own story. We strive to make your story at AspenTech a great one.
   

  

**Your Impact**
 As a Sr Principal Solution Consultant, you will collaborate closely with AspenTech sales teams to lead consultative discovery sessions, craft visionary solutions, and design strategies tailored to customer needs. Your deep understanding of the industries and coupled with AspenTech's broad product portfolio and value\-enablers will drive opportunities that deliver significant business value to our customers and AspenTech.
   

  

 In this customer\-facing role, you will leverage your technical domain expertise, industry knowledge, and business acumen to position AspenTech solutions effectively.
   

  

* Leading and executing the technical qualification of solutions to a business outcome.
* Serving as a discipline/practice subject matter expert with a strong understanding of operational challenges, best practices, and industry trends.
* Learning the complete AspenTech product portfolio to identify and apply products that solve real customer business challenges, including the value of solving those challenges.
* Developing the messaging and materials necessary to position AspenTech solutions in the industry – making adaptations for regional or market differences.
* Partnering closely with Sales Account Managers throughout the sales cycle, from discovery and solution design to executive presentations and deal execution.
* Engaging the senior executive level of customer organisations to paint the vision of how AspenTech can be a partner in their digitalisation journey.
* Developing industry\-specific solutions, aligning technology with measurable business value.
* Providing market input to the Product Management teams to improve solution adoption.
* Identifying and leading sales campaigns to improve AspenTech’s reach, pipeline and awareness.
* Coaching and enabling Sales Account Managers and Solution Consultants on industry\-specific messaging, customer engagement strategies and solution positioning.
* Representing AspenTech at industry conferences, customer forums, webinars and trade events across the region.


 What You'll Need
   

  

**Must\-Have**
* 10\+ years of experience in industrial software, services, solution consulting, presales, technical sales or related customer\-facing technical roles.
* Bachelor’s degree in Chemical Engineering or a related technical discipline (preferred).
* Proficiency in Industrial Data Platforms (Inmation), Historians (IP.21\), and Advanced Process Control (APC) \& Real Time Optimization (RTO) (DMC3, GDOT, Aspen Plus), or equivalent competitor technologies.
* Demonstrated successes in business development.
* Strong ability to bridge technology and business, articulating high\-level technical solutions and their differentiated value.
* Strong drive to convert opportunities into recognised value for customers, with exceptional problem\-solving and analytical skills.
* Proficiency in English.
* Must be authorized to work in India without restriction/sponsorship.


**Nice\-to\-Have**
* Services or solution consulting exposure to industries such as Metals \& Mining, LNG, Specialty Chemicals, Pharmaceuticals, Polymers, Consumer Packaged Goods, Food \& Beverage, Pulp \& Paper, Power Generation, and Water \& Wastewater.
* Breadth across several AspenTech solution areas / well\-rounded across multiple disciplines.
* Knowledge of AI/ML solutions and their application in industry.
* Strong understanding of digital transformation initiatives within asset\-intensive industries.
* Working knowledge of Supply Chain/Production Planning \& Scheduling \- Aspen Plant Scheduler, Aspen Unified Planning, or equivalent competitor technologies.


 Regional travel up to 35%.

6b46671e.description:
**Minimum qualifications:**
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 6 years of experience with cloud native architecture in a customer\-facing or support role.
* Experience with cloud engineering, on\-premise engineering, virtualization, or containerization platforms.
* Experience engaging with, or presenting to, technical stakeholders or executive leaders.


**Preferred qualifications:**
* Experience selling technical solutions in one or more of the following: Infrastructure Modernization, Application Modernization, Data Management, Data Analytics, Cloud AI, Networking, Migrations, Security.
* Experience driving the entire sales cycle (e.g., defining the delivery and consumption plan and transitioning it for execution).
* Experience building long\-term technical strategies to uncover new workloads with customers.
* Experience migrating applications and services to cloud platforms.
* Experience working with AI, building Agentic systems and AI based solutions.


**About the job** 
 The Google Cloud Platform team helps customers transform and build what's next for their business — all with technology built in the cloud. Our products are developed for security, reliability and scalability, running the full stack from infrastructure to applications to devices and hardware. Our teams are dedicated to helping our customers — developers, small and large businesses, educational institutions and government agencies — see the benefits of our technology come to life. As part of an entrepreneurial team in this rapidly growing business, you will play a key role in understanding the needs of our customers and help shape the future of businesses of all sizes use technology to connect with customers, employees and partners.
   

  

 As a Platform Customer Engineer, you will partner with technical Sales teams to differentiate Google Cloud to our customers. You will serve as the customer’s primary technical partner and trusted advisor, engaging in technical\-led conversations to understand their business challenges. You will troubleshoot technical questions and roadblocks, engage in proofs of concepts and demos, and use your expertise to architect cross\-pillar cloud solutions that solve these business challenges. You will drive the technical win and define the delivery and consumption plans. You will use your strategic acumen and presentation skills to engage with technical and business leaders, and persuasively present practical and useful solutions on Google Cloud. You will have a breadth of technical expertise, spanning infrastructure modernization, application modernization, data analytics and more. You will blend sales expertise, market knowledge and direct technical engagement to prove the value of the Google Cloud portfolio.Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise\-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting\-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Develop and own the technical account plan and strategy, participating in planning and supporting targeted sales motions.
* Combine sales, programming, and solutions architecture expertise to prove the value of Google Cloud Platform across the portfolio through complex demos, pilots and in\-depth workshops.
* Architect cross\-pillar solutions, drive technical wins, and define initial delivery plans for customers; continue to lead the technical engagement in the solution phase.
* Facilitate the post\-sales transition by supporting pricing activities and transitioning the final delivery plan to implementation teams.
* Maintain awareness of progress against the delivery plan, providing support to cross\-functional teams during ramp, delivery, migration or implementation phases.

e0ad00e2.title: Sr. Solutions Architect, AWS Industries India
e0ad00e2.description:
**Description**
 The AWS Industries team is committed to helping industry customers enable their digital transformation journeys. Our primary goal is to meet customers in their cloud journeys and work backwards from their industry\-specific needs to transform their businesses and industries. Our team focuses on business outcomes and industry use cases on behalf of our customers, whether that is how we build products and solutions, how we sell, how we deliver, or how we partner.
   

  

 As an Amazon Web Services (AWS) Solutions Architect within the Strategic Accounts segment you are responsible for partnering with our most valuable customers to design cloud architectures utilizing AWS services. You have technical depth, business aptitude, and the ability to lead in\-depth technology discussions, articulating the business value of the AWS platform and services. Effective communication and interpersonal skills are required for engaging and influence Enterprise Architects, Technical Architects, Cloud Architects, Directors, VP’s and CXOs.
   

  

 You will be part of a culture of innovation where you’ll use AWS services to help our customers solve business challenges such as rapidly releasing products/services to the market or building an elastic, scalable, cost optimized application. Enable innovation through continuous deployment in DevOps, build highly scalable web \& mobile applications with data store technologies.
   

  

 AWS services cover a wide range of technologies including operational security, infrastructure, DevOps, highly available software architectures, observability, machine learning and analytics. Our customer solutions usually involve many of these at once. AWS Solutions Architects are expected to have at least one technical areas of depth, but also need to be capable of leading discussions across most of these areas.
   

  

 Here at AWS, we embrace our differences. We are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. We have ten employee\-led affinity groups, reaching 40,000 employees in over 190 chapters globally. We have innovative benefit offerings, and we host annual and ongoing learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon diversity conferences. Amazon’s culture of inclusion is reinforced within our 14 Leadership Principles, which remind team members to seek diverse perspectives, learn and be curious, and earn trust.
   

  

 Our team also puts a high value on work\-life balance. Striking a healthy balance between your personal and professional life is crucial to your happiness and success here, which is why we aren’t focused on how many hours you spend at work or online. Instead, we’re happy to offer a flexible schedule so you can have a more productive and well\-balanced life—both in and outside of work.
   

  

 Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects based on what will help each team member develop into a better\-rounded professional and enable them to take on more complex tasks in the future.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 As a Solutions Architect, you will provide architectural and technical leadership to a portfolio of customers who are looking to leverage AWS services at scale. You will be the domain expert guiding architectural design decisions, while demonstrating customer obsession to ensure high availability and performance of the customers applications. You’ll have the opportunity to learn and be curious while evangelizing the latest innovations and best practices in infrastructure, engineering and application design. You will mentor peers and customers while growing your knowledge.
   

  

 As a core member of the account team, you will drive revenue growth across a specific customer. As a trusted customer advocate, you will help organizations understand and implement advanced cloud\-based solutions, and how to migrate existing workloads to the cloud. You will have the opportunity to shape and execute a strategy to build knowledge and broad use of AWS. You will also need to be adept at interacting, communicating and partnering with other teams within AWS such as services teams, marketing, and professional services, as well as representing your team to executive management.
   

  

 A day in the life
   

  

 Why AWS?
   

  

 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
   

  

 Inclusive Team Culture
   

  

 AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
   

  

 Mentorship \& Career Growth
   

  

 We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.
   

  

 Work/Life Balance
   

  

 We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
   

  

**About The Team**
 The AWS Industries team is committed to helping industry customers enable their digital transformation journeys. Our primary goal is to meet customers in their cloud journeys and work backwards from their industry\-specific needs to transform their businesses and industries. Our team focuses on business outcomes and industry use cases on behalf of our customers, whether that is how we build products and solutions, how we sell, how we deliver, or how we partner.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Knowledge of cloud architecture
* 10\+ years of cloud architecture and solution implementation experience
* 5\+ years of architecting/operating solutions built on any cloud service provider like Azure, AWS, GCP, OCI, etc. experience
* Experience presenting technical solutions to diverse audiences in pre\-sales environments
* 5\+ years of experience in any one specific technology domain areas (e.g. AIML, data \& analytics, migration and mordenisation).


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Knowledge of AWS services, market segments, customer base and industry verticals
* 7\+ years of cloud architecture and solution implementation experience, or AWS Professional level certification
* Experience leading the architecture and design (architecture, design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and current systems, or experience building complex software systems that have been successfully delivered to customers
* 10\+ years' experience in designing and implementing large distributed systems, with deep expertise in core infrastructure, solution architecture, and distributed computing patterns.
* Professional experience in pre\-sales consulting with proven presentation skills, executive engagement capabilities, and track record of effectively communicating with stakeholders at all levels while managing ambiguous requirements.


 Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.
   

  

  

**Company** 
 \- AWS India \- Maharashtra

0fbbdb1b.title: Solution Architect - BY
0fbbdb1b.description:
**CREATIVITY IS OUR SUPERPOWER.** 
 It’s our heritage and it’s also our future. Because we don’t just make toys. We create innovative products and experiences that inspire fans, entertain audiences and develop children through play. Mattel is at its best when every member of our team feels respected, included, and heard—when everyone can show up as themselves and do their best work every day. We value and share an infinite range of ideas and voices that evolve and broaden our perspectives with a reach that extends into all our brands, partners, and suppliers.
   

  

**The Team:**
**The Opportunity:**
**What Your Impact Will Be**
 We are seeking an experienced Blue Yonder (formerly JDA) ESP Solution Architect/Developer to lead the design, configuration, development and deployment of Enterprise Supply Planning solutions. This role will play a pivotal part in enabling global supply chain transformation by leveraging Blue Yonder’s advanced planning capabilities to optimize supply planning, inventory positioning, and production strategies. The candidate must be willing to work on site 4 days a week in Hyderabad, during US EST time zone.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Solution Architecture \& Design**
* Lead and own the end\-to\-end architecture and design of Blue Yonder ESP (Enterprise Supply Planning) solutions.
* Translate business requirements into scalable solution designs that align with industry best practices and Blue Yonder's functional framework.
* Define planning models, network design, constraints, and heuristics aligned to business supply strategies.
* Expertise in interpreting solver results ensuring optimized planning quality based on constraints.


**Configuration \& Development**
* Configure and develop components within Blue Yonder ESP, including supply planning, inventory balancing, pegging, and constraint\-based planning logic.
* Customize ESP engines to align with business supply network models, demand signals, and production capacities.
* Create and manage planning parameters, supply chain hierarchies, and master data elements.


**Implementation \& Configuration**
* Configure ESP modules including supply planning, constrained planning, and inventory optimization.
* Guide integration of ESP with up/downstream systems (Demand Planning, ERP, MRP, MES, Google Datalake).
* Oversee data modeling, master data configuration, and rule\-based planning logic.


**Technical Leadership \& Governance**
* Provide leadership and guidance to implementation teams and technical consultants.
* Review and approve functional and technical design documents.
* Ensure adherence to Blue Yonder standards and change management protocols.


**Business Collaboration \& Change Enablement**
* Collaborate with business stakeholders across supply chain, manufacturing, and IT to gather requirements and align solution outcomes.
* Conduct design workshops, walkthroughs, and training sessions to ensure knowledge transfer and user adoption.
* Act as the primary point of contact for solution design decisions and issue resolution.


**Continuous Improvement \& Support**
* Identify and propose enhancements for planning performance, configuration, or data integration.
* Support hypercare and transition to steady\-state planning operations.
* Evaluate emerging Blue Yonder capabilities and industry trends to evolve the planning landscape.
* Contribute to production support and documenting processes and facilitating enablement sessions to empower stakeholders with the necessary skills and knowledge to utilize BY ESP solutions effectively.
* Education Bachelor's or Master’s degree in Supply Chain, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field.
* Experience 10\+ years of experience in supply chain planning, with at least 5\+ years in Blue Yonder ESP architecture or implementation.
* Technical Skills Hands\-on expertise in configuring, designing and deploying Blue Yonder ESP modules (Supply Planning, Inventory Optimization, S\&OP, Manufacturing Planning) solutions and managing Control\-M with extensive experience of MAP solver and ability to understand and interpret solver output ensuring optimal planning results. Strong understanding of planning algorithms (constrained/unconstrained), pegging, and network optimization. Scripting (e.g., PL/SQL, Python, or batch scripting) skill is a must. Experience with integration to ERP systems like SAP, Oracle, or Infor. Familiarity with data integration tools (e.g., SAP PI, MuleSoft, Informatica) and batch/scheduled data feeds.
* Leadership Skills Excellent communication, leadership, and client\-facing skills.
* Problem\-Solving Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities, with a proactive approach to addressing challenges.
* Cultural Awareness Ability to work effectively in a multicultural and highly dynamic environment and manage teams across different time zones. Must be multi\-tasker and able to prioritize and deliver assignments with the highest quality under pressure with short deadlines.
* Preferred Qualifications
* Blue Yonder certification in ESP or SCPO suite is highly desirable.
* Experience in scripting (e.g., PL/SQL, Python, or batch scripting) is a significant advantage especially OIL scripts.
* Experience in deploying complex BOM, Load building planning, dynamic deployment functionality is highly preferred.
* Experience in SPARQ solver is a plus.
* Experience in large\-scale global supply chain transformation programs.
* Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Experience working in Agile or hybrid implementation methodologies.
* Knowledge of other Blue Yonder modules (Demand Planning, Sequencing, Control Tower) is a plus.
* Knowledge of Anaplan (planning) models is a plus.


 Don’t meet every single requirement? At Mattel, we are dedicated to an inclusive workplace and a culture of belonging. If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we still encourage you to apply. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.
   

  

**How We Work**
 We are a purpose driven company aiming to empower generations to explore the wonder of childhood and reach their full potential. We live up to our purpose employing the following behaviors
   

  

* We collaborate Being a part of Mattel means being part of one team with shared values and common goals. Every person counts and working closely together always brings better results. Partnership is our process and our collective capabilities is our superpower.
* We innovate At Mattel we always aim to find new and better ways to create innovative products and experiences. No matter where you work in the organization, you can always make a difference and have real impact. We welcome new ideas and value new initiatives that challenge conventional thinking.
* We execute We are a performance\-driven company. We strive for excellence and are focused on pursuing best\-in\-class outcomes. We believe in accountability and ownership and know that our people are at their best when they are empowered to create and deliver results.


**Our Approach to Flexible Work:**
 We embrace a flexible work model designed to empower a culture of growth, optimism, and wellbeing, where every employee can reach their full potential. Combining purposeful in\-person collaboration with flexibility, our focus is to optimize performance and drive connection for moments that matter.
   

  

**Who We Are**
 Mattel is a leading global toy and family entertainment company and owner of one of the most iconic brand portfolios in the world. We engage consumers and fans through our franchise brands, including Barbie, Hot Wheels, Fisher\-Price, American Girl, Thomas \& Friends, UNO, Masters of the Universe, Matchbox, Monster High, MEGA and Polly Pocket, as well as other popular properties that we own or license in partnership with global entertainment companies. Our offerings include toys, content, consumer products, digital and live experiences. Our products are sold in collaboration with the world’s leading retail and ecommerce companies. Since its founding in 1945, Mattel is proud to be a trusted partner in empowering generations to explore the wonder of childhood and reach their full potential.
   

  

 Mattel’s award\-winning workplace culture has been recognized by Forbes, Fast Company, Newsweek, Great Place to Work, TIME, and more.
   

  

 Visit us at https //jobs.mattel.com/ and www.instagram.com/MattelCareers .

92813cf8.title: Senior Solution Architect
92813cf8.description:
**Job Description**
**Ciklum** 
 is looking for a
 **Senior Solution Architect** 
 to join our team full\-time in India.
   

  

 We are a custom product engineering company that supports both multinational organizations and scaling startups to solve their most complex business challenges. With a global team of over 4,000 highly skilled developers, consultants, analysts and product owners, we engineer technology that redefines industries and shapes the way people live.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As a Senior Solution Architect, become a part of a cross\-functional development team engineering experiences of tomorrow.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Define the target architecture, integration patterns and reusable components across the conversational AI, API and data layers
* Design API contracts and middleware that decouple the virtual assistant from backend systems
* Produce solution designs, architecture diagrams and technical decision records for client review and sign\-off
* Agree access, integration approach and non\-functional requirements with client architects and system owners
* Run technical feasibility spikes and assess API readiness, dependencies and delivery risks
* Set the security and authentication approach, including identity, access control, audit logging and PII handling
* Keep track of the client's wider programme landscape to avoid duplication and design conflicts


**Requirements**
* API and middleware design: REST, canonical JSON contracts, payload transformation (JSON, XML, SQL), versioning, retries, rate limiting and standardised error handling
* Cloud architecture, ideally AWS serverless (API Gateway, Lambda, Secrets Manager, DynamoDB), with CI/CD awareness. Equivalent GCP or Azure depth is acceptable
* Security and identity: OAuth2, OIDC, JWT, service accounts, role\-based access control and GDPR\-aware data handling
* Data integration: warehouse and analytics platforms such as Snowflake or Databricks, including secure API access
* Applied LLM experience: prompt design, extraction of structured data from free text, confidence scoring and guardrails
* Integration with CRM and ticketing platforms such as Salesforce, Oracle Service Cloud, Jira Service Management or ServiceNow
* Clear written and verbal communication, including producing design documentation that passes enterprise review
* 8 or more years in software or solution architecture, including 3 or more years as a solution or integration architect on enterprise programmes
* Consulting or client\-facing experience in large, matrixed organisations


**Desirable**
* Voice AI or contact centre as a service (CCaaS) experience
* Multi\-agent or supervisor orchestration patterns
* Experience modernising or wrapping legacy APIs
* Work in regulated sectors such as financial services, healthcare or education
* Relevant cloud or platform certifications (for example AWS Solutions Architect Professional)


**Personal Skills**
* Pragmatic: knows when to wrap a legacy system and when to wait for its replacement
* Proactive in unblocking access and dependencies with system owners, rather than designing around them

cb58168e.title: Sr. Application Architect
cb58168e.description:
**Description**
 AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and
   

  

 fastest growing small\- and mid\-market accounts to enterprise\-level customers including public sector.
   

  

 Are you an experienced cloud architect/developer who can assist customers in designing and developing cloud\-native, AI\-integrated applications and/or re\-engineering applications to fully leverage the AWS Cloud? Do you like working on game\-changing projects at the forefront of application development, AI Agents, and cloud technology adoption?
   

  

 AWS ProServe India LLP is looking for highly talented hands\-on technical architects to accelerate our growing Professional Services business in India. You'll join Amazon's world\-class technical teams, working on diverse projects including reimagining customer agent\-enabled applications, modernization, Generative AI adoption, and AI\-DLC application development.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
 Design and build well\-architected, cloud\-native applications leveraging AWS services (EC2, ECS, Elastic Beanstalk, Auto Scaling, etc.)
   

  

 Architect AI/ML solutions using AWS AI services (Bedrock, SageMaker, Amazon Q, Rekognition, Comprehend)
   

  

 Guide customers through the AI Development Life Cycle (AI\-DLC) — from data readiness and model development to deployment and continuous improvement
   

  

 Design Generative AI and Agentic AI architectures that are secure, scalable, and cost\-optimized
   

  

 Advise on responsible AI practices including governance, explainability, and bias detection
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 We are looking for hands\-on architects/developers who are passionate about:
   

  

* Help internal customers make decisions on their cloud and AI journey, define scalable architecture, highly available solutions that leverage AWS services and AI capabilities
* Assisting internal customers to architect and develop applications that are cloud\-optimized and AI\-integrated, including Generative AI and Agentic AI solutions
* Working as a technical leader alongside customer business, development, and infrastructure teams
* Guiding customers through the AI Development Life Cycle (AI\-DLC), from problem framing, data readiness, and model selection to deployment, evaluation, and continuous improvement
* Sharing deep software development knowledge with respect to cloud architecture, AI design patterns, and programming
* Advising and implementing AWS best practices for both cloud\-native and AI\-powered workloads
* Assisting internal customers in infrastructure, application development, and AI solution integration
* Assisting internal customers in agile software development and Implementation of DevOps practices
* Independently leading a team that delivers applications including AI\-enabled features spanning the full software lifecycle: design, implementation, testing, deployment, and maintenance strategy
* Scoping development efforts, identifying risks, and prioritizing deliverables to meet organizational goals; providing guidance so your team designs solutions making the right trade\-offs between innovation, speed, and operational excellence


**About The Team**
 Diverse Experiences
   

  

 Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
   

  

 Why AWS
   

  

 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
   

  

 Work/Life Balance
   

  

 We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
   

  

 Inclusive Team Culture
   

  

 Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee\-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
   

  

 Mentorship and Career Growth
   

  

 We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 10\+ years of technical specialist, design and architecture experience
* 10\+ years of consulting, design and implementation of serverless distributed solutions experience
* 10\+ years of software development with object oriented language experience
* 10\+ years of external or internal customer facing, complex and large scale project management experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or equivalent
* Travel up to 30% of the time


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 6\+ years of leading development of applications backed by AWS services or using other cloud based technologies and services experience
* Experience with designing and building application using AWS services such as Lambda, AWS Elastic Beanstalk, Kubernetes
* Experience in one of the following programming languages: Java, Python, Ruby, Node.js, C\#, or C
* Experience in professional, non\-internship software development, or experience in machine learning, data mining, information retrieval, statistics or natural language processing
* Experience with CloudFormation, Chef, Puppet, Salt, or Ansible in production environments
* Familiarity with AI\-DLC data preparation, prompt engineering, model evaluation, and deploying Generative/Agentic AI solutions


 Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. 9e5cd6af.description:
**Description**
 The AWS Industries team is committed to helping industry customers enable their digital transformation journeys. Our primary goal is to meet customers in their cloud journeys and work backwards from their industry\-specific needs to transform their businesses and industries. Our team focuses on business outcomes and industry use cases on behalf of our customers, whether that is how we build products and solutions, how we sell, how we deliver, or how we partner.
   

  

 As an Amazon Web Services (AWS) Solutions Architect within the Strategic Accounts segment you are responsible for partnering with our most valuable customers to design cloud architectures utilizing AWS services. You have technical depth, business aptitude, and the ability to lead in\-depth technology discussions, articulating the business value of the AWS platform and services. Effective communication and interpersonal skills are required for engaging and influence Enterprise Architects, Technical Architects, Cloud Architects, Directors, VP’s and CXOs.
   

  

 You will be part of a culture of innovation where you’ll use AWS services to help our customers solve business challenges such as rapidly releasing products/services to the market or building an elastic, scalable, cost optimized application. Enable innovation through continuous deployment in DevOps, build highly scalable web \& mobile applications with data store technologies.
   

  

 AWS services cover a wide range of technologies including operational security, infrastructure, DevOps, highly available software architectures, observability, machine learning and analytics. Our customer solutions usually involve many of these at once. AWS Solutions Architects are expected to have at least one technical areas of depth, but also need to be capable of leading discussions across most of these areas.
   

  

 Here at AWS, we embrace our differences. We are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. We have ten employee\-led affinity groups, reaching 40,000 employees in over 190 chapters globally. We have innovative benefit offerings, and we host annual and ongoing learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon diversity conferences. Amazon’s culture of inclusion is reinforced within our 14 Leadership Principles, which remind team members to seek diverse perspectives, learn and be curious, and earn trust.
   

  

 Our team also puts a high value on work\-life balance. Striking a healthy balance between your personal and professional life is crucial to your happiness and success here, which is why we aren’t focused on how many hours you spend at work or online. Instead, we’re happy to offer a flexible schedule so you can have a more productive and well\-balanced life—both in and outside of work.
   

  

 Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects based on what will help each team member develop into a better\-rounded professional and enable them to take on more complex tasks in the future.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 As a Solutions Architect, you will provide architectural and technical leadership to a portfolio of customers who are looking to leverage AWS services at scale. You will be the domain expert guiding architectural design decisions, while demonstrating customer obsession to ensure high availability and performance of the customers applications. You’ll have the opportunity to learn and be curious while evangelizing the latest innovations and best practices in infrastructure, engineering and application design. You will mentor peers and customers while growing your knowledge.
   

  

 As a core member of the account team, you will drive revenue growth across a specific customer. As a trusted customer advocate, you will help organizations understand and implement advanced cloud\-based solutions, and how to migrate existing workloads to the cloud. You will have the opportunity to shape and execute a strategy to build knowledge and broad use of AWS. You will also need to be adept at interacting, communicating and partnering with other teams within AWS such as services teams, marketing, and professional services, as well as representing your team to executive management.
   

  

**About The Team**
 The AWS Industries team is committed to helping industry customers enable their digital transformation journeys. Our primary goal is to meet customers in their cloud journeys and work backwards from their industry\-specific needs to transform their businesses and industries. Our team focuses on business outcomes and industry use cases on behalf of our customers, whether that is how we build products and solutions, how we sell, how we deliver, or how we partner.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
* Knowledge of cloud architecture
* 10\+ years of architecting/operating solutions built on any cloud service provider like Azure, AWS, GCP, OCI, etc. experience


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Knowledge of software development tools and methodologies
* Knowledge of AWS services, market segments, customer base and industry verticals
* 7\+ years of cloud architecture and solution implementation experience, or AWS Professional level certification
* Experience leading the architecture and design (architecture, design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and current systems, or experience building complex software systems that have been successfully delivered to customers
* 10\+ years' experience in designing and implementing large distributed systems, with deep expertise in core infrastructure, solution architecture, and distributed computing patterns.
* Professional experience in pre\-sales consulting with proven presentation skills, executive engagement capabilities, and track record of effectively communicating with stakeholders at all levels while managing ambiguous requirements.


 Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. 47084d58.description:
**Company Description**
 Version 1 has celebrated 30 years in business and continues to be trusted by global brands to deliver technology and transformation solutions that drive customer success. Our deep expertise enables our customers to navigate the rapidly evolving technology landscape. We foster strong partnerships with global technology leaders including Microsoft, AWS, Oracle, Red Hat, OutSystems, Snowflake, ensuring that our customers are provided with the highest quality solutions and services.
   

  

 We’re an award\-winning employer reflecting how our employees are at the very heart of  what we do:
   

  

* UK \& Ireland's premier AWS, Microsoft \& Oracle partner
* 3300\+ strong, €350/£300m revenue business
* 10\+ years as a Great Place to Work in Ireland \& UK
* Best Workplace for Women in the UK \& Ireland by GPTW
* Best Workplace for Wellbeing in the UK by GPTW


 We’re a core values driven company, we hire people who share our values, and we reward those who display and foster them, it’s deeply embedded within our DNA. Invest in us and we’ll invest in you!.
   

  

**Job Description**
 As an Oracle Cloud ERP Functional Support Consultant (L2\), you will be responsible for providing first and second line support across the Oracle ERP suite. You will act as the initial point of contact for user queries and system issues, ensuring effective triage, resolution where possible, and appropriate escalation to L2/L3 teams.
   

  

 This is a process\-driven, customer\-focused role requiring strong communication skills, attention to detail, and the ability to operate effectively within an ITIL\-aligned support environment.
   

  

 You must be willing to work flexible hours on rotation including cover until 23:00 UK Time/ 04:30 IST (shift allowance payable).
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* You will deliver day\-to\-day operational support activities across one or more Oracle ERP modules (Financials, Procurement, Projects, HCM and other ERP areas), working as part of a global managed services team.
* Your responsibilities will include triaging incoming incidents and service requests, assessing their priority and business impact, and ensuring they are correctly categorised, logged, and assigned within the ITSM tool. You will take ownership of tickets through their lifecycle, monitoring progress, proactively following up with resolver groups, and ensuring timely resolution within agreed SLAs.
* As part of your role, you will resolve standard L1 \& L2 queries directly. This includes responding to “how do I” questions from end users, providing guidance on system processes, and supporting users in navigating Oracle Cloud ERP functionality. You will perform routine system administration activities such as user setup, password resets, role provisioning, and basic access management in accordance with defined security and governance procedures.
* You will engage with customers through agreed communication channels, providing regular and clear updates on ticket status and ensuring a high standard of customer service at all times.
* Where issues cannot be resolved at L1 or L2, you will ensure they are escalated to L2/L3 support teams with sufficient detail, including replication steps, logs, and impact analysis, to enable efficient resolution.
* You will contribute to knowledge management by documenting recurring issues, known errors, and standard operating procedures, helping to build a robust and reusable knowledge base.
* Additionally, you will support service improvement initiatives by identifying recurring incidents or trends and raising these with senior team members to enable root cause analysis and problem management.
* You will also assist in supporting Oracle Cloud quarterly release cycles by carrying out defined testing activities, logging defects, and supporting validation of fixes under guidance.


**Qualifications**
**Essential Qualifications \& Experience**
* Experience working in an application support or service desk role (2 to 3 years preferred)
* Exposure to Oracle ERP Cloud (Financials including General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Cash Management, PPM and related modules)
* Good understanding of basic ERP processes and business workflows
* Experience using ITSM tools for incident and request management
* Familiarity with ITIL concepts such as incident management, service requests, and SLAs
* Good analytical and problem\-solving skills with strong attention to detail
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Ability to work in a shift\-based model and collaborate across global teams


**Desirable Skills**
* Hands\-on experience with Oracle Cloud ERP modules (Finance, Projects, Procurement, etc.)
* Experience with user/security administration (role assignment, access control)
* Understanding of Oracle Cloud navigation, reporting tools (e.g. OTBI), or workflows
* Exposure to testing processes or release management activities
* Awareness of integrations or interfaces within ERP ecosystems


**Key Behaviours \& Attributes**
* Customer\-first mindset with a focus on responsiveness and service quality
* Strong organisational skills and ability to manage multiple tickets concurrently
* Process\-driven approach with adherence to defined support procedures
* Willingness to learn and develop functional expertise across Oracle ERP modules
* Ability to work collaboratively within onshore/offshore delivery teams


**Additional Information**
