87ffc366.description:
**Description**
 AWS Global Services includes experts from across AWS who help our customers design, build, operate, and secure their cloud environments. Customers innovate with AWS Professional Services, upskill with AWS Training and Certification, optimize with AWS Support and Managed Services, and meet objectives with AWS Security Assurance Services. Our expertise and emerging technologies include AWS Partners, AWS Sovereign Cloud, AWS International Product, and the Generative AI Innovation Center. You’ll join a diverse team of technical experts in dozens of countries who help customers achieve more with the AWS cloud.
   

  

 We are looking for a Senior Engagement Manager to lead and deliver complex, multi\-workstream cloud transformation programs for AWS Professional Services (ProServe) India. In this role, you will own the end\-to\-end delivery lifecycle of large and complex customer engagements, shaping cloud strategies, driving business outcomes, and acting as a trusted advisor to senior customer stakeholders.
   

  

 The ideal candidate is an experienced program leader with deep IT consulting expertise, a proven track record in delivering complex technical programs across enterprise customers, and the ability to navigate ambiguity with limited guidance. You thrive in a fast\-paced, growth environment, insist on incredibly high standards, and are passionate about mentoring others and scaling delivery best practices across teams.
   

  

 You will lead matrixed teams of AWS consultants, partners, and customer resources across multiple workstreams simultaneously. You are expected to drive delivery excellence, maximize engagement value, manage risks proactively, and serve as a force multiplier for your peers and the broader organization. You will actively contribute to pre\-sales, build deep customer trust, and leverage AI/GenAI to drive delivery innovation.
   

  

 In this capacity you will be based in India and are expected to travel occasionally (30\-40%). You will report into the India ProServe Engagement Management Delivery Practice Manager.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Own and lead end\-to\-end delivery of complex, multi\-workstream cloud transformation programs, ensuring business outcomes are achieved within schedule, scope, and financial constraints.
* Shape and validate cloud delivery strategies for complex engagements, applying frameworks such as the Cloud Adoption Framework (CAF), Well\-Architected Framework (WAF), and Engagement Delivery Framework (EDF).
* Serve as a strategic advisor to senior customer stakeholders, leading steering committees, driving alignment, and building deep trusted relationships.
* Proactively identify, manage, and escalate risks and issues; develop and execute mitigation plans; redirect distressed programs to delight customers.
* Maximize engagement value by negotiating conditions of acceptance, managing scope changes, and amending contractual terms within project constraints.
* Drive delivery excellence across engagements by defining and sharing EM best practices, creating reusable mechanisms, and establishing operational excellence.
* Actively mentor and develop team members; perform Technical Promotion Assessments (TPAs) and coach Engagement Managers to raise the bar.
* Participate in pre\-sales activities, contributing to proposals, scoping, and business development for complex services engagements.
* Leverage Agentic AI and GenAI to optimize delivery processes, improve team productivity, and drive innovative customer outcomes.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional AWS teams including Delivery Consultants, Account Executives, Cloud Architects, and Partner teams to solution and deliver cloud programs.


**About The Team**
 Diverse Experiences
   

  

 AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
   

  

 Why AWS?
   

  

 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
   

  

 Inclusive Team Culture
   

  

 AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
   

  

 Mentorship \& Career Growth
   

  

 We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.
   

  

 Work/Life Balance
   

  

 We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 7\+ years of leading multiple Agile teams (like Scrum Masters, Product Owners) concurrently or at scale experience
* 7\+ years of leading and delivering enterprise\-level IT engagements experience
* Knowledge of the value proposition of the public cloud and cloud engagement delivery (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS)
* Experience with Agile and project management toolsets like Jira, Rally, VersionOne or Taiga
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent, or 7\+ years of project/program management experience


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience working with and presenting to C\-level executives, IT, and lines of businesses across organizations or equivalent
* PMP, Prince2, PgMP, SAFe or SCRUM/Agile certification
* 9\+ years of working with Data \& AI related technologies, including, but not limited to, AI/ML, GenAI, Analytics, Database, and/or Storage experience
* AWS certification, such as, AWS Solutions Architect, or a similar cloud certification
* Partner delivery experience — enabling and managing delivery through third\-party partners


 Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information.  Content Commerce is a new and high\-impact initiative at the intersection of content, advertising and commerce. The vision is to make content shoppable. Users should be able to discover products naturally while watching shows, movies, sports, or short\-form content \- and move from inspiration to purchase with minimal friction. This team will build the platform that powers commerce experiences across JioHotstar content surfaces. * Strong grasp of risk/reward tradeoffs, and comfort operating in fast\-moving, high\-stakes environments with shifting priorities and evolving context
* Exceptional communicator, skilled in managing stakeholder expectations and aligning diverse teams on shared timelines, goals, and impact
* Strong program management experience managing cross functional initiatives end to end and driving influence without authority

8a7cc04d.description:
The Meta Product Technical Program Management (TPM) community is pioneering technologies to bring users and businesses at a global scale. Product TPMs work at the cross\-section between technical execution and business strategy and are expected to partner closely with Engineering and Product teams. Being a TPM at Meta means driving impact by delivering measurable results across a wide range of areas. You'll be responsible for defining and guiding high\-level goals and roadmaps, monitoring and communicating progress, and defining functional requirements for new products and features. It also means having a technical background in system architecture and cross\-functional product delivery, understanding system architecture, and the experience to effectively collaborate across functions and organizations to deliver impact.This role is for a Technical Program Manager with ASIC design and development experience. This Technical Program Manager will lead cross\-functional and multi\-site teams on delivering ASICs to enable Meta's Infrastructure Engineering organization, whose responsibilities include the growth, management and 24x7 upkeep of Meta's family of apps. This is a full\-time position reporting to the Director Technical Program Manager.
   

  

 Technical Program Manager, ASIC Responsibilities:
   

  

* Manage cross\-functional infrastructure programs in a matrix organization covering a range of functional areas in Silicon Engineering, Platform Software, Hardware Systems, Sourcing \& Operations and vendors
* Drive and manage ASIC development and their subsystems with vendors, from concept to production
* Provide hands\-on program management during all phases of silicon and firmware development from concept, design, development, fabrication, validation, qualification and production release phases
* Engage with stakeholders to define product development roadmaps
* Drive program execution to deliver high quality ASIC solutions
* Drive internal process improvements across multiple teams and functions
* Work with the software, hardware, architecture teams to understand requirements and constraints


 Minimum Qualifications:
   

  

* BS degree in Computer Science, Computer / Electrical Engineering or other technical field
* 10\+ years of experience in ASIC development
* 2\+ years of experience in Program/Product Management or Engineering Management with proven leadership in delivering successful products
* Demonstrated experience to manage from technical details to big picture
* Experience in managing ASIC design flow (architecture, micro\-architecture, RTL, Synthesis, functional verification, physical layout etc.)
* Experience in pre\-silicon testing with Emulation, FPGA and post\-silicon validation
* Experience managing stakeholder communication and alignment across cross\-functional teams, including defining shared goals, resolving competing priorities, and driving consensus
* Experience leading cross\-functional programs by defining milestones, coordinating across teams, and driving execution to delivery


 Preferred Qualifications:
   

  

* Hands\-on RTL design experience with VHDL/Verilog/SystemVerilog and modern Design Verification methodologies
* Work experience in semiconductor start\-ups
* Familiar with semiconductor technology and manufacturing processes
* Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies
* Familiarity with Machine Learning training or inference silicon and systems
* Experience with data center architecture and deployment
* Experience working with ODMs/vendors
* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
* Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)

 Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. **Description**
 AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small\- and mid\-market accounts to enterprise\-level customers including public sector.
   

  

 As an Amazon Web Services (AWS) Solutions Architect in AWS Industries HCLS segment, you are responsible for partnering with our most valuable customers to design cloud and AI architectures utilizing AWS services. You have technical depth, business aptitude, and the ability to lead in\-depth technology discussions, articulating the business value of the AWS platform and services. Effective communication and interpersonal skills are required for engaging and influence Enterprise Architects, Technical Architects, Cloud Architects, Directors, VP’s and CXOs.
   

  

 You will partner some of the worlds largest companies, to craft highly scalable, flexible and resilient cloud and AI architectures that address customer business problems and accelerate the adoption of AWS services. In collaboration with account managers, you will assist in driving growth across a small set of global customers in your defined country. As a trusted customer advocate, the solutions architect will help organizations understand best practices around advanced cloud\-based solutions, and how to migrate existing workloads to the cloud. You will have the opportunity to help shape and execute a strategy to build mind\-share and broad use of AWS within enterprise customers. The ability to connect technology with measurable business value is critical to a solutions architect. You should also have a demonstrated ability to think strategically about business, products, and technical challenges.
   

  

**Here Are Some Other Qualities We Are Looking For**
 Enjoy working with large, global customers as an active contributor to a diverse team. You will have a passion for educating, training, designing, and building cloud solutions for a diverse and challenging set of enterprise customers.
   

  

 Have a strong understanding of large scale computing solutions. You will enjoy keeping your existing technical skills honed and developing new ones, so you can make strong contributions to deep architecture discussions. You will regularly take part in deep\-dive education and design exercises to create world\-class solutions built on AWS.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Ensure success in building and migrating applications, software and services on the AWS platform
* Architect AI\-ML and Generative AI solutions on AWS
* In partnership with the account management team, formulate and execute a strategy
* Educate customers of all sizes on the value proposition of AWS, and participate in deep architectural discussions to ensure solutions are designed for successful deployment in the cloud
* Conduct one\-to\-few and one\-to\-many training sessions to transfer knowledge to customers considering or already using AWS
* Capture and share best\-practice knowledge amongst the AWS solutions architect community
* Author or otherwise contribute to AWS customer\-facing publications such as whitepapers
* Build deep relationships with senior technical individuals within customers to enable them to be cloud advocates
* Act as a technical liaison between customers, service engineering teams and support


 A day in the life
   

  

* Review customer requirements and technical challenges, focusing on opportunities to implement complex solutions architectures that can transform business outcomes also leveraging AI capabilities
* Develop proof\-of\-concepts that demonstrate how cloud solutions can transform business processes
* Influence service team leadership and product marketing on the future needs for customers, prioritizing roadmap features and GTM messaging
* Dedicate time to continuous learning about the latest advancements in AWS service capabilities
* Participate in knowledge sharing activities with colleagues, creating field enablement materials to help tech community understand how to integrate cloud solutions into customer architectures


**About The Team**

 Colgate\-Palmolive Company is a global consumer products company operating in over 200 countries specializing in Oral Care, Personal Care, Home Care, Skin Care, and Pet Nutrition. Our products are trusted in more households than any other brand in the world, making us a household name!

Guided by our core values—Caring, Inclusive, and Courageous—we foster a culture that inspires our people to achieve common goals. Together, let's build a brighter, healthier future for all.
   

  

 Role Overview The Planning Solution Architect is the technical and functional visionary for the global supply chain planning landscape. This role is responsible for designing a seamless, end\-to\-end planning architecture that integrates Demand, Supply, Inventory, and S\&OP processes. You will lead the strategic transition from legacy SAP APO environments to modern platforms like Kinaxis Maestro, ensuring that the organization achieves "Concurrent Planning" capabilities and real\-time visibility.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Architectural Strategy: Design the target\-state architecture for global planning, defining the co\-existence or migration strategy between SAP APO, SAP IBP, and Kinaxis.
* End\-to\-End Planning Integration: Ensure seamless data and process flow between Demand Planning (DP), Supply Network Planning (SNP), and Production Planning/Detailed Scheduling (PP/DS) within the planning hub.
* Concurrent Planning Excellence: Configure Kinaxis to enable instant "what\-if" scenario analysis, ensuring that a change in demand is immediately reflected across the entire supply network.
* Algorithm \& Solver Optimization: Lead the selection and configuration of planning engines, including Heuristics, Optimizers (Linear Programming), and Statistical Forecasting models.
* S\&OP Transformation: Architect the Integrated Business Planning (IBP) process to align financial targets with operational capabilities, facilitating executive\-level decision\-making.
* Data Orchestration: Define the Master Data strategy (Material, Location, Resource, BOM, and Routing) required to sustain high\-fidelity planning models across multiple tools.


 Domain Expertise \& Planning Principles
   

  

* Demand Management: Mastery of statistical forecasting, demand sensing, and collaborative forecasting.
* Supply \& Capacity Planning: Deep understanding of Rough Cut Capacity Planning (RCCP), constrained vs. unconstrained supply plans, and multi\-level pegging.
* Inventory Optimization (IO): Experience in Multi\-Echelon Inventory Optimization (MEIO) to balance service levels against working capital.
* Response \& Resupply: Designing logic for prioritized demand fulfillment and automated supply re\-balancing during disruptions.


 Technical Proficiency
   

  

* Kinaxis Maestro (RapidResponse): Expert\-level knowledge of Authoring (Resources, Attributes, Workbooks), Task Flows, and Integration .
* SAP IBP: Hands\-on experience with IBP Demand, IBP Supply \& Response, and IBP Inventory modules, including configuration of Planning Areas and Key Figures.
* SAP APO: Deep legacy knowledge of DP and SNP; ability to extract business logic from APO to migrate to modern cloud platforms.
* Integration Technologies: Proficiency in integrating planning hubs with ERP backbones (e.g., SAP S/4HANA or ECC) using SAP CPI\-DS, SDI, or flat\-file interfaces.


**Required Experience \& Qualifications**
* Experience: 10\+ years in Supply Chain Planning IT, with at least 5 years as a Solution Architect.
* Implementation Track Record: Proven experience leading at least two global implementations involving the integration of Kinaxis or SAP IBP with a legacy SAP landscape.
* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Operations Research, Industrial Engineering, or Information Technology.
* Certifications: Kinaxis Certified Author/Architect and/or SAP IBP Professional Certification.


 Soft Skills
   

  

* Strategic Communication: Ability to translate complex algorithmic logic (like Optimizer costs or Kinaxis heuristics) into clear business outcomes for stakeholders.
* Analytical Problem Solving: A "systems\-thinking" mindset to identify how a planning configuration in one node affects the global network.
* Change Leadership: Experience guiding planning teams through the mindset shift from "Batch Processing" (APO) to "Continuous/Concurrent Planning" (Kinaxis/IBP).

acc57c7b.title: Technology Solution Engineer
acc57c7b.description:
**Role Overview**
 The Technology Solution Engineer works with business and technology stakeholders to shape technical solutions, then builds them. This is a deliberately broad, hands\-on role that combines consultative solution design with real delivery across the enterprise technology platforms.
   

  

 At this level, the Technology Solution Engineer owns solutions end to end. The role runs requirement workshops directly with business stakeholders, authors the design, makes independent technical decisions, and leads the build through to operational handover. Work spans the full platform estate rather than a single technology, and includes reviewing the work of others and mentoring less experienced engineers.
   

  

 The platforms in scope include cloud infrastructure on Microsoft Azure and Amazon Web Services, integration, automation, APIs, containers, and web hosting. Platforms are run both as internal products and as managed services, so the role carries accountability for how solutions run as well as how they are built.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Solution Consulting and Design**
* Engage business functions and technology stakeholders to understand objectives, constraints, and the problem behind the request.
* Facilitate requirement and design workshops, and translate outcomes into clear technical solution designs.
* Produce options analyses with honest trade\-offs across cost, risk, delivery time, supportability, and strategic fit.
* Author solution designs, architecture decision records, interface definitions, and non\-functional requirements.


**Cross\-Platform Solution Delivery**
* Design and build solutions spanning cloud infrastructure, integration, APIs, automation, containers, and web hosting.
* Provision and configure platform services using Terraform, Ansible, and the approved Infrastructure as Code toolchain.
* Develop supporting automation and tooling in Python, PowerShell, Bash, or another appropriate language.
* Lead technical delivery of solutions involving multiple platforms and multiple contributing teams.


**Service Transition and Operational Ownership**
* Ensure solutions meet operational readiness criteria before production release, including monitoring, alerting, runbooks, backup, and recovery.
* Instrument solutions for observability using Datadog, Dynatrace, Prometheus, Grafana, Splunk, Cribl, or Observe.
* Own investigation and resolution of complex issues, root\-cause analysis, and preventive corrective actions.


**Security, Compliance, and Risk**
* Design and build to enterprise security standards, applying identity and access patterns based on Entra ID, Okta, OAuth2, and least privilege.
* Manage secrets and certificates through HashiCorp Vault, CyberArk, and cloud\-native key services.
* Identify and articulate technical risk, technical debt, and exceptions, with practical remediation proposals.


**Technical Craft and Engineering Practices**
* Write clean, tested, peer\-reviewed code and configuration, managed in version control with trunk\-based practices.
* Review the work of other engineers and raise the standard of design and implementation across the team.
* Use AI\-assisted engineering tools such as GitHub Copilot and Claude Code to accelerate design, development, testing, and documentation, applying appropriate review and technical judgement.


**Collaboration and Ways of Working**
* Work within an agile team with a shared backlog, defined customers, and service\-level objectives.
* Act as a credible technical partner to business stakeholders, explaining trade\-offs in plain language.
* Coordinate across platform, cloud, integration, web, security, architecture, and operations teams.
* Mentor less experienced engineers through pairing, review, and structured feedback.


**Qualifications**
**Required**
* Demonstrated capability in solution engineering, platform engineering, or technical delivery
* Strong hands\-on experience with at least one major public cloud, with practical exposure to a second.
* Proven ability to own a solution end to end, from requirements through design, build, and operational handover.
* Practical Infrastructure as Code experience with Terraform, and configuration management with Ansible.
* Proficiency in at least one scripting or programming language such as Python, PowerShell, Bash, JavaScript, or Java.
* Working knowledge across several of: containers and Kubernetes, integration and APIs, web hosting, networking, and identity.
* Demonstrated ability to run workshops and engage business stakeholders directly.
* Clear written and verbal communication in English, including presenting designs to technical and non\-technical audiences.


**Preferred**
* Experience mentoring engineers or leading small technical workstreams.
* Experience with OpenShift, Backstage or another developer portal, and GitOps tooling.
* Experience with integration or API platforms such as MuleSoft, Kafka, Solace, or Kong.
* Experience with web and application server technologies such as IIS, Tomcat, Apache, or Nginx.
* Experience delivering within a validated, GxP, or otherwise regulated environment, including awareness of data\-protection obligations such as GDPR.
* Certifications such as AWS or Azure professional or expert level, Certified Kubernetes Administrator, HashiCorp Terraform Associate, ITIL, or an agile qualification.
* A bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, information technology, or a related discipline.


**Core Competencies**
* Consultative mindset with genuine interest in the business problem
* Strong technical judgement and architectural awareness
* Breadth across technologies combined with useful depth in several
* Clear communication and stakeholder credibility
* Bias toward reuse, standardisation, and simplification
* Ownership and accountability from design through to operation
* Willingness to mentor and raise the standard around them


**Measures of Success**
* Solutions delivered to agreed scope, quality, cost, and timeline
* Increased reuse of approved patterns and platform capabilities, and reduced bespoke build
* Reduced defects, rework, and post\-implementation incidents
* Improved availability and supportability of delivered solutions
* Stakeholder satisfaction and repeat demand from business functions
* Reduced security findings and audit exceptions in delivered solutions
* Demonstrable growth in the engineers mentored

At the PFI Innovation Centre India, you’ll find high\-performance culture that’s flexible, collaborative, and grounded in respect. Based in India, the Director, Integrated Modeling Solutions will lead the team responsible for the architecture, design, development, testing, governance, and delivery of Prudential's strategic PyVal and Eureka! modeling platforms. This role combines deep financial or actuarial modeling expertise with modern software engineering, people leadership, and disciplined execution to advance an integrated global modeling ecosystem supporting valuation, forecasting, capital management, asset liability management, reinsurance analysis, and strategic decision\-making.

 If you are looking for an opportunity to solve deep technical problems and drive large\-scale cross\-functional initiatives in a fast\-paced environment working with smart, passionate engineers and business leaders, this might be the role for you.
   

  

 Within the Transportation Technology and Services organization, Relay Central delivers a seamless, intelligent, and trusted foundation that empowers Amazon’s middle mile carriers to thrive in a fast\-moving, complex environment. We believe that great products and experiences should enable carriers to focus on what matters most — safety, reliability, operational excellence, and growing their business with Amazon.
   

  

 Relay Central’s mission is to help carriers succeed while insisting on the highest standards across safety, compliance, trust, and delivery quality. We are building the systems, experiences, and operational mechanisms that simplify complexity, reduce friction, and create confidence for carriers operating within Amazon’s transportation network.
   

  

 By unifying essential capabilities into one cohesive experience, we enable smooth onboarding, effective trip management, trusted operational support, and engaging loyalty experiences. Our vision is to become the trusted control tower for carriers — delivering the right insights, tools, and intelligent experiences that unlock carrier potential and help shape the future of transportation.
   

  

 Our team is actively seeking motivated and multi\-talented individuals who are passionate about reinventing and transforming transportation and logistics operations while maintaining a relentless focus on customer trust and operational excellence.
   

  

 As a Senior Technical Program Manager, you will lead complex, cross\-functional programs that power the Relay Central platform and carrier experience. You will partner closely with engineering, product, operations, and business stakeholders to deliver scalable solutions that improve carrier success while upholding Amazon’s high bar for quality, reliability, and customer trust.
   

  

 You will own roadmap planning, dependency management, execution mechanisms, and delivery for strategic initiatives spanning multiple teams and organizations. This role requires strong technical depth, excellent judgment, and the ability to influence across organizations. You should be a self\-starter with a bias for action who can balance long\-term vision with operational rigor in highly ambiguous environments.
   

  

 Successful candidates will have a proven track record of driving large\-scale technical programs, simplifying complex problems, and delivering measurable business impact while maintaining high standards in execution.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Lead large\-scale technical programs and strategic initiatives across Relay Central and partner organizations
   

  

 Drive initiatives that improve carrier experience, operational efficiency, platform scalability, and trust
   

  

 Partner with engineering teams to design simple, scalable, and sustainable solutions to complex business and technical challenges
   

  

 Establish mechanisms that raise the bar on execution, operational excellence, and delivery quality
   

  

 Drive roadmap planning, execution tracking, dependency management, and release coordination across multiple teams
   

  

 Work backwards from carrier and business needs to influence product and technical direction
   

  

 Identify risks proactively and drive alignment across technical and non\-technical stakeholders
   

  

 Communicate program status, risks, and trade\-offs clearly to senior leadership and partner teams
   

  

 Use data\-driven decision making to improve customer outcomes and operational performance
   

  

 Help build a culture of ownership, continuous improvement, and high standards across teams
   

  

 Professional traits that are not unique to this position, but necessary for Amazon leaders
   

  

 Exhibits excellent judgment
   

  

 Earns trust across technical and business teams
   

  

 Has relentlessly high standards and insists on operational excellence
   

  

 Is able to dive deep and stay connected to both business and technical details
   

  

 Thinks strategically while maintaining strong execution focus
   

  

 Demonstrates strong ownership and bias for action
   

  

 Has passion and conviction and the ability to inspire others
   

  

 Thinks big while remaining customer obsessed
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related technical discipline
   

  

 3\+ years of technical program management experience working directly with software engineering teams
   

  

 Experience managing large\-scale cross\-functional technical programs
   

  

 Experience driving roadmap strategy, execution planning, and release coordination
   

  

 Experience working with distributed systems and scalable software architectures
   

  

 Excellent written and verbal communication skills
   

  

 Experience that will make you successful in this role
   

  

 Strong technical depth with the ability to engage deeply with engineers and architects
   

  

 Proven track record of delivering complex technical initiatives in fast\-paced environments
   

  

 Ability to influence across organizations and align diverse stakeholders toward common goals
   

  

 Experience defining mechanisms and processes that improve execution at scale
   

  

 Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with attention to detail
   

  

 Ability to balance strategic thinking with operational execution
   

  

 Passion for improving customer and carrier experiences through technology and operational excellence
   

  

 Experience in transportation, logistics, marketplace, or operational technology domains is a plus
   

  

 Exceptional customer focus and ability to translate business needs into scalable technical solutions
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of technical product or program management experience
* 7\+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience

**Preferred Qualifications**

**Description**
 It’s no secret that Amazon relies on its technology to deliver millions of packages every day to its customers – on time, with low cost. We build the complex software solutions that work across our vendors, warehouses and carriers to optimize both the time and cost of getting packages delivered. Our products and services already handle thousands of requests per second, make business decisions impacting billions of dollars a year, integrate with a network of small and large carriers worldwide, manage business rules for millions of unique products, and improve the ordering and delivery experience for millions of online shoppers.
   

  

 We are looking for a Sr. Technical Program Manager (TPM) to join our growing team! This position requires influencing across multiple teams, businesses, and senior leaders. The role requires a deep understanding of customer needs and thinking big about how we can make the purchase experience across online retail seamless and delightful. The ideal candidate is excited by technology, passionate about learning and should view every customer interaction as an opportunity to create an exceptional experience. You will need to be entrepreneurial, and work in a highly collaborative environment. You have a track record of exceptional performance and love working in a dynamic, ambiguous, fast\-paced environment in which managing multiple projects and priorities is the norm. You dive deep and like the complexity of systems but drive simple, innovative solutions for customer\-facing experiences. You have excellent judgment and high standards. You are an articulate, persuasive communicator and a good writer. People trust and respect you and they like to work with you. You are eager to pioneer new experiences, putting the customer first and challenging conventional wisdom.

* Inspect \& adapt the delivery processes to bring continuous improvements in quality and speed.
* Share knowledge and best practices within and across SWA teams
* Driving technical programs related to supply chain, logistics, First mile operations, onboarding, network planning, Shipment lifecycle management, customer support and backend services of billing, payments, claims will be required.


**Basic Qualifications**

* 5\+ years of technical product or program management experience
* 3\+ years of software development experience
* 5\+ years of technical program management working directly with software engineering teams experience
* Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
* Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
* Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules
* Experience defining KPI's/SLA's used to drive multi\-million dollar businesses and reporting to senior leadership
* Experience in FinTech domain with UPI, digital wallets, cards , driving programs involving Billing and Payment flows (Accounts Payable, Account Receivable) and having interface with accounting, tax systems, Ledger systems, is highly desired

* Drive program milestones, remove blockers, and manage cross\-functional dependencies to ensure seamless delivery and measurable outcomes.
* Navigate high\-ambiguity environments by breaking down complex organizational challenges into actionable workstreams and data\-driven goals.
* Partner with Engineering, Product, and Business leadership to align priorities and ensure organizational readiness for global initiatives.

* Ability to propose and implement end\-to\-end solutions that enhance performance across multiple processes and global sites.
* Experience presenting strategic topics to senior leadership and creating scalable documentation (e.g., project plans, requirement documents, or reporting).
* Bachelor's degree in Business Operations, Engineering, or a related field; or equivalent professional experience.


****Preferred Qualifications****

* Ability to thrive in a fast\-paced environment with frequent changes in priority and tight deadlines.

As Senior Salesforce Consultant / Solution Architect, you will own the design, delivery and reliability of the enterprise Salesforce platform across **Sales Cloud and Service Cloud**. You will cover the full customer lifecycle, from onboarding through case management and ongoing account operations.


You will own the complete SDLC: consulting with the business, architecting solutions, building on the platform, integrating with the wider enterprise and keeping production stable. Salesforce consumes the customer golden record from an Oracle Fusion CDM master. Through **MuleSoft**, it connects to transportation management, billing, order management and finance systems.


**Why it matters:** sales, customer service and revenue operations depend on this platform daily. Your job is to keep it architecturally sound, reliably integrated and continuously improving.


### **What You’ll Do**


**Business Consulting \& Stakeholder Engagement**


* Translate business objectives into Salesforce capabilities.
* Run requirements workshops, solution discovery and impact analysis.
* Advise Customer Service, Sales Operations, Credit and Billing teams on future\-state processes.
* Provide technical guidance on account management, hierarchies, ownership and compensation.

**Solution Architecture \& Design**


* Design enterprise\-grade solutions across Sales Cloud, Service Cloud and the customer lifecycle.
* Produce solution designs, architecture diagrams, process flows and technical specifications.
* Recommend scalable, secure designs aligned to Salesforce best practice and governor limits.
* Lead design reviews and platform architecture governance.

**Platform Development**


* Build with Apex, Triggers, Lightning Web Components and Flows.
* Deliver Platform Events, REST/SOAP APIs, Custom Objects, Custom Metadata, Validation Rules and Approval Processes.
* Enhance account and case management, routing, hierarchies, ownership and compensation.
* Build reusable, well\-tested components and reduce technical debt.

**Enterprise Integration**


* Design and maintain integrations with MuleSoft, the customer master, TMS, billing, order management and ERP.
* Define integration architecture, authentication standards, asynchronous patterns and error handling.
* Monitor interfaces and resolve synchronisation and data\-processing failures.

**Production Support \& Reliability**


* Resolve production incidents across Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, integrations and automation.
* Monitor scheduled jobs, Batch and Queueable Apex, Platform Events, Flows and async processes.
* Lead root cause analysis so recurring issues get permanent fixes.
* Run proactive health checks to protect service levels and performance.

**Data Management \& Reconciliation**


* Reconcile data between Salesforce and integrated systems.
* Support migrations, bulk updates, duplicate management, cleansing and validation.
* Investigate discrepancies and coordinate fixes across enterprise applications.

**Release, DevOps \& Quality**


* Own the full SDLC: build, unit testing, SIT, UAT, deployment and post\-release validation.
* Coordinate releases using DevOps and CI/CD best practice with strong deployment governance.
* Carry out code reviews and performance tuning, and enforce governor\-limit compliance.

**Technical Leadership**


* Evaluate new Salesforce capabilities and recommend improvements.
* Mentor developers and administrators, and set coding standards.
* Maintain specifications, runbooks, architecture diagrams and knowledge articles.

### **How Success Is Measured**


* **Platform stability:** lower incident volume, faster resolution and fewer repeat issues.
* **Integration health:** reliable, timely interfaces with MuleSoft, the customer master, TMS and billing.
* **Delivery quality:** on\-time, low\-defect releases through SIT and UAT.
* **Code quality:** governor\-limit compliance, test coverage and reduced technical debt.
* **Data integrity:** consistency across systems and fewer reconciliation exceptions.
* **Business enablement:** automation that measurably improves customer and revenue operations.

### **What You’ll Bring**


**Essential**


* 8\+ years of Salesforce experience across delivery and production support.
* Deep expertise in **Sales Cloud and Service Cloud**, including case management and the customer lifecycle.
* Strong hands\-on development with **Apex, LWC, Flows and Platform Events**.
* Proven experience with enterprise integrations using **MuleSoft** and APIs.
* Experience supporting large\-scale production orgs and complex automation.
* Ownership of end\-to\-end SDLC and DevOps / CI/CD release practices.

**Desirable**


* Salesforce Application Architect and/or System Architect.
* Platform Developer II.
* Administrator and Advanced Administrator.
* Sales Cloud Consultant and Service Cloud Consultant.
* Experience in transportation, logistics, supply chain or another high\-volume, integration\-heavy industry.
* Familiarity with an MDM platform, such as Oracle Fusion CDM, as an upstream source.
* Cloud experience, ideally Microsoft Azure.

### **Why Apply**


* A senior role with real ownership, from business consulting through architecture, build and production.
* A complex, integration\-rich enterprise landscape.
* Direct impact on the sales, service and revenue operations of a major logistics business.
**Job Type:** Full Time
**Job Location:** Mysuru

acfc3f34.title: Senior Technical Program Manager, UnifiedAuth
acfc3f34.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Unified Authorization is responsible for securing customer and corporate communication across all of Amazon. Whether it's the retail website, Alexa, or Kindle, we ensure actors are authenticated and authorized to take the requested action. Every aspect of Amazon's business interacts with our systems, including enabling the next generation of retail services on AWS infrastructure. As a global security provider, we're at the intersection of resiliency, availability, and the need to move at agile internet speed.
  

  

You are an experienced technical program manager who can work closely with product management and other business partners to define strategy and requirements, and help lead teams from concept through delivery and subsequent operation. You have regular communication with senior management on status, risks and product strategy. You have excellent listening, writing skills and very strong technical competency. You're a thought leader, but you don't just know how to solve the problem, you prove it by leading team to build the solution. Last but not the least; you have a high bar for quality and passion for design and architecture.
  

  

As the ideal candidate you will be experienced in working closely with a team of software development engineers and have a proven track record of working on complex software solutions using an agile methodology. You will have the ability to dive deep into the understanding of problems in order to help your team make the right decisions for the product and the business. You will have a proven track record of working across organizational lines. You will also be a strong communicator and will have proven abilities in managing through ambiguous situations.  

  

About the team  

Unified Auth is responsible for securing every service transaction within Amazon SDO’s service\-oriented architecture (SOA) by authenticating the services involved in the transaction, authorizing APIs access, and enforcing least\-privilege access to Amazon’s business data such as Cart, Order, Customer Identity, Item, Employee Information and more. Unified Auth’s systems are classified as Maximally Secure Applications (MSA) by Amazon Security as they control access to all Amazon services. Amazon’s SOA is large, complex, and ever\-growing. A single Amazon customer interaction such as adding an item into cart, proceeding to checkout, adding/changing payment methods, confirming purchase, etc. spans tens to hundreds of inter\-service interactions that must be secured and observed using Unified Auth’s systems. Stores, Alexa, Ring, IMDB, Prime Video, Advertisement, Selling Partners, Pharmacy, Ordering and Payments, Fulfillment Centers, and Amazon’s internal systems such as PXT rely on Unified Auth solutions to meet rising access control security and privacy standards, such as Digital Markets Act (DMA) compliance, GDPR, and SOC 2 Type II certification.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 7\+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
* 5\+ years of technical product or program management experience
* 3\+ years of software development experience
* 5\+ years of technical program management working directly with software engineering teams experience
* Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science or equivalent

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 5\+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
* Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules
* Experience defining KPI's/SLA's used to drive multi\-million dollar businesses and reporting to senior leadership

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

8826b1a0.title: SymphonyAI - Senior Technical Consultant - Solution Design
8826b1a0.description:
**Introduction**
**About Us :**
 SymphonyAI is a leading enterprise AI solutions provider helping retailers and manufacturers optimize business operations through advanced analytics, planning, and automation solutions.
   

  

 Our products support global organizations in improving supply chain efficiency, inventory performance, forecasting accuracy, and customer satisfaction.
   

  

 We are committed to delivering measurable outcomes for our clients through innovative technology, deep domain expertise, and strong customer partnerships.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Job Summary :**
 We are looking for a Senior Consultant with strong technical expertise to support the implementation of SymphonyAI SCPO solutions for global retail customers.
   

  

 This is a customer\-facing role focused on US retailer rollout support, requiring close collaboration with business stakeholders, product teams, architects, and implementation teams.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will have strong hands\-on experience across enterprise application development, integrations, middleware, databases, and cloud technologies, along with the ability to lead technical workshops, define solution architecture, and support successful implementation and go\-live activities.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Technical Discovery \& Solution Design :
* Lead technical discovery sessions and workshops with customers to understand current system landscapes, integration needs, and technical requirements.
* Design scalable and secure technical solutions aligned with SymphonyAI SCPO capabilities and customer business objectives.
* Define architecture, data flows, integration patterns, and deployment approaches for implementation programs.
* Integration \& Technical Implementation :
* Support end\-to\-end integration efforts across enterprise systems, planning platforms, ERP systems, and third\-party applications.
* Configure and support REST APIs, middleware, messaging systems, and data integration pipelines.
* Collaborate with product, engineering, and customer IT teams to ensure successful technical implementation.
* Application Development \& Technical Support :
* Provide hands\-on support across Java, Angular, .NET, shell scripting, and related technologies during implementation activities.
* Work with PL/SQL, Oracle databases, UNIX/Linux environments, and middleware platforms such as WebLogic and Glassfish.
* Support development and troubleshooting of J2EE, JSP, and web\-based application components.
* Testing, Deployment \& Go\-Live Support :
* Support integration testing, defect resolution, performance validation, and production readiness activities.
* Coordinate deployment support, go\-live activities, and post\-implementation stabilization.
* Proactively identify technical risks and ensure timely issue resolution.
* Documentation \& Stakeholder Collaboration :
* Create technical design documents, integration specifications, environment setup guides, and deployment documentation.
* Work closely with customer stakeholders, implementation teams, and internal engineering teams throughout the project lifecycle.
* Support knowledge transfer sessions and provide technical guidance to customers and internal teams.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
* 6 \- 10 years of experience in enterprise application development, technical consulting, or software implementation.
* Strong hands\-on experience with Java, Angular, .NET, and bash/shell scripting.
* Experience working with PL/SQL, Oracle databases, UNIX/Linux, middleware platforms such as WebLogic and Glassfish, and web technologies including J2EE and JSP.
* Good understanding of REST APIs, system integrations, and enterprise application architecture.
* Experience supporting integration testing, go\-live, and production support activities.
* Strong problem\-solving, troubleshooting, and communication skills.
* Ability to work in a customer\-facing environment and manage multiple technical stakeholders effectively.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with Python, Kubernetes, Data Lake technologies, Snowflake, Kafka, and cloud\-native platforms.
* Familiarity with retail planning systems, supply chain applications, or enterprise retail platforms.
* Exposure to implementation projects for US\-based retailers.
* Experience working with large\-scale data integration and distributed systems.


**What We Offer**
* Competitive salary and benefits package.
* Opportunity to work on high\-impact retail transformation programs.
* Exposure to leading global retailers and large\-scale implementation projects.
* A collaborative and fast\-paced work environment.
* Learning and growth opportunities across supply chain, retail, and enterprise AI solutions.

7633a606.title: Salesforce Technical Architect
7633a606.description:
**Description**
 Technical Architect successfully designs and manages the delivery of complex Salesforce solutions for our customers. These technologies include—but are not necessarily limited to Salesforce products and APIs, Apex/Visualforce, Lightning, mobile development technologies, and integration/ETL technologies.
   

  

 You are both a big picture thinker and in\-depth problem solver, your knowledge and skills are both broad and deep. You take pride in designing systems that stand up to high volumes and won't fail at critical points. You have a good mix of technical and enterprise skills when it comes to architecting a solution, including knowing how to leverage AI development tools like Claude and GitHub Copilot to optimize code quality and accelerate design cycles. The solutions you design are built for the long\-term and will scale with the customer's growth plans seamlessly. You have proven experience integrating systems via API's as well as a strong development background.
   

  

 What You'll Actually Be Doing
   

  

* Collaborate with client stakeholders to define requirements, deliverables, and set and manage expectations
* Translate business requirements into well\-architected solutions that best leverage the Salesforce platform, including identifying opportunities to embed autonomous AI capabilities using Agentforce
* Drive Enterprise AI Architecture by designing and integrating scalable predictive and generative AI solutions within custom Salesforce environments, optimizing performance, resource consumption, and platform governor limits
* Lead technical design sessions; architect and document technical solutions aligned with client business objectives; identify gaps between client's current and desired end states, using advanced LLMs like Claude to review architectural assumptions and simulate system edge cases
* Provide oversight and governance of Salesforce projects, championing an AI\-First Delivery \& Engineering methodology by utilizing advanced AI tools, developer assistants (e.g., Cursor, Claude), and agentic evaluation frameworks to accelerate implementation
* Follow and help define coding standards. Lead code reviews during projects to ensure quality and appropriate design patterns are followed, utilizing AI coding assistants to help enforce standards and optimize code performance
* Manage the technical delivery of custom development, integrations, and data migration elements of a Salesforce implementation, championing the team's use of tools like GitHub Copilot to accelerate the generation of Apex classes, mock data, and REST integrations
* Focus on Performance Evaluation \& ROI by collaborating with customers to develop evaluation frameworks to measure AI performance and business value for their specific use cases
* Maintain a target billable utilization aligned to the role
* Ability to understand a project and deep dive to debug issues, leveraging AI diagnostics to interpret system logs and isolate performance bottlenecks quickly
* From time\-to\-time, the TA may be expected to partake in other pre\-sales activities such as discovery and technical deep\-dive sessions, Proof\-Of\-Concept (POC) development with prospects using AI tools to build prototypes rapidly
* Liaise with Salesforce product teams to support client implementations
* Travels to client sites for projects, estimated 50\-75%


 You're Our Person If...
   

  

* Degree or equivalent proven experience required. Experience will be evaluated based on the core proficiencies for the role (e.g. extracurricular leadership roles, military experience, volunteer roles, work experience, etc.)
* 9\-14 years CRM experience with a minimum of 6 years on the Salesforce platform
* Expert level understanding of the Salesforce product suite, including Sales, Service, Community, Marketing, and Community Clouds, as well as an understanding of Agentforce architecture
* Understanding of systems architecture and ability to design scalable performance\-driven solutions, including using AI platforms to evaluate architectural scaling and load limits
* Understanding of key design patterns and large data volume limitations and best practices, with experience using AI tools to model data distribution and analyze potential data skew risks
* Understanding of data sharing and visibility considerations and how these play into platform architecture
* Familiarity with platform authentication patterns (SAML, SSO, OAuth) and how to configure them securely
* Knowledge of data integration tools and experience integrating Salesforce with different business systems (ETL, CPQ, marketing automation, reporting, etc.), utilizing AI platforms to parse third\-party REST API documentation and map complex data schemas
* Strong understanding of environment management, release management, code versioning best practices, and deployment methodologies
* Experience with platform security capabilities (TLS, SSL)
* Practical fluency using AI coding assistants and modern development ecosystems (e.g., Copilot, Cursor, Claude) to accelerate delivery, document technical architecture, and maintain a high standard of code quality
* Expert level experience defining the system architecture landscape, identifying gaps between current and desired end\-states, and delivering a comprehensive solution that will enable achievement of the desired business outcomes
* Strong background in design/development of large web\-based systems, or complete software product lifecycle exposure
* Active Salesforce certifications or ability to achieve relevant certifications upon hire.

d46fff78.description:
**About Exponentia.ai**
 Exponentia.ai is a fast\-growing AI\-first technology services company, partnering with enterprises to shape and accelerate their journey to AI maturity. With a presence across the US, UK, UAE, India, and Singapore, we bring together deep domain knowledge, cloud\-scale engineering, and cutting\-edge artificial intelligence to help our clients transform into agile, insight\-driven organizations.
   

  

 We are proud partners with global technology leaders such as Databricks, Microsoft, AWS, and Qlik, and have been consistently recognized for innovation, delivery excellence, and trusted advisories.
   

  

**Awards \& Recognitions**
* Innovation Partner of the Year \- Databricks, 2024
* Digital Impact Award, UK \- 2024 (TMT Sector)
* Rising Star \- APJ Databricks Partner Awards 2023
* Qlik's Most Enabled Partner \- APAC


**About The Role**
 We are seeking a Solution Architect \- AWS AI/ML to lead the end\-to\-end architecture of an enterprise\-scale Propensity Model Development Platform on AWS. The role involves designing scalable data and ML architectures, defining MLOps and governance frameworks, and guiding cross\-functional teams to deliver secure, reliable, and business\-impacting AI solutions.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will combine strong AWS architecture expertise with data engineering, machine learning, stakeholder management, and solution governance capabilities to drive successful platform implementation.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Solution Architecture \& Design :**
* Translate business objectives and propensity\-model use cases into scalable solution architectures and implementation roadmaps.
* Define target\-state architecture covering data ingestion, transformation, feature engineering, model training, deployment, and consumption.
* Design secure, scalable, and cost\-optimized AWS\-based AI/ML platforms.


**AWS Data \& ML Platform Architecture**
* Architect solutions using AWS S3, Glue, Athena, Redshift, SageMaker, Lambda, IAM, Lake Formation, CloudWatch, EventBridge, and related services.
* Define architecture for batch and real\-time model scoring, feature stores, model registries, and monitoring frameworks.
* Establish integration patterns, APIs, and environment management strategies.


**MLOps, Security \& Governance**
* Define CI/CD and MLOps approaches for model development, deployment, and lifecycle management.
* Establish architectural guardrails for security, IAM, encryption, networking, auditability, lineage, and compliance.
* Ensure adherence to responsible AI, governance, and data management best practices.


**Technical Leadership \& Stakeholder Engagement**
* Lead architecture reviews and provide technical direction to Data Scientists, ML Engineers, Data Analysts, and client engineering teams.
* Own architecture blueprints, solution diagrams, interface specifications, and technical documentation.
* Facilitate workshops, align stakeholders, and drive technical decision\-making across teams.


**Risk Management \& Delivery Support**
* Identify architectural risks, dependencies, assumptions, and mitigation strategies.
* Support implementation, deployment, troubleshooting, and performance optimization activities.
* Ensure solutions meet reliability, scalability, maintainability, and cost objectives.


**Ideal Candidate Profile**
* 6 \- 8 years of experience in Cloud Architecture, Data Engineering, AI/ML Solutions, or Analytics Platforms.
* Strong expertise in AWS architecture and cloud\-native AI/ML solutions.
* Experience designing enterprise\-scale data lakes, MLOps platforms, and machine learning ecosystems.
* Strong understanding of data governance, security, scalability, and performance optimization.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and leadership skills.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, Engineering, Information Technology, Data Science, or a related discipline.
* AWS Certified Solutions Architect or equivalent AWS certification.
* Experience delivering customer analytics, propensity, churn, recommendation, cross\-sell, upsell, or next\-best\-action solutions.
* Exposure to BFSI, Insurance, or other regulated industries.
* Knowledge of Explainable AI, Model Risk Management, and Responsible AI frameworks.
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum delivery environments.


**Why Join Exponentia.ai?**
* Innovate with Purpose : Opportunity to create pioneering AI solutions in partnership with leading cloud and data platforms.
* Shape the Practice : Build a marquee capability from the ground up with full ownership.
* Work with the Best : Collaborate with top\-tier talent and learn from industry leaders in AI.
* Global Exposure : Be part of a high\-growth firm operating across US, UK, UAE, India, and Singapore.
* Continuous Growth : Access to certifications, tech events, and partner\-led innovation labs.
* Inclusive Culture : A supportive and diverse workplace that values learning, initiative, and ownership.

340d5a68.description:
**Overview**
**Working at Atlassian**
 Atlassians can choose where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity.
   

  

**Why should you apply to this role?**
 The Principal Enterprise Delivery Manager is responsible for ushering Atlassian’s largest, most complex customers through their transition into the cloud. As the primary stakeholder, you will act as a reliable strategic advisor and technical consultant to senior customer decision\-makers, while also leading the delivery and governance of large\-scale Cloud migrations.
   

  

 You bring both business acumen and technical fluency. You will work closely with customer stakeholders and cross\-functional teams—including Sales, Solutions, Support, Product Management, Channel Partners, and Engineering—to help navigate architectural decisions, risk mitigation, performance guardrails, and adoption planning.
   

  

 This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of strategy, data, and execution — whether you come from delivery management, DevOps, QA/testing, or engineering. It requires proven expertise in developing and influencing customer cloud strategies and enabling technical adoption of cloud features, including AI. You understand how data moves, systems integrate, and migrations succeed (or fail). You will identify potential challenges and implement effective solutions that guide toward positive outcomes and ultimately lead Atlassian’s most strategic customers to Cloud.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Migration Strategy: Lead end\-to\-end cloud transformation engagements by evaluating customer environments and aligning technical execution with business outcomes.
* Risk Management: Facilitate migration readiness assessments, interpret guardrail results, and recommend actionable remediations (i.e. SQL\-based analysis, app remediations, automation deltas, workflow redesign).
* Technical Architecture: Understand and communicate the role of APIs, webhooks, and automation components in customer environments — explaining how they translate to Cloud and what requires refactor or replacement.
* Trusted Advisor: Act as a trusted advisor to senior leadership and other technical executives, guiding decision\-making through data\-backed insights.
* Delivery Excellence: Govern the migration lifecycle through disciplined execution, measurable outcomes, and coordination with support \& engineering teams — from discovery to UAT completion and go\-live.
* Drive Accountability: Drive team accountability through clearly defined milestones, transparent reporting, proactive risk management and optimal resourcing.
* Stakeholder Management: Lead all project communications, plan reviews, and steering committee to guide project direction. Maintain effective communication with stakeholders to advocate for the team and meet customer objectives.
* Escalation Management: Act as the escalation point for customers to drive urgency on critical blockers during migrations.
* Team Leadership: Mentor peers on technical literacy and lead internal enablement efforts, including training workshops and playbook development. Model a consultative, data\-driven mindset expected of Atlassian’s delivery leaders.


**Industry Insight:** 
 Stay ahead of industry trends and integrate insights into customer interactions. Propose innovative solutions to business challenges.
   

  

**Compensation**
 At Atlassian, we strive to design equitable, explainable, and competitive compensation programs. We follow consistent hiring practices and account for each candidate's skills, knowledge, and experience when setting base pay within the range.
   

  

 This role may also be eligible for benefits, bonuses, commissions, and equity.
   

  

**Qualifications**
* Extensive experience working in or around software delivery — roles such as Delivery Manager, DevOps Engineer, QA/Test Lead, Systems Engineer, or Support Lead are a plus
* Proven track record leading data migration, systems integrations, or platform transformations.
* Knowledge of APIs, automations, and integration patterns, including how they translate between on\-prem and cloud.
* Strong understanding of the software development lifecycle (SDLC) — able to connect process, tooling, and delivery outcomes.
* Strong ability to influence customer decision\-making through expertise in delivery knowledge and value discussions.
* Skilled in negotiating effectively with senior\-level decision\-makers and c\-suite executives.
* Demonstrated leadership, teamwork, and mentorship skills that enhance team learning and engagement.
* Over 10 years of professional experience as a technical program/delivery manager responsible for complex technology projects for enterprise customers.
* Bachelor’s or advanced degree in engineering, computer science, or equivalent professional experience.


**Benefits \& Perks**
 Atlassian offers a wide range of perks and benefits designed to support you, your family and to help you engage with your local community. Our offerings include health and wellbeing resources, paid volunteer days, and so much more. To learn more, visit
 **go.atlassian.com/perksandbenefits**

 At Atlassian, we're motivated by a common goal: to unleash the potential of every team. Our software products help teams all over the planet and our solutions are designed for all types of work. Team collaboration through our tools makes what may be impossible alone, possible together.
   

  

 We believe that the unique contributions of all Atlassians create our success. To ensure that our products and culture continue to incorporate everyone's perspectives and experience, we never discriminate based on race, religion, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or marital, veteran, or disability status. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

2d578b38.title: Cloud Infrastructure & Platform Specialist
2d578b38.description:
**About Our Client**
 Our client is a growing SaaS company providing cloud\-based software that helps energy, utility, telecom, and infrastructure companies protect their critical network infrastructure. With nearly three decades of industry experience, the company serves customers across North America and continues to expand its platform with new data\-driven and AI\-powered capabilities.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Our client is building a governed, multi\-cloud data estate on
 **Databricks** 
 to power cross\-product insights. This role owns the cloud infrastructure and platform side that the Data Engineering, Data Science, MLOps, and Data Architecture teams depend on. You will provision and configure what these teams need in Databricks, in Azure (the backend for all Databricks solutions), and in AWS. Identity and Access Management is the core of the role, from IAM roles and access policies to the service principals that let other applications connect to Databricks. Requests often arrive through help desk tickets, but this is not a support position: your work is what allows the teams to move forward, faster and securely. The role is remote, based in India (Bangalore preferred, Pune also an option), Monday to Friday during standard business hours, with some overlap with the US team a few days a week.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Provision, configure, and manage the core cloud infrastructure behind a Databricks\-based data estate, with Azure as the primary backend for Databricks and additional work in AWS.
* Make Azure configuration changes required for Databricks resources and settings to work as expected.
* Manage infrastructure components such as VPCs/VNets, subnets, route tables, network connectivity, S3 buckets and Azure Storage Accounts, compute resources, and private endpoints.
* Establish and maintain secure DEV, QA, and PROD environments with proper isolation and platform guardrails.
* Build, version, test, and deploy infrastructure changes through Infrastructure\-as\-Code, mainly Terraform (Azure ARM/Bicep and AWS CloudFormation also apply).
* Provision and manage IAM roles, service principals, managed identities, groups, and access policies across AWS, Azure, and Databricks.
* Create service principals so other applications can connect to Databricks and exchange results.
* Implement least\-privilege access and role\-based access control (RBAC), and support identity federation and automated identity lifecycle management (SSO, SCIM, SAML, OAuth).
* Review and process elevated or administrative access requests through controlled, auditable procedures, and take part in periodic access reviews.
* Create, configure, and administer Databricks workspaces, including Unity Catalog metastores, catalogs, schemas, storage credentials, external locations, and permissions.
* Define and maintain Databricks cluster policies, instance profiles, and storage credentials for secure, cost\-controlled data access.
* Onboard Data Engineering, Data Science, MLOps, and Data Architecture projects by setting up the right catalogs, schemas, access, and infrastructure ahead of time.
* Resolve onboarding and access blockers such as missing admin privileges, cluster\-policy conflicts, permission problems, storage\-access failures, and authentication issues.
* Act as the primary escalation point for Databricks platform and infrastructure issues.
* Monitor security and governance across the platform, and flag and correct any security issue a team may introduce without realizing it.
* Implement secure private connectivity (AWS PrivateLink/VPC endpoints, Azure Private Link/private endpoints, VNet/VPC peering, network security groups, firewall controls, and egress restrictions).
* Implement encryption and key management using AWS KMS, AWS Secrets Manager, Azure Key Vault, or equivalent services.
* Maintain audit logging and provide evidence for access reviews, administrative activity, infrastructure changes, and security reviews.
* Enforce tagging standards, monitor cloud and Databricks spend, and apply policies that prevent unnecessary spend.
* Automate recurring work such as workspace provisioning, catalog and schema setup, IAM role assignment, and standard onboarding.
* Maintain clear runbooks, architecture documentation, access procedures, and onboarding guides.


**Requirements**
* 3\-5 years of experience in cloud infrastructure, platform engineering, cloud administration, or a closely related role. Strong data engineers with solid Databricks experience and a genuine interest in moving into platform work are also considered.
* Strong, hands\-on Identity and Access Management experience: IAM role provisioning, service principals, managed identities, RBAC, least\-privilege access, SSO, SCIM, and SAML.
* Hands\-on Databricks administration: workspace provisioning and configuration, Unity Catalog, metastores, catalogs and schemas, cluster policies, and data\-access controls.
* Hands\-on Microsoft Azure experience, as the backend for Databricks.
* Hands\-on AWS experience, used alongside Azure.
* Working knowledge of Infrastructure\-as\-Code, mainly Terraform. Azure ARM/Bicep or AWS CloudFormation is also valued.
* Solid understanding of security and governance, with the judgment to spot and correct security issues across the platform.
* Familiarity with cloud networking and security fundamentals: VPC/VNet architecture, subnets and routing, private connectivity, network segmentation, secrets management, encryption, and key management.
* Ability to quickly troubleshoot infrastructure, networking, identity, permission, and platform\-access issues.
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain infrastructure and access issues clearly to technical teams.
* Familiarity with enterprise compliance and security frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR), audit logging, and access reviews.
* Based in India, with Bangalore preferred and Pune also an option, and able to overlap with US hours a few days a week.


**Nice\-to\-Have**
* Some data engineering background or experience.
* Databricks certification (e.g., Databricks Platform Administrator).
* Other cloud certifications, such as Azure Solutions Architect, Azure Administrator, or AWS Solutions Architect.
* Infrastructure and platform CI/CD experience, including GitHub Actions, Databricks Asset Bundles (DABs), and DEV to QA to PROD promotion.
* FinOps and cloud cost\-management practices.
* Oil \& gas, pipeline, utility, energy, or asset\-integrity industry experience, including GIS or geospatial data.


**What We Offer**
* Be part of a dynamic and growing company that is well\-respected in its industry.
* Competitive compensation based on experience and qualifications.
* Health insurance coverage.


**AI Use in Hiring**
**As part of our hiring process, this role may use artificial intelligence or automated tools to assist with reviewing and screening applications. These tools support, but do not replace, human judgment in making hiring decisions.**
**Your application will only be counted once you complete the full registration process on the KeyStone platform, including creating your profile, uploading your CV, and submitting your application. The AI interview is optional and encouraged, but is not required for your application to be counted.**
