920e945c.description:
**Description**
 AWS Global Sales (AGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small\- and mid\-market accounts to enterprise\-level customers including public sector.
   

  

 Are you excited to work with the team that enables India’s conglomerates to build innovative services with AWS, scaling to serve billion\+ Indians? The Conglomerates team in AWS India is looking for a Solutions Architect who can work with our customers who are augmenting their existing business empires with new business models on the foundations of payment infrastructure like UPI, quick commerce, widespread 5G internet access, affordable smartphones, exploding digital content, identity infrastructure like Aadhaar and world class AI \& cloud infrastructure. These new businesses are rapidly and profoundly changing everyday life of billion\+ Indians through their platforms \& services for E\-commerce, Smart Factories, Connected Vehicles, Travel \& Hospitality, FinTech and many more.
   

  

 \#aws\-ags\-India
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Your broad responsibilities will include, owning the technical engagement and ultimate success around specific implementation projects, and developing deep expertise in the AWS technologies as well as broad know\-how around how applications and services are constructed using the AWS platform. An ideal candidate should have worked on solution design \& architecture of as part of a CoE, Cloud Practice team etc. Candidate must have have in\-depth experience one or more of following technologies \- Full stack application development/ DevOps / Databases / Networking / Security / Observability / Data Analytics \& AIML. Good understanding of patterns and frameworks and ability to identify trade\-offs is required. Candidate should have a flair for hands\-on coding to do Proof of Concepts and demonstrate technologies. Candidate should be good at identifying repeatable pattern and best practices, and able to learn new technologies and customer business domain.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will possess customer facing skills that will allow them to represent AWS India well within a customer’s or partner's environment and drive discussions with mid to senior personnel within the company, as well as a technical background that enables them to easily interact and give guidance to software developers and architects.
   

  

 Diverse Experiences
   

  

 Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
   

  

 Why AWS
   

  

 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
   

  

 Work/Life Balance
   

  

 We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
   

  

 Inclusive Team Culture
   

  

 Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee\-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (DEI) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
   

  

 Mentorship and Career Growth
   

  

 We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.
   

  

 A day in the life
   

  

 The selected candidate will work with subsidiairies / JV of large Indian conglomerates to map business requirements to technology. This will include but not limited to, understanding various design patterns \& discern between various data \& compute technologies. The candidate will also ensure right TCO while meeting the functional \& non\-functional requirements. The candidate will also guide on building DevSecOps, Observability \& Monitoring of Infrastructure \& Applications; conduct Well Architected Reviews; partner with AWS Domain \& Technology Specialists to implement innovative solutions; collaborate with the Service Teams to identify feature gaps \& engage with Technical communities and Customer C\-Suite on Technology strategy \& Best practices.
   

  

**About The Team**
 The Conglomerates team is one of the most diverse teams you would ever get in your career. Our team members have deep technology experience spanning areas of Analytics, IoT, AI/ML, GenAI, Observability, Resiliency \& Security. Top it up with years of domain expertise across Automotive, Manufacturing, e\-Commerce, Telco, Travel \& Hospitality \- this is the team where Tech meets Business for the largest movers \& shakers of India's push to $5T economy.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 8\+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data \& analytics) experience
* 3\+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
* 10\+ years of IT development or implementation/consulting in the software or Internet industries experience


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
* Experience architecting/operating solutions built on AWS
* Experience communicating across technical and non\-technical audiences, including executive level stakeholders or clients
* Knowledge of SAP systems (like SAP Business Suite, S/4HANA, SAP Business Warehouse, SAP HANA, SAP Business Objects, etc.) and their architecture and infrastructure needs
* Experience leading or developing high quality, enterprise scale software products using a structured system development lifecycle
* 5\+ years of solving problems with technology in the Automotive \& Manufacturing industries experience

We need individuals who can enable customer productivity and develop lasting relationships with our technology partners, making NVIDIA an integral part of end\-user solutions. We are looking for someone always thinking about artificial intelligence, someone who can maintain constructive collaboration in a fast paced, rapidly evolving field, someone able to coordinate efforts between corporate marketing, industry business development and engineering. You will be working with the latest AI architecture coupled with the most advanced neural network models, changing the way people interact with technology.

 AWS is where innovation, risks, and ideas are celebrated. We are builders; we try new things, imagine big dreams and reuse whenever we can. Come join us and work with AWS technologies that enable our Independent Software Vendor (ISV) customers and partners to adopt cloud\-based solutions.
   

  

 Diverse Experiences
   

  

 AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
   

  

 Why AWS?
   

  

 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
   

  

 Inclusive Team Culture
   

  

 AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
   

  

 Mentorship \& Career Growth
   

  

 We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.
   

  

 Work/Life Balance
   

  

 We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 This role is within the ISV team in Amazon Web Services India (AWS India) and can be based out of Bangalore, Delhi, Mumbai, Pune and Hyderabad locations.
   

  

 As a Solutions Architect, you’ll help your customers plan their successful cloud journey leveraging emerging technologies like GenAI to achieve business outcomes. You’ll solve complex, technical challenges so your customers can focus on their business. This includes using your knowledge to craft scalable, flexible, and resilient cloud architectures. You’ll drive or take part in technical solutions discussions, diving deep into the details with customer teams.
   

  

 Building relationships to understand our customers and partners is key. As a trusted technical advisor, you’ll use your interpersonal skills to influence a variety of stakeholders from technical teams to executives. You’ll help ensure their short\-term technology decisions are aligned with their long\-term goals. Speeding up the adoption of our services will be part of your day to day.
   

  

 You’ll also act as thought leader in the wider community. This includes taking part in educating, sharing best practices, presenting at events, writing white papers, blogs, and running workshops. You won’t just be part of an industry movement; you’ll be leading it.
   

  

 As a customer obsessed advisor, you’ll also have the chance to shape the direction of our products and services. This is through gathering feedback from customers whilst collaborating with our engineering and service teams.
   

  

 To be successful in this role you need to be passionate about ISV and cloud architectures. You are a builder with genuine curiosity about how technology can support your customers’ business models and objectives.
   

  

 Want to find out what it’s like to be a Solution Architect at AWS? Watch this video (https://bit.ly/3keYcC9\).
   

  

 A day in the life
   

  

 The Solutions Architect team at AWS is responsible for helping customers successfully implement cloud technologies. In a typical week you will meet multiple customers, and you will collaborate with them on designing and operating well\-architected solutions. You will earn their trust and show them the art of the possible, educating them around the capabilities of AWS. Partnering with internal teams and experts, leveraging a deep knowledge of our tools and products, you’ll craft highly scalable, flexible, and resilient cloud architectures that address our customers’ business problems. As part of our team, you’ll have the opportunity to continuously learn and innovate daily.
   

  

**About The Team**
 ISV Solutions Architects work hand in hand with AWS customers to help drive AWS services adoption. They are at the crossroads of business and technology and engage with customers of different stages. Supporting the overall technical relationship between customers and AWS, they work to understand the customer's business needs and give prescriptive guidance on how to create business value with technology. Solutions Architects also have broader impact at scale, taking a supporting role in creating and presenting technical content and best practices.
   

  

 You will be part of a team that is responsible for driving adoption of AWS technologies while bringing differentiated value to customers. This is a team dedicated to ISV customers, an important and growing subset of customers for AWS India. ISV customers follow unique technology adoption patterns and growth trajectories that distinguish them from traditional businesses, so you will be employing engagement strategies and programs tailored to their business needs and technical preferences.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree
* Experience in design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures
* Experience in a similar role such as technical account manager, consultant, solutions architect, platform engineer, systems engineer, cloud architect, or service delivery manager
* Experience in specific technology domain areas like software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data and analytics
* 4\+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
* Experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems
* Experience communicating clearly and concisely with leadership, stakeholders, and cross\-functional teams
* Can create proof of concepts, demos, and/or scripts from scratch or leveraging reusable components.
* Able to create technical content that is easily adopted and reusable by others.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Knowledge of AWS services
* Experience architecting, migrating, transforming or modernizing customer requirements to the cloud
* Experience architecting/operating solutions built on AWS, or experience implementing a cloud\-based technology solution
* Experience implementing cloud services including migrations and modernization projects or similar
* AWS certification, such as, AWS Solutions Architect, or a similar cloud certification, or Cloud Technology Certification
* Able to present to technical and business audiences (training, workshops, publications)
* 4 years’ experience as a Solution Architect or related role.

4a576a7b.description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Artificial Intelligence \& Engineering**
 AI \& Engineering leverages cutting\-edge engineering capabilities to help build, deploy, and operate integrated/verticalized sector solutions in software, data, AI, network, and hybrid cloud infrastructure. These solutions insights are powered by engineering for business advantage, helping transforming mission\-critical operations.
   

  

 Join our AI \& Engineering team to help in transforming technology platforms, driving innovation, and helping help make a significant impact on our clients' success achievements. You’ll work alongside talented professionals reimagining and re\-engineering operations and processes that are could be critical to businesses.
   

  

**Level:** 
**AI and Data Solutions Engineer**
 As an AI and Data Solutions Engineer at Deloitte Consulting, you will design, develop, and deploy enterprise\-scale software solutions, lead the creation of robust pipelines and manage code deployment across environments. You will collaborate with cross\-functional, global teams to translate functional requirements into effective deliverables, independently guiding and mentoring junior team members. Your role spans the full project lifecycle, including estimation, planning, execution, and tracking key metrics for analysis, ensuring high\-quality and timely delivery of solutions.
   

  

**Work you’ll do:**
 Lead discussions with business and functional analysts to understand requirements and assess integration impacts on business architecture. Prepare technical architecture and design, clarify requirements, and resolve ambiguities. Develop solutions in line with established technical designs, integration standards, and quality processes. Create and enforce technical design and development guides, templates, and standards. Facilitate daily scrum meetings, manage deliverables, and prepare weekly status reports for leadership review. Conduct detailed deliverable reviews and provide technical guidance to team members. Collaborate with onsite clients, coordinators, analysts, and cross\-functional teams. Design templates or scripts to automate routine development or operational tasks.
   

  

**The team:**
 AI \& Data offers a full spectrum of solutions for designing, developing, and operating cutting\-edge Data and AI platforms, products, insights, and services. Our offering helps clients innovate, and enhance their data, AI, and analytics capabilities, ensuring they can mature and scale effectively.
   

  

 AI \& Data professionals will work with our clients to:
   

  

* Design and modernize large\-scale data and analytics platforms including data management, governance and the integration of structured and unstructured data to generate insights leveraging cloud, edge and AI/ML technologies, platforms and methodologies for storage, processing
* Leverage automation, cognitive and AI based solutions to manage data, predict scenarios and prescribe actions
* Drive operational efficiency by managing and upgrading their data ecosystems and application platforms, utilizing analytics expertise and providing As\-a\-Service models to ensure continuous insights and enhancements.


**Location:** 
 Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Pune/Chennai
   

  

**Qualifications**
**Required:**
* 6\-9 years of relevant consulting, industry or technology experience
* Proficiency in cloud architecture design in any of the given areas – AWS/Azure/GCP Architecture.


**AWS Architect**
* Experience in provisioning and spinning up AWS EC2 instances \- on\-Demand, Spot, dedicated instances, and cost calculation.
* Experience with server less architecture (Lambda), API gateway and RESTful services/JSON etc.
* Experience with one or more relational databases on AWS RDS – Oracle/ SQL Server/ MySQL and/or cloud data warehouse databases such as AWS Redshift
* Exposure to Data migration facilities such as DMS, S3 COPY, streaming, Kinesis, Batch
* Experience in developing applications on AWS Cloud infrastructure.
* Exposure to DevOps tools, deployment and orchestration technologies such as AWS CodeBuild, CodeDeploy, AWS CodePipeline etc.
* Experience with monitoring resources and applications using CloudWatch metrics, alarms and logs and tracking user activity, API usage using CloudTrail
* Experience with cloud assessment and migration on\-premise workloads onto AWS.
* Expertise in AWS Architecture, Automation Tools and understanding of the agile development process.
* Experience in Migration from on\-prem to Cloud using AWS migration tools
* Experience with VPN connectivity between regions and subnets
* Experience with Business Continuity and Disaster Recover design, planning and implementation for cloud infrastructures
* Exposure to one or more \- Python, Perl, Ruby or UNIX shell scripting.
* Experience working with AWS Command line utility (CLI) and SDKs.
* Exposure to EMR, Elasticsearch, Kinesis, DynamoDB, Athena, WAF, CloudHMS, Direct Connect, Glue, Load balancer
* Expertise in SPARK programming using Scala or Pyspark or Java
* Experience with cloud security architectures – Encryption (Rest \& Motion)


**Azure Architect**
* Hands\-on experience with Microsoft Azure and a strong understanding of Azure capabilities and limitations with demonstrated experience in end\-to\-end deployment of MS Azure BI solution(s)
* Experience in migrating physical or virtualized workloads to the cloud.
* Experience in defining highly available, DR solutions in Azure
* Experience in assessing applications for cloud adoption and define Cloud strategy for enterprise
* Experience in using agile methodologies in implementing Azure solutions.
* Hands\-on experience with Tools for system management, monitoring, automation, and agile development
* Design and develop robust, scalable solutions for collecting, analyzing large data sets, creating, and maintaining data pipelines, data structures and/or support of highly distributed applications
* Exposure to Microsoft Azure data platform, including Azure Data Factory (ADF),Azure Databricks, Azure Data Flow, Azure Cosmos DB, Azure Storage, Azure Synapse Analytics / erstwhile Azure Data Warehouse (SQLDW), Event Hubs, Stream Analytics, Data Lake Store, Data Lake Analytics, U\-SQL, HDInsight, Azure Analysis Services, Azure Purview, Power Apps, Power BI and PowerShell Scripting
* Configure large database solutions in Azure using SQL Server / Azure SQL DWH / Synapse and optimize the existing or new solutions as and when needed for optimum performance.
* Build data lake from multiple data sources with ingestion, data governance and auditing capabilities
* Experience in any of Programming/Scripting languages \- Bash, PySpark, Scala, Python, PowerShell, Ruby – would be preferred
* Experience in defining cloud strategy for enterprise for but not limited to migrating physical or virtualized workloads to the cloud.


**GCP Architect**
* Experience in software development, professional services, solution engineering, and technical consulting with expertise in architecting and rolling out new technology and solution initiatives.
* Experience working with recommendation engines, data pipelines, or distributed machine learning and experience with data analytics and data visualization techniques and software.
* Experience in GCP Dataflow, BigQuery, Dataproc, Datalab, Dataprep, Pub/Sub and Genomics
* Experience with core Data Science techniques such as regression, classification or clustering, and experience with deep learning frameworks (such as TensorFlow, Torch, Caffe, Theano, etc).
* Develop a direction to manage the portfolio of to\-be solutions in alignment with business outcomes
* Identify problem areas, perform root cause analysis of architectural design and provide relevant solutions to the problem
* Enable delivery teams and act as mentor by providing optimal delivery solutions with automations and frameworks for improved productivity
* Implement proof of concepts to validate cloud concepts, architecture and requirements and environments (such as Apache Beam, Hadoop, Spark, Pig, Hive, MapReduce, Flume).
* Develop a direction to manage the portfolio of to\-be solutions in alignment with business outcomes
* Identify problem areas, perform root cause analysis of architectural design and provide relevant solutions to the problem
* Enable delivery teams and act as mentor by providing optimal delivery solutions with automations and frameworks for improved productivity
* Implement proof of concepts to validate cloud concepts, architecture and requirements.
* Knowledge of cloud computing includes virtualization, hosted services, multi\-tenant cloud infrastructures, storage systems and content delivery networks.


**Preferred:**
* Experience in Cloud Computing (Public/Private/Hybrid) specifically on Cloud first application development
* Systematic problem\-solving approach, coupled with strong communication skills and a sense of ownership and drive.
* Experience maintaining internet facing production\-grade applications in virtualized environments in AWS Cloud Platform.
* Experience writing scripts in one or more languages such as Python, UNIX Scripting and/or similar.
* AWS/Azure/GCP Certified Associate or Professional


**Education** 
 :
   

  

* BE/B.Tech/M.C.A./M.Sc degree or equivalent from accredited university

59ad8ea1.title: Consulting Account Lead, Google Cloud Consulting
59ad8ea1.description:
Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following:
 **Bengaluru, Karnataka, India; Gurugram, Haryana, India** 
 .
 **Minimum qualifications:**
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 10 years of experience in consulting, IT services, or a related field.
* Experience leading cloud migrations, digital implementations, or managed services operations for organizations.
* Experience with IT infrastructure or cloud\-native applications development.


**Preferred qualifications:**
* Advanced degree in a Management, Technical, or Engineering field.
* 15 years of experience in customer\-facing roles.
* Experience leading enterprise organizations through a people, process, and technology transformation from building and operating legacy, on\-premises software to running as a digital\-native business in the public cloud.
* Experience helping customers decide whether to make investments in new technologies and projects based on expected value and Return On Investment (ROI).
* Experience with data center migration strategies, and collaborating with channel partners and systems integrators.
* Knowledge of the Google Cloud ecosystem.


**About the job** 
 As a Consulting Account Lead, you will act as a trusted advisor to Google Cloud’s customers by enabling them to use Google Cloud products to achieve their business goals. You will partner with customers to develop cloud success plans such as organizational, programmatic, and technical strategies to meet their business and stakeholder goals. You will work with customers to remove organizational and technical barriers and identify opportunities to help customers expand their use of Google Cloud products. You will recommend best practices related to their industry and organizational changes to accelerate their onboarding and migration plans. You will lead the adoption of Google Cloud, guiding customers through the people, process, and technology facets of their cloud transformation journey. You will work across customer\-facing teams to ensure that a customer’s experience on Google Cloud exceeds their expectations. You will understand the customer’s industry and business goals and regularly engage with executive stakeholders across a cross\-functional and geographically dispersed team to ensure Google is helping them achieve their goals.  Our company offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support our employees’ health, well\-being, and professional growth. 7c296d5b.description:
**Description**
 AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small\- and mid\-market accounts to enterprise\-level customers including public sector
   

  

 The Amazon Web Services Professional Services (ProServe) team is seeking a skilled Engagement Manager to join our team at Amazon Web Services (AWS). In this role, you will lead delivery quality and velocity for programs spanning several concurrent workstreams, orchestrating 50\+ person teams of AWS builders, partners, and customers to deliver transformational AI, data, and enterprise modernization outcomes for the world's leading HCLS organizations.
   

  

 Your objective will be to deliver distinctive customer business outcomes and experience. In doing so, you will lead the implementation of AWS delivery innovations with customers, including re\-designing software development processes to become AI\-native end\-to\-end (“AI\-DLC”). You will bring exceptional stakeholder orchestration and relationship\-building skills, intrinsic problem\-solving ability to proactively shape program direction, anticipate and mitigate risks, and actively manage interdependencies, and the backbone to influence customers and partners when program success demands it. This is an opportunity to shape the future of the industry directly through hands\-on transformation leadership.
   

  

 The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using AWS services. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing and AI transformation initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Build and nurture trusted executive relationships (VP\+), delivering strategic counsel on program direction, health, risks, and trade\-offs to inform executive decisions
* Proactively manage interdependencies, mitigate risks, and drive accountability for program outcomes in ambiguous, fast\-changing environments
* Orchestrate across customer lines of business, IT, and partner teams simultaneously, aligning these stakeholders on priorities, timelines, and definitions of success, and escalating blockers where necessary for resolution
* Define and track measurable customer business outcomes (e.g., time\-to\-market acceleration) as the north star for program success, translating technical delivery progress into executive\-ready value narratives that demonstrate ROI and inform strategic decisions
* Own the program financial health, including forecasting, revenue recognition, commercial management, change request negotiation, and scope management for fixed\-price, milestone\-based delivery constructs
* Influence human builder and agent builder teams effectively, establishing clear operating models and responsible AI guardrails as delivery increasingly incorporates AI\-augmented development workflows and agentic automation
* Drive adoption of AI\-DLC (AI\-Driven Development Life Cycle) methodologies across delivery programs, adapting delivery models and team structures for accelerated scale and pace, establishing outcomes\-based governance frameworks for AI\-native builds, and steering multi\-agent systems at scale to drive delivery productivity across the program
* Establish and enforce governance frameworks for agentic AI in delivery — including observability, cost controls, human\-in\-the\-loop checkpoints, and compliance guardrails — ensuring AI\-augmented workflows remain auditable, secure, and aligned with customer regulatory requirements
* Proactively surface ideas on how ProServe and other AWS teams can innovate to help our customers achieve their goals at a faster pace and larger scale


**About The Team**
 Diverse Experiences
   

  

 Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
   

  

 Why AWS
   

  

 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
   

  

 Work/Life Balance
   

  

 We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
   

  

 Inclusive Team Culture
   

  

 AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
   

  

 Mentorship and Career Growth
   

  

 We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent, or 5\+ years of solving problems with technology in the Healthcare/Life Sciences Industry experience
* Experience delivering results for large, cross\-functional initiatives/projects, or experience in solving complex business challenges by delivering accurate and timely financial models, analysis, and recommendations that have a proven impact on business (e.g., financial savings, operational improvements, or customer benefits)
* 5\+ years of experience in technology transformation program management, with experience leading complex, multi\-workstream delivery programs ($5M\+/year in professional services revenue) end\-to\-end, including governance, program delivery quality and velocity, and financial health


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience managing executive customer relationships and key business stakeholders
* cloud certification like AWS Cloud Practitioner or AWS Solutions Architect \- Associate
* Experience creating and implementing large\-scale programs
* MBA, or 6\+ years of working with Data \& AI related technologies, including, but not limited to, AI/ML, GenAI, Analytics, Database, and/or Storage experience
* 3\+ years of owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience
* Experience developing strategies that influence leadership decisions at the organizational level


 Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

68279e7d.description:
**Job Description**
**Engagement Manager (US Region)\- HYD based**
**About Darwinbox**
 Darwinboxis Asia's fastest\-growing HR technology platform, designing the future of work by building the world's best HR tech, driven by a fierce focus on employee experience and customer success, and continuous, iterative innovation. We are the preferred choice of 1000\+ global enterprises to manage their 4 million\+ employees across 130\+ countries.
   

  

 Darwinbox's new\-age HCM suite competes with local as well as global players in the enterprise technology space (such as SAP, Oracle, and Workday). The firm has acquired notable customers ranging from large conglomerates to unicorn start\-ups: Nivea, Starbucks, DLF, JSW, Adani Group, Crisil, CRED, Vedanta, Mahindra, Glenmark, Gokongwei Group, Mitra Adiperkasa, EFS Facilities Management, VNG Corporation, and many more.
   

  

 Our vision of building a world\-class product company from Asia is backed by marquee global investors like Microsoft, Salesforce, Sequoia Capital, TCV, KKR, and Partners Group.
   

  

**Why Join Us?**
 The rate at which our product and market presence are growing is unprecedented. We’re a Rocketship. We’re not planning on slowing down anytime soon. And, that’s why we need you! You’ll experience a culture of:
   

  

* Disproportionate Rewards for top performance
* Accelerated Growth in a hyper\-growth environment
* Continuous Learning and Professional Development
* Meaningful Relationships and a Collaborative Environment


**What This Role Is**
 Darwinbox is transforming how enterprises manage people, workflows, and employee experiences at scale. As we evolve, implementation is no longer about configuration and delivery tracking. The real challenge is helping organizations rethink how HR should operate across systems, processes, adoption, and decision\-making.
   

  

**Candidates with exposure to North America implementations and an understanding of US statutory and compliance requirements will be preferred.**
 This role sits at the intersection of:
   

  

* Enterprise consulting
* Product thinking
* Customer transformation
* Large\-scale SaaS delivery
* You will act as:
* A trusted advisor to enterprise customers
* A strategic partner to CHROs and business leaders
* The “Voice of Customer” internally across Product and Engineering
* An owner responsible for customer outcomes — not just go\-live milestones


**What The Work Looks Like**
* You won’t just inherit a project plan. You’ll inherit ambiguity.
* A customer struggling to standardize processes globally.
* An implementation that technically works, but operationally doesn’t.
* A workflow designed for manual operations that now needs to scale intelligently.


 Your role is to understand the business problem behind the requirement and drive the transformation end\-to\-end.
   

  

 That means:
   

  

* Leading enterprise HCM transformation programs from discovery through adoption
* Challenging legacy processes and driving transformation conversations
* Influencing senior stakeholders with clarity and credibility
* Working closely with internal teams to shape customer outcomes
* Balancing customer expectations, scalability, product capabilities, and operational realities
* Because enterprise transformation breaks when those worlds operate separately.


**Who Thrives Here**
* People who think in systems.
* People who naturally ask: “Will this scale?” / “What breaks after go\-live?” / “Are we solving the actual customer problem?”
* People with consulting instincts, strong ownership mindset, and executive presence.
* People who care equally about customer outcomes, product experience, and operational excellence.


**What We Explicitly Don’t Optimize For**
* Coordination\-heavy implementation profiles
* Delivery managers who only track timelines
* Requirement takers who never challenge assumptions
* Governance without ownership
* Implementation thinking without business context


**What We’re Looking For**
* 6–12 years of experience in enterprise SaaS, HCM implementation, consulting, or transformation roles
* Strong stakeholder management and executive communication skills
* Consulting mindset with ability to drive transformation conversations
* Strong customer advocacy and product\-oriented thinking
* Data\-driven and automation\-first approach to problem solving


**What We Offer:**
* A dynamic and collaborative work environment that fosters innovation.
* Opportunities for professional growth and career advancement.
* Competitive compensation and benefits package.
* The chance to work on products that make a meaningful impact on businesses and their employees.

abf47f94.title: Program Manager - Technology
abf47f94.description:
* Full\-time

**Company Description**
-----------------------


AbhiBus is a leading online bus\-ticketing platform that aggregates ticket inventory from over 4,000 bus operators \- including major State Road Transport Corporations (SRTCs), covering more than 3\.5 lakh (350,000\+) routes across India. The AbhiBus website and apps allow users to check amenities provided by bus operators, compare booking fares, check bus timings in the searched route, live tracking of the bus before arrival, cancellation protection options and other facilities. It is the official ticketing partner for several state road transport corporation bus tickets and IRCTC bus bookings.


AbhiBus is owned and operated by ixigo (Le Travenues Technology Limited), India’s leading OTA for the Next Billion Users. With over 54 crore Annual Active Users in FY25, ixigo offers AI\-powered train, flight, bus, and hotel bookings through its platforms \- ixigo, ConfirmTkt, and AbhiBus.

**Job Description**
-------------------

**The Role**


We are looking for a Technology Program Manager who can drive complex, cross\-functional technology initiatives from problem definition to execution and delivery.  

  

This is not a traditional Scrum Master / Agile Project Manager role.  

  

You will work in an environment where requirements evolve, priorities change, teams may not be co\-located, and there isn't always a well\-defined process or single owner for every dependency.  

  

Your job will be to bring clarity, structure and momentum to these situations.  

  

You will work closely with Product, Engineering, Design, Data, Operations and external technology partners to ensure that complex initiatives move forward and eventually reach production.

**What You Will Do**

* Drive end\-to\-end technology programs — translate high\-level objectives into clear plans, milestones, dependencies and execution paths.
* Navigate complex technical dependencies across multiple engineering teams, services, platforms and third\-party systems.
* Work closely with engineering leads to understand architecture, APIs, data flows, system dependencies and technical constraints well enough to identify execution risks early.
* Identify the critical path for programs and continuously remove blockers that could impact delivery.
* Coordinate execution across distributed and non\-co\-located teams, ensuring alignment without relying purely on formal processes.
* Bring structure to ambiguous problems — figure out what needs to happen, who needs to be involved and how we get from where we are today to the desired outcome.
* Identify risks, dependencies and decisions proactively rather than waiting for issues to surface.
* Facilitate discussions between teams when there are conflicting priorities, unclear ownership or competing technical approaches.
* Partner with Product Managers and Engineering Managers to convert product/business objectives into executable technology plans.
* Maintain program visibility for leadership — what is on track, what is blocked, why it is blocked and what decisions are required.
* Manage execution across multiple parallel workstreams without becoming a task tracker.
* Work with external vendors/partners where technology integration or operational dependencies are involved.
* Establish lightweight processes where needed — but avoid adding process for the sake of process.
**Qualifications**
------------------

* 3–5 years of experience in Technical Program Management, Product Operations, Engineering Program Management, Technology Consulting or a similar role.
* Strong understanding of software development and technology systems. You don't need to be a coder, but you should be comfortable discussing APIs, databases, services, integrations, data flows, releases and system dependencies with engineers.
* Demonstrated experience driving cross\-functional technology initiatives involving multiple teams.
* Strong ability to understand technical dependencies and identify risks before they become delivery problems.
* Comfortable working with ambiguity, changing priorities and incomplete information.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, particularly across teams with different priorities.
* Ability to operate effectively with distributed / geographically dispersed engineering teams.
* Strong ownership mindset — you see a problem through to resolution rather than simply escalating it.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.


Ability to operate in a high\-paced startup environment where processes are evolving continuously.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience working in a consumer internet, marketplace, OTA, fintech, mobility or other high\-scale technology environment.
* Experience working with microservices, APIs, cloud infrastructure or data platforms.
* Engineering / Computer Science background.
* Experience working with external technology vendors or partners.
* Experience managing programs involving multiple engineering teams and complex integrations.
* Experience in an environment where Product and Engineering operate with high autonomy and lightweight processes.

**What Success Looks Like**


After 6 months, you should be the person teams rely on to answer:

* What exactly are we trying to deliver?
* Which teams and systems are involved?
* What are the critical dependencies?
* What is blocking us?
* Who needs to make a decision?
* What can derail the program?
* What needs to happen next?

**You don't need to create more meetings or more status reports.**  

  

**You need to make complex things happen.**

**Additional Information**
--------------------------


Candidates are responsible for safeguarding sensitive company data against unauthorized access, use, or disclosure, and for reporting any suspected security incidents in line with the organization's ISMS (Information Security Management System) policies and procedures.

This is a high\-visibility, high\-impact role where your work will shape the delivery experience for hundreds of millions of customers worldwide.
   

  

 At Amazon, we're working to be the most Customer\-centric company on earth. One customer experience that we’re constantly looking to take to a new level is how we fulfill and deliver their orders. Our Last Mile organization is at the forefront of this mission: pioneering new products and services, partnering with Delivery Service Partners and Amazon Flex, and building a world\-class operation that spans North America, Europe, and Asia Pacific. Last Mile is one of the most customer\-visible and strategically important pillars of this work, and you'll be at the center of it.
   

  

 As part of Amazon Delivery's PRISM (Central TPM) organization, you will own the end\-to\-end program strategy for last mile initiatives, driving cross\-functional alignment across business, product, and engineering teams to launch and scale programs that move the needle on delivery speed. You will partner with senior leaders across multiple organizations to define priorities, remove blockers, and deliver results.
   

  

 The ideal candidate thrives in ambiguity, brings strong business and technical judgment, and has a track record of delivering complex programs. You are a crisp communicator who can influence at the VP level and translate business goals into actionable roadmaps. If you want to solve one of the most challenging problems in logistics, making delivery faster for every customer, everywhere, this is your role.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Serve as the single\-threaded leader owning complex programs across multiple VP organizations
* Identify business and technical requirements with science, operations, product, and engineering stakeholders, translating them into specifications, scoped deliverables, and program roadmap from design through launch
* Lead design and implementation efforts across cross\-functional teams, making trade\-offs to optimize time\-to\-market
* Own stakeholder communication through all stages of the product lifecycle, clearly articulating goals, roles, and desired outcomes
* Drive high\-level strategic initiatives while being willing to roll up your sleeves and get the job done


 The right candidate will have a strong program management background, demonstrated experience leading large to extra\-large projects, and a well\-rounded technical foundation. You must thrive in an entrepreneurial environment and not be hindered by ambiguity or competing priorities.
   

  

 A day in the life
   

  

 Your day starts by connecting the dots across teams, aligning product, engineering, and operations leaders on what matters most for our customer and business. You will run strategic reviews, unblock cross\-functional dependencies, and make trade\-off decisions that keep programs on track. Some days you are deep in data, shaping the roadmap; other days you are in a room full of senior leaders driving alignment on the next big bet. No two days look the same, but every day you are directly influencing how fast customers get their packages.
   

  

**About The Team**
 PRISM is Amazon Delivery's central Technical Program Management organization. We drive programs that span Last Mile and partner organizations including Robotics, Pharmacy, Prime Air, and more. The problems we solve sit at the intersection of customer experience, technology, and operations at massive scale. If you want to work on programs that shape how Amazon delivers to customers globally, this is the team to be on.

885750b9.title: Sr Tech Infra Program Manager, DCPD
885750b9.description:
**Description**
 AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
   

  

 You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
   

  

 Amazon Web Service (AWS) is a comprehensive, evolving, and growing business unit within Amazon.com. Since early 2006, AWS has provided a highly reliable, scalable, low\-cost cloud infrastructure platform that empowers hundreds of thousands of businesses in 190 countries to innovate and invent.
   

  

 Do you have the business background, complex cross functional program management experience, financial expertise, legal/regulatory comprehension and technical understanding? Can you communicate effectively, find clarity in ambiguity, and simplicity in complexity ? Have you managed complex infrastructure projects ?
   

  

 If yes, then come and explore this exciting role. This role in Amazon Data Services India Private Limited (ADSIPL) Hyderabad, Telengana builds infrastructure that hosts AWS cloud services. It delivers AWS cloud infrastructure in a challenging, high growth, fast paced and customer focused work environment. In this role, you will lead cross functional teams to deliver usable data center capacity. You will partner with senior stakeholders to develop, document, manage and deliver infrastructure designs, implementation schedules and budgets. You will earn trust of your partners in your ability to solve complex issues and steer teams in right direction to deliver results, on\-time and at\-cost.
   

  

 You must be an exceptionally strong communicator (both written and verbal), and possess relevant experience in managing technical and strategic programs. If you bring past experience in data center deployment programs, great. If not, then having a background in program and project management, architecture/design, mechanical/electrical engineering, software/hardware engineering managing a team with strong urge to learn will be essential.
   

  

 Come Join us, have fun, and create history!!
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Senior Infrastructure TPM owns delivery of new DC across one or more availability zones in Hyderabad, Telangana India. The Sr TIPM manages delivery of \~5 projects at any time. They bridge internal customers, business functions, (Planning, Finance, Procurement, Legal, Policy, Operations), and functional delivery teams (Construction, Commissioning, Controls, Fiber and Network) to enable on\-time and right sized delivery of new DC capacity. The Sr TIPM is able to guide and develop partner teams to accomplish the regions goal.
   

  

 The scope begins with early expansion planning, which includes a feasibility analysis to approve expansion plans and associated build timelines. They evaluate multiple factors prior to approving a new plan of record, including owned/leased/collocated DC supply, utility delivery (power, water, and fiber), and long lead equipment (LLE) availability. It requires region\-wide knowledge and monitoring of in\-flight projects, major risks, and remediation efforts to ensure DC delivery is not only on track to meet supply commitments but also to meet customer demand, which is constantly changing.
   

  

 A successful TPM Manager must be capable of managing a combination of metrics, tools, and mechanisms to remain aware of ongoing risks or issues that require their action, decision, mitigations, or effort to identify alternative solutions communicating up, down, and across the organization to align direction, gain support and drive remediation efforts

 Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
   

  

 Why AWS
   

  

 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

 We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
   

  

 Inclusive Team Culture
   

  

 AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
   

  

 Mentorship and Career Growth
   

  

 We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.

5caa4563.title: Technical Program Manager - Core Network Delivery & MNO Onboarding
5caa4563.description:
**The world still has coverage blind spots. You could help eliminate them at Skylo.**
 Skylo has pioneered a standards\-based approach to satellite connectivity. We connect smartphones and IoT devices directly to satellites. No special hardware, no entirely new networks. Just billions of existing devices, suddenly reachable anywhere on Earth. We're not building toward this future. We're already in it.
   

  

 Our direct\-to\-device service is live on millions of activated devices across five continents, covering more than 72 million square kilometers, in partnership with leading satellite operators, mobile network operators, Tier\-1 chipset makers, and OEMs worldwide. And we're just getting started.
   

  

 At the heart of it all is Skylo's commercial NTN vRAN: a 3GPP standards\-based, cloud\-native platform that seamlessly bridges terrestrial and satellite networks. It's the infrastructure that makes true anywhere, anytime connectivity possible.
   

  

 When you join Skylo, you'll work at the intersection of three markets reshaping how the world stays connected: mass\-market consumer devices, automotive, and industrial IoT. Enabling people outdoors and critical workflows in the world's most remote places.
   

  

**This is a rare chance to work on technology that matters, at a company that's already proving it works**
*This role is located in Bangalore, India where we are onsite 3 days a week in office. You will collaborate with a high\-velocity, global team spanning multiple time zones.*
**How You Will Impact Skylo**
 You will own end\-to\-end program delivery across the three systems that determine whether an MNO partner can be onboarded, whether traffic flows correctly, and whether it settles correctly: the
 **packet core** 
 , the
 **signalling plane** 
 , and
 **billing \& settlement** 
 . You sit at the seam between Network Engineering, Product, Solutions Engineering, Finance/Billing, and external partners (MNOs, IPX providers, clearing houses, roaming suppliers), and you are accountable for turning a growing partner pipeline into predictable, on\-time technical delivery.
   

  

 This is a builder's role. You will be defining the onboarding program, the release cadence, and the launch\-readiness bar — not inheriting a mature machine.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Own the MNO technical onboarding program end\-to\-end from the core/signalling/billing lens — integration milestones, dependencies, Definitions of Done, and cutover plans across the partner lifecycle.
* Drive signalling delivery programs: Diameter interfaces (S6a, SGd), MAP\-over\-IPX via IWF, DRA configuration and routing policy, SMS\-over\-NAS enablement, and roaming signalling readiness per partner.
* Coordinate billing \& settlement programs: TAP3 / RAP / NRTRDE exchange, BCE readiness, mediation and rating, CDR integrity and reconciliation, and integration with settlement and finance systems.
* Program\-manage the multi\-supplier roaming stack — supplier onboarding, contractual/technical cutover, parallel\-run and rollback planning, and de\-risking the transition away from single\-supplier dependency.
* Run program governance: maintain roadmaps, RAID logs, release trains, and cross\-functional launch\-readiness reviews; make dependencies and risks visible before they become escalations.
* Own the metrics that matter: onboarding cycle time, signalling success/attach rates, routing correctness, CDR and settlement accuracy, and billing\-run reliability — and report them to engineering and commercial leadership.
* Be the translation layer between deep network engineering and commercial/partner stakeholders, so that partner commitments and network reality stay aligned.


**Sound like you? You bring:**
 You know how wholesale roaming works end to end, and you have the program management discipline to keep a complex multi\-partner portfolio running smoothly without losing track of the details.
   

  

* 8\+ years in mobile core / signalling engineering or technical program leadership, with deep, hands\-on time in the signalling plane
* Understanding of Signalling in 3GPP core, across EPC and 5GC:
+ NAS procedures (attach, TAU, service request) and the interfaces that carry them — S6a, S6c, S13, SGd, T6a — with fluency in Diameter base protocol, AVP design, realm/application routing, and error/overload handling.
+ DRA/DEA architecture: understanding of routing policy \& topology
+ A clear grasp of the SS7/MAP ↔ Diameter boundary and IWF interworking (e.g. legacy SMS via MAP over IPX vs. SGd Diameter).

* NB\-IoT / CIoT and NTN signalling specifics: control\-plane CIoT EPS optimisation, NIDD, and the way NTN propagation delay and timer handling (Rel\-17 NTN) change attach/retransmission behaviour.
* Hands\-on roaming operations: IREG/TADIG, IR.21/RAEX, IPX interconnect, and per\-partner signalling readiness.
* Working understanding of billing \& settlement as it depends on signalling and CDR generation: TAP3 (TD.57\), RAP (TD.32\), NRTRDE, and the CDR lifecycle from record generation to settlement.
* Demonstrated track record shipping cross\-functional network programs on time across engineering and external partners.
* Credible in a signalling design review and in a partner integration call alike — equally at home with core engineers and external carrier counterparts.Every role at Skylo uses AI tools daily to amplify output. We expect active habits using AI tools and a track record of picking up new ones quickly.


**It Would Be Great If You Had Experience With**
* NTN, NB\-IoT, or cellular IoT connectivity experience.
* SMS\-over\-NAS delivery paths (SGd Diameter and MAP\-via\-IPX), and CIoT optimizations (NIDD, control\-plane CIoT).
* Experience with wholesale roaming, MVNO/MVNE, or roaming\-hub environments.
* Familiarity with BCE and next\-generation settlement, and with ERP/finance\-system integration for billing.
* Exposure to clearing\-house and IPX supplier commercial/technical management.


**What Success Looks Like (First 6\-12 Months)**
* A single, trusted onboarding program that partner\-facing and engineering teams both plan against — with cycle time trending down as volume grows.
* Signalling and billing readiness treated as a gated part of every partner launch, not a post\-launch surprise.
* The multi\-supplier roaming transition de\-risked with a clear cutover and rollback plan, and no single\-supplier lock\-in surprises.
* Program\-level visibility into signalling and settlement health that leadership actually uses to make calls.


**What We Offer**
 With employees working across three continents, Skylo is proud to be an equal opportunity employer dedicated to building an inclusive and diverse workforce. Our worldwide and inclusive culture encourages a flexible approach to work, and we also offer an attractive range benefits such as:
   

  

* Competitive compensation packages including a stock option based equity program
* Comprehensive benefits plan
* Monthly allowances for wellness and education reimbursement
* A generous time off policy, holidays, and the opportunity to temporarily work abroad
* Once in a lifetime opportunity to be a part of developing and running world’s first commercial, live direct\-to\-device satellite network and service
* Access to world\-class team and talent across tech domains: software, hardware, chipsets, telecom, satellite and network virtualization
* Open, transparent, inclusive culture that blends the Silicon Valley, Nordic and South Asia characteristics


**EEO Statement**
 Skylo is an equal\-opportunity employer and we celebrate diversity. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, ancestry, national origin, caste, sex, sexual orientation, parent or caregiver status, political affiliation, gender, gender identity or expression, age, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic makeup, marital status, or military service consistent with applicable federal, state, and local laws.
   

  

 We are also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. Please let us know if you need assistance or accommodation due to a disability.

a6cb51bc.title: Sr. Portfolio Program Manager - R&D
a6cb51bc.description:
**Our Mission:**
 6sense's mission is to multiply what matters: growth, retention, and efficiency. We envision a future where companies, teams and people reach their full potential.
   

  

**Our People:**
 People are the heart and soul of 6sense. We serve with passion and purpose. We live by our Being 6sense values of Win as One Team, Stay Curious, Do The Right Thing, Own the Outcome, and Create Belonging. Every 6sensor plays a part in deﬁning the future of our industry\-leading technology. 6sense is a place where difference\-makers roll up their sleeves, take risks, act with integrity, and measure success by the value we create for our customers. We want 6sense to be the best chapter of your career.
   

  

**About the Role :**
 We are seeking a Senior Portfolio Program Manager to provide standing, exception\-based orchestration across an assigned Research \& Development (R\&D) pillar. Reporting to the Head of Program Management, this individual contributor partners with Product and Engineering Pillar Leaders to maintain a connected view of portfolio commitments, dependencies, risks, capacity, readiness, and key decisions while improving delivery predictability and organizational effectiveness. Combining Agile coaching with portfolio program management, the role helps teams strengthen planning discipline, execution health, and continuous improvement while translating team\-level insights into actionable portfolio visibility and leadership decision support.
   

  

 The role also serves as a champion for AI\-enabled Program Management, continuously identifying and introducing automation, emerging technologies, and workflow improvements that increase scalability, operational efficiency, and decision\-making effectiveness. The Portfolio Program Manager coordinates, synthesizes, and escalates material exceptions across teams, product areas, pillars, and functions.
   

  

 Accountability for product strategy, roadmap priorities, customer outcomes, engineering architecture, technical design, staffing, performance management, team execution, Scrum practices, backlog management, Jira hygiene, funding decisions, launch approvals, and risk acceptance remains with the appropriate Product, Engineering leaders. End\-to\-end ownership of strategic initiatives is assumed only when explicitly assigned.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities :**
* Partner with Product and Engineering Pillar Leaders to establish and maintain portfolio baselines, including commitments, milestones, dependencies, ownership, readiness expectations, capacity assumptions, and success measures.
* Maintain visibility into portfolio commitments and execution progress, surfacing material variances and coordinating appropriate change\-management actions when scope, timeline, resource, or delivery commitments materially change.
* Establish and continuously improve portfolio metrics, dashboards, reporting practices, automation, and AI\-enabled workflows that strengthen portfolio visibility, decision\-making, execution transparency, and operational efficiency.
* Identify, evaluate, and introduce AI, automation, and emerging technologies that improve Program Management effectiveness, scalability, decision\-making, and operational efficiency across the R\&D pillar.
* Partner with R\&D Operating System teams to improve data quality, portfolio tooling, process standards, reporting, and adoption of portfolio management practices.
* Establish and maintain visibility into cross\-team and cross\-pillar dependencies, ensuring ownership, impacts, required dates, and status are understood and tracked.
* Coordinate dependency management across teams and pillars, facilitate alignment, resolution discussions, and escalate unresolved risks, impacts, and decisions through established governance forums.
* Lead portfolio reviews focused on material changes, risks, dependencies, readiness gaps, capacity conflicts, and decisions requiring leadership attention.
* Facilitate scaled planning, portfolio governance, and synchronization forums that improve alignment, transparency, and execution across the pillar.
* Support quarterly planning cycles by validating commitments, dependencies, capacity assumptions, risks, and decision readiness across the pillar.
* Synthesize portfolio information into decision\-ready executive insights, including risks, dependencies, trade\-offs, and recommendations, and ensure resulting decisions, escalations, and accountable follow\-through are tracked through closure.
* Coach Product and Engineering teams on Agile practices, planning discipline, delivery predictability, flow efficiency, and continuous improvement to strengthen execution effectiveness and delivery outcomes.
* Identify work that may warrant dedicated Strategic Initiative Program Management support and provide evidence to support coverage decisions.
* Coordinate with Strategic Initiative Program Managers to incorporate initiative health, dependencies, change impacts, and readiness into the pillar portfolio view.


**Qualifications :**
* 8\+ years of experience in Portfolio Management, Program Management, Technical Program Management, Product Operations, or related roles within a SaaS or technology environment.
* Experience leading Product and Engineering portfolios spanning multiple teams, product areas, or organizational units.
* Experience establishing and leading portfolio governance frameworks, operating rhythms, quarterly planning processes, executive review forums, and reporting mechanisms that improve visibility, alignment, decision\-making, and execution predictability.
* Demonstrated success managing portfolio risk, dependencies, capacity constraints, competing priorities, and roadmap execution at scale.
* Experience facilitating executive, leadership, and cross\-functional governance forums that drive alignment, accountability, and decision\-making.
* Demonstrated success improving team effectiveness, delivery predictability, planning maturity, flow efficiency, and execution outcomes through Agile coaching, facilitation, and continuous improvement practices.
* Demonstrated ability to influence without formal authority, navigate ambiguity, clarify accountability, and drive alignment, decision\-making, and follow\-through across multiple stakeholders.
* Experience identifying, evaluating, and implementing automation, AI\-enabled workflows, and emerging technologies that improve portfolio visibility, operational efficiency, scalability, and decision\-making effectiveness.
* Strong analytical, facilitation, communication, and stakeholder\-management skills, with the ability to synthesize complex information into executive\-ready insights and recommendations.
* Working knowledge of Productboard, Jira, Confluence, dashboarding, and business intelligence platforms.
* Agile coaching or Agile delivery certifications such as ICP\-ACC, CSP, CSM, PSM, SAFe SPC, SAFe Agilist, or equivalent practical experience.
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.


**Success In This Role :**
* Trusted portfolio visibility enables informed leadership decisions.
* Risks, dependencies, and changes to commitments are identified and addressed early.
* Capacity and readiness issues are surfaced before they impact delivery.
* Portfolio governance drives timely decisions and clear accountability.
* Strategic initiatives are integrated into a unified portfolio view.
* Teams improve commitment reliability, delivery predictability, and flow efficiency over time.
* Stakeholders experience greater alignment and faster decision\-making with minimal reporting overhead.
* Automation and AI improve operational efficiency, scalability, and insight quality.


**Our Benefits:**
 Full\-time employees can take advantage of health coverage, paid parental leave, generous paid time\-off and holidays, quarterly self\-care days off, and stock options. We’ll make sure you have the equipment and support you need to work and connect with your teams, at home or in one of our oﬃces.
   

  

 We have a growth mindset culture that is represented in all that we do, from onboarding through to numerous learning and development initiatives including access to our LinkedIn Learning platform. Employee well\-being is also top of mind for us. We host quarterly wellness education sessions to encourage self care and personal growth. From wellness days to ERG\-hosted events, we celebrate and energize all 6sense employees and their backgrounds.
   

  

**Equal Opportunity Employer:**
 6sense is an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employers. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status. If you require reasonable accommodation in completing this application, interviewing, completing any pre\-employment testing, or otherwise participating in the employee selection process, please direct your inquiries to jobs@6sense.com.
   

  

*We are aware of recruiting impersonation attempts that are not affiliated with 6sense in any way. All email communications from 6sense will originate from the @6sense.com domain. We will not initially contact you via text message and will never request payments. If you are uncertain whether you have been contacted by an official 6sense employee, reach out to jobs@6sense.com*
