2c0b61c9.title: Sr Solution Sales - AI Platform
2c0b61c9.description:
Lexsi Lab is a frontier AI research lab and platform company building the
 
****AI Engineering Layer for mission\-critical AI****

 . We help enterprises turn open and closed models into
 
****governed, auditable, production\-grade systems****

 without vendor or infrastructure lock\-in.
 





 Founded by pioneers in deep learning, with research hubs in Mumbai and Paris, Lexsi operates at the intersection of
 
****AI safety, interpretability, alignment, and systems engineering****

 . Our work is published at top\-tier venues (ICML, IJCNN, WWW, ACL), and our patented technologies, such as
 
****DL\-Backtrace****

 , enable explainability and auditability at a scale that enterprise AI demands.
 





 Our customers deploy AI in environments where failures are expensive, regulation is real, and evidence matters: banking, financial services, insurance, and other high\-risk domains.
 




  





 The Role
 


 We are looking for a
 
****Senior AI Solutions Architect****

 to lead strategic, high\-value customer engagements and support large enterprise transactions. This is a senior, customer\-facing pre\-sales role for someone who combines
 
****deep AI understanding, system\-level thinking, and executive communication skills****

 .
 





 You will work closely with sales leadership, researchers, and engineers to shape deals from first conversation to closure. You will regularly engage with CXOs, Heads of AI, Risk, and Engineering, helping them understand how to build
 
****sovereign, governed, and defensible AI systems****

 using Lexsi’s platform and research\-led primitives.
 





 This role is not about running delivery projects. It is about
 
****owning technical credibility in complex sales cycles****

 .
 




  





 What You’ll Do
 


 You will lead technical discovery, solution design, and executive\-level presentations for large, multi\-stakeholder customers across Europe, the Middle East, and South Asia. You will frame customer problems around AI sovereignty, risk, governance, cost, and control, and translate them into clear architectures and evidence\-backed solutions.
 





 You will own the technical narrative in proposals, RFPs, and regulatory questionnaires, working closely with internal research and engineering teams to ensure accuracy, rigor, and feasibility. You will support advanced demos and proofs\-of\-concept, and help customers understand how Lexsi enables governed LLM gateways, explainability at scale, alignment and fine\-tuning pipelines, and runtime observability.
 





 Internally, you will act as the voice of the customer, feeding structured insights back into product, platform, and go\-to\-market strategy.
 




  





 Who You Are
 


 You have significant experience working with AI systems and have spent time in
 
****pre\-sales, solution architecture, or technical consulting roles****

 tied to complex enterprise deals. You have built or shipped AI products and understand modern ML systems beyond surface\-level tooling.
 





 You are comfortable discussing topics such as explainability, alignment, evaluation, and deployment trade\-offs with both researchers and senior enterprise stakeholders. You can walk into a high\-stakes meeting and clearly explain why governance, auditability, and model optionality matter, without losing the room in technical detail.
 





 You write clearly, present confidently, and operate well in ambiguity. You enjoy shaping solutions rather than following scripts.
 




  





 Why This Role at Lexsi
 


 You will work at the frontier of
 
****trustworthy and mission\-critical AI****

 , influencing how advanced research is adopted in real enterprises. You will play a visible role in large strategic deals and help define how Lexsi is positioned with regulators, banks, and global institutions.
 





 This is a role for someone who wants to sit where
 
****research, product, and revenue intersect****

 , and who enjoys being trusted with conversations that actually matter.

d91c75db.title: Solutions Architect
d91c75db.description:
MongoDB is seeking a Partner Solutions Architect to focus on our Large Deals exclusively on strategic, high\-value pursuits with Global System Integrators (GSIs). This role will lead the technical strategy and execution of complex GSI\-led bids, helping MongoDB and its GSI partners develop differentiated solutions and secure large, strategic opportunities.
   

  

 The successful candidate will operate across MongoDB, GSI partners, customers, sales teams, delivery organizations, and executive stakeholders to develop compelling joint solutions, strengthen technical win strategies, and drive successful outcomes for large transformation programs.
   

  

 We are looking for candidates who are based in Bengaluru/Gurugram/Delhi/Hyderabad/Chennai for our hybrid working model.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Lead the technical architecture and solution strategy for large, complex, and strategic bids
* Partner with sales, bid leadership, account teams, product specialists, services, legal, finance, and executive sponsors to deliver coordinated pursuits
* Develop joint value propositions, solution architectures, technical proposals, statements of work, and bid responses
* Engage partner architects and delivery teams to validate feasibility, implementation approach, scope, risks, and dependencies
* Facilitate technical discovery, architecture workshops, solution reviews, demonstrations, proof\-of\-value activities, and executive presentations
* Translate customer business outcomes into scalable MongoDB\-based architectures and partner delivery models
* Shape partner\-led modernization, migration, cloud, application development, data, analytics, and AI solutions
* Identify technical risks, competitive threats, delivery constraints, and commercial considerations early in the bid lifecycle
* Create reusable bid assets, reference architectures, technical content, and best practices for future pursuits
* Ensure proposed solutions align with MongoDB product capabilities, partner expertise, security requirements, and customer success criteria
* Support deal qualification, opportunity prioritization, account planning, and pipeline\-generation activities
* Coordinate technical responses across multiple partners and ensure consistency in messaging, assumptions, and commitments
* Mentor field Solutions Architects and partner technical teams on large\-bid strategy and execution
* Capture field feedback and communicate product, capability, and partner requirements to internal teams


**Required Qualifications**
* Experience in a customer\-facing Solutions Architect, Partner Solutions Architect, Presales Architect, Consulting Architect, or equivalent role
* Experience supporting complex enterprise bids, tenders, RFPs, or strategic pursuits
* Proven ability to design and communicate distributed, scalable, secure, and highly available architectures
* Experience working with Global System Integrators (GSIs), including GSI sales, consulting, architecture, and delivery teams
* Strong understanding of cloud platforms, modern application architectures, microservices, APIs, data platforms, and DevOps
* Experience developing technical proposals, solution designs, presentations, and executive\-level bid content
* Ability to manage multiple stakeholders, work under tight deadlines, and drive outcomes in ambiguous situations
* Excellent written, verbal, presentation, facilitation, and negotiation skills
* Ability to explain complex technical and business concepts clearly to technical and executive audiences
* Willingness to travel as required for customer and partner engagements
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with MongoDB, Atlas, relational database modernization, or NoSQL technologies
* MongoDB certification or certification with a major cloud provider
* Experience with AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud
* Experience in large\-scale transformation, legacy modernization, data modernization, AI/ML, or application development programs
* Familiarity with enterprise sales methodologies such as MEDDPICC or Command of the Message
* Experience working with public\-sector or regulated\-industry procurement processes
* Experience developing joint go\-to\-market propositions and partner delivery models
* Experience leading technical workstreams in multi\-year, multi\-million\-dollar pursuits


**About MongoDB**
 MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud\-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi\-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.
   

  

 With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI\-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.
   

  

 Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.
   

  

 To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!
   

  

 MongoDB is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter.
   

  

 MongoDB is an equal opportunities employer.

e3140143.title: FAAS-Presales Solutioning/Pursuits- Senior Manager
e3140143.description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**FAAS Managed Services (MS) – Senior Manager (Pre\-Sales Solutioning, Pursuits \& Commercial Strategy Lead)**
 At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**About Global Delivery Services**
 Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
   

  

 Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
   

  

 Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high\-quality, value\-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
   

  

 Enablement Services provides cost\-effective, high\-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
   

  

 Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 As a Senior Manager in FAAS Managed Services, you will lead pre\-sales solutioning, large\-scale pursuits, and commercial strategy, enabling successful deal closure and supporting revenue growth across markets.
   

  

 You will act as a solution architect and pursuit leader, translating client requirements into scalable, outcome\-driven solutions, while ensuring alignment with commercial objectives, delivery feasibility, and profitability.
   

  

 This role requires strong expertise across F\&A solution design, RFX management, pricing strategy, stakeholder engagement, and client presentations, along with the ability to influence senior leadership and drive strategic deal outcomes.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Lead F\&A pre\-sales, solutioning, and client enablement initiatives aligned to growth priorities
* Develop and lead solutioning for large, integrated F\&A revenue pursuits
* Analyse client artifacts, RFP documents, and stakeholders’ inputs to understand business requirements and challenges
* Translate client needs into comprehensive, outcome\-driven solution proposals aligned to EY capabilities
* Build effort estimation models (FTE), cost structures, and benefit cases to support proposals
* Lead participation in client workshops, discovery sessions, and FGDs, including solution shaping and cost discussions
* Ensure alignment between solution design, operational feasibility, and commercial viability
* Act as deal/pursuit owner, leading end\-to\-end responses for RFI, RFP, and RFQ processes
* Drive the full pursuit lifecycle including:
+ Opportunity assessment and qualification
+ Solution structuring and proposal development
+ Executive story lining and value articulation
+ Pricing and commercial modelling

* Coordinate effectively between internal and external stakeholders to enable successful deal closure
* Lead solution defence sessions, presenting EY’s differentiators and value propositions
* Support client meetings, orals, and demonstrations, including POC and solution walkthroughs
* Lead or support due diligence exercises where required
* Develop and implement commercial strategies aligned with deal objectives and growth targets
* Design and execute pricing approaches including:
+ Outcome\-based pricing models
+ Time \& Material (T\&M) pricing
+ Hybrid pricing structures

* Ensure pricing is competitive, profitable, and supported by strong business justification
* Align pricing with internal delivery capability, cost models, and margin expectations
* Support negotiation strategies and commercial structuring for complex engagements
* Support mitigation of challenges across existing engagements and ensure continuity
* Ensure seamless alignment between pre\-sales commitments and delivery execution capability
* Work closely with external auditors to support timely and successful completion of F\&A reconciliation audits (where applicable)
* Enable smooth transition from deal closure to implementation
* Collaborate with:
+ Onshore partners and account leadership
+ Sales and business development teams
+ Delivery teams for feasibility and costing
+ External stakeholders and client leadership

* Deliver compelling, tailored presentations to clients showcasing solution benefits and differentiation
* Build strong relationships with stakeholders to support pursuit success and long\-term growth
* Lead solution presentations, demos, and executive discussions at senior/partner levels
* Manage, mentor, and performance manage direct and indirect solutioning team members
* Build and develop a strong pipeline of pre\-sales and solutioning talent
* Drive knowledge sharing, capability building, and best practice standardization across teams


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Strong expertise in pre\-sales solutioning, bid management, and pursuit leadership
* Deep functional knowledge across F\&A processes (P2P, R2R, O2C, Treasury, Tax, Reconciliation)
* Proven ability to lead large, complex RFP and solution defence engagements
* Strong commercial acumen with experience in pricing strategy and financial modelling
* Excellent communication, storytelling, and presentation skills
* Ability to influence senior stakeholders and drive decision\-making


**Ideally, you’ll also**
* Experience in managed services, consulting, or large transformation programs
* Exposure to global clients and multi\-region delivery models
* Experience in digital transformation, automation, or robotics initiatives
* Familiarity with KPI/SLA and outcome\-based delivery models


**What We Look For**
 We are looking for individuals with 12–15 years of experience in Finance \& Accounting, with exposure across multiple areas, strong commercial mindset, solution\-driven thinking, and leadership capabilities, who can drive high\-impact pursuits and influence outcomes. The ability to manage complexity, engage stakeholders, and deliver client\-centric solutions is critical in this role.
   

  

**What We Offer You**
 At EY, we’ll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams.
   

  

 To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability\-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
   

  

**Our Commitment** 
 : As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
   

  

**Professional Development** 
 : From entry\-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
   

  

**People and Culture** 
 : In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
   

  

**Benefits** 
 : Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting\-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
   

  

**How to Apply** 
 : If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user\-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
   

  

 Successful candidates advance to a competency\-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
   

  

 “We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity \& Inclusion”.
   

  

**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

3ded77d4.description:
**Description**
 AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small\- and mid\-market accounts to enterprise\-level customers including public sector.
   

  

 This job opening is for a Solutions Architect role within the public sector team of AWS, India. We work with the central government ministries, state and local governments, public sector units, education institutions, EdTechs, nonprofits, and healthcare. Our vision is to help public institutions in India to make a significant impact to the lives of citizens, by taking a technology generation leap through use of AWS cloud services within the domains of Skilling, Smart Infrastructure, Healthcare and Inclusion (Physical, Digital and Financial).
   

  

 As a solutions architect you will provide a consistent approach for customers and partners to evaluate architectures, and implement designs that will scale over time based on five pillars of the AWS Well\-Architected Framework — operational excellence, security, reliability, performance efficiency, and cost optimization.
   

  

 Diverse Experiences
   

  

 Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
   

  

 Why AWS
   

  

 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
   

  

 Work/Life Balance
   

  

 We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
   

  

 Inclusive Team Culture
   

  

 Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee\-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
   

  

 Mentorship and Career Growth
   

  

 We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 This job opening is for a Solutions Architect role within the public sector team of AWS, India. We work with the central government ministries, state and local governments, public sector units, education institutions, EdTechs, nonprofits, and healthcare. Our vision is to help public institutions in India to make a significant impact to the lives of citizens, by taking a technology generation leap through use of AWS cloud services within the domains of Skilling, Smart Infrastructure, Healthcare and Inclusion (Physical, Digital and Financial).
   

  

 We are known for our unwavering customer obsession. Our solutions architecture teams are on the front line of helping customers succeed using AWS technologies. Our team members leverage their deep knowledge of AWS technologies in collaboration with our sales and partner teams to impact how solutions are proposed, architected and implemented for clients. Helping make customer success a reality and seeing the impact in real\-time drives our teams to explore new frontiers in leveraging AWS cloud for both commercial and public sector organizations.
   

  

 If you have worked with Amazon Web Services technologies or have AWS certifications you would like to leverage, we will help you maximize the impact of your skills and knowledge.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 13\+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data \& analytics) experience
* 10\+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
* 10\+ years of IT development or implementation/consulting in the software or Internet industries experience
* 6\+ years of responding to requests for proposals (e.g., determining requirements, matching requirements to technical approach and solutions, developing solutions against requirements) experience
* Experience working with Data \& AI related technologies, including, but not limited to, AI/ML, GenAI, Analytics, Database, and/or Storage


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of infrastructure architecture, database architecture and networking experience
* Knowledge of SAP systems (like SAP Business Suite, S/4HANA, SAP Business Warehouse, SAP HANA, SAP Business Objects, etc.) and their architecture and infrastructure needs
* Experience working with end user or developer communities
* Experience managing relationships with SAP customers and partners
* Experience in SAP S/4HANA, SAP Cloud Platform, SAP Cloud ERP and Cloud ERP Private
* Experience in SAP clean core design concepts, including design and build using non\-SAP technologies in domains such as Generative / Agentic AI, and data \& analytics


 Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. 1f8a04df.title: Principal Software Engineer (Java Full Stack with Cloud)
1f8a04df.description:
**Overview:**

At Zebra, we are a community of innovators who come together to create new ways of working. United by curiosity and a culture of caring, we develop smart solutions that anticipate our customer’s and partner’s needs and solve their challenges.


Being part of Zebra Nation means you are seen, heard, valued, and respected. Drawing from our unique perspectives, we collaborate to deliver on our purpose. Here you are part of a team pushing boundaries today to redefine the work of tomorrow for organizations, their employees, and those they serve.  



You’ll have opportunities to learn and lead in a forward\-thinking environment, defining your path to a fulfilling career while channeling your skills toward causes you care about—locally and globally.


Come make an impact every day at Zebra.


**What We're Looking For:**

As a Principal Software Engineer at Zebra, you will act as a key technical leader and full\-stack developer, shaping the future of our enterprise device and cloud solutions. Under consultative direction, you will be entrusted to determine and pursue courses of action essential to achieving our predetermined long\-range targets. This is a hands\-on, full\-stack software engineering leadership role, not a DevOps or IT infrastructure position. We are seeking a master\-level engineer who will personally research, architect, design, and write production\-grade code for our most complex and real\-time cloud solutions. You will also maintain the critical software for our products and systems, acting as a technical leader who builds and delivers enterprise\-grade platforms from the ground up. A key aspect of your work will involve performing complex system integration of software and hardware to ensure program consistency and maintain system throughput. Beyond coding, you will develop, validate, and test system structures and user documentation to ensure we deliver robust, high\-quality, and well\-documented solutions.
  

  

Candidates whose experience is primarily in DevOps, SRE, or cloud administration will not be considered for this position.
**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**  

* Architects, designs, and oversees the development of cloud software solutions for highly complex technical projects, ensuring alignment with business and technical strategies and highly decoupled microservices optimized for distributed cloud environments.
* Creates detailed software specifications and leads the technology roadmap process, recommending project approaches and long\-term goals
* Champions innovation and cultivates creativity among team members, fostering an environment that attracts and retains top talent
* Leads and advises on all aspects of the software development lifecycle, prioritizing quality and continuous improvement
* Monitors competitor products and development strategies, ensuring the organization’s designs exceed industry standards
* Develops next\-generation technologies and solutions in collaboration with other engineering disciplines, anticipating and addressing client needs before the competition
* Protects intellectual property by analyzing competitor patents and contributing to related organizational initiatives
* Serves as a thought leader, representing the organization as a spokesperson on specialized projects and programs
* Establishes formal networks and coordinates efforts across teams and organizational units to achieve shared objectives
* Acts as a prime consultant and advisor for projects impacting the organization’s long\-term technical and business goals
* Provides strategic mentorship to senior engineers and management, fostering knowledge sharing and technical excellence
* Lead end\-to\-end development of high\-performance cloud solutions, ensuring maximum reliability and system uptime.

7499805f.title: Technical Account Manager - Strategic Account
7499805f.description:
**Technical Account Manager**

 **Responsibilities:**


* Drive pre\-sales initiatives to secure impactful deals by identifying opportunities, crafting compelling technology roadmaps, and supporting sales teams to achieve their business targets
* As an account technical solution leader engaging with specified key account(s) to generate, lead and execute upon consultative sales engagements with key technical and business leaders at the customer
* Influence specifications, secure approved vendor status, and establish Siemens solutions as the preferred choice with EPCs / OEMs / End users / Consultants
* Build trusted advisor status by communicating knowledgably with the customer around business challenges, industry trends, competitor landscapes and wider interfaces, through the delivery of thought leadership, and speaking with authority, articulating adoption of appropriate Integrated Automation \& Digitalization solution to deliver competitive advantages
* Engage at early stage of a Project, understand the nature of the opportunities and associated deliverables, accordingly, develop strategies to stitch \& pitch the portfolio elements like Instrumentation, Automation \& Drives, Digitalization \& AI along with overall system architecture
* Crafting, co\-creating \& convincing digital transformation roadmap for customers with value propositions and real use cases
* Build and maintain trusted relationships up to CxO\-level / key business stakeholders — as the account's strategic technical advisor
* Understand the complete scope of the project and position the possible portfolio elements by engaging with multiple stakeholders and stitch the data\-fabric across systems to provide unified view of the operations to EPC / End\-users / Consultant as a differentiator.
* Support to drive profitable sales growth and expand market share of SIEMENS across assigned key account(s)
* Build an integrated approach where technical expertise, business understanding, and commercial strategy reinforce each other. Because the most ambitious projects require the commitment of many stakeholders, the TAM plays an essential role in coordination, alignment, and transforming opportunities into concrete successes
* Fully understand the portfolio (Instrumentation, VFDs, Automation, Digitalization \& AI and Cybersecurity) and effectively use available opportunities to articulate Siemens’ value\-added propositions and create sustainable business growth
* Lead technical discussions, solution workshops, customer presentations, Demo and proof\-of\-concept discussions. Organize product training for customers.
* Building and expanding trusted relationships with respective Sales team, technical experts, Channel Partners, EPCs/OEMs, Consultants and End\-users
* Capability to prepare the technical proposal along with system architecture and convince the customer with most optimized BoM to actively negotiate in coordination with Sales Account Manager and key stakeholders
* Collaboration with channel partners to co\-create value propositions that accelerate deal cycles and expand wallet share
* Align with respective Sales team for the forecast \& opportunity pipeline for assigned key account(s); further to find opportunities to widen the portfolio footprint and actively support to close the opportunities \& achieve the assigned targets
* Collaborate with sales teams to qualify leads, conduct discovery workshops, and uncover customer pain points, process optimization, and achieve a healthy lead\-to\-opportunity conversion rate
* Analyzing markets, customer needs, technology trends and competing portfolios to identify strategic opportunities, value creation, support to do pilot project and scale

**Qualifications / Background:**

* Degree in Engineering (Electronics / Electrical / Instrumentation \& Control / Information Technology); A master's degree or specialization is advantageous
* 10\+ years of practical experience in Industrial Automation; Proven track records of 6\+ years of experience in Technical Sales / Pre\-sales, supported as Solution Consultant for Industrial Automation systems
* Having experience of crafting, co\-creating \& convincing the digital transformation roadmap to customers with value propositions and real use cases
* Expertise and deep understanding of Minerals, Material Handling and Metals industries; and experience of handling large EPCs/OEMs/Consultants/End\-users
* Strong technical knowledge about Instrumentation, VFDs, PLC, SCADA, DCS System and Industrial Communication
* Good understanding of IT/OT integration, Digitalization, IIoT, Industrial AI and Cybersecurity
* Commercial awareness with experience of developing suitable solution concepts, system architecture, technical proposals and value propositions in collaboration with relevant teams
* Strong analytical and systemic problem\-solving skills with a clear passion for addressing business needs \& add new dimensions to the strategy
* A winning combination of engineering experience and strong interpersonal skills: you communicate clearly, listen carefully, present convincingly, and influence stakeholders at every level up to C\-suite executives.
* The ability to collaborate across functions, manage several bids or opportunities simultaneously
* This role requires travelling to customer locations across India for meetings \& account development activities

7d6da57c.title: Solutions Architect , AGS India Public Sector
7d6da57c.description:
**Description**
 AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small\- and mid\-market accounts to enterprise\-level customers including public sector.
   

  

 This job opening is for a Solutions Architect role within the public sector team of AWS, India. We work with the central government ministries, state and local governments, public sector units, education institutions, EdTechs, nonprofits, and healthcare. Our vision is to help public institutions in India to make a significant impact to the lives of citizens, by taking a technology generation leap through use of AWS cloud services within the domains of Skilling, Smart Infrastructure, Healthcare and Inclusion (Physical, Digital and Financial).
   

  

 As a solutions architect you will provide a consistent approach for customers and partners to evaluate architectures, and implement designs that will scale over time based on five pillars of the AWS Well\-Architected Framework — operational excellence, security, reliability, performance efficiency, and cost optimization.
   

  

 Diverse Experiences
   

  

 Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
   

  

 Why AWS
   

  

 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
   

  

 Work/Life Balance
   

  

 We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
   

  

 Inclusive Team Culture
   

  

 Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee\-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
   

  

 Mentorship and Career Growth
   

  

 We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 This job opening is for a Solutions Architect role within the public sector team of AWS, India. We work with the central government ministries, state and local governments, public sector units, education institutions, EdTechs, nonprofits, and healthcare. Our vision is to help public institutions in India to make a significant impact to the lives of citizens, by taking a technology generation leap through use of AWS cloud services within the domains of Skilling, Smart Infrastructure, Healthcare and Inclusion (Physical, Digital and Financial).
   

  

 We are known for our unwavering customer obsession. Our solutions architecture teams are on the front line of helping customers succeed using AWS technologies. Our team members leverage their deep knowledge of AWS technologies in collaboration with our sales and partner teams to impact how solutions are proposed, architected and implemented for clients. Helping make customer success a reality and seeing the impact in real\-time drives our teams to explore new frontiers in leveraging AWS cloud for both commercial and public sector organizations.
   

  

 If you have worked with Amazon Web Services technologies or have AWS certifications you would like to leverage, we will help you maximize the impact of your skills and knowledge.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 13\+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data \& analytics) experience
* 10\+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
* 10\+ years of IT development or implementation/consulting in the software or Internet industries experience
* 6\+ years of responding to requests for proposals (e.g., determining requirements, matching requirements to technical approach and solutions, developing solutions against requirements) experience
* Experience working with Data \& AI related technologies, including, but not limited to, AI/ML, GenAI, Analytics, Database, and/or Storage


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of infrastructure architecture, database architecture and networking experience
* Knowledge of SAP systems (like SAP Business Suite, S/4HANA, SAP Business Warehouse, SAP HANA, SAP Business Objects, etc.) and their architecture and infrastructure needs
* Experience working with end user or developer communities
* Experience managing relationships with SAP customers and partners
* Experience in SAP S/4HANA, SAP Cloud Platform, SAP Cloud ERP and Cloud ERP Private
* Experience in SAP clean core design concepts, including design and build using non\-SAP technologies in domains such as Generative / Agentic AI, and data \& analytics


 Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

dbcc8e0b.description:
The HR Technology organization is looking for a seasoned Senior Technical Program Manager to help enable the efficient delivery of technology solutions to meet stakeholder needs. TPMs in the organization enable IT to accelerate business impact and strategically transform how we work with technology and AI.


As a Senior Technical Program Manager, you will own the successful delivery of complex, cross\-functional efforts. You will partner closely with stakeholders across the organization from Human Resources, Legal, Finance and other teams across the business as needed to develop and execute against our overall product vision and business objectives, uncover solutions to technical challenges, and provide data\-driven insights that power strategic decision\-making for our organization.



We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model.


### **Position Expectations:**


* Execute and improve the processes and tools that inform the daily life of the HR Technology delivery teams
* Drive coordination between product development teams and internal stakeholders to prioritize the team's backlog and plan its release roadmap
* Identify risks to the team's delivery, mitigating them where possible
* Own the data around the health of each team's project and ticket backlog
* Know when a project/team requires more hands\-on management and know when it is time to operationalize and develop a process framework for the project and/or team(s)
* Promote a culture of continuous improvement by conducting retrospectives to help identify areas of growth and learnings within and across teams
* Recognize patterns in a sea of information and take action accordingly
* Expand knowledge into new domains by consistently working to gain the requisite technical knowledge required to skillfully manage the complexities, dependencies, and risks associated with HR technology enabled projects

### **The right candidate for this role will be**


* Experienced with 7\+ years working in an PMO and/or engineering organization, whether in technical program management delivery, support, or an analytics role.
* Skilled at managing HR related technical programs end\-to\-end and working with engineering teams using a variety of program management and agile delivery techniques
* Capable of deep user empathy and adept at balancing product goals and engineering constraints to deliver impactful experiences
* Proficient in grasping the technologies of the HR Technology portfolio, and skilled at identifying the technical interfaces between teams
* Proficient in HR related processes and capabilities, including but not limited to: Talent Management, Learning and Development, Core HCM, Benefits/Compensation and more.
* Able to maintain a strategic view of our engineering processes while also supporting and optimizing the operations of the team
* Inspired to innovate in areas where automation can replace manual work. The team works primarily with JIRA, Smartsheet, and GSuite so programming proficiency with all tools is a plus
* Skilled at communicating across a diverse set of engineers and stakeholders
* Hyper\-organized and capable of juggling all of the data associated with technical programs and task\-tracking
* Knowledgeable of agile methodologies and experienced with implementing program management best practices
* Driven by an attuned sense of priority and urgency to ship features and achieve the right business outcomes
* Trained in working with project tracking software (e.g. JIRA, Smartsheet, GSuite etc)
* Interested in learning everything about MongoDB

### **About MongoDB**



MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB's unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud\-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi\-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.



With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI\-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we're powering the next era of software.



Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It's what makes us MongoDB.



To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we're committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees' wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it's like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!



MongoDB is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter.



MongoDB is an equal opportunities employer.

2bfb811d.title: Solution Engineer
2bfb811d.description:
Etraveli Group is a leading global flight technology provider, specializing in flight sales and offering flight content delivery and fintech products. We are here to solve complexity, by connecting millions of flights and travelers across the globe, from search and selection to trip and beyond.
   

  

 We partner with major global platforms such as Booking.com, Google Flights, Skyscanner, and Kayak, providing seamless flight booking and related services. Our B2B portfolio includes Precision, our specialist in travel fintech; Tripstack, our B2B Flights as a Service Provider and world leader in virtual interlining, serving as the gateway to Etraveli Group’s flight content and fulfillment services; Wenrix, the AI Infrastructure for profitable growth in air; and Flygresor.se, Sweden’s leading flight comparison site. We also operate our own online travel agency brands including Gotogate, Mytrip, and Flightnetwork.
   

  

 Every day we strive to make the world smaller for our customers and bigger for our people. Our diverse team of more than 3200 passionate professionals is what makes us the industry’s tech wonder and the best in the world at what we do.
   

  

 Major offices in Sweden (HQ), Greece, India, Canada, Israel, Poland, UK, and Uruguay.
   

  

**Job Purpose**
 The System Solution Engineer is accountable for the strategic oversight, successful implementation and reliable maintenance of the core Customer Services technology stack, including systems like Genesys, Zendesk, Teramind, and associated Data \& Quality Management (QM) tools. This role acts as the primary subject matter expert, ensuring system stability, optimal performance, and continuous feature adoption. The purpose is to maximize agent efficiency, ensure compliance and align the capabilities of these platforms directly with operational objectives to deliver a seamless, high\-quality agent \& customer experience.
   

  

**Duties \& Responsibilities**
* System Ownership \& Strategy: Take full ownership of the technical health, lifecycle management, and multi\-year roadmap for the entire Customer Services IT systems portfolio (including Genesys Cloud, Zendesk, Teramind, and integrated 3rd party tools).
* Cross\-System Integration: Define and govern the strategic approach for integrating different platforms (telephony, CRM, WFM, QA) to ensure data flow, system compatibility, and a unified agent experience.
* Vendor \& Budget Management: Manage key technology vendor relationships and oversee system\-related budgets and capacity planning.Provide L3 subject matter expertise and guidance on how agents and supervisors can best utilize the appointed systems.
* Maintain an expert\-level understanding of new features and market trends across the CS technology landscape to drive continuous feature adoption.
* Assesses situations to make appropriate recommendations based on operational needs.
* Adheres to support processes and best practices.

5817a814.title: Presales Solution Architect-Digital Workplace Services
5817a814.description:
**Role description**  

The Presales Solution Architect for Digital Workplace Services will play a critical role in shaping technology and managed service solutions that enable modern, productive and user\-centric workplace environments.



The role will partner closely with sales, practice, delivery, engineering, commercial teams, technology partners and clients to understand business requirements, develop tailored solutions and articulate the value of Digital Workplace Services.



The solution scope may include Service Desk, Field Services, Modern Endpoint Management, Device Lifecycle Services, Microsoft 365 and Collaboration, Workplace AI and Automation.



The ideal candidate will be a Digital Workplace generalist with broad solutioning experience across multiple workplace service areas and deeper expertise in one or more domains.



The candidate should combine technical understanding, managed services solutioning, commercial awareness, strong documentation capability and confident client\-facing communication skills.


**Key Responsibilities:**



Solution Design and Architecture Lead the design of end\-to\-end Digital Workplace solutions spanning Service Desk, Field Services, VIP support, endpoint management, device lifecycle services, Microsoft 365, collaboration platforms, Digital Employee Experience, digital adoption and workplace automation.



Translate customer business, operational and technical requirements into scalable, supportable and cost\-effective solution architectures.



Design integrated operating models covering service scope, support tiers, delivery locations, coverage windows, staffing, governance, service levels and enabling technology platforms.



Coordinate inputs from domain specialists, delivery teams, technology vendors and service partners to create a cohesive end\-to\-end solution. Develop solution blueprints, architecture diagrams, service descriptions, service catalogues, operating models and transformation roadmaps. Define solution assumptions, dependencies, exclusions, risks, customer responsibilities and third\-party responsibilities.



Ensure proposed solutions are aligned with customer objectives, operational requirements and delivery capabilities.



Presales and Bid Support Work with sales and account teams to qualify opportunities and define appropriate Digital Workplace solution strategies.



Lead or contribute to RFP, RFI and proposal responses.



Conduct customer discovery workshops, requirements sessions, assessments and solution walkthroughs.



Develop high\-quality solution proposals, response documents, PowerPoint presentations, bid\-orals decks, executive narratives and supporting solution artefacts.



Build value propositions, business cases, ROI and TCO models, transformation benefits and competitive differentiators.



Lead or support bid\-orals presentations, solution walkthroughs and client solution\-defence sessions.



Respond to technical, operational and commercial challenges relating to the proposed solution.



Support customer due diligence, clarification sessions and commercial negotiations.



Create detailed effort estimates across transition, transformation, engineering, service management and business\-as\-usual operations.



Define service levels, KPIs, OLAs, XLAs, governance structures and reporting requirements.



Provide resource models, effort estimates, technology requirements and commercial inputs.



Work with pricing, finance, delivery and partner teams to validate solution cost, feasibility and competitiveness.



Support the development of pricing models, including resource\-based, transaction\-based, per\-user, per\-device and outcome\-based constructs where applicable.



Participate in internal solution reviews, risk reviews and commercial approval processes.



Ensure proposed commitments are measurable, deliverable and commercially viable.



Field Services and Partner Solutioning Work with global, regional and local field\-service partners to develop onsite support, scheduled visit and dispatch\-based service models.



Validate partner coverage, delivery capability, service hours, language support, logistics capability and regional constraints.



Obtain and validate partner effort, pricing, lead\-time and service\-level inputs.



Define scope boundaries, hand\-offs, escalation paths, service responsibilities and governance requirements for partner\-delivered services.



Integrate partner\-delivered field services into the overall Digital Workplace operating model and commercial solution.



Support partner selection, benchmarking and solution\-risk assessment where required.



Customer Engagement Present and articulate Digital Workplace capabilities, solution options and transformation roadmaps to senior and executive stakeholders.



Facilitate customer workshops and consultative discussions across business, technology and operational stakeholders.



Conduct demonstrations, proof\-of\-concept planning and solution walkthroughs where applicable. Serve as a trusted advisor on workplace technologies, managed service models, employee experience and workplace transformation.



Translate technical and operational concepts into clear business outcomes and measurable value.



Defend solution assumptions, design decisions, operating models, service levels, effort estimates and commercial constructs in front of customers.



Collaboration and Delivery Enablement Work closely with service delivery, engineering, transition, operations and practice teams to ensure solution feasibility and accuracy.



Engage product vendors, OEMs and service partners where third\-party capabilities form part of the solution.



Develop and review Statements of Work, service descriptions, responsibility matrices, assumptions, dependencies and contractual solution commitments.



Ensure alignment between the proposed solution, contractual scope, pricing model and delivery approach.



Practice and Capability Development Contribute to the development of reusable solution assets, reference architectures, estimators, service descriptions, accelerators and proposal content.



Share knowledge, market insights and solution lessons across sales, presales, practice and delivery teams.



Market and Technology Expertise Maintain awareness of developments across modern endpoint management, Microsoft 365, collaboration, workplace AI, automation, Digital Employee Experience and device lifecycle services.



Understand market trends, customer priorities, competitor offerings and evolving workplace operating models.



Ability to understand complex customer environments and translate requirements into coherent and workable solutions.



Ability to integrate inputs from multiple domain specialists and partners into a single end\-to\-end solution.



Strong customer\-facing presales, consulting and stakeholder\-management experience.



Comfortable working in fast\-paced, multi\-stakeholder and deadline\-driven deal environments.



Strong commercial awareness and understanding of how solution decisions affect cost, risk and delivery.



Ability to balance customer expectations, technical feasibility, operational practicality and commercial viability.



Experience 8–15 years of overall IT industry experience.



At least 5 years of experience in Digital Workplace presales, solution architecture, consulting or managed services solutioning.



Experience designing managed service operating models, support structures, resource models and coverage approaches.



Technical and Service Skills Strong understanding of enterprise endpoint architectures and modern device\-management platforms.



Strong understanding of Service Desk, Field Services and managed workplace support models.



Understanding of device lifecycle processes, including procurement, provisioning, deployment, support, refresh, recovery and disposal. Understanding of workplace AI, conversational AI, automation and self\-service use cases.



Familiarity with ITIL processes, IT service management, governance and service\-delivery models. Ability to design support\-tier structures, coverage models, service levels and operational processes.

Presales, DWS

Powered by technology, inspired by people and led by purpose, UST partners with their clients from design to operation. eb9e8f0f.title: Oracle SaaS Cloud Security - Senior Consultant
eb9e8f0f.description:
**Oracle Cloud Security**


**Role Summary**


We are seeking an **Oracle** **Cloud Security Consultant / OCI Security Architect** to help organizations design, secure, and govern **Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI)** environments while protecting critical business applications, data, and cloud\-native services. The role focuses on OCI security architecture, identity and access management, data protection, cloud governance, posture management, and secure cloud transformation initiatives.


**Key Responsibilities**


* Design and review secure OCI architectures, landing zones, and infrastructure security controls.


* Implement and govern OCI Identity and Access Management (IAM), policies, compartments, and least\-privilege access models.


* Assess and improve OCI security posture using cloud security best practices.


* Design and implement data protection controls, including encryption, key management, vault services, and secrets management.


* Support Zero Trust initiatives, network segmentation, and secure connectivity using OCI networking services.


* Conduct OCI security assessments, threat modeling, architecture reviews, and compliance evaluations.


* Enable secure DevSecOps practices and protect CI/CD pipelines deployed within OCI environments.


* Secure Oracle PaaS and SaaS integrations, including database, analytics, and application workloads.


* Support cloud migration and modernization programs by embedding security controls into OCI landing zones and migrated workloads.


* Develop cloud security dashboards, security monitoring use cases, and compliance reporting capabilities.


* Collaborate with infrastructure, application, database, and business teams to operationalize security controls and remediate identified risks.


* Support incident response, security investigations, and cloud threat detection activities within OCI environments.


**Required Skills**


* Hands\-on experience with **Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI)** services and security capabilities.


* Strong understanding of OCI security architecture, governance, and operational best practices.


* Experience implementing OCI IAM, compartments, dynamic groups, federation, and privileged access controls.


* Knowledge of OCI **Cloud Guard**, **Security Zones**, **Vault**, and **Key Management Services (KMS)**.


* Experience securing OCI networking components, including VCNs, NSGs, security lists, load balancers, and hybrid connectivity.


* Understanding of encryption, key lifecycle management, and secrets management.


* Familiarity with CSPM, cloud governance, and cloud compliance frameworks.


* Knowledge of DevSecOps practices, Infrastructure as Code (Terraform), and secure CI/CD pipelines.


* Experience with cloud monitoring, logging.


**Preferred Qualifications**


* Basic understanding of AI and securing AI\-enabled cloud workloads.


* OCI certifications such as:

o Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Architect Professional


o Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Security Professional


* Industry certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, CCSK, or CISM.


* Experience supporting large\-scale cloud migration, modernization, or Oracle workload transformation programs.


* Knowledge of compliance frameworks such as NIST, CIS Benchmarks, PCI\-DSS, HIPAA, ISO 27001, and SOC 2\.


**Our purpose**  

  

Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.

It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.

45a6732c.title: Senior Consultant - Cloud & Application Engineering-Core Java
45a6732c.description:
**Job Description**
 Bristlecone India Limited is seeking a seasoned Senior Consultant for its Cloud Development – Delivery team. You will design, develop, and integrate core Java services within SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) and SAP API Management, leveraging modern cloud technologies, IaC, and DevOps practices to enable seamless enterprise integration on‑premises and in the cloud.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Architect and implement Java‑based microservices for SAP API Management and Integration Suite.
* Develop automation scripts using Python and Shell to streamline deployment pipelines.
* Design and maintain infrastructure\-as\-code using Terraform and Ansible across AWS, Azure, GCP, and OpenStack.
* Collaborate with cross‑functional teams to define API security, governance, and lifecycle management.
* Implement CI/CD workflows with Jenkins or Concourse, ensuring reliable and repeatable releases.
* Monitor application performance and availability using Dynatrace and other observability tools.
* Provide technical guidance on Cloud Foundry and DevOps best practices to junior engineers.
* Participate in code reviews, design discussions, and agile ceremonies.
* Troubleshoot and resolve production issues in multi‑cloud environments.
* Contribute to knowledge sharing, documentation, and continuous improvement initiatives.


**Qualifications**
* 10\+ years of experience in software engineering with strong Java development expertise.
* Deep understanding of cloud concepts, multi‑cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP, OpenStack).
* Proficiency in Python and shell scripting for automation tasks.
* Hands‑on experience with Ansible and Terraform for configuration and infrastructure management.
* Familiarity with SAP BTP, Integration Suite, Business Accelerator Hub, and SAP API Management.
* Knowledge of Cloud Foundry, containerization, and basic DevOps principles.
* Experience with monitoring tools such as Dynatrace.
* Solid background in CI/CD tools like Jenkins or Concourse.
* Excellent problem‑solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.


**About Us**
**ABOUT US**
 Bristlecone is the leading provider of AI\-powered application transformation services for the connected supply chain. We empower our customers with speed, visibility, automation, and resiliency – to thrive on change.
   

  

 Our transformative solutions in Digital Logistics, Cognitive Manufacturing, Autonomous Planning, Smart Procurement and Digitalization are positioned around key industry pillars and delivered through a comprehensive portfolio of services spanning digital strategy, design and build, and implementation across a range of technology platforms.
   

  

 Bristlecone is ranked among the top ten leaders in supply chain services by Gartner. We are headquartered in San Jose, California, with locations across North America, Europe and Asia, and over 2,500 consultants. Bristlecone is part of the $19\.4 billion Mahindra Group.
   

  

**Equal Opportunity Employer**
 Bristlecone is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status .
   

  

**Information Security Responsibilities**
* Understand and adhere to Information Security policies, guidelines and procedure, practice them for protection of organizational data and Information System.
* Take part in information security training and act while handling information.
* Report all suspected security and policy breach to InfoSec team or appropriate authority (CISO).
* Understand and adhere to the additional information security responsibilities as part of the assigned job role.

bd92265c.title: Infrastructure Specialist-Cloud Platforms
bd92265c.description:
**Introduction**
 A career in IBM Consulting is built on long\-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You’ll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you’ll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You’ll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long\-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences.
   

  

**Your Role And Responsibilities**
 As an Infrastructure Specialist for Cloud Platforms, you will manage and implement infrastructure solutions across various cloud environments according to established designs, ensuring scalability, reliability, and security. You will collaborate with IT teams to implement and integrate cloud infrastructure solutions based on existing designs.
   

  

**Your Primary Responsibilities Will Include**
* Set Up and Configure Cloud Infrastructure: Set up, configure, and manage virtual machines, storage solutions, networking, and databases across different cloud platforms to effectively support business applications.
* Implement and Oversee Cloud Resources: Implement and oversee essential cloud resources such as Virtual Private Clouds (VPCs), Load Balancers, and Cloud Storage solutions to ensure smooth operations.
* Monitor and Troubleshoot Infrastructure: Continuously monitor infrastructure, troubleshoot issues, and maintain high availability (HA) and disaster recovery (DR) configurations to ensure reliable performance.
* Apply Security Measures: Apply and enforce security measures to ensure cloud infrastructure complies with organizational policies and industry regulations.
* Optimize Cloud Costs: Optimize cloud costs by right\-sizing resources, developing cost\-effective solutions, and monitoring usage patterns.


**Preferred Education**
 Master's Degree
   

  

**Required Technical And Professional Expertise**
* Cloud Services Proficiency: Exposure to cloud services from providers such as Oracle Cloud, Nutanix Cloud, Alibaba Cloud, and others, with expertise in Linux and VMware environments.
* Automation Tools Experience: Exposure to automation tools like Terraform, Ansible, and native cloud automation services to automate and streamline processes.
* Cloud Migration Project Experience: Experience with cloud migration projects, including implementation and execution, with a focus on effective planning and delivery.
* Kubernetes Cluster Management: Proficiency in managing Kubernetes clusters across various cloud environments for effective container orchestration and scaling.
* DevOps Practices Knowledge: Exposure to DevOps practices, such as continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD), with an understanding of their application in cloud infrastructure management.


**Preferred Technical And Professional Experience**
* Cloud Cost Optimization Techniques: Exposure to methods for optimizing cloud costs, including right\-sizing resources, developing cost\-effective solutions, and monitoring usage patterns to minimize expenses.
* Advanced Cloud Security Measures: Experience with implementing and enforcing advanced security measures to ensure cloud infrastructure compliance with organizational policies and industry regulations.
* Multi\-Cloud Environment Expertise: Exposure to managing and implementing infrastructure solutions across multiple cloud environments, including Oracle Cloud, Nutanix Cloud, Alibaba Cloud, and others.

0dfb7285.title: Technical Delivery Manager
0dfb7285.description:
Join us as Technical Delivery Manager at Barclays where you will spearhead the evolution of our infrastructure and deployment pipelines, driving innovation and operational excellence. You will harness cutting\-edge technology to build and manage robust, scalable, and secure infrastructure, ensuring seamless delivery of our digital solutions.
   

  

**To be successful as a Technical Delivery Manager, you should have experience with:**
* Experience in managing large multi\-year complex projects involving global teams, through the full project lifecycle from inception to implementation.
* Collaborating with an experienced team of SMEs, Operations, Dev managers, and other Global Business stakeholders to understand the requirements and project deliverables.
* Managing Risks, Assumptions, Issues and Dependencies closely, across all aspects of the project.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, together with well\-developed collaborative mindset.


**Some Other Highly Valued Skills May Include**
* Formal credentials in PMP/SAFE.
* Estimation skills for tasks, including design, development, technical debt, and testing.
* Exposure to Agile / SAFe methodologies.
* Understanding of any Merchant Payments.


 You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job\-specific technical skills.
   

  

 The role is based out of Pune, India.
   

  

**Purpose of the role**
 To manage change projects that help the organisation achieve its strategic objectives, while ensuring that projects are delivered on time, within budget, in control and in compliance with regulatory requirements and internal policies and procedures.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Management of change projects within the organisation, ensuring that they are delivered on time, within scope, budget, and to the required quality standards.
* Development and management of project plans that outline the scope, objectives, timelines, and resource requirements for change projects.
* Communication with stakeholders, including senior management, project teams, and external partners, to ensure that they are informed about project progress and that their needs and expectations are being met.
* Management of project teams, ensuring that they are properly resourced and that they have the necessary skills and expertise to deliver on project objectives.
* Management of project budgets, ensuring that projects are delivered within the agreed budget.
* Creation of reports on project progress to ensure that proposed solutions are delivered on time and within budget.
* Management of project risks, ensuring that risk, assumptions, issues and dependencies are identified, assessed, and mitigated as necessary.
* Facilitation of change management activities, including training and communication, to ensure that change projects are successfully implemented and embedded in the organisation.


**Assistant Vice President Expectations**
* To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions.
* Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they will lead collaborative assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.
* Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues.
* Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done.
* Perform work that is closely related to that of other areas, which requires understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub\-function.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategy.
* Engage in complex analysis of data from multiple sources of information, internal and external sources such as procedures and practises (in other areas, teams, companies, etc).to solve problems creatively and effectively.
* Communicate complex information. 'Complex' information could include sensitive information or information that is difficult to communicate because of its content or its audience.
* Influence or convince stakeholders to achieve outcomes.


 All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

384aa68d.title: Technical Account Manager
384aa68d.description:
**About Gruve**
 Gruve is an innovative software services startup dedicated to transforming enterprises to AI powerhouses. We specialize in cybersecurity, customer experience, cloud infrastructure, and advanced technologies such as Large Language Models (LLMs). Our mission is to assist our customers in their business strategies utilizing their data to make more intelligent decisions. As a well\-funded early\-stage startup, Gruve offers a dynamic environment with strong customer and partner networks.
   

  

**Position Summary**
 We are seeking a highly skilled Technical Account Manager with strong hands\-on experience in Network Security, Firewall technologies, and team leadership. The ideal candidate will be an individual contributor as well as a team manager, capable of driving complex projects while also mentoring and managing a team of Network Security Engineers and Consultants.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead and manage end\-to\-end network security projects across global enterprise environments.
* Act as a technical subject matter expert on Palo Alto Networks, FortiGate, Cisco Firewalls, and Load Balancers (Citrix/F5\).
* Design, implement, and manage security rules and configurations on Palo Alto and FortiGate firewalls.
* Troubleshoot Layer 4 and Layer 7 application and connectivity issues.
* Oversee Global Protect VPN configurations and support.
* Manage firewall backups and recovery operations for business continuity.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to define project scope, objectives, timelines, and deliverables aligned with PMP and ITIL frameworks.
* Develop and enforce Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for configuration changes and operational processes.
* Lead, mentor, and manage a team of network security engineers and consultants, ensuring high\-quality project delivery.
* Interface with clients, vendors, and internal teams to present project status, security recommendations, and risk assessments.
* Lead and mentor a team of network security engineers and consultants.
* Allocate tasks, review configurations, and guide the team to ensure quality and timely delivery.
* Conduct training and upskilling sessions for team members on security best practices and tools.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives across network security operations.


**Basic Qualifications**
* A Bachelor’s or Master's in one of: Computer Science or Related filed.
* 8\+ years of overall experience in Network Security and Project Management.
* Strong hands\-on expertise with Palo Alto or FortiGate firewalls and Load Balancers (F5/Citrix).
* In\-depth understanding of Network Security, Firewalls, VPN, and advanced troubleshooting at L4\-L7\.
* Proven experience managing global security infrastructure projects.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Knowledge of ITIL processes, change management, and incident/problem management.

* PCNSE (Palo Alto Networks Certified Network Security Engineer)
