8d42ffc2.title: Salesforce Solution Architect (Healthcare or Health Cloud exp mandatory)
8d42ffc2.description:
**Description**
 Salesforce Industries is looking to expand our Professional Services Global Delivery Center team by hiring talented and enthusiastic Industry Solution Architects.
   

  

 Salesforce Industries’ goal is to deliver rapid, value\-driven customer solutions for complex business problems. Our Industry Solution Architects play a key role in determining the optimal use of the Vlocity product in the customer environment.
   

  

 We are looking for industry experts who are passionate about the digital transformation of Health Domain and customer experience. Your responsibility is to understand the customer’s business requirements, design, and configure the desired solution.
   

  

 This is a focused team of industry experts whose mission is to work with our largest and most important customers and implementation partners to deliver solutions that delight the customers.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Effective in working with customers, including business executives, business analysts, and IT development staff
* Effective in understanding business needs and distilling the information into business and technical requirements
* Comfortable working with complex business requirements and translating into the design of solutions, including insurance product configuration, rate models, user stories, business rules, etc.
* Speed is paramount. This team is nimble and is the fulcrum to accelerate the delivery of the solution for customers.
* A collaborative and empathetic relationship with the business stakeholders will be central to your role. Your commitment to their success should never be in doubt.
* You’ll be a key channel back to the Salesforce Industries product management team as they look to drive innovation and improvements into future releases of Industry Cloud products.
* If you enjoy working with customers to help them succeed and thrive on working with leading\-edge technologies, this is the role for you.
* This role will require travel to customer locations.


**Experience**
* At least 8\+ years of Healthcare Industry Experience
* Involved in the Implementation of healthcare solutions at operators
* Demonstrated Ability in Healthcare domain or Health Cloud
* Engage business users to understand requirements and create solution designs
* Help in mapping business requirements to Salesforce Industry(SFI) Vlocity product functionality
* Identifies ‘What to implement’ in Vlocity CRM and ‘Solution’ level designs
* Able to evaluate the long\-term impact of implementing a capability \- Any conflict or limitations, impact on operations, roadmaps, or upgrades
* Knowledge of Salesforce Platform
* Champion an AI\-first delivery methodology, utilizing advanced AI tools, developer assistants (e.g., Cursor, Claude), and agentic evaluation frameworks to accelerate implementation across projects
* Collaborate with internal team members (sales/pre\-sales, engineering, other services teams, etc.) to help customers increase the value of their Salesforce Industry products and services (Health Cloud)
* You will have a proven track record of successful delivery of customer projects, preferably enterprise CRM implementations for Telecom clients
* You will have direct experience in working with Salesforce (at an Admin level, minimum)
* You’ll be a self\-starter, adept at picking up new skills and technologies, and eager to break new ground
* You’ll have excellent communication skills to communicate with customers, partners, and internal team members
* You’ll have the vision to help us take our company to the next level


**Technical Skills**
* Ability to technically lead complex projects throughout the complete IT lifecycle (Analysis, Architecture, Design, Build, Test \& Production)
* Hands\-On experience of
* Process modeling tools and best practices
* Project management tools and best practices
* Data modeling
* Systems analysis and design


**Desired Certifications/Qualification**
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Business or a related field
* Salesforce Sales/Service Cloud Consultant
* Salesforce Administrator
* Salesforce Developer
* Certified Scrum Master / Certified Product Owner

11d1bbb7.title: Technology Architect
11d1bbb7.description:
**Project Role :** 
 Technology Architect
   

  

**Project Role Description :** 
 Design and deliver technology architecture for a platform, product, or engagement. Define solutions to meet performance, capability, and scalability needs.
   

  

**Must have skills :** 
 Internet of Things (IoT)
   

  

**Good to have skills :** 
 NA
   

  

**Minimum 15 Year(s) Of Experience Is Required**
**Educational Qualification :** 
 15 years full time education
   

  

 Summary: We are looking for an IT/OT – Industrial AI – Connectivity Solution Architect / Senior Manager with 15\+ years of experience and strong expertise in IT/OT convergence, industrial connectivity, data platforms, edge computing, automation, cybersecurity, and AI\-enabled operations. The candidate will lead solution architecture, technical delivery, and client engagement for Smart Manufacturing, Connected Factory, Industrial AI, and Digital Twin programs across Automotive, Aerospace, CPG, Life Sciences, Resources, and Manufacturing. Strong experience is required in secure industrial connectivity, protocols, data contextualization, streaming, edge/cloud integration, architecture governance, global team leadership, PoCs, RFP/RFI responses, technical workshops, and business development.
   

  

 Roles and Responsibilities:
   

  

 Lead architecture and delivery of secure, scalable IT/OT, Industrial AI, plant connectivity, and Smart Manufacturing solutions.
   

  

 Define reference architectures connecting OT assets, PLCs, DCS, SCADA, historians, MES/MOM, edge, enterprise, and cloud platforms.
   

  

 Assess brownfield/greenfield environments and define current, target, transition, and deployment architectures.
   

  

 Translate manufacturing needs into connectivity, data, contextualization, integration, analytics, and AI solutions.
   

  

 Design industrial data pipelines for real\-time and historical production, quality, maintenance, energy, event, and time\-series data.
   

  

 Lead Industrial AI and Edge AI use cases including predictive maintenance, anomaly detection, quality/process optimization, computer vision, and energy management.
   

  

 Architect industrial connectivity using OPC UA, MQTT, Sparkplug B, Modbus TCP, EtherNet/IP, PROFINET, REST APIs, and vendor interfaces.
   

  

 Integrate OT with MES/MOM, ERP, PLM, WMS, QMS, EAM/APM, IoT, data platforms, Digital Twin, and analytics.
   

  

 Establish standards for asset hierarchy, Unified Namespace, semantic models, contextualization, metadata, and data quality.
   

  

 Implement OT cybersecurity and resilient architectures covering segmentation, zones/conduits, identity, encryption, remote access, redundancy, and disaster recovery.
   

  

 Lead site assessments, PoCs, feasibility studies, workshops, design reviews, vendor evaluations, and demonstrations.
   

  

 Govern architecture, integration, testing, DevSecOps/MLOps, documentation, risks, dependencies, quality, and multi\-site delivery.
   

  

 Provide technical leadership across IT/OT, automation, data, AI, cloud, and cybersecurity teams, including client engagements, RFP/RFI, proposals, estimation, and partner coordination.
   

  

 Develop reusable frameworks, accelerators, reference architectures, and deployment patterns that deliver measurable improvements in downtime, quality, throughput, cost, energy efficiency, and scalability.
   

  

 Professional and Technical Skills:
   

  

 Strong hands\-on expertise in industrial IT/OT architecture, factory connectivity, manufacturing integration, edge computing, industrial data engineering, and Industrial AI is mandatory.
   

  

 Deep knowledge of OT systems including PLC, DCS, SCADA, HMI, historians, industrial gateways, machine controllers, sensors, drives, robots, and vision systems.
   

  

 Advanced knowledge of OPC UA, MQTT, Sparkplug B, Modbus TCP, EtherNet/IP, PROFINET, REST, AMQP, Kafka, and industrial/vendor connectivity patterns.
   

  

 Strong understanding of Purdue/ISA\-95 architecture, industrial network segmentation, DMZ patterns, zones and conduits, and enterprise\-to\-plant integration.
   

  

 Experience designing high\-availability industrial networks and edge architectures with firewalls, switches, routing, VLANs, redundancy, time synchronization, and secure remote access.
   

  

 Strong understanding of IEC 62443, NIST Cybersecurity Framework, zero\-trust principles, asset inventory, identity and access management, certificate management, patching, and vulnerability management.
   

  

 Experience with industrial connectivity and data platforms from Siemens, Rockwell Automation, Schneider Electric, Honeywell, ABB, PTC, Microsoft, AWS, NVIDIA, or equivalent ecosystems.
   

  

 Experience with edge and IoT platforms, containerized workloads, Kubernetes, Docker, APIs, message brokers, streaming platforms, and hybrid\-cloud architectures.
   

  

 Strong experience integrating OT data with MES/MOM, ERP, PLM, WMS, QMS, EAM/APM, historians, data lakes, lakehouses, Digital Twin, and analytics platforms.
   

  

 Strong knowledge of industrial data modelling, asset hierarchies, Unified Namespace concepts, semantic models, contextualization, time\-series data, event processing, and data governance.
   

  

 Experience designing Industrial AI/ML solutions covering data preparation, feature engineering, training, deployment, inference, monitoring, retraining, and responsible AI controls.
   

  

 Experience with Python, SQL, REST APIs, scripting, data engineering, analytics, and integration automation is preferred.
   

  

 Understanding of AI/ML, deep learning, anomaly detection, predictive models, optimization, computer vision, GenAI, and retrieval\-oriented industrial knowledge solutions.
   

  

 Strong understanding of Digital Twin, Industry 4\.0, smart manufacturing, connected operations, virtual commissioning, and closed\-loop optimization concepts.
   

  

 Experience with observability and operations covering device health, connectivity status, data quality, pipeline monitoring, model performance, logging, alerting, and support processes.
   

  

 Knowledge of manufacturing operations, production systems, maintenance, quality, material flow, utilities, energy management, and industrial engineering.
   

  

 Strong solution architecture, system design, analytical, troubleshooting, problem\-solving, and technical decision\-making skills.
   

  

 Strong understanding of SDLC, Agile, DevSecOps, DataOps, MLOps, project delivery, technical governance, quality management, and change control.
   

  

 Excellent client\-facing communication, executive stakeholder management, workshop facilitation, presentation, and technical documentation skills.
   

  

 Proven experience leading global and distributed teams and coordinating industrial OEMs, automation vendors, network providers, cloud providers, and delivery partners.
   

  

 Strong experience in solution design, PoCs, feasibility studies, technical assessments, site surveys, RFP/RFI responses, effort estimation, and proposal development.
   

  

 Strong understanding of Automotive, Aerospace, CPG, Life Sciences, Resources, Utilities, or General Manufacturing domains.
   

  

 Ability to convert architecture and Industrial AI insights into actionable recommendations, scalable rollout patterns, and quantified business outcomes.
   

  

 Additional Information:
   

  

 Experience: 15\+ years of overall experience with significant expertise in industrial IT/OT, manufacturing connectivity, automation, industrial data, edge computing, cybersecurity, and Industrial AI.
   

  

 Location: Bengaluru, India.
   

  

 Travel: Willingness to travel internationally and to client manufacturing sites based on project requirements.
   

  

 Team Leadership: Proven experience leading technical and multidisciplinary teams across OT, IT, data, AI, cloud, networking, and cybersecurity.
   

  

 Education: Bachelor s or Master s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Communication, Instrumentation, Automation, Control Systems, Computer Science, Information Technology, Mechatronics, or a related discipline.
   

  

 Preferred Certifications: IEC 62443, ISA\-95, cloud architecture, networking, cybersecurity, industrial automation, data engineering, AI/ML, Kubernetes, PMP/PMI, or relevant vendor certifications.
   

  

 Core Focus Areas: IT/OT Convergence Industrial AI Plant Connectivity Edge Computing Industrial Data OPC UA MQTT Unified Namespace MES/MOM Integration OT Cybersecurity Digital Twin Smart Manufacturing Industry 4\.0

38d5fbf2.title: IT Data Solution Architect
38d5fbf2.description: Own and govern the end\-to\-end solution architecture for Supply Chain Planning and Procure\-to\-Pay (P2P) platforms. Translate business, operational, and analytics requirements into scalable, secure, and sustainable technology solutions. Define application, data, integration, and infrastructure architecture aligned with enterprise standards and business objectives. Design and maintain solution blueprints, architecture roadmaps, and technical standards for Supply Chain Planning and P2P domains. Architect integrations between SAP, Coupa, Supply Chain Planning platforms, Data \& Analytics platforms, and other enterprise systems. Govern data models, data flows, transformation rules, interfaces, and integration frameworks across the ecosystem. Provide technical leadership and architectural guidance to development, configuration, testing, and deployment teams. Lead architecture reviews, solution assessments, technical risk evaluations, and mitigation planning. Ensure platform scalability, performance, stability, security, compliance, and long\-term supportability. Drive architecture governance and ensure adherence to enterprise architecture principles and platform standards. Collaborate with business stakeholders, Product Owners, Enterprise Architects, platform teams, vendors, and implementation partners. Support solution evaluation, proof\-of\-concept (POC), proof\-of\-value (POV), and minimum viable product (MVP) initiatives. Drive continuous improvement, platform standardization, technical debt reduction, and cost optimization initiatives. Monitor solution quality, data integrity, integration reliability, and operational effectiveness. Provide recommendations on technology adoption, modernization, and architectural improvements. Create and maintain technical documentation, architecture diagrams, integration standards, governance artifacts, and design specifications. Support release planning, deployment governance, and solution lifecycle management activities. Work closely with global teams and stakeholders, ensuring effective collaboration across CET and distributed delivery environments.

1b3ddb5b.title: AMS Cloud EPM ARCS Consultant
1b3ddb5b.description:
Overview:
   

 At Peloton, we don't just implement technology. We transform the way organizations work, compete, and grow. Recognized on the Inc. 5000 list of fastest\-growing companies in the US, Peloton is one of the most respected and fastest\-growing global Oracle consulting firms, delivering Advisory, Consulting, and Managed Services to leading organizations across many industries, including Retail, Financial Services, Manufacturing, Consumer Packaged Goods, and more.
   

 Peloton Consulting Group has the vision and connected global capabilities to help organizations envision, implement, and realize the benefits of digital transformation. Our team has the best practices, knowledge, industry expertise, and know\-how. We make digital transformation a reality by leveraging AI, Enterprise Performance Management (EPM), Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP), Supply Chain Management (SCM), Human Capital Management (HCM), Customer Experience (CX), Analytics, and Data Management for the cloud. Through connected capabilities, we bring people, processes, and technology together. We help organizations go further faster. That is the Peloton way!
   

 What truly sets us apart is our people. We are team players. We are energetic and entrepreneurial. We are problem solvers and innovative thinkers who believe the best outcomes are built together. We believe in quality, appreciate creativity, recognize individual contributions, and place trust in every member of our team. If you bring strong business or technical expertise and want to do meaningful work alongside people who are equally passionate about getting it right, we think you'll feel right at home here.
   

 This role requires a balance of client relationship management, operational oversight, and strategic thinking to ensure services are delivered efficiently and aligned with evolving client business needs.
   

  

 Key responsibilities
   

  

 This role requires candidates to work in IST hours from 5:30 PM to 2:30 AM and have a minimum of 6\+ years of relevant professional experience.
   

 While this is a remote opportunity open to candidates across India, applicants based in Hyderabad or Bangalore will be preferred, as these are our primary hiring locations.
   

  

 The consultant will work as part of the Application Managed Services (AMS) / Support team, providing ongoing functional and technical support for Oracle ARCS (Account Reconciliation Cloud Service) and related EPM Cloud applications. The role focuses on ensuring smooth reconciliation processes, resolving production issues, and supporting business users in financial close activities.
   

  

 \- Provide L2/L3 support for Oracle ARCS including Reconciliation Compliance and Transaction Matching modules
   

 \- Monitor and support month\-end and period\-end reconciliation processes to ensure timely completion
   

 \- Resolve issues related to reconciliations, matching rules, data loads, profiles, and automated business rules
   

 \- Troubleshoot and fix issues in ARCS configurations, security, reports, and workflow processes
   

 \- Support data integration activities between ERP/source systems and ARCS, including validation and reconciliation
   

 \- Perform root cause analysis for recurring issues and provide permanent fixes or workarounds
   

 \- Assist in data validation, tie\-outs, and discrepancy resolution between source systems and ARCS
   

 \- Handle incident tickets, service requests, and minor enhancement requests within SLA timelines
   

 \- Support user access, security roles, and application maintenance activities
   

 \- Coordinate with technical teams for system issues, enhancements, and integration fixes
   

 \- Maintain support documentation, knowledge base articles, and issue resolution logs
   

 \- Ensure adherence to ITIL processes (incident, problem, and change management)
   

 \- Support business users during financial close cycles and audit\-related activities
   

 \- Participate in shift\-based support as required for global clients
   

  

  

 Required Qualifications \& Experience
   

 \- 6–10 years of experience in Oracle ARCS / FCCS implementation or support (AMS preferred)
   

 \- Hands\-on experience in Oracle EPM Cloud support or post\-go\-live environments
   

 \- Exposure to FDM / FDMEE / Data Management tools
   

 \- Understanding of reconciliation processes, financial close cycle, and reporting
   

 \- Knowledge of GAAP, IFRS, SOX compliance, and financial controls
   

 \- Experience with ERP systems (Oracle, SAP, PeopleSoft, etc.)
   

 \- Strong skills in data reconciliation, issue troubleshooting, and analysis
   

 \- Exposure to intercompany eliminations, currency translation, and financial reporting concepts
   

 \- Familiarity with Smart View and Financial Reporting tools
   

 \- Strong communication and problem\-solving skills
   

 \- Ability to work in a client\-facing AMS/support environment
   

 \- Alignment with delivery values: ownership, teamwork, can\-do attitude, and client focus
   

  

 Compensation:
   

 Peloton provides a reasonable range of compensation for roles. Actual compensation is influenced by a variety of factors including but not limited to skills, experience, qualifications, business needs, and geographic location. Peloton also offer bonus opportunities and a comprehensive benefits package including
   

 \- Competitive base salary with performance\-based bonus
   

  

 \- Vacation, Leave, and Holiday pay
   

  

 \- Annual Health Wallet
   

  

 \- Group Medical Insurance
   

  

 \- Group Term Accident \& Life Insurance
   

  

 \- Paid holidays and PTO
   

  

 Peloton Group is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.
   

  

  

 \#OracleEPM \#ARCS \#AccountReconciliation \#EPMCloud \#AMSSupport \#ProductionSupport \#FinancialReconciliation \#OracleCloud \#FinanceTransformation

--------------------

  

* We are looking for smart self driven focused high energy people with top notch communication skills intellectual curiosity and expertise in change management to deliver strategic and transformational advice within complex and demanding environments and develop effective working relationships with stakeholders ranging from the front line users to senior teams at the CXO level

083b70f8.title: Sr. Technical Program Manager, Trust CX Innovations
083b70f8.description:
**Description**
 Trust depends on two things being true at once: that every piece of customer data is governed, controlled, and provably compliant, and that the organization can move fast enough to keep up as products evolve in the era of AI. TCI's AI Enablement \& Data Governance charter owns both. On the data side, we make sure data is classified, its handling is enforceable, and compliance can be proven rather than asserted. On the enablement side, we use AI\-driven automation to take operational load off the entire organization so builders spend their time building trust, not maintaining it by hand.
   

  

 We are looking for a Senior Technical Program Manager to drive the programs across this charter. You will own complex, cross\-functional initiatives that span product, engineering, and science teams, and often multiple organizations, from data governance and enforcement programs to the automation efforts that reduce operational burden at scale. Operating with significant autonomy, you will set the plan, map dependencies across teams, surface risks early, and keep a broad set of stakeholders aligned on a shared bar and timeline, including partners in privacy, legal, and other organizations we depend on. You will operate at a technical level, understanding the systems and trade\-offs well enough to ask the right questions and drive sound decisions, and you will bring the judgment and influence to hold teams that do not report to you accountable to their commitments. Above all, you will be the connective tissue that turns provable data governance and AI\-driven efficiency from goals into delivered outcomes.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Own and drive complex, cross\-functional programs across both data governance and AI enablement, spanning multiple engineering, product, and science teams and often multiple organizations.
* Build the program plan from ambiguity: define scope, milestones, and success criteria, and translate a broad charter into an executable roadmap with clear owners.
* Map and manage cross\-team and cross\-org dependencies, including partners in privacy and legal, surface risks early, and drive them to resolution before they affect delivery.
* Drive data governance programs so that data classification, handling enforcement, and retention obligations are met and provable, and make those requirements a prerequisite for new services rather than an afterthought.
* Drive the AI enablement and automation agenda that reduces operational burden across the organization, and track its impact on capacity and delivery.
* Establish the bar for what "done" and "compliant" mean in this space and embed it into how programs are planned and run.
* Keep a diverse set of stakeholders aligned, from individual builders to senior leaders, through clear written narratives, status, and decision documents.
* Operate at a technical level: understand the systems and trade\-offs well enough to ask the right questions, challenge assumptions, and drive sound decisions.
* Define and track the metrics that show whether governance is provable and whether automation is actually returning capacity, and use them to prioritize.
* Influence and hold teams that do not report to you accountable to shared commitments and timelines.


**About The Team**
 The Trust CX Innovation team drives advancements across Amazon Devices \& Services (D\&S) products. Our mission focuses on maintaining trust as the foundation while ensuring universal access as AI technology evolves. Our team develops essential privacy safeguards and accessibility features that serve millions of customers globally.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 8\+ years of technical product or program management experience
* 7\+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
* Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
* Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules
* Experience defining KPI's/SLA's used to drive multi\-million dollar businesses and reporting to senior leadership

a67f82f1.description:
**Description**
 Amazon strives to be Earth's most customer\-centric company, where customers can find and discover anything they want to buy online. Retail Business Services (RBS) accelerates Amazon's growth by improving customer and Selling Partner (SP) experiences, while optimizing costs across Stores WW. RBS operates at the intersection of retail, operations, technology, and finance, ensuring Amazon's systems and processes scale reliably while maintaining a high\-quality customer and selling\-partner experience.
   

  

 Cost to Serve (CtS) is a specialized organization within RBS focused on improving Amazon's per\-unit economics across the global supply chain. CtS operates on two pillars: defect identification and defect elimination, and partners with WW Operations, Finance, Returns, Concessions, and abuse\-related programs to uncover true cost drivers and remove them systematically. The team builds mechanisms that improve cost predictability, strengthen upstream defect visibility, and enable consistent governance across high\-impact cost categories, contributing directly to improved Free Cash Flow and scalable business growth.
   

  

 Are you passionate about building AI\-powered cost intelligence solutions at scale? Amazon's RBS CtS organization is looking for an experienced Senior Program Manager to lead our charter for identification of emerging cost trends, which serves as the first step in the journey of Defect Identification and contributes to the organization’s defect elimination work. This role serves as the primary business POC, engaging with RBS, Retail category, FBA and Finance teams in managing two projects (i) Project Strata, a layered analytical product built on a "peel the layers" philosophy that gives RBS and Stores leadership a unified, one\-stop view of how Cost to Serve is trending — decomposing headline P\&L costs into granular operational drivers and identifying cost opportunities through benchmarking between different time periods, MPs, channels and business lines. (ii) Defining and setting up P0 output and input metrics for RBS's UDE program. This role also serves as the primary POC to our tech partners in building and scaling above two projects and guides a team of Business Analysts who co\-develop and validate the MLP and scaled product's outputs.
   

  

 This leader will define requirements, own the working backward plan and oversee the daily mechanisms that connect business expertise to technical development. The ideal candidate is equally comfortable managing technical product delivery and presenting program health to Director\-level leadership, with the judgment to navigate ambiguity in a fast\-moving, high\-visibility space.
   

  

 Why You’ll Love This Role
   

  

* High Impact at Scale: You'll lead identification of emerging cost trends and drive investment by the Org in right cost areas.
* Build with Tech: Serve as the key business voice shaping an AI\-powered platform from the ground up, defining what good looks like and ensuring the tool meets the bar for downstream adoption.
* Leadership Visibility: Own updates to senior leaders on key organizational priorities, with direct influence on how the organization invests in automation long\-term.


 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Business/Tech Partnership \& Requirements Definition: Serve as the primary business counterpart to the analytics and tech teams.
* Working Backward Planning: Own the milestone delivery plan for above two projects. Identify risks early, adjust plans proactively, and maintain credible path\-to\-green narratives for leadership.
* BA Team Oversight: Manage the Business Analysts who develop MLP of the products. Iteratively capture feedbacks from Stores leaders and ensure the feedback mechanism runs smoothly, quality standards are maintained, and BAs are effectively translating domain expertise into product development.
* Quality \& Trade\-off Decisions: Hold a high bar on output quality. When design or quality blockers arise, make trade\-off decisions that balance speed, accuracy, and adoption — escalating to senior leaders for significant calls.

9e9e4506.title: Pre-sales Techno-functional Consultant (FCC & GRC)
9e9e4506.description:
Sciente is a Singapore-headquartered specialist BFSI technology and AI/data consulting firm, with offices across Singapore, Malaysia, India, and the USA. We help banks, insurers, and financial services firms modernize through AI-driven governance, risk and compliance (GRC), data intelligentisation, and business technology consulting, delivered through strategic partnerships with Dataiku, Denodo, and Neo4j, alongside our technology talent management practice.

**Role Summary**

Sciente is hiring a mid-level, India-based Pre-sales Techno-functional Consultant (FCC & GRC) who turns BFSI clients' financial crime compliance (FCC) and governance, risk and compliance (GRC) problems into solution concepts, and grows into a senior pre-sales role.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. **Problem discovery.**
   Run discovery sessions with compliance, risk, operations and IT stakeholders at banks, insurers and other financial institutions. Turn vague pain points into structured problem statements with scope, root causes and success measures.
2. **Solution conceptualisation.**
   Design solution concepts across FCC (AML, sanctions screening, fraud, KYC/CDD, transaction monitoring) and GRC (regulatory mapping, controls, risk registers, audit readiness).
3. **Partner-stack architecture.**
   Map each problem to Sciente's capabilities and partner technologies, for example:

* Neo4j for entity resolution, network analytics and linking regulations to controls and risks
* Denodo for unifying data spread across core banking, case management and GRC systems
* Dataiku for models, analytics and explainable decisioning

1. **Proposals and effort estimates.**
   Write solution sections of RFP/RFI responses and proposals, including scope, assumptions, phasing and effort estimates, with delivery leads.
2. **Demos and proofs of concept.**
   Build and present demos and small proofs of concept tailored to the client's data and use case.
3. **Client presentations.**
   Present to both business buyers (Chief Compliance Officer, Chief Risk Officer, Head of Financial Crime) and technical buyers (CIO, CDO, enterprise architects), mostly remotely, with occasional travel.
4. **Market and regulatory awareness.**
   Track regulatory change and industry practice in the markets Sciente serves, and feed this into reusable solution accelerators.
5. **Handover to delivery.**
   Hand over won deals with clear solution documentation so delivery starts without rework.

**Requirements**

Candidates need depth in either GRC or FCC domain and working knowledge of the other.

**Must have**

* Roughly 6 to 10 years in BFSI, including hands-on work in FCC or GRC
* Deep expertise in at least one of the following, with working knowledge of the other domain, enough to frame its problems credibly:

**(a) FCC:**
AML transaction monitoring, sanctions screening, fraud detection, KYC/CDD or case management

**(b) GRC:**
regulatory compliance mapping, risk and control frameworks, operational risk, internal audit or policy management

* Hands-on experience with at least one FCC or GRC platform, as implementer, consultant or user
* Hands-on work experience in technology solutioning is a must
* Solid data literacy: data models, data quality, integration patterns, and how analytics and models drive alerts or risk scores
* Familiarity with regulatory expectations beyond one country, such as FATF standards and at least one of MAS, BNM, US BSA/FinCEN
* Strong written and spoken English; able to whiteboard a solution live with senior client stakeholders
* Willingness to take calls across APAC and US time zones, and to travel occasionally

Find out more: www.sciente.com

When you apply, you voluntarily consent to the disclosure, collection and use of your personal data for employment/recruitment and related purposes in accordance with the SCIENTE Group Privacy Policy, a copy of which is published at SCIENTE’s website (https://www.sciente.com/privacy-policy/).

Confidentiality is assured, and only shortlisted candidates will be notified.

a2024acf.title: Solutions Architect
a2024acf.description:
**This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Solutions Architect based in India.**
This is a senior, client-facing technical leadership opportunity focused on designing and delivering modern Data & AI solutions.
  
  
You’ll work directly with clients to understand business objectives, translate complex challenges into technical strategies, and architect scalable solutions.
  
  
The role combines deep engineering expertise with consulting, stakeholder management, and delivery leadership.
  
  
You’ll guide engineering teams from discovery and architecture through implementation and production deployment.
  
  
You’ll also help clients adopt AI-first engineering practices that improve productivity, quality, and business outcomes.
  
  
Working across distributed global teams, you’ll engage with both technical teams and executive stakeholders.
  
  
The role offers significant ownership, exposure to complex enterprise environments, and opportunities to shape modern data and AI solutions.
  
  
Accountabilities
  
  

* Lead client discovery sessions to understand business objectives, technical requirements, constraints, and desired outcomes.
* Translate complex client challenges into scalable, secure, and production-ready Data & AI architectures.
* Serve as the primary technical advisor throughout client engagements, providing guidance on architecture, tooling, implementation approaches, and technical trade-offs.
* Develop architecture diagrams, technical design documentation, implementation plans, standards, and other materials required to support successful delivery.
* Lead enterprise Data & AI solutions from initial architecture through implementation and production deployment.
* Guide engineering teams through technical implementation while identifying risks, resolving architectural challenges, and removing delivery blockers.
* Apply AI throughout the software delivery lifecycle to improve solution design, engineering productivity, code quality, testing, documentation, troubleshooting, and client outcomes.
* Advise clients on practical approaches to adopting AI within their engineering and data environments.
* Mentor engineers through architectural guidance, technical coaching, design reviews, and knowledge sharing.
* Contribute to technical hiring, onboarding, enablement, and the development of engineering capabilities.
* Communicate complex technical concepts and architectural decisions clearly to engineering teams, technical leaders, and executive stakeholders.
* Operate effectively across distributed teams and time zones while maintaining strong collaboration and delivery standards.

**Requirements**

* 8+ years of experience in Solutions Architecture, Data Engineering, technical consulting, or a related field.
* Proven experience designing and delivering enterprise Data & AI solutions into production within cloud environments.
* Demonstrated experience using modern AI technologies throughout the software delivery lifecycle to improve solution design, engineering productivity, code quality, testing, documentation, troubleshooting, and client outcomes.
* Strong consulting experience leading technical discovery, solution architecture, and client-facing engagements.
* Hands-on experience with several modern cloud and data platforms, such as Snowflake, Databricks, Google BigQuery, AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud Platform.
* Strong experience with data engineering technologies such as Python, SQL, Java and/or Scala, Spark, Kafka, Airflow, dbt, Fivetran, Matillion, or comparable technologies.
* Experience with modern engineering practices, including CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, observability, and monitoring.
* Practical experience incorporating AI into engineering and solution delivery using technologies such as Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, GitHub Copilot, Microsoft Copilot, Google Gemini, Snowflake Cortex AI, AWS Bedrock, LangChain, LangGraph, or similar enterprise AI platforms and frameworks.
* Strong communication, consulting, and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to engage effectively with both technical and executive audiences.
* Ability to navigate ambiguity, make sound architectural decisions, and communicate technical trade-offs clearly.
* Experience mentoring engineers and providing technical leadership within distributed or global teams.
* Industry certifications across Snowflake, AWS, Azure, GCP, Anthropic, and/or Databricks are a plus.
* Contributions to technical communities through speaking, writing, open-source projects, or internal technical enablement are advantageous.

**Benefits**

* Remote-first workplace with the opportunity to work from India.
* Medical insurance coverage for employees and their families.
* Medical insurance coverage for parents.
* Term life and personal accident insurance.
* Wellness allowance.
* Broadband/internet reimbursement.
* Continuous learning and professional development opportunities.
* Support for professional certifications and technical skill development.

* Opportunities to work on challenging enterprise Data & AI initiatives.
* Exposure to modern cloud, data engineering, and AI technologies.

df408cfd.title: Associate Solutions Engineer- (Manufacturing) - Night Shift
df408cfd.description:
**About MISUMI Americas**

MISUMI Americas, a division of MISUMI Group, is a leading provider of standard, configurable, and custom manufacturing solutions. By integrating a vast catalog of components with a world-class digital manufacturing platform, MISUMI Americas empowers engineers and procurement teams to accelerate innovation across the entire product lifecycle. With operations in the San Francisco Bay Area and Chicago, the company serves as a vital partner for the most innovative companies in the Americas.

**What s in it for you**

**Opportunity To Unlock Your Creativity**

Think of all the times you were held back from trying new ideas because you were boxed in by bureaucratic legacy processes or old school tactics. Having a growth mindset is deeply ingrained into our company culture since day 1 so Fictiv is an environment where you have the creative liberty and support of the team to try big bold ideas to achieve our sales and customer goals.

**Opportunity To Grow Your Career**

There are plenty of jobs out there. The question is whether any of them will help you grow in your career Will you be challenged by teammates to achieve your potential Or are they roles that will ask you to do more of what youve already mastered. At Fictiv, youll be surrounded by supportive teammates who will push you to be your best through their curiosity and passion.

**Impact In This Role**

At Fictiv, we are building the worlds premier platform for hardware manufacturing. As an Associate Solutions Engineer, you will support our critical quoting and manufacturability functions, working at the interface between our two sets of customers - the builders who order parts through us, and the manufacturing partners who make them.

In this role you will learn to review the manufacturability and cost of parts submitted by our builders across processes such as CNC machining and 3D printing. Under the guidance of senior Solutions Engineers, you will apply your Mechanical Engineering background to interpret designs, prepare accurate quotes for custom parts, and flag design considerations that affect cost, quality, and lead time. Your work helps bring products to market faster and directly supports Fictivs growth.  
You will report to a Team Lead within Solutions Engineering, who will support your development from guided execution toward independent ownership of quoting and DFM work.

Why this role matters to our customers:  
Speed to Market - accurate quotes and timely DFM feedback help customers make faster decisions and launch sooner.  
Cost Confidence - precise, transparent costing prevents budget surprises later in the process.  
Risk Mitigation - catching manufacturability issues early avoids costly rework, material waste, and delays.  
Quality Assurance - confirming designs are feasible and tolerances are achievable helps customers get correct parts the first time

**What You ll Be Doing**

Quoting Support  
Prepare cost estimates for standard and moderately complex CNC machining and other manufacturing parts, combining your analysis with Fictivs software recommendations.  
Escalate complex geometries, non-standard processes, or challenging timelines to senior Solutions Engineers or High Touch (HT) quoting.  
Use platform tools to automate portions of the quoting process for speed and accuracy.

Design for Manufacturability (DFM)  
Perform DFM reviews on straightforward parts to highlight risks and suggest design or process adjustments, with guidance on more complex cases.  
Interpret engineering drawings, GDT, and material requirements to assess feasibility.

Technical Support Learning  
Build knowledge of machining, finishing, and assembly processes and their cost drivers.  
Learn region-specific manufacturing considerations across the US, India, China, and Mexico.

Customer Engagement  
Communicate with customers on routine clarifications and provide clear, timely updates during quoting.  
Support senior engineers in explaining trade-offs between cost, lead time, and quality.

Cross-functional Collaboration  
Work with internal teams (Sales, Operations, Sourcing, Quality Logistics) to keep projects moving.  
Provide feedback to the quoting software team to help improve the accuracy of automated quoting.

Documentation  
Assist in generating clear 2D drawings per ANSI/ASME Y14.5 standards and maintain accurate records of your quoting analysis.

All employees are expected to maintain and contribute to the QMS.

**Desired Traits**

Experience Education  
1-2 years of hands-on experience in manufacturing, quoting, design, or a related engineering function (internships and co-ops count).  
4-year Mechanical Engineering degree or equivalent technical training.  
Working familiarity with CNC machining and 3D printing is required; exposure to additional processes (sheet metal, urethane casting, injection molding, etc.) is a plus.  
Understanding of GDT and conventional (coordinate) tolerancing.  
Working knowledge of the manufacturability and limitations of common metals and plastics.

Traits  
Meticulous, detail-oriented, with an inclination for documentation.  
Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English required.  
Self-starter who manages time efficiently and is eager to learn and take on more responsibility over time.  
Enjoys learning from others and, in time, sharing knowledge about manufacturing processes.

We re actively seeking teammates who:

* Bring diverse perspectives and experience to our culture and company.
* Excel at being part of a strong, empathetic team.
* Thrive in an environment emphasizing respect, honesty, collaboration, and growth.
* Have an always learning mindset that celebrates learning, not just wins.
* Help us continue to build a world-class organization that values the contributions of all of our teammates

We encourage applications from members of underrepresented groups, including but not limited to women, members of the LGBTQ community, people of color, people with disabilities, and veterans.

  
  
Disclaimer: This job posting has been aggregated from external source. Role details, content, and availability are subject to change. Applicants are advised to confirm the latest information directly on the company website before applying.

30015066.title: AI Solution Architect
30015066.description:
**ROLE SUMMARY:** We are looking for an AI Solution Architect who can take an enterprise AI initiative from vision to execution. You will shape AI strategy with C-level stakeholders, architect cloud-native GenAI and ML platforms on Azure and Databricks, and lead cross-functional teams across data science, MLOps and product engineering to deliver them. You are equally comfortable presenting a roadmap to a board, reviewing a RAG pipeline design and coaching an engineer through a production incident.

**Experience**

* 12+ years in data, analytics or software engineering, including 5+ years leading AI/ML platforms or products in an enterprise setting.
* Proven record of taking ML and GenAI solutions into production at scale, with measurable business impact.
* Hands-on delivery of at least one production LLM/RAG solution, plus hands-on experience with agentic AI patterns.
* Experience leading multidisciplinary teams and presenting to C-level executives.
* Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, Data Science, Engineering, Statistics or a related field.

**Cloud & MLOps:** Azure (ADF, Azure ML, Synapse, Event Hubs, Key Vault), Databricks, Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform, CI/CD

**Data & ML:** Python, SQL, PySpark, MLflow, TensorFlow, Gurobi, Dataiku, SAS, Alteryx

**GenAI & Agentic AI:** OpenAI and other LLMs, LangChain, Milvus / vector databases, RAG, prompt engineering, memory agents, NLP, LLM evaluation

**BI & Visualisation:** Power BI, Tableau, Spotfire, Qlik

**Leadership Competencies:**

* AI strategy and roadmap execution
* AI/ML product lifecycle management
* Responsible AI and governance
* Stakeholder engagement and executive communication
* Training, change management and AI adoption
* Cross-functional team leadership
* Vendor and partner collaboration

**Nice to Have**

* Certifications such as Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Azure AI Engineer, Databricks ML Professional or TOGAF.
* Experience with AWS or GCP AI services, or multi-cloud architectures.
* Industry exposure in financial services, energy, healthcare, manufacturing or the public sector.
* Experience designing or delivering AI training and enablement content.

**SUCCESS IN THE FIRST 12 MONTHS**

* An agreed AI roadmap and reference architecture adopted across key client engagements.
* At least two GenAI or ML solutions in production with tracked business value.
* A working Responsible AI and MLOps framework reused by delivery teams.
* A high-performing, cross-functional team and a strong bench of client executive relationships.

**Reports to: Chief Executive Officer / Head of AI**

 **Requirements**

**AI Strategy & Leadership**

* Define and own AI strategy and multi-year roadmaps aligned to client and C-level business priorities, with clear value metrics (revenue, cost, risk, productivity).
* Lead the full AI/ML product lifecycle: opportunity discovery, business case, architecture, build, deployment, adoption and value tracking.
* Build, mentor and lead agile delivery teams spanning data scientists, ML/MLOps engineers, data engineers and product managers.
* Act as a trusted advisor to executives, translating complex technical options into clear decisions on investment, risk and trade-offs.

**Solution Architecture & Delivery**

* Architect enterprise-grade, cloud-native AI/ML and analytics platforms on Azure (ADF, Azure ML, Synapse, Event Hubs, Key Vault) and Databricks.
* Design and deliver GenAI and agentic AI solutions: LLM integrations (OpenAI and others), retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), vector databases (e.g. Milvus), prompt engineering, memory-enabled agents and NLP pipelines.
* Establish MLOps foundations using MLflow, Docker, Kubernetes and Terraform for reproducible training, CI/CD, monitoring and scalable model serving.
* Set architecture standards, reference designs and reusable components that reduce time-to-production across engagements.
* Guide data and analytics solutions end to end, from pipelines (Python, SQL, PySpark) to optimisation (Gurobi) and BI dashboards (Power BI, Tableau, Spotfire, Qlik).

**Responsible AI & Governance**

* Define and embed Responsible AI practices: fairness, explainability, privacy, security, model risk management and human oversight.
* Design governance for GenAI, including evaluation frameworks, guardrails, hallucination and prompt-injection controls, cost monitoring and audit trails.
* Ensure solutions comply with relevant regulations and client policies (e.g. PDPA, GDPR, MAS FEAT principles where applicable).

**Stakeholder, Change & Adoption**

* Engage business, IT, security and risk stakeholders to align scope, secure buy-in and manage expectations.
* Lead training, change management and AI adoption programmes so solutions are used, trusted and sustained.
* Manage vendor and partner relationships (cloud providers, LLM providers, platform and SI partners), including evaluation, selection and commercial input.
* Produce clear executive communication: roadmaps, status reports, value realisation reviews and steering committee materials.

d0e170e0.description:

* Understanding of systems architecture and ability to design scalable performance-driven solutions
* Understanding of key design patterns and large data volume limitations and best practices
* Understanding of data sharing and visibility considerations and how these play into platform architecture

**A Snapshot of your Day!**
We are seeking an experienced Solution Architect to lead the end-to-end architecture of business-facing applications. In this role, you will translate business and non-functional requirements into secure, scalable, resilient, and maintainable solutions; define technical standards and implementation guardrails; and guide delivery teams from solution design through deployment and production support. You will collaborate with business, product, security, platform, operations, and engineering stakeholders to ensure solutions align with enterprise architecture principles and deliver measurable business value. As a senior professional, you will be expected to work independently on complex problems, manage development processes, and provide technical guidance to other team members.
  
  
**How You'll Make An Impact**

* Own the end-to-end solution architecture for enterprise applications built with Angular, .NET Core, APIs, relational and non-relational databases, and cloud-native services
* Translate business and non-functional requirements into scalable, secure, resilient, and supportable solution designs
* Define application, integration, data, security, deployment, and observability architecture across frontend, backend, third-party services, and enterprise platforms
* Select appropriate patterns, frameworks, cloud services, and reusable components while balancing cost, performance, maintainability, and delivery speed
* Produce architecture diagrams, interface specifications, deployment models, technology decisions, and implementation guardrails
* Guide developers through design reviews, technical spikes, code reviews, and resolution of complex engineering issues
* Ensure solutions follow enterprise architecture standards, cybersecurity controls, data privacy requirements, and DevSecOps practices
* Design for automated testing, continuous integration and delivery, monitoring, logging, disaster recovery, and production support
* Collaborate with product managers, business stakeholders, platform teams, security, operations, and vendors to align architecture with business outcomes.
* Identify technical risks, dependencies, and modernization opportunities, and drive pragmatic mitigation and architectural improvements

**What You Bring**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
* 8+ years of software engineering experience, including substantial responsibility for solution architecture or technical design leadership
* Expert knowledge of object-oriented design, domain-driven design, design patterns, and distributed application architecture using C# and .NET Core.
* Strong experience architecting modern web applications using Angular, TypeScript, HTML, CSS, and component-based frontend patterns
* Proven experience designing RESTful APIs, event-driven integrations, identity and access controls, and integrations with enterprise and third-party services
* Hands-on architecture experience with AWS and container platforms such as OpenShift or Kubernetes
* Strong knowledge of SQL and NoSQL data stores, including data modelling, performance, availability, security, and lifecycle considerations
* Experience with Git-based development, CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure automation, observability, and DevSecOps practices.
* Ability to evaluate architectural trade-offs, create clear technical documentation, and communicate decisions to both engineering and business stakeholders
* Strong leadership, stakeholder management, analytical, and problem-solving skills, with professional written and verbal communication in English

**About The Team**
Our Transformation of Industry division is decarbonizing the industrial sector. Increasing electrification and efficiency are key and demand for green H2 and derivative fuels will rise. We enable decarbonization of the industrial sector and the transition to sustainable processes, building on a strong industrial customer base, a global network, diverse technologies, and integrated execution capabilities. Candidates want to learn about the divisions they will be joining–the structure, how it works together, and the role it plays in driving Siemens Energy’s mission forward
**.**
**Who is Siemens Energy?**
At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies crafted in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.
  
  
Our distributed team is committed to making balanced, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.
  
  
Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo
  
  
**Our Commitment to Diversity**
Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

* All employees are automatically covered under the Medical Insurance. Company paid considerable Family floater cover covering employee, spouse and 2 dependent children up to 25 years of age.

c3026f9a.title: AWS Cloud Engineer
c3026f9a.description:
**Your Career, Accelerated**

Vivanti, Australia's leading technology data and analytics consulting firm, is growing their team in their Bengaluru Global Delivery Center.

Vivanti was founded as a platform for talented technologists who want to make a real impact for their clients. Some of the world’s biggest businesses turn to us to help bring their data strategy, AI, cloud engineering and digital solutions to life. We’re the home base for talented technologists who want more and are looking to take their career to the next level by having more learning, more variety, more support and more chances to do meaningful work.

Our consultants use emerging technologies and best practices to help clients become more data driven across a range of industries. Recent projects include building a customer data platform for a leading Airline, an IoT based real-time driver safety dashboard for a global logistics firm, architecture advisory for Australia’s largest radio network, a full fledged enterprise cloud and data platform for the world’s leading medical aid manufacturing company, to name a few.

We work with all the major technologies used in the market today and are partners with some of the largest names in the industry i.e. Databricks, Snowflake, Google, AWS, Azure and many more.

If that sounds like the kind of place you’d thrive in, keep reading.

**What You’ll Get**

We know you're bringing the skills, the passion and the drive. What we bring is the platform to help you go further.

At Vivanti, you're not just taking a job, you're investing in your growth.

Here’s a taste:

* A platform for growth: Work across industries, clients and technologies that stretch your thinking and build your personal and professional skills.
* Access global businesses: Work with some of the world's biggest brands
* IP, frameworks and accelerators: We share what we know. Our playbooks and toolkits fast-track your success on projects.
* Access to a broad ecosystem of technologies
* Senior consultants who have your back: You’ll always have a guide on your journey, not just be thrown into the deep end.
* Serious learning support: Paid certs, weekly training, guilds, hackathons, mentoring and more.
* Progress that’s transparent: Annual Progress Reviews based on 360° feedback, not vague vibes. Clear goals, solid feedback and real growth.
* Toastmasters and Pitch sessions to embrace your public speaking and leadership skills
* Hackathons to gear up for technologies on the horizon
* Comprehensive Health Insurance
* Kudos and rewards: We celebrate wins, reward impact and offer long-term incentives.
* Real connection: From Friday socials to annual team building days - we work hard and play harder.

**What You’ll Do**

Scaling and Operating a robust AWS platform:-

* Act as a technical lighthouse. You’ll join client reviews to explain why they should migrate to EKS, adopt Serverless, or rethink their Disaster Recovery strategy.
* Design, deploy, and maintain multi-tenant AWS environments using Terraform. You’ll ensure that "manual change" isn't in our vocabulary.
* Build and optimize deployment pipelines (GitLab CI) that allow our clients to ship code safely and frequently without waking you up at 3 AM.
* Identify repetitive operational tasks, from certificate renewals to environment provisioning, and write the Python or Go code to automate them away
* Implement "Observe-everything" stacks using Amazon CloudWatch,
  and Open Telemetry

Designing and Scaling the next generation of LLM workloads on AWS Bedrock

* Operationalize AWS Bedrock by managing model access, provisioning "Provisioned Throughput" for consistent performance.
* Deploy and maintain the "plumbing" for Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), including Bedrock Knowledge Bases and vector databases.
* Implement Bedrock Guardrails to enforce content filtering and PII masking, ensuring client AI applications stay within safety and compliance boundaries.

**What We’re Looking For**

4+ years deep familiarity with AWS products and services, including:

* Serverless architecture with Lambda, ECS and Fargate
* Expertise in cloud networking (security groups, WAF, ALBs, API Gateway, etc)
* Cloud governance with IAM roles and permissions
* Knowledge of AWS AI offerings including AWS Bedrock Agentcore, AWS Strands, and Bedrock KnowledgeBases
* Operational reporting and monitoring with CloudWatch and Open Telemetry
* Experience with IaC frameworks like Terraform and Cloud Formation
* Strong fundamentals in Linux, scripting, automation

**If you don’t have 4+ years of deep AWS experience, this might not be the right fit just yet.**
We encourage you to keep building those cloud muscles and look out for our mid-level openings in the future!

**Why Explore a Career at Vivanti**

We are a consultant led organisation. We invest heavily in our consultants to ensure they have the technical skills and commercial acumen to be successful in their work. Our consultants have a passion for data and solving complex problems. They are curious, ambitious and experts in their fields. We have developed a first rate team so you will be supported and learn from the best.

We invest heavily in professional development both technically, through training and guided certification pathways, and in consulting, through workshops in client engagement and communication. Growth in our organisation happens from growth in our people.

Working on your own macbooks in our custom designed offices in the heart of Bengaluru, away from the big tech parks, we provide a peaceful and productive work environment close to shops, parks and metro stations.

Vivanti consultants engage with the business to give expert advice, solve problems and deliver data, analytics, digital, AI, customer and cloud solutions, by drawing on years of experience across diverse projects, industries and technologies!

**The Vivanti Interview Process**

We like keeping it to the point and explore a candidate's competence through 4 stages of:

* A technical online screening test where we do a baseline assessment of your problem solving skills
* Introductory and Cultural Assessment to make sure we are all on the same page in terms of our growth and career prospects.
* Technical Assessment to understand your technical competency assessed by our technical panel.
* Final Round to make sure the technicality is in balance with the aptitude and culture fit.

And after this, you pack and join us: )

612511f2.description:
**A Snapshot of your day**
You will work as a hands-on technical leader driving the design, development, and deployment of production-grade Generative AI solutions across enterprise and industrial domains. You will collaborate closely with product managers, data scientists, engineers, and business stakeholders to translate complex business needs into scalable, secure, and reusable AI architectures on cloud platforms. Your day will involve architectural decision-making, technical mentorship, solution design reviews, and guiding teams from proof-of-concept to production.
  
  
**How You'll Make An Impact**

* Lead the end-to-end architecture and implementation of Generative AI solutions, from ideation to production deployment.
* Design scalable, reusable cloud-based architectures for AI and GenAI workloads.
* Build and evolve advanced Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) frameworks and multi-agent systems.
* Provide technical leadership and mentorship to engineering teams.
* Collaborate with product managers and stakeholders to define requirements and delivery milestones.
* Ensure solutions meet enterprise standards for security, reliability, and performance.
* Identify and mitigate technical risks to enable smooth production releases.
* Drive adoption of MLOps best practices for model lifecycle management.

**What You Bring**

* Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
* 8+ years of experience in software engineering, data science, with minimum 4+ years’ experience in AI-related roles.
* Proven experience delivering production-grade Generative AI solutions using LLMs.
* Strong expertise in Python and modern AI/ML frameworks.
* Hands-on experience with RAG, multi-agent, and graph-based AI architectures.
* Experience with Azure OpenAI, AWS SageMaker is must.
* Strong background in MLOps platforms such as MLflow and Kubeflow
* DevOps experience in OpenShift will be a major advantage.
* Experience with API design using FastAPI.
* Knowledge of SQL, NoSQL, and vector databases.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills

**About The Team**
Our Transformation of Industry division is decarbonizing the industrial sector. Increasing electrification and efficiency are key, and demand for green hydrogen and derivative fuels will rise. We enable the decarbonization of the industrial sector and the transition to sustainable processes by building on a strong industrial customer base, a global network, diverse technologies, and integrated execution capabilities.
  
  
The Data & Artificial Intelligence team develops and operates digital and AI solutions that support business transformation. The team brings together AI engineering, data, cloud, architecture, and software development capabilities to convert business requirements into secure, scalable, and operational solutions.
  
  
**Who is Siemens Energy?**
At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With +100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world’s electricity generation.
  
  
Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.
  
  
Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: [1] https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo
  
  
Our Commitment to Diversity
  
  
Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion, and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character—no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.
  
  
**Rewards/Benefits**

* Flexible and hybrid working environment
* Opportunities for continuous professional and personal development
* Collaborative and inclusive international work environment
* Access to learning, training, and knowledge-sharing opportunities
* Competitive local benefits
* Opportunities to work with innovative technologies and contribute to impactful projects

* Design scalable, fault-tolerant, and production-ready AI architectures on AWS.
* Implement monitoring, logging, observability, and performance optimization for AI applications.
* Establish CI/CD pipelines for automated testing, deployment, and release management.
* Collaborate with architects, product managers, and cross-functional engineering teams to deliver enterprise AI solutions.

d2b171d3.title: Manager, Applied AI Architect

**This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Manager, Applied AI Architect based in India.**
This leadership role focuses on guiding a team of senior technical professionals responsible for helping complex enterprise customers turn advanced AI capabilities into measurable business outcomes.
  
  
You’ll shape technical strategy across the customer lifecycle, from discovery and solution evaluation through production deployment, adoption, and expansion.
  
  
The role combines people leadership, enterprise architecture, executive engagement, and hands-on technical coaching.
  
  
You’ll work across AI models, agentic applications, data, APIs, cloud platforms, security, privacy, governance, evaluation, and deployment.
  
  
Success requires balancing regional strategy and resource allocation with direct involvement in high-impact customer engagements.
  
  
You’ll collaborate closely with Sales, Product, Engineering, Research, Security, Legal, Privacy, Deployment, and external partners.
  
  
The environment emphasizes technical excellence, responsible AI adoption, customer value, continuous learning, and strong cross-functional ownership.
  
  
Accountabilities
  
  

* Hire, coach, mentor, and develop a high-performing team of Applied AI Architects, fostering technical excellence, accountability, continuous learning, and strong customer stewardship.
* Define and continuously improve the team's operating model and technical strategy in alignment with organizational priorities and strategic customer needs.
* Partner with Sales leadership and Account Directors to prioritize strategic accounts, allocate technical resources, and establish focused technical strategies for major engagements.
* Ensure architects own technical account plans, milestones, adoption priorities, account health, production readiness, and expansion opportunities across their portfolios.
* Lead complex customer journeys from executive vision and business objectives through use-case qualification, solution evaluation, governance, deployment, and measurable production impact.
* Coach the team on enterprise AI architectures covering models, applications, data, integrations, identity, security, privacy, governance, evaluation, reliability, and deployment.
* Build trusted relationships with C-suite, board-level, technology, data, security, engineering, and AI leaders, acting as an executive technical sponsor for critical engagements.
* Mobilize internal and external specialists across deployment, implementation, enablement, Product, Engineering, Research, Security, Legal, Privacy, and partner ecosystems to resolve blockers and coordinate delivery.
* Establish a comprehensive view of portfolio health, tracking qualified use cases, technical milestones, production readiness, adoption, usage, risks, customer impact, and technical contributions to growth.
* Translate customer and field insights into actionable feedback for product, engineering, research, and go-to-market teams.
* Develop reusable architecture guidance, customer practices, and technical approaches that can improve consistency and effectiveness across engagements.
* Promote responsible AI deployment while maintaining clear ownership, thoughtful prioritization, effective specialist handoffs, and ambitious customer outcomes.

**Requirements**

* 10+ years of experience in customer-facing technical roles such as solutions architecture, solutions engineering, technical account leadership, AI deployment, or technical consulting, including experience with large and complex enterprises.
* 4+ years of people-management experience, including hiring, coaching, and developing high-performing customer-facing technical teams.
* Deep technical knowledge of modern AI systems, foundation models, agentic applications, software and cloud architecture, APIs, data integration, identity, security, privacy, evaluation, and enterprise deployment.
* Demonstrated experience guiding enterprise customers from technical discovery and evaluation through production adoption, sustained usage, and measurable business outcomes.

Veefin Solutions is a pioneer in powering digital supply chain finance and lending technology for financial ecosystems globally. Our enterprise platforms allow banks and financial institutions to capture working capital opportunities through intelligent automation and unified SCF platforms.

**Role Overview:**

We are seeking a dynamic and results-driven Pre-Sales Consultants to join our team. In this role, you will act as the technical and functional expert supporting the sales team in presenting our product/solutions to prospective clients.

We are looking for someone who knows how to strategically position our platform to capture global market share and scale with Veefin's next phase of growth.

* Direct and manage the entire RFP/RFQ/RFI lifecycle for complex enterprise Digital Lending (LOS, LMS, LCS) & Supply Chain Finance opportunities.

* **Environment Setup & Executive Product Demos:**

* Map complex multi-entity, multi-anchor, and corporate ecosystem structures directly to Veefin's solution modules.
* **Inter-Departmental Collaboration & Client Relationship Management:**
* Act as the strategic liaison between Market Sales, Product Engineering, and Delivery teams to drive future-proof feature developments in Digital Lending and Supply Chain Finance technology.

  MBA preferred. Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Business, or related field.

  .

**The Opportunity**
As a Business Partner in our Domain Risk Pre-Sales unit, you'll identify and cultivate new opportunities related to credit and fraud risk, combining deep business knowledge across both domains with a consultative, solutions-based approach to selling. This role focuses on building new revenue streams through the expansion of FICO Platform capabilities, working closely with the Asia Pacific sales team to translate client business challenges into compelling and credible solutions.
  
  
**What You’ll Contribute**

* Apply your knowledge of the risk management lifecycle, including originations, customer management, fraud, collections, and digital transformation, to build platform demos with Key Account Managers, Solution Sales Executives, and Platform Presales teams.

**What We’re Seeking**

You’ll play a part in our commitment to help businesses use data to improve every choice they make, using advances in artificial intelligence, machine learning, optimization, and much more.
  
  
FICO makes a real difference in the way businesses operate worldwide:
  
  

* Credit Scoring — FICO® Scores are used by 90 of the top 100 US lenders.

Global trends toward digital transformation have created tremendous demand for FICO’s solutions, placing us among the world’s top 100 software companies by revenue. We help many of the world’s largest banks, insurers, retailers, telecommunications providers and other firms reach a new level of success. Our success is dependent on really talented people – just like you – who thrive on the collaboration and innovation that’s nurtured by a diverse and inclusive environment.
