c472259d.title: Lead Demo Engineer / Presales Solutions Consulting
c472259d.description:
Here at Appian, our values of
**Intensity**
and
**Excellence**
define who we are. We set high standards and live up to them, ensuring that everything we do is done with care and quality. We approach every challenge with ambition and commitment, holding ourselves and each other accountable to achieve the best results. When you join Appian, you’ll be part of a passionate team dedicated to accomplishing hard things, together.

**Lead Demo Engineer**

Here at Appian, our core values of Excellence and Intensity define who we are. In short, this means we constantly seek to understand the best for our customers, we go beyond completion in our work, we strive for excellence with intensity, and we embrace candid communication. These values guide our actions and shape our culture every day. When you join Appian, you'll be part of a passionate team that's dedicated to accomplishing hard things.

SC 2.0 is the engine powering our vision
. Appian's Sales Solutions Consulting team is in the midst of an exciting transformation -- redefining what it means to be a trusted advisor in today's fast-paced, mission-driven environment. Our SCs don't just demo features -- they tell stories, co-create with customers, and help shape strategy with technical credibility and business insight.
Read More About SC 2.0 Here

You can listen to our Global SSC leader, Gregg Aldana discuss SC 2.0
here
.

The SPEAR Team (Strategic Presales Execution and Readiness) is the operational engine behind Appian's global Presales organization -- the team that builds the tools, assets, governance, and infrastructure that let Solutions Consultants do their best work. As Lead Demo Engineer on SPEAR, you are not on the sidelines of SC 2.0 -- you are leading one of the teams that makes it possible at scale.

**The Role**

Are you a seasoned Appian developer with a passion for crafting impactful technology solutions and mentoring others? As the Lead Demo Engineer for Appian's SPEAR Team in Chennai, you'll take on a dual role: leading the day-to-day operations of the Chennai Demo Engineers and serving as a senior individual contributor yourself. You'll play a critical part in scaling Appian's global Presales organization by managing team workflows, providing technical guidance, and personally delivering the highest-quality demo assets that fuel hundreds of sales engagements each year.

In this role, you'll act as both a manager and a technical lead. You'll oversee the daily activities of the team, monitor progress, ensure work is completed on time and to a high standard, and serve as a key resource for technical guidance when Demo Engineers run into challenges. You'll also continue to do the work yourself -- de-branding prospect demos, modernizing aging assets with the latest Appian capabilities, contributing to DemoHub (Appian's centralized demo catalog and governance system), and producing polished clickable demos, walkthrough videos, and scripts. By fostering a collaborative and supportive environment, you'll empower your team to excel while ensuring alignment with global SPEAR priorities and deadlines.

You will report directly to the US-based Area Vice President of Solutions Consulting, who leads the SPEAR Team. This reporting structure gives you a direct line into the strategy and priorities of Appian's global Presales organization, and positions you as the on-site Chennai leader and primary liaison between the Chennai team and stakeholders worldwide.

This role combines leadership, deep technical expertise, and strategic oversight, offering you the chance to make a significant impact both as a contributor and as a mentor. If you thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative environment and are ready to elevate the capabilities of your team while showcasing the power of Appian's platform, this role is for you.

**What you'll be doing...**

* Team Leadership: Manage and mentor a team of Demo Engineers in Chennai, ensuring smooth day-to-day operations, clear priorities, and alignment with global Presales strategy.
* Technical Oversight: Provide senior technical guidance on capturing, refining, and expanding product demos, ensuring all outputs are reusable, impactful, and aligned with current Appian capabilities and industry trends.
* Operational Excellence: Own the cataloging and ingestion of product demos into DemoHub, maintaining high standards of quality, consistency, and discoverability across hundreds of assets per year.
* Senior Technical Contribution: Personally de-brand prospect-specific demos, enhance them with advanced new Appian features, and prepare them for broader organizational use -- setting the technical bar for the team's work.
* DemoHub Application Development: Lead and contribute to ongoing development and maintenance of the DemoHub Appian application itself -- the platform that stores, governs, and surfaces demo content to the global SC team. This includes building new features, fixing bugs, and improving usability.
* Clickable Demo Production: Oversee and personally contribute to the recording, editing, and continuous updating of interactive clickable demos in a commercial third-party demo platform, ensuring our self-service and accelerated demo experiences stay accurate, on-brand, and current.
* Demo Artifact Creation: Produce and oversee production of supporting artifacts including walkthrough videos, demo scripts, talk tracks, and quick-reference guides that help SCs adopt and adapt assets quickly.
* Cross-functional Collaboration: Act as the primary liaison between the Chennai team and global stakeholders, including the US-based SPEAR Team and Presales leadership, ensuring seamless communication, project execution, and knowledge transfer across time zones.
* Continuous Improvement: Develop and implement processes that improve the efficiency, quality, and throughput of demo ingestion, refinement, and maintenance workflows.
* Mentorship: Provide technical mentorship to Demo Engineers, fostering skill development, career growth, and a strong engineering culture within the team.
* Additional SPEAR Initiatives: Lead or contribute to other Presales enablement and readiness initiatives as the SPEAR Team's portfolio evolves.

**Who you are...**

* Strong, senior-level experience with Appian or a similar low-code application development platform, including design, development, and debugging of complex applications.
* Proven ability to manage and mentor technical teams, with demonstrated leadership and people management skills.
* Excellent technical and programming skills, with concrete examples of delivering polished, impactful work that others have used as a benchmark.
* Highly organized, with a track record of managing multiple projects and priorities in a high-volume, dynamic environment.
* Skilled in cross-functional collaboration, with solid verbal, written, presentation, and interpersonal communication abilities -- including the ability to communicate clearly across global teams and time zones.
* Familiarity with interactive demo platforms (Storylane, Reprise, Navattic, Walnut, or similar) is a strong plus.
* Familiarity with video recording and editing tools for producing walkthrough content is a plus.
* Self-motivated, driven individual with a proactive approach to problem-solving and a strong sense of urgency.
* B.S. or M.S. in Engineering, Computer Science, or related fields, or equivalent work experience.

**Tools and Resources**

* Training and Development: During onboarding, we focus on equipping new hires with the skills and knowledge for success through department-specific training. Continuous learning is a central focus at Appian, with dedicated mentorship and the First-Friend program being widely utilized resources for new hires.
* Growth Opportunities: Appian provides a diverse array of growth and development opportunities, including our leadership program tailored for new and aspiring managers, a comprehensive library of specialized department training through Appian University, skills based training, and tuition reimbursement for those aiming to advance their education. This commitment ensures that employees have access to a holistic range of development opportunities.
* Community: We’ll immerse you into our community rooted in respect starting on day one. Appian fosters inclusivity through our 8 employee-led affinity groups. These groups help employees build stronger internal and external networks by planning social, educational, and outreach activities to connect with Appianites and larger initiatives throughout the company.

**Benefits**

Appian offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your health, wellbeing, and financial future. Benefits may include health coverage, Employee Assistance Program (EAP) with free mental health support, life and disability insurance, an Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP), a retirement/pension plan, wellness dollars, tuition reimbursement, family-forming benefits and more. Benefits vary by country—please ask your Talent Acquisition contact for details specific to the location you are applying to.

**About Appian**

Appian provides AI automation for mission-critical work. We automate complex processes in large enterprises and governments. Our platform is known for its unique reliability and scale. We’ve been automating processes for more than 25 years and understand enterprise operations like no one else. For more information, visit appian.com. [Nasdaq: APPN]

Follow Appian: LinkedIn, Youtube, Instagram, Facebook

*Appian provides reasonable accommodations to applicants in accordance with all applicable laws. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please contact us by email at ReasonableAccommodations@appian.com. Please note that only inquiries concerning a request for reasonable accommodation will be responded to from this email address.*

99a7ab11.title: Sr. Enterprise Solution Architect - Supply Planning, Manufacturing
99a7ab11.description:
**Scope**

* Lead the design, implementation, and optimization of Blue Yonder Supply Chain Planning & Optimization solutions, driving business process transformation for global customers.
* Own solution architecture, integration strategy, effort estimation, and functional design while collaborating with cross-functional teams across Pre-Sales, Product Management, Consulting, and Customer IT.
* Serve as a trusted advisor to customers and executive stakeholders, providing industry best practices, solution recommendations, and leadership throughout the project lifecycle from discovery to post-go-live support.

**What You'll Do**

* Estimate workload for implementation activities within scope; assess integration complexity, architecture cost, and labor requirements.
* Lead business process analysis and design during the sales cycle and throughout development; create functional and technical specifications.
* Prepare and deliver presentations to user, management, and executive audiences.
* Assist Project Managers with planning and create detailed tasks for project plans, including sales‑cycle and post‑go‑live enhancements.
* Demonstrate and facilitate integration discussions of product functionality and architecture (e.g., end‑to‑end data and process flows).
* Identify and communicate incremental revenue and enhancement opportunities.
* Communicate business cases and product trend insights to management to influence future functionality and solution offerings.
* Develop or lead teams in producing functional specs for modifications, interfaces, reports, and screens that meet customer objectives and best‑practice design.
* Ensure knowledge transfer with Cloud Services, Consulting Services, and Support stakeholders.
* Advise customers on industry best practices and process methodologies; tailor Blue Yonder solutions to customer uniqueness and industry verticals.
* Serve as the functional liaison in key meetings between Project Managers, customer contacts, users, and executive sponsors.
* Work with consulting, Product Management, and Pre‑Sales to recommend which Blue Yonder applications solve specific business challenges.
* Help define functional and technical specs to ensure efficient implementation and integration between technical and functional requirements.

**What We Are Looking For**

* 13+ years of professional experience in enterprise software delivery; at least 6–8 years in solution architecture or senior consulting roles.
* Proven track record leading end‑to‑end implementations for large, complex customers (requirements, design, integration, configuration, UAT, cutover).
* Hands‑on experience estimating implementation effort, scoping integrations, and defining architecture cost and labor.
* Strong domain experience in retail supply chain, planning, allocation, merchandising, or closely related verticals.
* Demonstrated ability to run business process workshops and translate outcomes into functional and technical specifications.
* Experience facilitating integration and data/process flow discussions across application stacks.
* Experience advising executive and management stakeholders and delivering executive‑level presentations.
* Strong stakeholder management across Pre‑Sales, Product Management, Cloud Services, Consulting, Operations, and Customer IT.
* Experience mentoring teams and conducting knowledge transfer to internal stakeholders.

**Additional Skills**

* Prior experience with Blue Yonder product suite or equivalent retail planning/allocation platforms.
* Experience with multi‑tenant SaaS delivery, cloud migrations, and enterprise SaaS operations.
* Working knowledge of CI/CD, containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes).
* Familiarity with integration technologies and patterns (REST APIs, Kafka, Mulesoft, SFTP, AS2) and modern data platforms (Snowflake, Elasticsearch).
* Prior involvement in pre‑sales scoping and the ability to identify incremental revenue opportunities.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, Business, or a closely related field — or equivalent practical experience.
* Relevant certifications (examples):

+ Cloud: Azure/AWS Solution Architect or equivalent
+ Enterprise architecture: TOGAF (or equivalent)
+ Delivery/project: PMP, Prince2, or Agile/Scrum certifications (CSM, PMI‑ACP)
+ Blue Yonder product certifications (if available)

**Our Values**
If you want to know the heart of a company, take a look at their values. Ours unite us. They are what drive our success – and the success of our customers. Does your heart beat like ours? Find out here: Core Values
  
  
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status.

84757f43.title: Solutions Architect
84757f43.description:
At YNV Group, we are building an AI-enabled engineering organisation and are looking for a hands-on Solution / Technical Architect who can translate business needs into secure, practical, and deliverable technology solutions. You will work from business context and requirements through architecture, build, and operational handover, leading the design of internal tools, AI agents, workflow automations, and integrated applications.

This is not a role that stops at producing diagrams. You will shape the solution, make the key technical decisions, define the work for engineering teams, guide delivery and verify that the implemented product meets the intended business outcome. You will also design the Microsoft Azure resources required by each solution and ensure that AI-assisted engineering is applied safely through appropriate guardrails, quality controls and end-to-end engineering practices.

The ideal candidate combines business analysis, solution architecture and technical delivery leadership. They can move comfortably between stakeholder conversations, architecture design, Azure configuration, engineering backlog refinement and hands-on validation of working solutions.

**Helping people thrive and grow in the modern digital world.**

YNV Group has been building successful businesses that deliver long-term value since 2010. As a privately owned holding company, we excel at identifying and addressing unmet market needs. With a global workforce of over 6,000 employees across the Americas, EMEA, and Asia, our portfolio spans technology, real estate, and financial services. Led by industry experts committed to sustainable growth and innovation, we prioritize building lasting relationships with our clients and partners, ensuring their needs remain central to our approach. The brands in our portfolio include TeKnowledge, Everty, Sandglass, Monifai and Smart Factoring.

**Mindset & Ways of Working**

* Business-first: starts with the problem, users, process, and measurable outcome before selecting technology
* Hands-on by default: prototypes, validates assumptions, reviews implementation and uses the Azure portal when needed
* Delivery-minded: produces designs that engineers can build, operate, secure, and support
* Clear and decisive: makes trade-offs visible, records decisions and gives development teams actionable direction
* AI-enabled but accountable: uses AI coding tools to accelerate delivery while maintaining human review, traceability and engineering quality
* Secure and responsible: treats identity, data protection, privacy, safety, compliance and misuse prevention as core design concerns
* Pragmatic and adaptable: balances target architecture, delivery pace, cost and technical debt
* Collaborative: works effectively with product owners, business SMEs, developers, data/AI specialists, security, operations and vendors

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own end-to-end solution architecture from business discovery and requirements clarification through design, build guidance, testing, release, and operational handover
* Understand the business context, user journeys, operating processes, pain points, constraints, and expected benefits, and translate them into clear solution requirements
* Lead the design of tools, AI agents, workflow automations, integrations, and supporting cloud services
* Decompose the target solution into components, interfaces, data flows, user stories, technical enablers, and delivery work packages
* Provide clear technical direction to development teams, including architecture patterns, acceptance criteria, non-functional requirements and implementation guardrails
* Review code, infrastructure, integrations, prompts, agent workflows and technical outputs to ensure alignment with the approved design
* Facilitate design workshops and make proportionate decisions across build, buy, configure and integrate options
* Create and maintain architecture artefacts, including context diagrams, solution designs, data flows, integration contracts, threat models, design decisions and support models
* Identify risks, dependencies, technical debt and delivery constraints early, and drive appropriate resolution or escalation
* Partner with product and delivery leads to shape estimates, sequencing, milestones and release plans
* Ensure solutions are production-ready, observable, supportable, cost-conscious and aligned with enterprise architecture standards
* Contribute reusable reference architectures, templates, patterns and engineering standards to the architecture practice

**Solution Design & Delivery Leadership**

* Convert functional and non-functional requirements into an implementable architecture covering application, data, integration, security, cloud and operations
* Design modern solutions using APIs, events, microservices, serverless components, low-code/workflow platforms and appropriate packaged services
* Define system boundaries, component responsibilities, interfaces, error handling, resilience, performance, scalability and service-level requirements
* Lead technical discovery and proof-of-concept activity to validate feasibility, value, user experience and key architectural assumptions
* Guide engineers during sprint planning, backlog refinement and delivery, resolving design questions and preventing divergence from the intended architecture
* Define engineering quality gates covering code review, automated testing, security scanning, dependency management, deployment controls and architecture conformance
* Plan the transition into production, including environments, release approach, rollback, monitoring, documentation, support ownership and knowledge transfer
* Assess vendor or platform designs and ensure external delivery teams meet organisational architecture, security and engineering expectations

**AI, Agents & Automation Architecture**

* Design AI-enabled applications and agentic workflows that combine models, tools, enterprise data, APIs and human decision points
* Determine when to use deterministic automation, generative AI, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), agentic patterns or a hybrid approach
* Define AI guardrails including authorised tools and actions, prompt and policy controls, content safety, data boundaries, grounding, confidence thresholds, human approval and exception handling
* Design for traceability and evaluation through prompt/version management, model and tool logging, quality measures, test datasets, feedback loops and audit evidence
* Address AI-specific risks such as hallucination, prompt injection, data leakage, excessive agency, unsafe actions, model drift and inappropriate reliance on model output
* Establish secure patterns for model access, secrets, identities, vector stores, knowledge sources, memory, tool invocation and agent-to-system integration
* Apply responsible AI principles and ensure solutions have appropriate transparency, explainability, privacy, accessibility and human oversight
* Define operating controls for AI solutions, including monitoring, usage and cost controls, incident response, change governance and periodic re-evaluation

**AI-Enabled Engineering**

* Use AI-assisted engineering tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor or equivalent to accelerate analysis, design, coding, testing, documentation and troubleshooting
* Define safe usage patterns for AI coding tools, including approved repositories and models, data handling, intellectual property protection, secure prompt practices and prohibited uses
* Ensure AI-generated code is treated as untrusted until reviewed, tested, scanned and validated against engineering standards
* Integrate AI assistance into the software development lifecycle without weakening peer review, segregation of duties, security testing or release controls
* Promote specification-led development, reusable prompts and context, automated tests and evidence-based quality checks
* Coach engineering teams on effective and responsible use of AI tools and continuously improve the end-to-end engineering process

**Azure Architecture & Platform Responsibilities**

* Design the Azure resources required for each solution and validate designs directly in the Azure portal where appropriate
* Select suitable services across App Service, Container Apps, Functions, AKS, Azure OpenAI / Azure AI Foundry, Azure AI Search, Logic Apps, API Management, Service Bus, Event Grid, Storage, Azure SQL, PostgreSQL, Cosmos DB and Key Vault
* Design identity and access using Microsoft Entra ID, managed identities, role-based access control and least-privilege principles
* Define secure networking patterns using virtual networks, private endpoints, private DNS, firewalls and controlled ingress/egress
* Design environment and subscription structures, resource groups, naming, tagging, policy, secrets, configuration and deployment boundaries
* Ensure infrastructure is repeatable through Bicep and/or Terraform and delivered through Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions pipelines
* Build observability into the solution using Azure Monitor, Log Analytics and Application Insights, including actionable logs, metrics, traces and alerts
* Estimate and manage cloud consumption, model usage and automation run costs, and design appropriate budget, quota and scaling controls
* Align designs with the Azure Well-Architected Framework and organisational cloud governance standards

**Required Qualifications**

**Experience**

* Minimum 10 years in software engineering, systems integration or technology delivery, including at least 5 years in solution or technical architecture roles
* Proven experience leading complex solutions from early business discovery through production implementation and operational handover
* Demonstrated ability to translate ambiguous business problems into clear requirements, architecture decisions and executable engineering work
* Experience providing technical leadership to multidisciplinary development teams without relying solely on formal line authority
* Hands-on experience designing and deploying solutions on Microsoft Azure
* Experience delivering automation, AI-enabled applications, digital tools or integration-led solutions in an enterprise environment
* BSc/BA in Computer Science, Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience

**Technical Skills**

* Strong solution architecture skills across application, integration, data, security, cloud and operational domains
* Strong understanding of APIs, event-driven architecture, microservices, asynchronous processing and integration patterns
* Working knowledge of modern software engineering practices, including source control, branching, CI/CD, automated testing, code review, security scanning and release management
* Practical knowledge of Azure compute, integration, data, identity, networking, security and monitoring services
* Ability to define non-functional requirements for security, privacy, availability, resilience, performance, scalability, maintainability and supportability
* Experience with infrastructure as code using Bicep and/or Terraform
* Ability to read and review code in one or more languages such as Python, TypeScript, C# or Java, and to challenge implementation choices constructively
* Understanding of data modelling, data quality, information lifecycle, integration contracts and access controls

**AI & Automation Skills**

* Practical understanding of large language models, RAG, embeddings, vector search, prompt design, tool/function calling and agent orchestration
* Experience designing guardrails and human-in-the-loop controls for AI-enabled or higher-risk automated processes
* Experience with Azure OpenAI / Azure AI Foundry or comparable enterprise AI platforms
* Hands-on experience using AI coding assistants and establishing quality controls for AI-generated code and artefacts
* Understanding of AI evaluation, safety testing, model and prompt versioning, observability and production monitoring
* Experience with workflow automation or low-code platforms such as Azure Logic Apps, Power Automate or equivalent

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305) and/or Azure AI Engineer Associate (AI-102)
* Experience with Azure DevOps, GitHub Enterprise, GitHub Actions and GitHub Copilot governance
* Experience implementing multi-agent or tool-using agent solutions in a controlled enterprise environment
* Knowledge of Microsoft Power Platform, Dataverse, Copilot Studio or robotic process automation platforms
* Experience in regulated or security-conscious environments and familiarity with ISO 27001, SOC 2, GDPR, or comparable control frameworks
* Experience applying threat modelling, secure-by-design, Zero Trust and DevSecOps practices
* TOGAF or equivalent architecture certification
* Excellent facilitation, stakeholder management, written communication and technical leadership skills

**What Success Looks Like**

* Business problems are converted quickly into clear, proportionate and buildable solution designs
* Development teams understand what to build, why it is being built and the engineering standards they must meet
* AI and automation solutions progress from prototype to production without losing security, quality, control or supportability
* Azure resources are well designed, repeatable, observable and cost-conscious
* Architecture decisions reduce ambiguity, delivery risk and rework while improving time to value
* Reusable patterns and guardrails increase engineering speed across future solutions

a8c0731a.title: Architect, IT Solutions, Copilot & Agentic AI Platforms
a8c0731a.description:
Edwards Lifesciences is expanding its global technology capabilities with the launch of a new IT Innovation Hub in Pune, India. The Hub strengthens the technology foundation that supports our business worldwide, working in close partnership with teams across regions to deliver reliable, high-quality solutions at scale. Designed as a long-term investment, the Pune Hub will advance newer digital capabilities such as automation, data, AI, and cloud, and will include roles spanning end user services, application development, and enterprise platform teams. Together, these teams will help Edwards operate more efficiently and accelerate innovation in support of our mission of advancing patient care.
  
  
As Edwards accelerates its AI-driven transformation, we are seeking an Architect, IT Solutions to serve as the enterprise technical authority for our two most strategic agentic AI platforms — Microsoft Copilot (M365 Copilot, Copilot Studio) and Moveworks. This is a multi-faceted architecture role that spans platform leadership, integration design, and end-to-end solution architecture. You will define how these platforms are built, extended, integrated, and governed across the enterprise.
  
  
This role works alongside our existing Azure infrastructure architect and complements cloud expertise with deep, platform-specific technical authority. If you thrive at the intersection of enterprise architecture, applied AI, and business-facing delivery — and want to shape how a global lifescience company adopts agentic AI at scale — this is the role for you.
  
  
**How you’ll make an impact:**
**Platform Architecture Leadership — Copilot & Moveworks**

* Own the enterprise platform architecture for Microsoft Copilot (M365 Copilot, Copilot Studio) and Moveworks — serving as the definitive technical authority on capabilities, extensibility, and best practices.
* Define the ecosystem blueprint, platform standards, extensibility patterns, and long-term technical roadmap for both platforms.
* Evaluate and recommend new platform features, plugins, connectors, and agentic AI capabilities as they emerge from Microsoft and Moveworks.

**Integration Architecture**

* Design and govern the integration layer connecting Copilot and Moveworks to enterprise systems such as ServiceNow, Workday, JDE, Active Directory, HRIS, LMS, and CMDB.
* Define API strategies, event-driven patterns, connector frameworks, and messaging standards that enable secure, reliable, and scalable data flows across platforms.
* Partner with the Azure architecture team to ensure integration patterns align with cloud infrastructure, identity (Entra ID), and security standards.

**Lead Solution Architecture**

* Provide end-to-end solution design and technical authority for all AI agent, copilot, and automation solutions built on these platforms.
* Lead architecture reviews, approve design decisions, and ensure solutions are production-ready, secure, and aligned with enterprise standards.
* Translate complex business requirements into scalable, repeatable architectural patterns and executable design strategies.

**Governance, Mentorship & Innovation**

* Develop, institute, and maintain platform-specific design methodologies, development standards, security patterns, and operational best practices.
* Provide training, coaching, and technical mentorship to Forward-Deployed Engineers (FDEs), solution developers, and IT team members on Copilot and Moveworks architecture.
* Survey emerging developments in agentic AI — including multi-agent orchestration, RAG patterns, and tool-using agents — and recommend approaches that extend platform value.
* Develop and maintain architecture models, reference designs, integration maps, and documentation for current and proposed implementations.

**What you’ll need (Required):**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related technical field.
* Progressive IT experience, including significant depth in platform architecture, integration architecture, or solution architecture.
* Experience in an architect role working with cross-functional teams (within IT and/or business) on enterprise-level or complex system implementations.
* Deep expertise in at least one of the following: Microsoft Copilot ecosystem (M365 Copilot, Copilot Studio, Graph API, Graph Connectors, Copilot extensibility) or Moveworks platform (conversational AI, enterprise integrations, workflow automation).
* Strong integration architecture skills: REST/GraphQL APIs, event-driven architectures, enterprise connectors, middleware, and messaging patterns (e.g., Azure Service Bus, Logic Apps, Power Automate).
* Proven ability to design end-to-end solution architectures for enterprise AI, automation, or digital workplace platforms.
* Experience defining platform standards, governance frameworks, and reusable architectural patterns at enterprise scale.
* Strong understanding of identity, security, and compliance requirements in enterprise AI deployments (e.g., Entra ID, conditional access, DLP, data classification).
* Expert-level documentation and communication skills — ability to create architecture blueprints, integration maps, and present complex technical concepts to senior leadership and non-technical stakeholders.
* Strong interpersonal and leadership skills, including cross-functional negotiation, vendor management, and the ability to drive alignment across distributed teams.

**What else we look for (Preferred):**

* Hands-on experience with Microsoft Copilot Studio — building custom copilots, plugins, connectors, topics, and generative AI orchestration.
* Hands-on experience with Moveworks platform — configuring enterprise virtual agents, workflow automation, knowledge integration, and analytics.
* Experience with agentic AI patterns including multi-agent orchestration, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), tool-using agents, and planner-executor models.
* Experience integrating AI platforms with enterprise systems such as ServiceNow, Workday, SAP, Active Directory, LMS, and CMDB.
* Familiarity with Microsoft Power Platform (Power Automate, Power Apps) as an automation and extensibility layer.
* Experience deploying AI solutions in regulated industries (e.g., medical device, pharmaceuticals, financial services) with attention to governance and responsible AI practices.
* Advanced degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related discipline.
* Professional certifications such as Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Microsoft 365 Administrator Expert, TOGAF, or equivalent architecture frameworks.
* Track record of mentoring engineers and building technical communities of practice.

**Why is this role different?**
This is not a generic enterprise architect role. You will be the single technical authority for two of the most strategic AI platforms at Edwards Lifesciences — platforms that are actively transforming how our work, decide, and collaborate. You will shape the architecture, set the standards, and mentor the next generation of Forward-Deployed AI Engineers who build on these platforms every day.
  
  
You will operate at the intersection of platform strategy, hands-on architecture, and business impact — with direct visibility to senior IT leadership and the opportunity to influence how a global healthcare company scales agentic AI responsibly.

**Overview**

* Leading AI-driven Global Supply Chain Solutions Software Product Company and one of Glassdoor’s “Best Places to Work”
* We are seeking an astute and enthusiastic individual who has a strong technical foundation with the additional ability to be hands-on with the Professional Services team as part of the development/deployment cycle, and deep knowledge of industry best practices, with the ability to lead and implement independently working with both the platform, and the solution teams.

**Scope**

* The Professional services team within Blue Yonder operates globally and is growing rapidly.
* Blue Yonder Enterprise Technical Architect (Planning) will be responsible for services delivery of product implementation and related integration.
* This role will provide the associate to be hands-on with the Professional Services team as part of the development/deployment cycle, and deep knowledge of industry best practices, with the ability to implement them working with both the platform, and the solution teams.
* Core responsibilities include Strategy, Architecting, Design/Development (along with counterparts, customer, and Architects) and leading the technical team on projects and delivery initiatives catered around Supply Chain Planning solution and capabilities implementation.

**Desired Skills And Experience**

* Knowledge on
* OS – Windows, Unix
* DB – RDBMS Concepts, Oracle, MS SQL Server, SQL/ PL SQL
* Implementation experience using SCPO Platform or any other relevant enterprise planning product and platforms.
* Enterprise Architecture frameworks certifications or awareness is an added advantage.
* Next Gen Skills - Data Science, Data Analytics, Agile, Python, AI/ML, Cloud Fun, Azure, Google Cloud Platform, AWS, Databases/Data Platforms(emerging) – Snowflake, MongoDB, NoSQL, etc
* Reporting Skills – MS PowerBI
* Professional Attributes:
* Excellent communication, Inter-personal, Stakeholder management, Analytical and Problem-solving skills
* Excellent organization and project documentation skills
* Meticulous planning with attention to detail and multi-tasking skills
* Domain knowledge: Understanding of Supply Chain Planning and how it integrates with other systems. Any industry specific experience is a big plus.

**What You’ll Do**

* Lead and mentor team of technical associates on Solution implementation, enhancement, managed services, integration, custom projects either at the customer site or offshore.
* Estimate the workload of implementation activities that are within the scope of their skills; assess business needs that fall outside the standard solution, assess integration complexity, architecture.
* Able to work and own initiatives for the technical planning team (Professional Services) and demonstrate good skills in leading the strategy and contribute towards complex customer assessment and sales cycle.
* Collaborate with Global Team/Partners and Customers or internal stakeholders.
* Conduct technical analysis sessions with customers and/or the project team to understand the functional and technical needs of the customer and develop technical solutions to meet those needs. Configure and implement Blue Yonder software solutions according to the client's specific requirements.
* Documentation Support - Technical aspects of Blue Yonder Solutions, including technical specifications, configuration details, and user manuals.
* Implementation and steady state support, contribute on internal development projects and activities.
* Contribute to the growth of the technical professional services practice by developing and maintaining practice aids, databases, best-practice collateral, assets, and accelerators.
* Continuously upskill Blue Yonder’ s product suite and technology innovation to convey relationships and touchpoints to the customer. Incumbent should be up to date on the Product Roadmap and strategy and need to have a synergy with cross functional team(s).
* Ready to travel to customer sites based on business needs.
* Identify areas of improvement and scope of automation on routine tasks or activities
* Handle activities with a diverse scope where analysis of data requires evaluation of identifiable factors.
* Accelerate Time-to-Value for customer by iteratively delivering in short cycles.
* Recognize and highlight incremental revenue opportunities within existing customer projects.
* Ensures compliance with the internal and external company policies and procedures.

**What We Are Looking For**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree and 14+ years of experience in Software industry; ideally a candidate who has started as a Consultant and has worked his/her way to leading the technical team on 5+ complete implementation cycles.
* Demonstrable understanding of software engineering fundamentals and design principles
* Experience working with large customers in challenging environments and having design/implemented enterprise application solutions and integration architectures.
* Demonstrable experience leading, building, deploying and maintenance of enterprise solutions (cloud or on-premises)
* Excellent communication, Inter-personal, Analytical and Problem-solving skills
* Strong programming experience and problem-solving skills
* Supply Chain Planning Industry Experience
* Expertise on performance tuning techniques and ability to assist other team members with benchmarking and sizing exercises.
* Possess technical expertise on emerging technologies and integration with different database and scripting languages like Python, SQL/PLSQL, Linux, etc
* Good understanding of Web Technologies and API fundamentals
* Strong understanding on Cloud and Architectural design (Azure or equivalent, Microservices Architecture, Multi-Tenant)
* Demonstrable experience with Blue Yonder SCPO Platform.
* Hands-on development skills; should not have moved away from development activities.
* Passionate about working with new and emerging technologies, products and demonstrates the ability to learn quickly, and have good interpersonal & communication

**Our Values**
If you want to know the heart of a company, take a look at their values. Ours unite us. They are what drive our success – and the success of our customers. Does your heart beat like ours? Find out here: Core Values
  
  
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status.

491b14d8.title: Salesforce Technical Architect - (Life Sciences Industry exp mandate)
491b14d8.description:

Job Category
  
  
Customer Success
  
  
Job Details
  
  
**About Salesforce**
Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
  
  
Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
  
  
The Technical Architect will have to be execution-focused, support the full implementation lifecycle, from scoping to deployment in an evolving ecosystem consisting of clients and partners. The Technical Architect will be responsible for successfully solutioning the enterprise application E2E, designing and building the Salesforce Industry-specific Life Sciences, Health industry solutions.
  
  
As a Technical Architect, you will become a deep product expert with Industry Salesforce Life Sciences Cloud (including Health Cloud) applications, and work closely with our sales and delivery teams to ensure customer success.
  
  
The Technical Architect will lead the technical design and implementation of Salesforce solutions, ensuring compliance with industry regulations (HIPAA, GxP, etc.) and alignment with business goals. The ideal candidate combines deep Salesforce expertise with strong domain understanding of pharmaceuticals, biotech, medtech, or healthcare providers.
  
  
The Technical Architect maintains an ongoing comprehensive understanding of the cloud-computing ecosystem.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Serve as the technical lead for Salesforce Life Sciences Cloud implementations, including Health Cloud and other related Salesforce products.
* Architect and design scalable, secure, and high-performance Salesforce solutions that align with industry best practices and compliance standards (e.g., HIPAA, PHI, GxP).
* Define and oversee data models, security architecture, API integrations (FHIR/HL7), and performance optimization strategies.
* Lead a team of developers driving optimized solutions across multi-cloud implementations, ensuring seamless integration between Health Cloud, Service Cloud, and Experience Cloud and Omnistudio framework.
* Lead functional and technical workshops. Demonstrate leadership skills in designing, delivering, testing, and deploying.
* Expertise in User Journey preparations, User Story reviews, Data Modeling, Apex Design Patterns, LWC, and other modern UI techniques.
* Serve as a trusted advisor to the client driving conversations with their Enterprise Architects and business partners that shape the architectural vision, and establish a program architectural roadmap.
* Lead customer expectations; negotiate solutions to sophisticated problems with both the customer and third-party partners
* Guide our customers, partners, and implementation teams on how best to implement digital transformation with the Salesforce platform using Salesforce Industries.
* Establish trust with the customer’s leadership, promoting and/or implementing standard processes with SFI and Salesforce
* Build out sophisticated business processes using native Salesforce Industries technology and the toolkit of the platform and integration tools.
* Research, recommend and implement AppExchange applications and Salesforce upgrades to help meet business needs.
* Successfully create custom enterprise applications using Salesforce.com and integrate Salesforce.com with other enterprise systems.
* Work closely with Delivery Managers, Solution Architects, and directly with clients to architect technology solutions to meet client needs.
* Highlight and lead risk areas in the solution in a proactive manner, and commit to seeing an issue through to completion.

**Qualifications**

* 10+ years of experience in developing technology solutions.
* 3+ years of experience in handling client-facing projects in positions of increasing responsibility in the context of systems development and related business consulting.
* Proven experience architecting enterprise-level Salesforce solutions in the life sciences or Veeva product or healthcare industry.
* Strong understanding of compliance and regulatory requirements including HIPAA, GxP, PHI, HL7, and FHIR.
* Expertise in one or multiple domains of Healthcare Providers, Healthcare Payers,Life Science and Pharmaceuticals, Medical Devices, Public health & Government Healthcare programs, Insurance.
* Experience in healthcare domain (Preferred)
* Integration Architecture (Must have)
* Platform Security (Must have)
* Identity and Access Management / Integration Security
* Sharing and Visibility (Must have)
* Data Architecture and Management (Must have)
* Architectural Design Patterns (Must Have)
* Apex Design Patterns (Must Have)
* Salesforce/Apex, Triggers, Lightning Flows, Lightning, LWC, and experience with modern web and mobile technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Web Components, others) or Veeva CRm experience
* Salesforce Certification Preferred (Admin, Developer, Sales, and Service Clouds, Application Architect, System Architect)
* OmniStudio Developer/Consultant
* Health Cloud Certification (Good to have).

Unleash Your Potential
  
  
When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and
*be your best*
, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can
*do your best*
. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.
  
  
Accommodations
  
  
If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form.
  
  
Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.
  
  
Posting Statement
  
  
Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.

6ee53337.title: Solutions Architect - Digital Buildings
6ee53337.description:
**FPC Digital.**

At FPC Digital, we are driven by a bold vision: to become a global leader in digitally transforming real estate into secure and sustainable environments that set the digital building standard and benefit both people and our planet.

Our mission is clear: to empower the global delivery of intelligent, secure and vendor-agnostic digital buildings that prioritize human-centric design, operational effectiveness and sustainability.

As an aspiring leader in Digital Building Design, Delivery and Operations, FPC Digital specializes in creating spaces that are not only smart and connected but also environmentally responsible. With a dedicated team operating across the Americas, EMEA, APAC and India, we are shaping a more innovative and sustainable built environment.

**Job Description**

**Overview.**

We are looking for a Digital Buildings Architect to support the design and delivery of digital building solutions across international projects.

This role sits within the Digital Engineering team and focuses on smart building design, systems integration and digital infrastructure. You will work alongside senior architects and engineers to help shape how Independent Data Layers, building systems, networks and cloud platforms are brought together to deliver secure, sustainable and human centric buildings.

The ideal candidate will architect integrated solutions across BMS, IoT, analytics, and enterprise platforms while managing engineering teams and ensuring successful project execution from concept through handover.

**Key Responsibilities.**

Support Solution Architecture and Integration Design.

* Assist senior colleagues in developing digital building architectures covering building systems, networks, cloud platforms and Independent Data Layers.
* Help document integration between systems such as BMS, HVAC, lighting, metering, access control, vertical transport, IoT devices and workplace applications.
* Prepare and maintain technical artefacts including diagrams, data flow maps, interface schedules, device lists and point schedules.
* Contribute to the definition of IP addressing, VLAN structures, device naming and tagging that support scalability, security and analytics.

Smart Building Requirements, Energy and User Outcomes.

* Work with senior architects, project managers and client stakeholders to capture and refine smart building requirements, user journeys and use cases.
* Support the design of solutions that improve comfort, wellbeing, maintainability, space utilisation and energy performance, not just connectivity.
* Assist in selecting and specifying sensors, platforms and analytics tools that support optimisation, FDD and reporting against ESG and performance KPIs.

Cybersecurity and OT Network Support.

* Help apply secure by design principles to digital building architectures, aligned with client policies and recognised standards.
* Support coordination with client IT and security teams on topics such as segmentation, remote access and monitoring.
* Contribute to OT cyber risk assessments and remediation activities on projects, under guidance from senior team members.

Delivery Coordination, QA and Technical Support

* Support the Digital Solutions and MSI teams through the full project lifecycle, from concept and design through construction, commissioning and handover.
* Assist in reviewing contractor and vendor submissions for alignment with the agreed architecture, standards and scope.
* Help develop integration test plans, commissioning scripts and data validation checklists, and support their execution on projects.
* Provide day to day technical support to project managers and site teams, escalating complex issues to senior architects as needed.

Client, Stakeholder and Partner Engagement

* Participate in client workshops, design meetings and technical reviews, contributing to discussions and capturing actions and requirements.
* Support the preparation of technical content for proposals, scopes of work, deliverables and client presentations.
* Help coordinate with technology partners and vendors to align solutions, clarify interfaces and resolve design questions.

Standards, Knowledge Management and Continuous Improvement

* Use and help refine FPC Digital’s standards, templates and playbooks for MSI, IDL, smart building design and OT cyber.
* Contribute to internal knowledge libraries, lessons learned and case studies from live projects.
* Take part in training sessions, brown bag talks and communities of practice, both as a learner and, over time, as a contributor.

Team Leadership & People Management

* Lead and mentor solution engineers, deployment coordinators, and technical specialists.
* Support resource planning and team allocation across programs.
* Support hiring, training, performance management, and career development.
* Build technical capability within the remote center of excellence.

**Qualifications**

**Education.**

* Preferred: Degree in Engineering, Building Services, Computer Science, IT, or a related technical discipline.
* Equivalent industry experience will be considered.
* Additional training or certifications in any of the following would be beneficial but not essential:

  + Controls, BMS or systems integration
  + Networking fundamentals
  + Cloud platforms, data engineering or analytics

**Experience.**

* Industry Expertise:

  + Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Electrical, Mechanical, Controls, or related field).
  + 12–15 years of experience in BMS, smart buildings, or digital infrastructure
  + Exposure to commercial, workplace, life sciences, mixed use or similar building projects is preferred.
  + Strong knowledge of: Niagara Framework, BACnet / BACnet SC, Modbus,MQTT,,OPC, Cloud IoT platforms
  + Experience managing teams
  + Good to have knowledge of OT cybersecurity frameworks (NIST, IEC 62443).
* Technical Skills:
  + Good understanding of at least some key building systems and protocols, for example BMS, HVAC, lighting, metering, access control, BACnet, Modbus, MQTT or REST APIs.
  + Experience with integration design, data flows or connecting systems through gateways, APIs or middleware is desirable.
  + Awareness of IP networking concepts (addressing, VLANs, routing, firewalls) and an interest in developing deeper OT networking skills.
  + Interest or experience in analytics, FDD, dashboards, digital twins or data visualisation is beneficial.
  + Any exposure to tagging standards or ontologies (for example Haystack, Brick, custom schemas) would be a plus.
* Soft Skills:
* Clear written and verbal communication, able to present technical information in a structured and accessible way.
* Strong analytical and problem solving skills with attention to detail in documentation and design outputs.

**Additional Information**

**Our Culture and Values.**

At FPC Digital, our values guide everything we do:

Integrity: We act with honesty, accountability and a commitment to doing what’s right.

Diversity and Inclusion: We celebrate diverse perspectives and foster an inclusive environment where everyone thrives.

Collaboration: By working together, we unlock creativity and deliver exceptional results for our clients.

Effectiveness: We strive to deliver impactful solutions that maximize value and drive measurable outcomes.

**Why Join Us?**

FPC Digital is more than a company, it’s a mission-driven organization focused on delivering human-centric, effective and sustainable solutions. We value professional development, continuous learning and work-life balance.

b523e416.description:

- • Automate infrastructure provisioning, configuration management and deployment processes.
- • Drive DevOps culture and automation across development and operations teams.
- • Design, implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines to enable reliable and frequent releases.

- • Implement and maintain monitoring, observability, alerting and logging solutions across all environments.

- • Strong experience with containerisation technologies including Docker and Kubernetes.
- • Strong experience implementing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins or similar platforms.
- • Strong experience with source control management and Git-based development workflows.
- • Strong experience with observability platforms including CloudWatch, Datadog, Grafana, Prometheus, Splunk and ELK.
- • Strong experience with monitoring, alerting, log aggregation, distributed tracing and application performance monitoring.
- • Strong experience implementing operational excellence practices including SLI, SLO and SLA management.
- • Strong experience troubleshooting production incidents, performing root cause analysis and driving preventative measures.

- • Good experience developing automation solutions using Python, Bash or similar technologies.
- • Strong knowledge of cloud security best practices including IAM, RBAC, least-privilege access, encryption, secrets management and vulnerability remediation.
- • Strong experience with AWS Security Hub, compliance frameworks and security remediation activities.
- • Experience implementing DevSecOps practices and integrating automated security controls into CI/CD pipelines.
- • Experience evaluating and integrating cloud security tooling for vulnerability assessments, penetration testing and threat modelling.
- • Experience supporting microservices and distributed architectures in production environments.
- • Experience implementing high-availability, disaster recovery and business continuity solutions.
- • Strong experience with cloud cost optimisation, FinOps practices and cloud consumption governance.
- • Experience using Cloudability or similar cloud financial management platforms to drive cloud visibility, optimisation and reporting.
- • Experience defining and implementing cloud tagging strategies, governance standards and operational compliance controls.
- • Experience designing and implementing automated remediation workflows.
- • Experience creating operational dashboards, alerting frameworks, reliability metrics and engineering KPIs.
- • Experience driving cloud migration initiatives, account onboarding and AWS platform transformations.
- • Experience building reusable platform components, self-service capabilities and developer enablement tooling.
- • Experience creating technical solution designs, architecture diagrams, operational runbooks and engineering documentation.
- • Strong understanding of cloud platform services as both a producer and consumer.
- • Strong understanding of release management, deployment strategies and environment management.
- • Strong experience with Agile delivery methodologies and engineering tooling including Jira, Confluence and GitHub.
- • DevOps as a mindset.
- • Customer-centric, passionate about delivering reliable digital platforms and services.
- • Demonstrating a true engineering craftsmanship mindset.

a2142123.title: Senior Engagement Manager, AWS Strategic Industries
a2142123.description:
**Description**
Are you energized by leading complex technical programs that transform how organizations operate in the cloud? As a Senior Engagement Manager within Amazon Web Services (AWS) Professional Services, you will guide customers through their most ambitious cloud initiatives, turning strategic vision into measurable business outcomes. You will own the full lifecycle of large-scale engagements, orchestrating teams of technical consultants, customer stakeholders, and partners to deliver results that matter.
  
  
This role puts you at the intersection of technology and business strategy. You will navigate ambiguity, align competing priorities, and build trusted relationships with executives and technical leaders alike. If you are a collaborative, adaptable program leader who thrives on solving hard problems and helping customers realize the full value of cloud adoption, we want to hear from you.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Lead the end-to-end delivery of large, multi-workstream cloud engagements by creating and maintaining comprehensive project plans, defining quality standards, and aligning AWS, customer, and partner resources to achieve agreed-upon business outcomes.
* Build and manage strategic customer relationships across technical and executive stakeholders, proactively identifying risks, clearing blockers, and driving timely decisions to keep programs on track — including redirecting distressed engagements toward successful delivery.
* Facilitate release planning, workshops, and discovery sessions using multiple delivery and cloud frameworks (such as Agile, Waterfall, Well-Architected Framework, and Cloud Adoption Framework) to translate customer strategy into executable roadmaps.
* Lead complex business and technical discussions, harmonize conflicting perspectives, and guide customers to define and expand on their cloud adoption strategy while identifying opportunities to maximize engagement value through scope and financial negotiations.
* Establish reusable delivery mechanisms, best practices, and documentation standards that improve quality and efficiency across engagements, and mentor fellow engagement managers to raise the overall team capability.

A day in the life
  
  
You start your morning reviewing program dashboards and preparing for a steering committee meeting with a customer's leadership team, where you present delivery progress and align on upcoming milestones. Mid-morning, you facilitate a cross-team planning session, helping architects and developers prioritize the next sprint. After lunch, you join a technical review to validate that a proposed solution meets the customer's business objectives, then spend time coaching a newer engagement manager on stakeholder communication. Your afternoon wraps with a pipeline discussion, where you help shape an upcoming pre-sales opportunity.
  
  
**About The Team**
AWS Professional Services partners with customers worldwide to accelerate their cloud journeys, from migration and modernization to building entirely new capabilities. Our engagement managers are the connective thread between technical delivery and business strategy, ensuring every project creates lasting value.
  
  
We are a collaborative, customer-focused team that values continuous learning and operational excellence. Whether you are helping a customer adopt generative artificial intelligence or guiding a complex enterprise transformation, you will work alongside some of the brightest minds in cloud technology and have the opportunity to shape how organizations innovate at scale.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 2+ years of leading multiple Agile teams (like Scrum Masters, Product Owners) concurrently or at scale experience
* 7+ years of leading and delivering enterprise-level IT engagements experience
* Bachelor's degree in STEM field
* Knowledge of the value proposition of the public cloud and cloud engagement delivery (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS)
* Experience in leading multiple Agile teams (like Scrum Masters, Product Owners) concurrently or at scale
* Experience in leading and delivering enterprise-level IT engagements

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 5+ years of delivering customer engagements in a professional services role experience
* active project management certification (e.g., APM, CSM, PMI-ACP, PRINCE2)
* AWS certification
* Experience in delivering customer engagements in a professional services role
* Experience with Agile and project management toolsets like Jira, Rally, VersionOne or Taiga
* Experience working with and presenting to C-level executives, IT, and lines of businesses across organizations or equivalent

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.
  
  
  
**Company**
- AWS India - Karnataka

e75cb6b3.title: Principal Architect — Cloud, Agentic AI & Data Engineering
e75cb6b3.description:
**Principal Architect — Cloud, Agentic AI & Data Engineering**

**Field**

**Detail**

**Job Title**

Principal Architect — Cloud, Agentic AI & Data Engineering

**Function / Practice**

Digital, Data & AI — Technology & Solutions

**Reports To**

Head of Architecture / Practice Head — Digital & AI

**Experience**

15+ years in software, data and cloud engineering, including 5+ years in an architect capacity

**Location**

Hyderabad / Bengaluru / Pune (Hybrid), with travel to client sites as required

**Employment Type**

Full-time, Permanent

**Grade / Band**

Principal Architect

**ROLE SUMMARY**

Cyient is looking for a Principal Architect who can operate at the intersection of cloud platform engineering, agentic AI and modern data engineering — and who is equally comfortable in front of a customer as in a design review.

This is a hands-on, customer-facing architecture role. You will own end-to-end solution architecture for strategic engagements, shape winning proposals and RFP responses, build demos and proofs of concept alongside the delivery team, and set the technical direction that engineering teams execute against. You will also mentor architects and senior engineers, and partner with fellow architects across practices to drive reusable assets, accelerators and an active innovation agenda.

Success in this role looks like architecture decisions that survive production, customers who ask for you by name, proposals that convert, and a bench of engineers who are measurably stronger because you invested in them.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Solution & Cloud Architecture**

* **Own end-to-end architecture**
  for large, multi-workstream programs spanning cloud infrastructure, data platforms and AI services.
* **Design cloud-native solutions**
  on Microsoft Azure (or AWS ) covering compute, networking, identity, integration, observability, cost management and security.
* **Define the non-functional architecture**
  — scalability, resilience, latency, availability, disaster recovery and multi-tenancy — and hold designs accountable to it.
* **Establish architecture governance**
  : reference architectures, design standards, review checkpoints, a technology radar and architecture decision records (ADRs).
* **Drive cloud modernisation**
  and migration strategy — landing zones, containerisation, microservices, event-driven patterns and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform / Bicep / ARM).

**Agentic AI & Applied GenAI**

* **Architect agentic AI systems**
  — multi-agent orchestration, tool and function calling, planning and reflection loops, memory, and human-in-the-loop control points.
* **Select and integrate the AI stack**
  : LLM providers (Azure OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, open-weight models), orchestration frameworks (LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, MCP-based tooling) and vector / retrieval layers.
* **Design production-grade RAG**
  and knowledge-grounding pipelines — chunking strategy, embeddings, hybrid search, re-ranking, grounding and citation.
* **Define AI evaluation and guardrails**
  : accuracy and hallucination benchmarks, red-teaming, prompt-injection defence, PII handling, cost and token governance, and model observability.
* **Operationalise LLMOps**
  — prompt versioning, CI/CD for AI assets, regression evaluations, drift monitoring and safe rollout patterns.
* **Champion Responsible AI**
  principles — transparency, traceability, bias assessment and auditability — aligned to client and regulatory expectations.

**Data Engineering & Platform**

* **Architect modern data platforms**
  — lakehouse and medallion architectures on Azure Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, Synapse, Snowflake or equivalent.
* **Design batch and streaming pipelines**
  using Spark, Kafka / Event Hubs, Azure Data Factory and dbt, with clear SLAs on freshness and data quality.
* **Establish data governance**
  : cataloguing, lineage, master data management, quality frameworks and access control (Unity Catalog, Microsoft Purview).
* **Model data for both analytics and AI consumption**
  , ensuring the same governed assets serve BI, ML and agentic workloads.
* **Optimise for cost and performance**
  — partitioning, storage tiering, compute right-sizing and workload isolation.

**Customer Engagement & Presales**

* **Act as the senior technical face to the customer**
  — run discovery workshops, architecture reviews and executive briefings for both engineering and CxO audiences.
* **Translate business problems into solution options**
  , with honest trade-offs on cost, risk, time-to-value and long-term maintainability.
* **Lead technical responses to RFPs, RFIs and proactive proposals**
  — solution narrative, architecture diagrams, delivery approach, effort estimation, staffing model and risk register.
* **Build compelling demos and proofs of concept**
  with the team — tightly scoped, built fast, and mapped to a measurable customer outcome.
* **Support deal shaping**
  alongside sales and account teams: value articulation, differentiation, competitive positioning and defence of the proposed architecture.
* **Own the technical narrative post-win**
  , ensuring that what was sold is what gets designed and delivered.

**Leadership, Mentoring & Innovation**

* **Guide and mentor**
  architects, tech leads and senior engineers through design reviews, pairing, structured feedback and career conversations.
* **Collaborate with peer architects**
  across practices and geographies to align on standards, resolve cross-domain design conflicts and avoid duplicated effort.
* **Drive the innovation agenda**
  : identify emerging technologies, run experiments and spikes, and convert successful ones into reusable accelerators, frameworks and IP.
* **Build the capability bench**
  — define skill paths, run internal enablement sessions and raise the architectural maturity of the practice.
* **Represent Cyient externally**
  through whitepapers, conference talks, partner forums and customer advisory sessions.

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related discipline.
* 15+ years of overall IT experience, including 5+ years in a formal architect role on large-scale distributed systems.
* Deep, hands-on expertise with Azure (preferred) or equivalent depth in AWS or GCP — demonstrable production ownership, not design-deck experience alone.
* Proven delivery of at least one production agentic AI or applied GenAI solution, from architecture through evaluation, guardrails and go-live.
* Strong data engineering background: lakehouse architectures, distributed processing (Spark), streaming and enterprise-scale data governance.
* Demonstrated presales and customer-facing track record — owned technical solutioning on proposals and RFPs that converted.
* Hands-on coding credibility in Python and one of Java / C# / Scala; able to build a POC personally when it matters.
* Experience with DevOps and platform engineering practices: CI/CD, IaC, containerisation, Kubernetes and observability tooling.
* Track record of mentoring senior technical talent and leading architecture communities of practice.
* Excellent written and verbal communication — able to hold a room of engineers and a room of executives with equal effect.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Azure certifications: Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305), Data Engineer Associate (DP-203) or AI Engineer Associate (AI-103); equivalent AWS certifications equally valued.
* Databricks, Snowflake or Microsoft Fabric certification.
* Experience with the Model Context Protocol (MCP), agent interoperability standards and enterprise agent platforms.
* Domain exposure in one or more Cyient focus verticals: Aerospace & Defence, Rail & Transportation, Energy & Utilities, MedTech / Healthcare, Semiconductor or Communications.
* Experience building reusable accelerators, platforms or IP adopted across multiple accounts.
* Prior work in a services, consulting or systems-integrator environment with multi-client, multi-geography delivery.
* Published thought leadership, patents or active open-source contribution.

**TECHNICAL SKILLS SNAPSHOT**

**Area**

**Technologies & Practices**

**Cloud Platforms**

Azure (AKS, Functions, App Service, API Management, Event Hubs, Key Vault, Entra ID, Monitor); AWS or GCP equivalents

**Agentic AI / GenAI**

Azure OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, open-weight LLMs; LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, MCP; RAG, vector stores, evaluations, guardrails, LLMOps

**Data Engineering**

Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, Synapse, Snowflake; Spark, Kafka / Event Hubs, ADF, dbt, Delta Lake; Purview, Unity Catalog

**Architecture Patterns**

Microservices, event-driven, domain-driven design, API-first, lakehouse / medallion, multi-tenancy, zero-trust security

**Engineering & DevOps**

Python, SQL, Java / C# / Scala; Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform / Bicep, Azure DevOps / GitHub Actions, OpenTelemetry

**Consulting Skills**

Discovery workshops, solution storytelling, estimation, RFP response, POC and demo build, executive communication
